```sql
-- supabase/migrations/20261111090000_industry_research.sql
-- I-0 (industry research spec 6th draft §4.3, §4.8): tables, constraints, indexes, RLS policies,
-- table privileges, the industry-manifests bucket, the four dataset licence rows and the weekly
-- freshness cadence. Functions, triggers and function privileges are in
-- 20261111091000_industry_research_functions.sql — except the three read-only licence helpers
-- (industry_dataset_is_public, industry_metric_run_visible, industry_valuation_run_visible), which
-- live here because the policies below call them.
-- Ownership model (V1): the migration role owns every table and every security definer function;
-- functions run as the table owner (no table uses FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), so they read and write
-- across modules. service_role has NO insert/update/delete/truncate on the protected tables: every
-- write goes through a function (V2). Semi-protected: industry_classifications (service_role
-- insert/update, no delete/truncate), industry_dataset_licenses (select only; written by
-- set_industry_dataset_license), industry_sync_scope (service_role read/write, not a fact table).
-- Public read (anon, authenticated; owner decision F: same rights) is gated per dataset by
-- industry_dataset_licenses through the helper functions; service_role has using(true) policies.
-- issuer_industry_memberships is altered in place: the landed all-status exclusion
-- issuer_industry_memberships_no_overlap is dropped explicitly (superseded history must coexist with
-- its replacement), the primary key moves to membership_id, the old five-column key becomes a
-- partial unique index over status='ok', and a per-level exclusion over status='ok' replaces it.
-- The upgrade requires an empty issuer_industry_memberships (no loader wrote it before this
-- migration); a non-empty table stops the migration with industry_upgrade_requires_empty_memberships.
-- Hosted postgres is not a superuser: no create role, no alter … owner. Local harness: only
-- storage.buckets exists (no storage.objects reference). Replayable: guarded creates, drop-then-add
-- constraints, drop-then-create policies, insert … on conflict.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- lock order
-- Every existing industry table is locked up front, in the order the functions of 20261111091000 touch
-- them (licences → nodes → source records → memberships → observations → runs → rows → manifests →
-- dependencies). A replay (tests replay migrations while other sessions run the functions) then only
-- ever waits while holding earlier tables, so it queues behind an in-flight function instead of
-- deadlocking with it. On the first apply only the two landed tables exist.
do $$ declare t text; begin
  foreach t in array array['industry_dataset_licenses','industry_classifications','industry_source_memberships','issuer_industry_memberships',
                           'industry_sync_scope','industry_fetch_events','industry_observation_receipts','security_marks','industry_official_valuations',
                           'industry_metric_runs','industry_metrics','industry_valuation_runs','industry_valuations','industry_valuation_pairs',
                           'industry_manifests','industry_run_dependencies'] loop
    if to_regclass('public.' || t) is not null then
      execute format('lock table public.%I in access exclusive mode', t);
    end if;
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- upgrade guard
do $$ begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_attribute where attrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and attname = 'membership_id' and not attisdropped)
     and exists (select 1 from public.issuer_industry_memberships) then
    raise exception 'industry_upgrade_requires_empty_memberships' using errcode = '55000';
  end if;
end $$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- dq_freshness: weekly cadence (identical to plan 3)
alter table public.dq_freshness
  drop constraint if exists dq_freshness_expected_cadence_check,
  add constraint dq_freshness_expected_cadence_check check (expected_cadence in ('daily','weekly','monthly','quarterly','event'));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_classifications (altered)
alter table public.industry_classifications
  drop constraint if exists industry_classifications_scheme_check,
  add constraint industry_classifications_scheme_check check (scheme in ('sw2021','sw2014','gics','csrc','custom','sic'));
alter table public.industry_classifications add column if not exists attributes jsonb not null default '{}';
alter table public.industry_classifications
  drop constraint if exists industry_classifications_attributes_object,
  add constraint industry_classifications_attributes_object check (jsonb_typeof(attributes) = 'object');
create unique index if not exists industry_classifications_code_level_uidx on public.industry_classifications(scheme, version, code, level);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_dataset_licenses
create table if not exists public.industry_dataset_licenses (
  dataset_key text primary key check (length(dataset_key) between 1 and 64),
  status      text not null check (status in ('internal','public')),
  decided_by  text not null check (length(decided_by) between 1 and 128),
  decided_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  note        text
);
-- §4.1 defaults (owner decision A pending). on conflict do nothing: a replay never overrides an admin decision.
insert into public.industry_dataset_licenses (dataset_key, status, decided_by, note) values
  ('scheme:sw2021:2021', 'internal', 'migration:20261111090000', 'owner decision A pending'),
  ('scheme:sic:sec-current', 'public', 'migration:20261111090000', 'SEC submissions are public primary data'),
  ('marks:tushare-daily_basic', 'internal', 'migration:20261111090000', 'owner decision A pending'),
  ('official:tushare-sw_daily', 'internal', 'migration:20261111090000', 'owner decision A pending')
on conflict (dataset_key) do nothing;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_source_memberships (§4.4)
create table if not exists public.industry_source_memberships (
  id               uuid primary key,
  scheme           text not null check (scheme = 'sw2021'),
  version          text not null check (version = '2021'),
  source           text not null check (length(source) between 1 and 64),
  ts_code          text not null check (length(ts_code) between 1 and 16),
  name             text,
  l1_code          text not null check (length(l1_code) between 1 and 32),
  l2_code          text not null check (length(l2_code) between 1 and 32),
  l3_code          text not null check (length(l3_code) between 1 and 32),
  in_date          date not null,
  out_date         date,
  observed_at      timestamptz not null,
  batch_id         uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  raw_hash         text not null check (length(raw_hash) between 1 and 128),
  locator          jsonb not null,
  status           text not null check (status in ('current','superseded')),
  superseded_by    uuid,
  issuer_id        uuid references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  resolution       jsonb not null default '{}',
  resolution_error jsonb,
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint industry_source_memberships_locator_object check (jsonb_typeof(locator) = 'object'),
  constraint industry_source_memberships_resolution_object check (jsonb_typeof(resolution) = 'object'),
  constraint industry_source_memberships_error_object check (resolution_error is null or jsonb_typeof(resolution_error) = 'object'),
  constraint industry_source_memberships_superseded_pair check ((status = 'superseded') = (superseded_by is not null))
);
do $$ begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.industry_source_memberships'::regclass and conname = 'industry_source_memberships_superseded_by_fkey') then
    alter table public.industry_source_memberships add constraint industry_source_memberships_superseded_by_fkey
      foreign key (superseded_by) references public.industry_source_memberships(id) deferrable initially deferred;
  end if;
end $$;
create unique index if not exists industry_source_memberships_current_key on public.industry_source_memberships(scheme, version, source, ts_code, l3_code, in_date) where status = 'current';
create index if not exists industry_source_memberships_l1_idx on public.industry_source_memberships(scheme, version, l1_code, status);
create index if not exists industry_source_memberships_issuer_idx on public.industry_source_memberships(issuer_id);
create index if not exists industry_source_memberships_unresolved_idx on public.industry_source_memberships(l1_code, in_date) where status = 'current' and issuer_id is null;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- issuer_industry_memberships (altered, §4.3)
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships drop constraint if exists issuer_industry_memberships_no_overlap;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists membership_id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid();
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists level int not null check (level between 1 and 4);
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists available_date date not null;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists valid_to_available_date date;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists source_membership_id uuid references public.industry_source_memberships(id) on delete restrict;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists batch_id uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists status text not null default 'ok' check (status in ('ok','quarantined','superseded'));
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add column if not exists superseded_by uuid;
alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships
  drop constraint if exists issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_pair,
  add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_pair check ((valid_to is null) = (valid_to_available_date is null)),
  drop constraint if exists issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_after,
  add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_after check (valid_to_available_date is null or valid_to_available_date >= valid_from),
  drop constraint if exists issuer_industry_memberships_superseded_pair,
  add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_superseded_pair check ((status = 'superseded') = (superseded_by is not null));
-- Primary key: (issuer_id, scheme, version, code, valid_from) → (membership_id). The old key survives as a
-- partial unique index over ok rows, so a superseded version and its replacement share the key.
do $$ begin
  if exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and contype = 'p' and cardinality(conkey) <> 1) then
    alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships drop constraint issuer_industry_memberships_pkey;
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and contype = 'p') then
    alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_pkey primary key (membership_id);
  end if;
  -- superseded_by → the replacement row; deferred so status+successor are written in one update before the replacement exists (§4.5)
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and conname = 'issuer_industry_memberships_superseded_by_fkey') then
    alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_superseded_by_fkey
      foreign key (superseded_by) references public.issuer_industry_memberships(membership_id) deferrable initially deferred;
  end if;
  -- level must be the node's level (the landed (scheme, version, code) FK is kept)
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and conname = 'issuer_industry_memberships_classification_level_fkey') then
    alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_classification_level_fkey
      foreign key (scheme, version, code, level) references public.industry_classifications(scheme, version, code, level);
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.issuer_industry_memberships'::regclass and conname = 'issuer_industry_memberships_one_per_level') then
    alter table public.issuer_industry_memberships add constraint issuer_industry_memberships_one_per_level
      exclude using gist (issuer_id with =, scheme with =, version with =, level with =, daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)') with &&) where (status = 'ok');
  end if;
end $$;
create unique index if not exists issuer_industry_memberships_ok_key on public.issuer_industry_memberships(issuer_id, scheme, version, code, valid_from) where status = 'ok';
create index if not exists issuer_industry_memberships_code_window_idx on public.issuer_industry_memberships using gist (scheme, version, code, daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)')) where status = 'ok';
create index if not exists issuer_industry_memberships_source_idx on public.issuer_industry_memberships(source_membership_id) where source_membership_id is not null;
create index if not exists issuer_industry_memberships_issuer_idx on public.issuer_industry_memberships(issuer_id, scheme, version);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- fetch events and receipts (§6.1, U3, V7)
create table if not exists public.industry_fetch_events (
  fetch_event_id uuid primary key,
  job            text not null check (length(job) between 1 and 64),
  params         jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(params) = 'object'),
  started_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  batch_id       uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  attempt        int not null default 1 check (attempt >= 1)
);
create index if not exists industry_fetch_events_batch_idx on public.industry_fetch_events(batch_id);

create table if not exists public.industry_observation_receipts (
  fetch_event_id uuid not null references public.industry_fetch_events(fetch_event_id) on delete restrict,
  kind           text not null check (kind in ('marks','official')),
  natural_key    text not null check (length(natural_key) between 1 and 256),
  payload_hash   text not null check (payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  outcome        text not null check (outcome in ('inserted','duplicate','superseded_previous')),
  observation_id uuid,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (fetch_event_id, kind, natural_key)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- security_marks (§6.1, observation-versioned)
-- *_text columns carry the exact decimal for JSON clients (PostgREST sends numeric as a JSON number).
create table if not exists public.security_marks (
  observation_id   uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  ticker           text not null references public.stocks_universe(ticker) on delete restrict,
  trade_date       date not null,
  fetch_event_id   uuid not null references public.industry_fetch_events(fetch_event_id) on delete restrict,
  observed_at      timestamptz not null,
  close            numeric not null check (close > 0),
  total_share      numeric not null check (total_share > 0),
  market_cap       numeric generated always as (close * total_share) stored,
  close_text       text generated always as (close::text) stored,
  total_share_text text generated always as (total_share::text) stored,
  market_cap_text  text generated always as ((close * total_share)::text) stored,
  free_share       numeric check (free_share is null or free_share > 0),   -- Tushare free_share 万股 × 10000 (spec 7th draft K1; nullable)
  free_share_text  text generated always as (free_share::text) stored,
  source           text not null check (length(source) between 1 and 64),
  upstream         text not null check (upstream in ('sse','szse','bse')),
  raw_hash         text not null check (length(raw_hash) between 1 and 128),
  locator          jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(locator) = 'object'),
  batch_id         uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  status           text not null default 'ok' check (status in ('ok','quarantined','superseded')),
  supersedes       uuid references public.security_marks(observation_id),
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint security_marks_event_key unique (ticker, trade_date, fetch_event_id)
);
alter table public.security_marks add column if not exists free_share numeric check (free_share is null or free_share > 0);
alter table public.security_marks add column if not exists free_share_text text generated always as (free_share::text) stored;
create unique index if not exists security_marks_current_uidx on public.security_marks(ticker, trade_date) where status = 'ok';
create index if not exists security_marks_date_idx on public.security_marks(trade_date, status);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_official_valuations (§6.2)
create table if not exists public.industry_official_valuations (
  observation_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  scheme         text not null check (scheme = 'sw2021'),
  version        text not null check (length(version) between 1 and 32),
  code           text not null check (length(code) between 1 and 32),
  trade_date     date not null,
  metric         text not null check (metric in ('pe','pb','total_mv','float_mv','close')),
  fetch_event_id uuid not null references public.industry_fetch_events(fetch_event_id) on delete restrict,
  value          numeric not null,
  value_text     text generated always as (value::text) stored,
  observed_at    timestamptz not null,
  source         text not null check (length(source) between 1 and 64),
  upstream       text not null check (length(upstream) between 1 and 64),
  raw_hash       text not null check (length(raw_hash) between 1 and 128),
  locator        jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(locator) = 'object'),
  batch_id       uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  status         text not null default 'ok' check (status in ('ok','superseded')),
  supersedes     uuid references public.industry_official_valuations(observation_id),
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint industry_official_valuations_event_key unique (scheme, version, code, trade_date, metric, fetch_event_id)
);
create unique index if not exists industry_official_current_uidx on public.industry_official_valuations(scheme, version, code, trade_date, metric) where status = 'ok';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_manifests (§5.3 content-addressed index)
create table if not exists public.industry_manifests (
  manifest_hash text primary key check (manifest_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  kind          text not null check (kind in ('aggregate','valuation')),
  byte_length   int not null check (byte_length > 0),
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  -- incarnation storage key (Codex plan audit round 2 R2-1): chosen by put_industry_manifest when the row is created;
  -- a re-registration after GC is a new row with a new path, so a stale collector can only delete its own incarnation
  object_path   text not null,
  gc_claimed_at timestamptz,           -- GC tombstone (round 1 #4): set by gc_industry_manifest_candidates
  gc_claim      uuid,                  -- claim token; delete_industry_manifests only deletes the row of the matching claim
  constraint industry_manifests_object_path_check check (object_path = 'sha256/' || manifest_hash || '/' || substr(object_path, 73, 36) || '.json.gz'
    and substr(object_path, 73, 36) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_metric_runs / industry_metrics (§5.4)
create table if not exists public.industry_metric_runs (
  run_id           uuid primary key,
  scheme           text not null check (scheme in ('sw2021','sic')),
  version          text not null check (length(version) between 1 and 32),
  level            int not null check (level between 1 and 4),
  generation       bigint not null check (generation >= 1),
  facts_as_of      date not null,
  knowledge_date   date not null,
  history_class    text not null check (history_class in ('point_in_time','reconstruction')),
  method_version   text not null check (length(method_version) between 1 and 64),
  config_hash      text not null check (length(config_hash) between 1 and 128),
  formula_version  text not null check (length(formula_version) between 1 and 64),
  code_version     text not null check (length(code_version) between 1 and 64),
  expected_grid    jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(expected_grid) = 'object'),
  fingerprint_at   timestamptz not null,
  reused_from_run  uuid references public.industry_metric_runs(run_id) on delete set null,
  batch_id         uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  status           text not null check (status in ('building','active','superseded','failed')),
  coverage_summary jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(coverage_summary) = 'object'),
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  activated_at     timestamptz,
  constraint industry_metric_runs_generation_key unique (scheme, version, level, generation),
  constraint industry_metric_runs_activated_iff check ((status in ('active','superseded')) = (activated_at is not null))
);
create unique index if not exists industry_metric_runs_active_uidx on public.industry_metric_runs(scheme, version, level) where status = 'active';

create table if not exists public.industry_metrics (
  run_id         uuid not null references public.industry_metric_runs(run_id) on delete cascade,
  code           text not null check (length(code) between 1 and 32),
  metric         text not null check (metric in ('revenue_sum','net_income_parent_sum','gross_margin','roe','revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy','member_count')),
  period_start   date not null,
  period_end     date not null,
  duration       text not null check (duration in ('3M','12M','TTM','INSTANT')),
  status         text not null check (status in ('ok','missing')),
  missing_reason text check (missing_reason is null or missing_reason in ('empty_set','zero_denominator','no_members','financial_excluded','unresolved_over_limit','manifest_mismatch')),
  value          numeric,
  value_text     text generated always as (value::text) stored,
  unit           text not null check (length(unit) between 1 and 16),
  n_members      int not null check (n_members >= 0),
  n_with_data    int not null check (n_with_data >= 0),
  n_unresolved   int not null check (n_unresolved >= 0),
  manifest_hash  text references public.industry_manifests(manifest_hash) on delete restrict,
  updated_at     timestamptz,
  primary key (run_id, code, metric, period_start, period_end),
  constraint industry_metrics_ok_value check ((status = 'ok') = (value is not null)),
  constraint industry_metrics_ok_manifest check ((status = 'ok') = (manifest_hash is not null)),
  constraint industry_metrics_missing_reason check ((status = 'missing') = (missing_reason is not null))
);
create index if not exists industry_metrics_series_idx on public.industry_metrics(code, metric, period_end desc);
create index if not exists industry_metrics_manifest_idx on public.industry_metrics(manifest_hash) where manifest_hash is not null;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- valuation runs / rows / pairs (§6.4; pipeline deferred)
create table if not exists public.industry_valuation_runs (
  run_id           uuid primary key,
  scheme           text not null check (scheme in ('sw2021','sic')),
  version          text not null check (length(version) between 1 and 32),
  level            int not null check (level between 1 and 4),
  generation       bigint not null check (generation >= 1),
  method_version   text not null check (length(method_version) between 1 and 64),
  config_hash      text not null check (length(config_hash) between 1 and 128),
  formula_version  text not null check (length(formula_version) between 1 and 64),
  code_version     text not null check (length(code_version) between 1 and 64),
  expected_dates   jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(expected_dates) = 'array'),
  comparator_basis text not null check (comparator_basis in ('ttm','static','unknown')),
  recompute_from   date not null,
  carried_from_run uuid references public.industry_valuation_runs(run_id) on delete set null,
  fingerprint_at   timestamptz not null,
  batch_id         uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  status           text not null check (status in ('building','published','active','superseded','failed')),
  reconciliation   jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(reconciliation) = 'object'),
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  published_at     timestamptz,
  activated_at     timestamptz,
  constraint industry_valuation_runs_generation_key unique (scheme, version, level, generation),
  constraint industry_valuation_runs_published_at check (status not in ('published','active','superseded') or published_at is not null),
  constraint industry_valuation_runs_activated_iff check ((status in ('active','superseded')) = (activated_at is not null))
);
create unique index if not exists industry_valuation_runs_active_uidx on public.industry_valuation_runs(scheme, version, level) where status = 'active';

create table if not exists public.industry_valuations (
  run_id            uuid not null references public.industry_valuation_runs(run_id) on delete cascade,
  scheme            text not null,
  version           text not null,
  code              text not null check (length(code) between 1 and 32),
  trade_date        date not null,
  metric            text not null check (metric in ('pe_ttm','pe_static','pb','market_cap')),
  status            text not null check (status in ('ok','missing')),
  missing_reason    text check (missing_reason is null or length(missing_reason) between 1 and 64),
  value             numeric,
  value_text        text generated always as (value::text) stored,
  facts_as_of       date not null,
  n_members         int check (n_members is null or n_members >= 0),
  n_with_data       int check (n_with_data is null or n_with_data >= 0),
  n_unresolved      int check (n_unresolved is null or n_unresolved >= 0),
  mcap_coverage     numeric check (mcap_coverage is null or (mcap_coverage >= 0 and mcap_coverage <= 1)),
  mcap_coverage_text text generated always as (mcap_coverage::text) stored,
  manifest_hash     text references public.industry_manifests(manifest_hash) on delete restrict,
  updated_at        timestamptz,
  series_qualified  boolean not null default false,
  published         boolean not null default false,
  primary key (run_id, scheme, version, code, trade_date, metric),
  constraint industry_valuations_ok_value check ((status = 'ok') = (value is not null)),
  constraint industry_valuations_missing_reason check ((status = 'missing') = (missing_reason is not null)),
  constraint industry_valuations_published_requires check (not published or (status = 'ok' and series_qualified))
);
create index if not exists industry_valuations_published_idx on public.industry_valuations(scheme, version, code, metric, trade_date desc) where published;
create index if not exists industry_valuations_manifest_idx on public.industry_valuations(manifest_hash) where manifest_hash is not null;

create table if not exists public.industry_valuation_pairs (
  run_id                  uuid not null references public.industry_valuation_runs(run_id) on delete cascade,
  scheme                  text not null,
  version                 text not null,
  code                    text not null,
  trade_date              date not null,
  metric                  text not null check (metric in ('pe_ttm','pe_static','pb','market_cap')),
  official_observation_id uuid references public.industry_official_valuations(observation_id) on delete restrict,
  official_value          numeric,
  rel_diff                numeric,
  pair_status             text not null check (pair_status in ('within','outside','no_official','no_computed','invalid_denominator','not_applicable')),
  primary key (run_id, scheme, version, code, trade_date, metric)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_run_dependencies (§5.4, U4/V6)
create table if not exists public.industry_run_dependencies (
  run_kind  text not null check (run_kind in ('aggregate','valuation')),
  run_id    uuid not null,
  cell_key  text not null check (length(cell_key) between 1 and 64),
  issuer_id uuid not null,
  state_rev bigint not null check (state_rev >= 0),
  primary key (run_kind, run_id, cell_key, issuer_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- industry_sync_scope (SIC schedule; not a fact table)
create table if not exists public.industry_sync_scope (
  issuer_id       uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  job             text not null check (job in ('sic')),
  next_due_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  lease_until     timestamptz,
  lease_batch_id  uuid,
  last_attempt_at timestamptz,
  last_success_at timestamptz,
  last_status     text check (last_status is null or last_status in ('success','failed')),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (issuer_id, job),
  constraint industry_sync_scope_lease_pair check ((lease_until is null) = (lease_batch_id is null))
);
create index if not exists industry_sync_scope_due_idx on public.industry_sync_scope(job, next_due_at);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- bucket (§5.3)
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values ('industry-manifests', 'industry-manifests', false, 20971520, array['application/gzip'])
on conflict (id) do update
set public = false,
    file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit,
    allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- licence helpers (§4.3 function table; called by the policies)
create or replace function public.industry_dataset_is_public(p_key text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = pg_catalog, public as $$
  select exists (select 1 from public.industry_dataset_licenses l where l.dataset_key = p_key and l.status = 'public')
$$;
revoke execute on function public.industry_dataset_is_public(text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function public.industry_dataset_is_public(text) to anon, authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function public.industry_metric_run_visible(p_run uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = pg_catalog, public as $$
  select coalesce((select r.status = 'active' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || r.scheme || ':' || r.version)
                   from public.industry_metric_runs r where r.run_id = p_run), false)
$$;
revoke execute on function public.industry_metric_run_visible(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function public.industry_metric_run_visible(uuid) to anon, authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function public.industry_valuation_run_visible(p_run uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = pg_catalog, public as $$
  select coalesce((select r.status = 'active' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || r.scheme || ':' || r.version)
                   from public.industry_valuation_runs r where r.run_id = p_run), false)
$$;
revoke execute on function public.industry_valuation_run_visible(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function public.industry_valuation_run_visible(uuid) to anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- table privileges and policies (§4.3, §4.8)
do $$ declare t text; begin
  -- every industry table: RLS on, nothing for client roles until granted below; service_role reads everything
  foreach t in array array['industry_classifications','issuer_industry_memberships','industry_dataset_licenses','industry_source_memberships',
                           'industry_fetch_events','industry_observation_receipts','security_marks','industry_official_valuations',
                           'industry_manifests','industry_metric_runs','industry_metrics','industry_valuation_runs','industry_valuations',
                           'industry_valuation_pairs','industry_run_dependencies','industry_sync_scope'] loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t);
    execute format('revoke all on public.%I from public, anon, authenticated, service_role', t);
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to service_role', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s service read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('create policy "%s service read" on public.%I for select to service_role using (true)', t, t);
  end loop;
  -- licence-gated public reads (the landed "<t> public read" policies are replaced)
  foreach t in array array['industry_classifications','issuer_industry_memberships','industry_metric_runs','industry_metrics',
                           'industry_valuation_runs','industry_valuations','security_marks'] loop
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to anon, authenticated', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s public read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s licensed read" on public.%I', t, t);
  end loop;
end $$;
create policy "industry_classifications licensed read" on public.industry_classifications for select to anon, authenticated
  using (public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || scheme || ':' || version));
create policy "issuer_industry_memberships licensed read" on public.issuer_industry_memberships for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status = 'ok' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || scheme || ':' || version));
create policy "industry_metric_runs licensed read" on public.industry_metric_runs for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status = 'active' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || scheme || ':' || version));
create policy "industry_metrics licensed read" on public.industry_metrics for select to anon, authenticated
  using (public.industry_metric_run_visible(run_id));
create policy "industry_valuation_runs licensed read" on public.industry_valuation_runs for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status = 'active' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('scheme:' || scheme || ':' || version));
create policy "industry_valuations licensed read" on public.industry_valuations for select to anon, authenticated
  using (published and public.industry_valuation_run_visible(run_id));
create policy "security_marks licensed read" on public.security_marks for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status = 'ok' and public.industry_dataset_is_public('marks:tushare-daily_basic'));
-- semi-protected writes: classifications (adapter inserts nodes, renames go through quarantine; no delete) and the SIC schedule
grant insert, update on public.industry_classifications to service_role;
drop policy if exists "industry_classifications service insert" on public.industry_classifications;
create policy "industry_classifications service insert" on public.industry_classifications for insert to service_role with check (true);
drop policy if exists "industry_classifications service update" on public.industry_classifications;
create policy "industry_classifications service update" on public.industry_classifications for update to service_role using (true) with check (true);
grant insert, update, delete on public.industry_sync_scope to service_role;
drop policy if exists "industry_sync_scope service write" on public.industry_sync_scope;
create policy "industry_sync_scope service write" on public.industry_sync_scope for all to service_role using (true) with check (true);
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/functions.integration.test.ts
// I-0 (spec §4.3 function table, §4.5, §5.4, §6.1, §6.4, §13.2): migration 20261111091000 on real
// PostgreSQL — every function's security attributes and EXECUTE matrix, service_role without direct
// writes (42501, truncate included) yet able to run every RPC, the membership lifecycle / source
// immutability / run immutability / row freeze triggers, apply_industry_memberships atomicity and
// concurrency (two connections), apply_observations receipts (A→B→A, the V7 retry, concurrency),
// run creation/activation (incomplete, dependencies_incomplete, obsolete_run, dependency_regression,
// one activation instant, a run created before and activated after UTC midnight), the valuation
// publish/activate path with the freeze and the V8 prune, the manifest index, and (Task 4) the
// pgIndustryDb contract. Isolation: private classification versions 't…' with their own licence rows,
// random tickers, ts_codes and l1 codes; prune is always scoped to a private version.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomBytes,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import type {PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const MIGRATION='supabase/migrations/20261111091000_industry_research_functions.sql';
const hex=(n:number)=>randomBytes(n).toString('hex');
/** Every function of both migrations with its EXECUTE grantees ('internal' = nobody). */
const FUNCTIONS:Record<string,'read'|'service'|'internal'>={
 'industry_dataset_is_public(text)':'read','industry_metric_run_visible(uuid)':'read','industry_valuation_run_visible(uuid)':'read','industry_freshness()':'read',
 'set_industry_dataset_license(text,text,text,text)':'service','industry_state_fingerprint(text)':'service','upsert_industry_source_memberships(uuid,jsonb)':'service',
 'record_industry_source_resolution_error(uuid[],jsonb)':'service','apply_industry_memberships(uuid,uuid,text,text,jsonb,uuid[],jsonb)':'service','correct_industry_membership_windows(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,jsonb)':'service',
 'apply_sic_memberships(uuid,uuid,text,date,text,jsonb,uuid,jsonb)':'service','begin_industry_fetch_event(text,jsonb,uuid)':'service','retry_industry_fetch_event(uuid)':'service',
 'apply_observations(text,uuid,jsonb)':'service','create_industry_metric_run(jsonb)':'service','create_industry_valuation_run(jsonb)':'service',
 'set_industry_metric_run_coverage(uuid,jsonb)':'service','fail_industry_run(text,uuid,text)':'service','stage_industry_metrics(uuid,jsonb)':'service',
 'stage_industry_run_dependencies(uuid,text,jsonb)':'service','stage_industry_valuations(uuid,jsonb)':'service','stage_industry_valuation_pairs(uuid,jsonb)':'service',
 'publish_industry_valuations(uuid)':'service','activate_industry_metric_run(uuid)':'service','activate_industry_valuation_run(uuid)':'service',
 'put_industry_manifest(text,text,integer)':'service','gc_industry_manifest_candidates(integer,integer)':'service','delete_industry_manifests(jsonb,integer)':'service','industry_manifests_lock_for_reference(jsonb)':'internal',
 'prune_industry_runs(integer,text,text)':'service',
 'industry_metric_run_lock(uuid)':'internal','industry_valuation_run_lock(uuid)':'internal','industry_manifest_unreferenced(text)':'internal',
};
const TRIGGER_FUNCTIONS=['issuer_industry_memberships_lifecycle()','industry_source_memberships_immutable()','industry_runs_immutable()','industry_rows_frozen()'];

// Same replay policy as facts.integration.test.ts (not exported there).
const RETRYABLE=new Set(['55P03','40P01']);
async function replayMigration(pool:Pool,sql:string,attempts=10):Promise<void>{
 for(let attempt=1;;attempt++){
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query(`begin; set local lock_timeout='3s';\n${sql}\n;commit;`);
   return;
  }catch(e){
   await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});
   const code=(e as {code?:string}).code;
   if(attempt>=attempts||!code||!RETRYABLE.has(code))throw e;
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250*attempt+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)));
  }finally{c.release();}
 }
}
/** Runs body inside one transaction on its own connection (pid known); rolls back only if still open. */
interface Tx{c:PoolClient;pid:number;commit():Promise<void>}
async function inTx(pool:Pool,body:(tx:Tx)=>Promise<void>):Promise<void>{
 const c=await pool.connect();let open=false;let broken:Error|undefined;
 try{
  await c.query('begin');open=true;
  const pid=Number((await c.query('select pg_backend_pid() p')).rows[0].p);
  await body({c,pid,commit:async()=>{await c.query('commit');open=false;}});
 }finally{
  if(open)await c.query('rollback').catch(e=>{broken=e as Error;});
  c.release(broken);
 }
}
/** Deterministic "is blocked": polls (20 ms, <= 3 s) until some backend waits on `pid`, then asserts p is still pending. */
async function stillBlockedBehind(pool:Pool,pid:number,p:Promise<unknown>):Promise<void>{
 let settled=false;p.then(()=>{settled=true;},()=>{settled=true;});
 for(const deadline=Date.now()+3000;;){
  const n=Number((await pool.query(`select count(*)::int n from pg_stat_activity where $1 = any(pg_blocking_pids(pid))`,[pid])).rows[0].n);
  if(n>=1)break;
  if(settled||Date.now()>deadline)throw new Error(`no backend blocked behind pid ${pid} (settled=${settled})`);
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));
 }
 expect(settled).toBe(false);
}
type PgErr={message:string;code?:string};
const fails=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>{throw new Error('expected rejection');},e=>e as PgErr);

 const objectPath=async(h:string)=>(await one(`select object_path v from public.industry_manifests where manifest_hash=$1`,[h])) as string|undefined;
 const issuer=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_zh) values($1,'行业函数测试')`,[id]);return id;};
 const batch=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,'industry-test','industry.test')`,[id]);return id;};
 const ticker=async()=>{const t=`ZZ${hex(4).toUpperCase()}`;await q(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,'Industry Test','A')`,[t]);return t;};
 /** Private sw2021 version: nodes A1 > A11 > A111, B1 > B11 > B111 and an internal licence row. */
 const version=async()=>{
  const v=`t${hex(4)}`;

   ('sw2021',$1,'A1',1,'甲',null),('sw2021',$1,'B1',1,'乙',null),('sw2021',$1,'A11',2,'甲一','A1'),('sw2021',$1,'B11',2,'乙一','B1'),('sw2021',$1,'A111',3,'甲一一','A11'),('sw2021',$1,'B111',3,'乙一一','B11')`,[v]);
  return v;
 };
 const target=(code:string,level:number,o:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({code,level,valid_from:'2021-07-30',valid_to:null,available_date:'2021-07-30',valid_to_available_date:null,source:'tushare:index_member_all',provenance:{availability:'effective_date_assumed'},...o});

 const upsertSources=(b:string,rows:unknown[],c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.upsert_industry_source_memberships($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[b,JSON.stringify(rows)],c);
 const currentSource=async(l1:string)=>(await q(`select * from public.industry_source_memberships where l1_code=$1 and status='current' order by ts_code,in_date`,[l1]));
 const apply=(b:string,iss:string,v:string,rows:unknown[],sources:string[],c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.apply_industry_memberships($1,$2,'sw2021',$3,$4::jsonb,$5::uuid[],$6::jsonb) v`,[b,iss,v,JSON.stringify(rows),sources,JSON.stringify({method:'today',resolved_at:'2026-11-06'})],c);
 const rowsOf=(iss:string)=>q(`select membership_id,code,level,status,valid_to::text valid_to,superseded_by from public.issuer_industry_memberships where issuer_id=$1 order by level,status,valid_from`,[iss]);
 const createRun=async(v:string,b:string,o:Record<string,unknown>={},c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>(await one(`select public.create_industry_metric_run($1::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify({scheme:'sw2021',version:v,level:1,facts_as_of:'2025-03-31',knowledge_date:'2025-03-31',history_class:'reconstruction',
  method_version:'industry-agg/1.0',config_hash:'c'.repeat(64),formula_version:'derive/1',code_version:'test',expected_grid:{codes:['A1','B1'],period_ends:['2024-12-31'],metrics:['member_count']},fingerprint_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00Z',reused_from_run:null,batch_id:b,...o})],c)) as {run_id:string;generation:number};
 const manifest=async(c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>{const h=hex(32);expect(await one(`select public.put_industry_manifest($1,'aggregate',10) v`,[h],c)).toBe(true);return h;};
 const cells=(m:string,n:number,o:Record<string,unknown>={})=>['A1','B1'].map(code=>({code,metric:'member_count',period_start:'2024-12-31',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'INSTANT',status:'ok',missing_reason:null,value:String(n),unit:'count',n_members:n,n_with_data:n,n_unresolved:0,manifest_hash:m,...o}));
 const stage=(run:string,rows:unknown[],c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.stage_industry_metrics($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[run,JSON.stringify(rows)],c);
 const deps=(run:string,rows:{cell_key:string;issuer_id:string;state_rev:number}[],kind='aggregate',c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.stage_industry_run_dependencies($1,$2,$3::jsonb) v`,[run,kind,JSON.stringify(rows)],c);
 const activate=(run:string,c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.activate_industry_metric_run($1) v`,[run],c);
 const markRow=(t:string,close:string,o:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({ticker:t,trade_date:'2001-04-02',close,total_share:'1000',source:'tushare:daily_basic',upstream:'sse',raw_hash:hex(32),locator:{},...o});
 const begin=async(b:string,c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>(await one(`select public.begin_industry_fetch_event('marks','{"trade_date":"2001-04-02"}'::jsonb,$1) v`,[b],c)) as string;
 const observe=(e:string,rows:unknown[],kind='marks',c:Pool|PoolClient=admin)=>one(`select public.apply_observations($1,$2,$3::jsonb) v`,[kind,e,JSON.stringify(rows)],c);
 const currentMark=async(t:string,d='2001-04-02')=>(await q(`select observation_id,close_text,fetch_event_id,supersedes from public.security_marks where ticker=$1 and trade_date=$2 and status='ok'`,[t,d]))[0];
 const asRole=async<T>(role:string,body:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{
  const c=await admin.connect();
  try{await c.query(`set role ${role}`);return await body(c);}
  finally{await c.query('reset role').catch(()=>{});c.release();}
 };

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
 });
 afterAll(async()=>{await admin?.end();});

 it('every function is security definer, owned by the table owner, with search_path pinned; EXECUTE: four read functions for clients, the rest service_role only, helpers nobody; replays twice',async()=>{
  const owner=await one(`select relowner::regrole::text v from pg_class where oid='public.industry_metrics'::regclass`);
  for(const [sig,kind] of Object.entries(FUNCTIONS)){
   const f=(await q(`select prosecdef,proowner::regrole::text owner,array_to_string(proconfig,';') config from pg_proc where oid=$1::regprocedure`,[`public.${sig}`]))[0];
   expect({sig,secdef:f.prosecdef,owner:f.owner,config:f.config}).toEqual({sig,secdef:true,owner,config:'search_path=pg_catalog, public'});
   const can=async(role:string)=>one(`select has_function_privilege($1,$2,'EXECUTE') v`,[role,`public.${sig}`]);
   expect({sig,anon:await can('anon'),auth:await can('authenticated'),service:await can('service_role'),public:await one(`select exists(select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where p.oid=$1::regprocedure and a.grantee=0) v`,[`public.${sig}`])})
    .toEqual({sig,anon:kind==='read',auth:kind==='read',service:kind!=='internal',public:false});
  }
  for(const sig of TRIGGER_FUNCTIONS){
   const f=(await q(`select prosecdef,array_to_string(proconfig,';') config from pg_proc where oid=$1::regprocedure`,[`public.${sig}`]))[0];
   expect({sig,secdef:f.prosecdef,config:f.config}).toEqual({sig,secdef:false,config:'search_path=pg_catalog, public'});
  }
  const triggers=(await q(`select tgrelid::regclass::text t,tgname from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgname=any($1) order by 1,2`,[['issuer_industry_memberships_lifecycle','industry_source_memberships_immutable','industry_runs_immutable','industry_metrics_frozen','industry_valuations_frozen','industry_valuation_pairs_frozen']])).map(r=>`${r.t}.${r.tgname}`);
  expect(triggers).toEqual(['industry_metric_runs.industry_runs_immutable','industry_metrics.industry_metrics_frozen','industry_source_memberships.industry_source_memberships_immutable','industry_valuation_pairs.industry_valuation_pairs_frozen','industry_valuation_runs.industry_runs_immutable','industry_valuations.industry_valuations_frozen','issuer_industry_memberships.issuer_industry_memberships_lifecycle']);
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,readFileSync(MIGRATION,'utf8'))).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,readFileSync(MIGRATION,'utf8'))).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  expect(await one(`select has_function_privilege('anon','public.apply_observations(text,uuid,jsonb)','EXECUTE') v`)).toBe(false);
 },60000);

 it('industry_freshness returns only {dataset, status, last_ok_at} of industry.* rows; the fingerprint carries state_rev per issuer',async()=>{
  const d=`industry.fn-${hex(3)}`;
  await q(`insert into public.dq_freshness(dataset,expected_cadence,status,last_ok_at,consecutive_errors,detail) values($1,'weekly','fresh',now(),0,'{"secret":1}'),($2,'daily','missing',null,0,'{}')`,[d,`other.fn-${hex(3)}`]);
  const rows=await asRole('anon',async c=>(await c.query(`select public.industry_freshness() v`)).rows[0].v as Record<string,unknown>[]);
  expect(rows.every(r=>String(r.dataset).startsWith('industry.')&&Object.keys(r).sort().join()==='dataset,last_ok_at,status')).toBe(true);
  expect(rows.find(r=>r.dataset===d)).toMatchObject({status:'fresh'});
  const iss=await issuer();

  const f=await asRole('service_role',async c=>(await c.query(`select public.industry_state_fingerprint('CN') v`)).rows[0].v);
  expect(f.revs.find((r:{issuer_id:string})=>r.issuer_id===iss)).toEqual({issuer_id:iss,state_rev:5});expect(typeof f.taken_at).toBe('string');
 });

 it('service_role: no direct write on protected tables (42501, truncate included), the run status cannot be set directly, and every RPC runs end to end',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const iss=await issuer();const t=await ticker();
  const sicCode=`ZQ${hex(2)}`;await q(`insert into public.industry_classifications(scheme,version,code,level,name_en) values('sic','sec-current',$1,1,'Test SIC')`,[sicCode]);
  await asRole('service_role',async c=>{
   const denied=async(sql:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>expect((await fails(c.query(sql,values))).code).toBe('42501');
   await denied(`insert into public.industry_valuations(run_id,scheme,version,code,trade_date,metric,status,value,facts_as_of,series_qualified,published) values($1,'sw2021',$2,'A1','2024-12-31','pb','ok',1,'2024-12-31',true,true)`,[randomUUID(),v]);
   await denied(`update public.industry_valuations set published=true where version=$1`,[v]);
   await denied(`delete from public.industry_valuation_pairs where version=$1`,[v]);
   await denied(`update public.industry_metric_runs set status='building' where version=$1`,[v]);
   await denied(`insert into public.security_marks(ticker,trade_date,fetch_event_id,observed_at,close,total_share,source,upstream,raw_hash,locator,batch_id) values($1,'2001-01-01',$2,now(),1,1,'s','sse','h','{}',$3)`,[t,randomUUID(),b]);
   await denied(`update public.issuer_industry_memberships set status='quarantined' where issuer_id=$1`,[iss]);
   await denied(`truncate public.industry_metrics`);await denied(`truncate public.industry_valuation_pairs`);await denied(`truncate public.industry_metric_runs`);
   // the RPC path, as service_role
   const s=srcRow();
   expect(await upsertSources(b,[s],c)).toMatchObject({inserted:1});
   const [rec]=(await c.query(`select id from public.industry_source_memberships where l1_code=$1`,[s.l1_code])).rows;
   expect(await apply(b,iss,v,three(rec.id),[rec.id],c)).toMatchObject({inserted:3});
   expect(await one(`select public.record_industry_source_resolution_error($1::uuid[],'{"code":"x"}'::jsonb) v`,[[rec.id]],c)).toBe(0);   // already resolved
   await c.query(`select public.set_industry_dataset_license($1,'internal','svc',null)`,[`scheme:sw2021:${v}`]);
   const e=await begin(b,c);
   expect(await observe(e,[markRow(t,'2')],'marks',c)).toEqual({inserted:1,duplicates:0,superseded:0});
   expect(await one(`select public.retry_industry_fetch_event($1) v`,[e],c)).toBe(2);
   const m=await manifest(c);
   const r=await createRun(v,b,{},c);
   await c.query(`select public.set_industry_metric_run_coverage($1,'{"facts_scope_ready":true}'::jsonb)`,[r.run_id]);
   expect(await stage(r.run_id,cells(m,1),c)).toBe(2);
   expect(await deps(r.run_id,[{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:iss,state_rev:1},{cell_key:'B1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:iss,state_rev:1}],'aggregate',c)).toBe(2);
   expect(await activate(r.run_id,c)).toHaveProperty('activated_at');
   const r2=await createRun(v,b,{},c);await c.query(`select public.fail_industry_run('aggregate',$1,'test')`,[r2.run_id]);
   expect(Array.isArray(await one(`select public.gc_industry_manifest_candidates(10) v`,[],c))).toBe(true);
   expect(await one(`select public.delete_industry_manifests($1::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify([{hash:m,claim:randomUUID()}])],c)).toBe(0);
   expect(await one(`select public.prune_industry_runs(5,'sw2021',$1) v`,[v],c)).toBe(0);
   const vr=(await one(`select public.create_industry_valuation_run($1::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify({scheme:'sw2021',version:v,level:3,method_version:'industry-val/1.0',config_hash:'c',formula_version:'f',code_version:'x',expected_dates:['2024-12-31'],comparator_basis:'unknown',recompute_from:'2024-01-01',carried_from_run:null,fingerprint_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00Z',batch_id:b})],c)).run_id;
   const vrows=['A111','B111'].flatMap(code=>['pe_ttm','pe_static','pb','market_cap'].map(metric=>({code,trade_date:'2024-12-31',metric,status:'missing',missing_reason:'no_members',value:null,facts_as_of:'2024-12-31',n_members:0,n_with_data:0,n_unresolved:0,mcap_coverage:null,manifest_hash:null})));
   expect(await one(`select public.stage_industry_valuations($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[vr,JSON.stringify(vrows)],c)).toBe(8);
   expect(await one(`select public.stage_industry_valuation_pairs($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[vr,JSON.stringify(vrows.map(x=>({code:x.code,trade_date:x.trade_date,metric:x.metric,pair_status:'no_computed'})))],c)).toBe(8);
   expect(await one(`select public.publish_industry_valuations($1) v`,[vr],c)).toEqual({qualified_series:0,published_rows:0});
   expect(await one(`select public.activate_industry_valuation_run($1) v`,[vr],c)).toHaveProperty('activated_at');
   await c.query(`insert into public.industry_sync_scope(issuer_id,job,lease_until,lease_batch_id) values($1,'sic',now()+interval '1 hour',$2)`,[iss,b]);
   expect((await one(`select public.apply_sic_memberships($1,$2,'sec-current','2026-01-05',$3,'{}'::jsonb,$1) v`,[b,iss,sicCode],c)).outcome).toBe('inserted');
   expect((await fails(c.query(`select public.apply_sic_memberships($1,$2,'sec-current','2026-01-06','ZZZZ','{}'::jsonb,$1)`,[b,iss]))).message).toMatch(/^unknown_sic_code/);
  });
 },60000);

 it('membership triggers: identity frozen, valid_to only null→date, legal status moves, provenance only grows, no delete; source records are immutable evidence',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const iss=await issuer();const s=srcRow();
  await upsertSources(b,[s]);const [rec]=await currentSource(s.l1_code);
  await apply(b,iss,v,three(rec.id),[rec.id]);
  const [m]=await q(`select membership_id from public.issuer_industry_memberships where issuer_id=$1 and level=1`,[iss]);
  const upd=(set:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>q(`update public.issuer_industry_memberships set ${set} where membership_id=$1`,[m.membership_id,...values]);
  const refused=async(p:Promise<unknown>)=>{const e=await fails(p);expect(e.code).toBe('23514');expect(e.message).toMatch(/^append_only:/);};
  await refused(upd(`code='B1'`));await refused(upd(`valid_from='2021-07-31'`));await refused(upd(`batch_id=$2`,[await batch()]));
  await refused(upd(`valid_to='2021-07-30',valid_to_available_date='2021-07-30'`));             // not after valid_from
  await upd(`valid_to='2023-01-01',valid_to_available_date='2023-02-01'`);
  await refused(upd(`valid_to='2023-06-01',valid_to_available_date='2023-06-01'`));             // date → another date
  await upd(`status='quarantined'`);await upd(`status='ok'`);
  await refused(upd(`superseded_by=$2`,[randomUUID()]));
  await upd(`provenance=provenance||'{"note":"x"}'::jsonb`);
  await refused(upd(`provenance='{"availability":"effective_date_assumed"}'::jsonb`));
  await refused(q(`delete from public.issuer_industry_memberships where membership_id=$1`,[m.membership_id]));
  await refused(q(`insert into public.issuer_industry_memberships(membership_id,issuer_id,scheme,version,code,level,valid_from,available_date,source,batch_id,status,superseded_by) values($1,$2,'sw2021',$3,'B1',1,'2010-01-01','2010-01-01','t',$4,'quarantined',null)`,[randomUUID(),iss,v,b]));
  const c=await admin.connect();
  try{                                                                                             // superseded is terminal
   const n=randomUUID();await c.query('begin');
   await c.query(`update public.issuer_industry_memberships set status='superseded',superseded_by=$2 where membership_id=$1`,[m.membership_id,n]);
   await c.query(`insert into public.issuer_industry_memberships(membership_id,issuer_id,scheme,version,code,level,valid_from,valid_to,available_date,valid_to_available_date,source,batch_id) values($1,$2,'sw2021',$3,'A1',1,'2021-07-30','2023-01-01','2021-07-30','2023-02-01','t',$4)`,[n,iss,v,b]);
   await c.query('commit');
  }finally{await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});c.release();}
  await refused(upd(`status='ok',superseded_by=null`));
  await refused(q(`update public.industry_source_memberships set out_date='2024-01-01' where id=$1`,[rec.id]));
  await refused(q(`update public.industry_source_memberships set issuer_id=$2 where id=$1`,[rec.id,await issuer()]));
  await refused(q(`delete from public.industry_source_memberships where id=$1`,[rec.id]));
  await q(`update public.industry_source_memberships set resolution_error='{"code":"x"}'::jsonb where id=$1`,[rec.id]);   // resolution columns stay writable (functions)
 });

 it('upsert_industry_source_memberships: duplicate, null→date supersession with changed[], content change, current key kept unique',async()=>{
  const b=await batch();const s=srcRow();
  expect(await upsertSources(b,[s,{...s}])).toEqual({inserted:1,superseded:0,duplicates:1,changed:[]});
  const [r0]=await currentSource(s.l1_code);
  const x=await upsertSources(b,[{...s,out_date:'2024-01-02'}]);
  expect(x).toMatchObject({inserted:0,superseded:1,duplicates:0});expect(x.changed).toEqual([{old_id:r0.id,new_id:expect.any(String),null_to_date:true}]);
  const y=await upsertSources(b,[{...s,out_date:'2024-01-03'}]);
  expect(y.changed[0]).toMatchObject({old_id:x.changed[0].new_id,null_to_date:false});
  expect((await q(`select status,superseded_by,out_date::text from public.industry_source_memberships where ts_code=$1 order by created_at,status`,[s.ts_code])).map(r=>[r.status,r.out_date]))
   .toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([['superseded',null],['superseded','2024-01-02'],['current','2024-01-03']]));
  expect(await currentSource(s.l1_code)).toHaveLength(1);
 });

 it('apply_industry_memberships: a failing third row rolls back the first two, the supersession of the old rows and the resolution; the caller then records the error',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const iss=await issuer();const s=srcRow();
  await upsertSources(b,[s]);const [rec]=await currentSource(s.l1_code);
  await apply(b,iss,v,three(rec.id),[rec.id]);                                                   // A1/A11/A111 open
  await apply(b,iss,v,[target('B111',3,{valid_from:'2019-01-01',available_date:'2019-01-01',valid_to:'2020-01-01',valid_to_available_date:'2020-01-01'})],[]);   // an earlier level-3 window
  // out_date correction for the record; its third row is given a start that overlaps the 2019 window
  const up=await upsertSources(b,[{...s,out_date:'2024-01-02'}]);const nid=up.changed[0].new_id as string;
  const bad=three(nid,{valid_to:'2024-01-02',valid_to_available_date:'2024-01-02'});
  bad[2]={...bad[2],valid_from:'2019-06-01',available_date:'2019-06-01'};
  const before=await rowsOf(iss);
  const e=await fails(apply(b,iss,v,bad,[nid]));
  expect(e.code).toBe('23P01');expect(e.message).toMatch(/^membership_overlap/);
  expect(await rowsOf(iss)).toEqual(before);                                                    // old rows still ok, no new row
  const r=(await q(`select issuer_id,resolution,resolution_error from public.industry_source_memberships where id=$1`,[nid]))[0];
  expect(r).toEqual({issuer_id:null,resolution:{},resolution_error:null});
  expect(await one(`select public.record_industry_source_resolution_error($1::uuid[],$2::jsonb) v`,[[nid],JSON.stringify({code:'membership_overlap',at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00Z'})])).toBe(1);
  expect((await q(`select resolution_error from public.industry_source_memberships where id=$1`,[nid]))[0].resolution_error).toMatchObject({code:'membership_overlap'});
  // the correct correction supersedes all three and points each old row at its same-level successor
  expect(await apply(b,iss,v,three(nid,{valid_to:'2024-01-02',valid_to_available_date:'2024-01-02'}),[nid])).toMatchObject({inserted:3,superseded:3});
  const after=await rowsOf(iss);
  for(const code of ['A1','A11','A111']){
   const ok=after.find(x=>x.code===code&&x.status==='ok')!;const old=after.find(x=>x.code===code&&x.status==='superseded')!;
   expect(old.superseded_by).toBe(ok.membership_id);expect(ok.valid_to).toBe('2024-01-02');
  }
  expect((await q(`select resolution_error,resolution->'membership_ids' ids from public.industry_source_memberships where id=$1`,[nid]))[0]).toMatchObject({resolution_error:null,ids:expect.arrayContaining(after.filter(x=>x.status==='ok'&&x.code!=='B111').map(x=>x.membership_id))});
 });

 it('apply_industry_memberships: two transactions on one issuer serialise on the issuer row; the second sees the first and fails membership_overlap',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const iss=await issuer();
  await inTx(admin,async({c,pid,commit})=>{
   await apply(b,iss,v,[target('A1',1)],[],c);
   const second=apply(b,iss,v,[target('B1',1,{valid_from:'2022-01-01',available_date:'2022-01-01'})],[]);second.catch(()=>{});
   await stillBlockedBehind(admin,pid,second);
   await commit();
   const e=await fails(second);expect(e.code).toBe('23P01');expect(e.message).toMatch(/^membership_overlap/);
  });
  expect((await rowsOf(iss)).map(r=>r.code)).toEqual(['A1']);
 });

 it('apply_observations: A→B→A from three events is three observations; a retry is a duplicate by receipt even after a later change (V7); same content inserts nothing; a changed retry payload is refused',async()=>{
  const b=await batch();const t=await ticker();
  const e1=await begin(b),e2=await begin(b),e3=await begin(b),e4=await begin(b);
  expect(await observe(e1,[markRow(t,'10')])).toEqual({inserted:1,duplicates:0,superseded:0});
  expect(await observe(e2,[markRow(t,'10.00')])).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:1,superseded:0});   // same content: no row
  expect(await observe(e3,[markRow(t,'11')])).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:0,superseded:1});
  expect(await observe(e2,[markRow(t,'10.00')])).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:1,superseded:0});   // retry of E2: receipt, B stays
  expect((await currentMark(t)).close_text).toBe('11');
  expect((await fails(observe(e2,[markRow(t,'12')]))).message).toMatch(/^fetch_event_payload_changed/);
  expect(await observe(e4,[markRow(t,'10')])).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:0,superseded:1});
  const all=await q(`select fetch_event_id,status,close_text,supersedes from public.security_marks where ticker=$1 and trade_date='2001-04-02' order by created_at,observed_at`,[t]);
  expect(all.map(r=>[r.fetch_event_id,r.status])).toEqual([[e1,'superseded'],[e3,'superseded'],[e4,'ok']]);
  expect(all[1].supersedes).not.toBeNull();
  expect((await q(`select outcome from public.industry_observation_receipts where fetch_event_id=any($1::uuid[]) and natural_key=$2 order by created_at`,[[e1,e2,e3,e4],`${t}:2001-04-02`])).map(r=>r.outcome))
   .toEqual(['inserted','duplicate','superseded_previous','superseded_previous']);
  expect(await one(`select count(*)::int v from public.dq_quarantine where dataset='industry.marks' and natural_key=$1 and reason_code='mark_revised' and status='open'`,[`${t}:2001-04-02`])).toBe(1);
 });

 });

 it('metric runs: concurrent creation numbers generations; staging needs building; activation checks completeness, dependencies, obsolescence, regression per cell and issuer, and stamps one instant',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const i1=await issuer();const i2=await issuer();const m=await manifest();
  const gens=(await Promise.all(Array.from({length:4},()=>createRun(v,b)))).map(r=>Number(r.generation)).sort();
  expect(gens).toEqual([1,2,3,4]);
  const r=await createRun(v,b);
  await stage(r.run_id,cells(m,2).slice(0,1));
  expect((await fails(activate(r.run_id))).message).toBe('incomplete_run');
  await stage(r.run_id,cells(m,2));
  expect((await fails(activate(r.run_id))).message).toBe('dependencies_incomplete');
  // one issuer at different state_revs in different cells is fine (V6: per cell)
  await deps(r.run_id,[{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i1,state_rev:3},{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i2,state_rev:1},{cell_key:'B1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i1,state_rev:5},{cell_key:'B1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i2,state_rev:1}]);
  const {activated_at}=await activate(r.run_id);
  const stamps=await q(`select distinct updated_at=$2::timestamptz same from public.industry_metrics where run_id=$1`,[r.run_id,activated_at]);
  expect(stamps).toEqual([{same:true}]);
  expect(await one(`select activated_at=$2::timestamptz v from public.industry_metric_runs where run_id=$1`,[r.run_id,activated_at])).toBe(true);
  expect((await fails(stage(r.run_id,[]))).message).toBe('run_not_building');
  expect((await fails(q(`select public.set_industry_metric_run_coverage($1,'{}'::jsonb)`,[r.run_id]))).message).toBe('run_not_building');
  expect((await fails(q(`select public.fail_industry_run('aggregate',$1,'x')`,[r.run_id]))).message).toMatch(/^illegal_transition/);
  // a lower generation built earlier cannot activate after a newer one
  const low=await one(`select run_id v from public.industry_metric_runs where version=$1 and generation=1`,[v]);
  await stage(low,cells(m,0));
  expect((await fails(activate(low))).message).toBe('obsolete_run');
  // regression: the next run reads i1 in cell A1 at an older revision than the active run did
  const n=await createRun(v,b);await stage(n.run_id,cells(m,2));
  await deps(n.run_id,[{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i1,state_rev:2},{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i2,state_rev:1},{cell_key:'B1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i1,state_rev:5},{cell_key:'B1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i2,state_rev:9}]);
  expect((await fails(activate(n.run_id))).message).toBe('dependency_regression');
  await deps(n.run_id,[{cell_key:'A1:2024-12-31',issuer_id:i1,state_rev:3}]);
  await activate(n.run_id);
  expect(await q(`select run_id,status from public.industry_metric_runs where run_id=any($1::uuid[]) order by generation`,[[r.run_id,n.run_id]])).toEqual([{run_id:r.run_id,status:'superseded'},{run_id:n.run_id,status:'active'}]);
  // two weekly runs in a row both activate
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const w=await createRun(v,b,{facts_as_of:'2025-04-0'+(i+1),knowledge_date:'2025-04-0'+(i+1)});await stage(w.run_id,cells(m,0));expect(await activate(w.run_id)).toHaveProperty('activated_at');}
 });

 it('run immutability and row freeze: no direct status reset, metadata frozen, rows of a left-building run frozen except the activation stamp; building rows are invisible to anon',async()=>{
  const v=await version();const b=await batch();const m=await manifest();
```
