interface RpcResult{data:unknown;error:PgErrorLike|null;count?:number|null}
// The query builder is left untyped on purpose (same as facts/db.ts and table-client.ts).
interface NarrowClient{rpc:(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>PromiseLike<RpcResult>;from:(table:string)=>any}
type Query=PromiseLike<RpcResult>&{range:(from:number,to:number)=>Query};

export function supabaseIndustryDb(client:SupabaseClient):IndustryDb{
 const c=client as unknown as NarrowClient;
 const call=async<T>(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<T>=>{const {data,error}=await c.rpc(fn,args);if(error)throw toIndustryDbError(error);return data as T;};
 const rows=async<T>(q:PromiseLike<RpcResult>):Promise<T[]>=>{const {data,error}=await q;if(error)throw toIndustryDbError(error);return (data??[]) as T[];};
 /** `make` builds the filtered AND ordered query afresh per page; pages until a short page. */
 const pageAll=async(make:()=>Query):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>=>{
  const out:Record<string,unknown>[]=[];
  for(let from=0;;from+=READ_PAGE){
   const part=await rows<Record<string,unknown>>(make().range(from,from+READ_PAGE-1));
   out.push(...part);
   if(part.length<READ_PAGE)return out;
  }
 };
 const unresolvedOf=async(q:{code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string})=>{
  const col=levelColumn(q.level);const upTo=q.on<q.knownBy?q.on:q.knownBy;
  return (await pageAll(()=>c.from('industry_source_memberships').select('id,ts_code,in_date,out_date').eq('status','current').is('issuer_id',null).eq(col,q.code)
   .lte('in_date',upTo).or(`out_date.is.null,out_date.gte.${q.on}`).order('ts_code').order('in_date').order('id'))).map(unresolvedFromTable);
 };
 const db:IndustryDb={
  async upsertClassifications(_batch,input){
   let inserted=0,unchanged=0;const conflicts:ClassificationRow[]=[];
   const groups=new Map<string,ClassificationRow[]>();
   for(const r of input){const k=`${r.scheme}\u0000${r.version}`;groups.set(k,[...(groups.get(k)??[]),r]);}
   for(const group of groups.values()){
    const existing=new Map((await db.classificationTree(group[0].scheme,group[0].version)).map(r=>[r.code,r]));
    const fresh:ClassificationRow[]=[];
    for(const r of group){
     const e=existing.get(r.code);
     if(!e){if(!fresh.some(f=>f.code===r.code))fresh.push(r);continue;}
     if(sameClassification(e,r))unchanged++;else conflicts.push(r);
    }
    fresh.sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level||(a.code<b.code?-1:a.code>b.code?1:0));   // parents before children (parent FK)
    for(const part of chunk(fresh,STAGE_CHUNK)){
     if(part.length===0)continue;
     const {error}=await c.from('industry_classifications').insert(part.map(r=>({scheme:r.scheme,version:r.version,code:r.code,level:r.level,name_zh:r.name_zh,name_en:r.name_en,parent_code:r.parent_code,attributes:r.attributes??{}})));
     if(error)throw toIndustryDbError(error);
     inserted+=part.length;
    }
   }
   return {inserted,unchanged,conflicts};
  },
  async classificationTree(scheme,version){
   return (await pageAll(()=>c.from('industry_classifications').select('*').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).order('level').order('code'))).map(classificationFromTable);
  },
  async setDatasetLicense(key,status,by,note){await call('set_industry_dataset_license',{p_key:key,p_status:status,p_by:by,p_note:note});},
  async isDatasetPublic(key){return (await call<unknown>('industry_dataset_is_public',{p_key:key}))===true;},
  async upsertSourceMemberships(batch,input){
   const out={inserted:0,superseded:0,duplicates:0,changed:[] as {old_id:string;new_id:string;nullToDate:boolean}[]};
   for(const part of chunk(input,STAGE_CHUNK)){
    if(part.length===0)continue;
    const r=upsertSourceResult(await call<unknown>('upsert_industry_source_memberships',{p_batch:batch,p_rows:sourceArgs(part)}));
    out.inserted+=r.inserted;out.superseded+=r.superseded;out.duplicates+=r.duplicates;out.changed.push(...r.changed);
   }
   return out;
  },
  async currentSourceMemberships(opts){
   return (await pageAll(()=>{
    let q=c.from('industry_source_memberships').select('*').eq('status','current');
    if(opts.l1Code!==undefined)q=q.eq('l1_code',opts.l1Code);
    if(opts.unresolvedOnly)q=q.is('issuer_id',null);
    return q.order('ts_code').order('l3_code').order('in_date').order('id');
   })).map(sourceFromTable);
  },
  async recordResolutionError(ids,error){return Number(await call<unknown>('record_industry_source_resolution_error',{p_ids:ids,p_error:error}));},
  async applyMemberships(batch,issuer,scheme,version,input,sourceIds,resolution){
   return applyResult(await call<unknown>('apply_industry_memberships',{p_batch:batch,p_issuer:issuer,p_scheme:scheme,p_version:version,p_rows:input,p_source_ids:sourceIds,p_resolution:resolution}));
  },
  async correctMembershipWindows(batch,issuer,scheme,version,sourceId,rows){return correctResult(await call<unknown>('correct_industry_membership_windows',{p_batch:batch,p_issuer:issuer,p_scheme:scheme,p_version:version,p_source:sourceId,p_rows:rows}));},
  async applySicMembership(batch,issuer,observed,code,provenance,fence){
   const x=await call<{outcome:'inserted'|'duplicate'|'changed'|'none'}>('apply_sic_memberships',{p_batch:batch,p_issuer:issuer,p_version:'sec-current',p_observed:observed,p_code:code,p_provenance:provenance,p_lease_batch:fence.leaseBatch,p_sec_submissions:fence.secSubmissions??null});
   return x.outcome;
  },
  async membershipCandidates(q){
   return (await pageAll(()=>c.from('issuer_industry_memberships').select('*').eq('scheme',q.scheme).eq('version',q.version).eq('code',q.code).eq('level',q.level)
    .lte('valid_from',q.on).order('issuer_id').order('valid_from').order('membership_id'))).map(membershipFromTable);
  },
  async membershipsOfIssuer(issuer,q){
   return (await pageAll(()=>{
    let x=c.from('issuer_industry_memberships').select('*').eq('issuer_id',issuer);
    if(q.scheme!==undefined)x=x.eq('scheme',q.scheme);
    if(q.on!==undefined)x=x.lte('valid_from',q.on).or(`valid_to.is.null,valid_to.gt.${q.on}`);
    return x.order('scheme').order('version').order('level').order('valid_from').order('membership_id');
   })).map(membershipFromTable);
  },
  beginFetchEvent:(job,params,batch)=>call<string>('begin_industry_fetch_event',{p_job:job,p_params:params,p_batch:batch}),
  async retryFetchEvent(id){await call('retry_industry_fetch_event',{p_id:id});},
  async applyObservations(kind:'marks'|'official',fetchEventId:string,input:unknown[]){
   let out:ObservationResult={inserted:0,duplicates:0,superseded:0};
   for(const part of chunk(input,STAGE_CHUNK)){
    if(part.length===0)continue;
    out=addObservations(out,observationResult(await call<unknown>('apply_observations',{p_kind:kind,p_fetch_event:fetchEventId,p_rows:part})));
   }
   return out;
  },
  async currentMarksOn(tradeDate,tickers){
   const out:MarkRow[]=[];
   for(const part of chunkIds([...new Set(tickers)]))out.push(...(await pageAll(()=>c.from('security_marks').select('*').eq('trade_date',tradeDate).eq('status','ok').in('ticker',part).order('ticker'))).map(markFromTable));
   return out.sort((a,b)=>a.ticker<b.ticker?-1:a.ticker>b.ticker?1:0);
  },
  async createMetricRun(row){
   const x=await call<{run_id:string;generation:number|string}>('create_industry_metric_run',{p:newRunArgs(row)});
   return {runId:String(x.run_id),generation:Number(x.generation)};
  },
  async setMetricRunCoverage(run,summary){await call('set_industry_metric_run_coverage',{p_run:run,p_summary:summary});},
  async stageMetricRows(run,input){let n=0;for(const part of chunk(input,STAGE_CHUNK))n+=Number(await call<unknown>('stage_industry_metrics',{p_run:run,p_rows:stagedCellArgs(part)}));return n;},
  async stageRunDependencies(run,kind,input){let n=0;for(const part of chunk(input,DEPS_CHUNK))n+=Number(await call<unknown>('stage_industry_run_dependencies',{p_run:run,p_kind:kind,p_rows:part}));return n;},
  async activateMetricRun(run){const x=await call<{activated_at:string}>('activate_industry_metric_run',{p_run:run});return {activatedAt:isoTs(x.activated_at)};},
  async failRun(kind,run,reason){await call('fail_industry_run',{p_kind:kind,p_run:run,p_reason:reason});},
  async activeMetricRun(scheme,version,level){
   const r=await rows<Record<string,unknown>>(c.from('industry_metric_runs').select('*').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).eq('level',level).eq('status','active').limit(1));
   return r[0]?metricRunFromTable(r[0]):null;
  },
  async metricRun(run){const r=await rows<Record<string,unknown>>(c.from('industry_metric_runs').select('*').eq('run_id',run).limit(1));return r[0]?metricRunFromTable(r[0]):null;},
  async metricRowsOfRun(run,filter={}){
   return (await pageAll(()=>{
    let q=c.from('industry_metrics').select('*').eq('run_id',run);
    if(filter.codes)q=q.in('code',filter.codes);
    if(filter.metrics)q=q.in('metric',filter.metrics);
    if(filter.periodEnds)q=q.in('period_end',filter.periodEnds);
    if(filter.durations)q=q.in('duration',filter.durations);
    return q.order('code').order('metric').order('period_end').order('period_start');
   })).map(metricCellFromTable);
  },
  async runDependencies(kind,run){
   return (await pageAll(()=>c.from('industry_run_dependencies').select('cell_key,issuer_id,state_rev').eq('run_kind',kind).eq('run_id',run).order('cell_key').order('issuer_id'))).map(dependencyFromTable);
  },
  async activeValuationRun(scheme,version,level){
   const r=await rows<Record<string,unknown>>(c.from('industry_valuation_runs').select('*').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).eq('level',level).eq('status','active').limit(1));
   return r[0]?valuationRunFromTable(r[0]):null;

  async publishedValuations(run,filter){
   return (await pageAll(()=>{

  async manifestObjectPath(hash){const r=await rows<{object_path:string}>(c.from('industry_manifests').select('object_path').eq('manifest_hash',hash).limit(1));return r[0]?.object_path??null;},
  async manifestGcCandidates(limit){return gcClaimsFromJson(await call<unknown>('gc_industry_manifest_candidates',{p_limit:limit}));},

  async pruneRuns(keep){return Number(await call<unknown>('prune_industry_runs',{p_keep:keep}));},
  async stateFingerprint(market){return fingerprintFromJson(await call<unknown>('industry_state_fingerprint',{p_market:market}));},
  async freshness(){return freshnessFromJson(await call<unknown>('industry_freshness',{}));},
  async metricRunVisible(run){return (await call<unknown>('industry_metric_run_visible',{p_run:run}))===true;},
  async unresolvedCount(q){return distinctTsCodes(await unresolvedOf(q));},

// src/lib/industry/memory-industry-db.ts
// In-memory IndustryDb for unit tests (spec §4.9). It reproduces the SQL functions of migrations
// 20261111090000/20261111091000 so orchestrator tests see the database's behaviour: licence gate,
// classification nodes (insert-only, conflicts returned), source-record upsert (same key: duplicate
// or superseded + new current, `changed`), apply_industry_memberships (issuer-scoped, all-or-nothing:
// supersede via the superseded_by chain → close → insert with duplicate/conflict/overlap, resolution
// bookkeeping), the per-level exclusion over ok rows, apply_sic_memberships, fetch events and
// apply_observations (natural-key receipts, compare with the current observation, supersede then
// insert, mark_revised/official_revised quarantine items, atomic per call), metric runs (generation,
// building-only staging, completeness/dependency/obsolete/regression checks, one activation instant

// TableClient) and the unresolved-record count. Every method runs through one promise chain per
// instance (SQL: one transaction each); a failing call leaves no partial state. Decimal strings are
// stored as given (callers pass canonical decimals); market_cap is close × total_share with

const REQUIRED_DURATIONS:Record<AggMetric,readonly (readonly [AggDuration,boolean])[]>={revenue_sum:[['3M',false],['12M',true]],net_income_parent_sum:[['3M',false],['12M',true]],
 gross_margin:[['12M',true]],roe:[['TTM',false]],revenue_yoy:[['3M',false],['12M',true]],net_income_yoy:[['3M',false],['12M',true]],member_count:[['INSTANT',false]]};

export function memoryIndustryDb(opts:{tables?:TableClient;facts?:Pick<FactsDb,'scopeAll'>}={}):MemoryIndustryDb{
 const tables=opts.tables??memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],dq_freshness:['dataset']});
 interface State{
  licences:Map<string,LicenseStatus>;classes:Map<string,ClassificationRow>;sources:Map<string,SourceMembershipRow>;memberships:Map<string,MembershipRow>;
  events:Map<string,{job:string;params:Record<string,unknown>;batch_id:string;attempt:number;started_at:string}>;
  receipts:Map<string,{payload_hash:string;outcome:string;observation_id:string|null}>;marks:Map<string,MarkRow>;officials:Map<string,MemoryOfficialRow>;
  manifests:Map<string,{manifest_hash:string;kind:RunKind;byte_length:number;created_at:string;object_path:string;gc_claimed_at:string|null;gc_claim:string|null}>;
  runs:Map<string,MetricRunRow>;cells:Map<string,Map<string,MetricCellRow>>;deps:Map<string,Map<string,RunDependency>>;
  vruns:Map<string,ValuationRunRow>;vcells:Map<string,ValuationCellRow[]>;
 }
 let st:State={licences:new Map(Object.entries(DEFAULT_LICENSES)),classes:new Map(),sources:new Map(),memberships:new Map(),events:new Map(),receipts:new Map(),
  marks:new Map(),officials:new Map(),manifests:new Map(),runs:new Map(),cells:new Map(),deps:new Map(),vruns:new Map(),vcells:new Map()};
 let fixedNow:string|null=null;let last='';
 const now=()=>fixedNow??new Date().toISOString();
 /** Strictly increasing instants within one instance (SQL clock_timestamp()). */
 const tick=()=>{const t=now();last=t>last?t:new Date(Date.parse(last)+1).toISOString();return last;};
 const classKey=(s:string,v:string,c:string)=>`${s}|${v}|${c}`;
 const depKey=(kind:RunKind,run:string)=>`${kind}|${run}`;
 /** Runs fn on a copy of the state and installs it only when fn returns (SQL: the call is one transaction). */
 const atomic=async<T>(fn:(s:State)=>T|Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{const draft=clone(st);const out=await fn(draft);st=draft;return out;};

 const checkMembership=(s:State,m:MembershipRow)=>{
  const cls=s.classes.get(classKey(m.scheme,m.version,m.code));
  if(!cls)unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_scheme_version_code_fkey');
  if(cls!.level!==m.level)unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_classification_level_fkey');
  if(m.valid_to!==null&&m.valid_to<=m.valid_from)unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_window');
  if((m.valid_to===null)!==(m.valid_to_available_date===null))unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_pair');
  if(m.valid_to_available_date!==null&&m.valid_to_available_date<m.valid_from)unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_to_available_after');
 };
 const okRows=(s:State)=>[...s.memberships.values()].filter(m=>m.status==='ok');
 const insertMembership=(s:State,m:MembershipRow)=>{
  checkMembership(s,m);
  const ok=okRows(s);
  if(ok.some(o=>o.issuer_id===m.issuer_id&&o.scheme===m.scheme&&o.version===m.version&&o.code===m.code&&o.valid_from===m.valid_from))unknown('issuer_industry_memberships_ok_key');
  if(ok.some(o=>o.issuer_id===m.issuer_id&&o.scheme===m.scheme&&o.version===m.version&&o.level===m.level&&overlaps(o,m)))fail('membership_overlap',`membership_overlap: ${m.issuer_id} ${m.scheme} level ${m.level} from ${m.valid_from}`);
  s.memberships.set(m.membership_id,m);
 };
 const sortMemberships=(rows:MembershipRow[])=>rows.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.scheme,b.scheme)||cmp(a.version,b.version)||a.level-b.level||cmp(a.valid_from,b.valid_from)||cmp(a.membership_id,b.membership_id));
 const lockRun=(s:State,run:string)=>{const r=s.runs.get(run);if(!r)unknown('run_not_found');return r!;};
 const unreferenced=(s:State,hash:string)=>![...s.cells.values()].some(m=>[...m.values()].some(c=>c.manifest_hash===hash))&&![...s.vcells.values()].some(rows=>rows.some(c=>c.manifest_hash===hash));
 const oldEnough=(created:string)=>Date.parse(created)<=Date.parse(now())-MANIFEST_GC_GRACE_SECONDS*1000;
 const quarantineAfter=async(items:{dataset:string;table:string;key:string;reason:string;detail:Record<string,unknown>;batch:string}[])=>{
  for(const q of items){
   const open=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{dataset:q.dataset,table_name:q.table,natural_key:q.key,reason_code:q.reason,status:'open'});
   if(open.length)continue;
   await tables.insert('dq_quarantine',{id:randomUUID(),dataset:q.dataset,table_name:q.table,natural_key:q.key,reason_code:q.reason,detail:q.detail,payload:{},batch_id:q.batch,status:'open',resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:now()});
  }
 };
 const unresolvedOf=(q:{code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string}):ManifestUnresolved[]=>{
  const col=levelColumn(q.level);
  return [...st.sources.values()].filter(r=>r.status==='current'&&r.issuer_id===null&&r[col]===q.code&&r.in_date<=q.on&&r.in_date<=q.knownBy&&(r.out_date===null||r.out_date>=q.on))
   .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ts_code,b.ts_code)||cmp(a.in_date,b.in_date)||cmp(a.id,b.id))
   .map(r=>({ts_code:r.ts_code,in_date:r.in_date,out_date:r.out_date,source_membership_id:r.id}));
 };

 const applySicRow=(batch:string,issuer:string,observed:string,code:string,provenance:Record<string,unknown>)=>atomic(s=>{
    const node=s.classes.get(classKey('sic','sec-current',code));
    if(!node)unknown(`unknown_sic_code: ${code}`);
    const cur=okRows(s).filter(m=>m.issuer_id===issuer&&m.scheme==='sic'&&m.version==='sec-current'&&m.valid_to===null).sort((a,b)=>cmp(b.valid_from,a.valid_from))[0];
    let outcome:'inserted'|'duplicate'|'changed'='inserted';
    if(cur){
     if(cur.code===code)return 'duplicate' as const;
     if(cur.valid_from>=observed)fail('same_day_change',`same_day_change: issuer ${issuer} sic ${cur.code} -> ${code} on ${observed}`);
     cur.valid_to=observed;cur.valid_to_available_date=observed;outcome='changed';
    }
    insertMembership(s,{membership_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,scheme:'sic',version:'sec-current',code,level:node!.level,valid_from:observed,valid_to:null,available_date:observed,
     valid_to_available_date:null,source:'sec:submissions',source_membership_id:null,batch_id:batch,status:'ok',superseded_by:null,provenance:{...clone(provenance),availability:'observed'} as MembershipRow['provenance']});
    return outcome;
   });

 const raw:MemoryIndustryDb={
  tables,
  setNow:iso=>{fixedNow=iso===null?null:new Date(iso).toISOString();},
  seedValuationRun:(run,rows)=>{st.vruns.set(run.run_id,clone(run));st.vcells.set(run.run_id,clone(rows));},
  seedLicense:(key,status)=>{st.licences.set(key,status);},
  classifications:()=>clone([...st.classes.values()]),sources:()=>clone([...st.sources.values()]),memberships:()=>clone([...st.memberships.values()]),
  marks:()=>clone([...st.marks.values()]),officials:()=>clone([...st.officials.values()]),metricRuns:()=>clone([...st.runs.values()]),
  metricCells:()=>clone([...st.cells.values()].flatMap(m=>[...m.values()])),manifests:()=>clone([...st.manifests.values()]),

  upsertClassifications:(_batch,input)=>atomic(s=>{
   let inserted=0,unchanged=0;const conflicts:ClassificationRow[]=[];
   const fresh:ClassificationRow[]=[];
   for(const r of input){
    const e=s.classes.get(classKey(r.scheme,r.version,r.code));
    if(e){if(sameClassification(e,r))unchanged++;else conflicts.push(clone(r));continue;}
    if(!fresh.some(f=>f.scheme===r.scheme&&f.version===r.version&&f.code===r.code))fresh.push(r);
   }
   fresh.sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level||cmp(a.code,b.code));
   for(const r of fresh){
    if(r.name_zh===null&&r.name_en===null)unknown('industry_classifications_has_name');
    if(r.parent_code!==null&&!s.classes.has(classKey(r.scheme,r.version,r.parent_code)))unknown('industry_classifications_parent_fkey');
    s.classes.set(classKey(r.scheme,r.version,r.code),{...clone(r),attributes:clone(r.attributes??{})});inserted++;
   }
   return {inserted,unchanged,conflicts};
  }),
  async classificationTree(scheme,version){return clone([...st.classes.values()].filter(r=>r.scheme===scheme&&r.version===version).sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level||cmp(a.code,b.code)));},
  async setDatasetLicense(key,status,by){
   if(status!=='internal'&&status!=='public')unknown('invalid_status');
   if(!by||!by.trim())unknown('invalid_decided_by');
   if(!st.licences.has(key))unknown('invalid_dataset_key');
   st.licences.set(key,status);
  },
  async isDatasetPublic(key){return st.licences.get(key)==='public';},

  upsertSourceMemberships:(batch,input)=>atomic(s=>{
   let inserted=0,superseded=0,duplicates=0;const changed:{old_id:string;new_id:string;nullToDate:boolean}[]=[];
   const rows=[...input].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.source,b.source)||cmp(a.ts_code,b.ts_code)||cmp(a.l3_code,b.l3_code)||cmp(a.in_date,b.in_date));
   for(const x of rows){
    const cur=[...s.sources.values()].find(r=>r.status==='current'&&r.source===x.source&&r.ts_code===x.ts_code&&r.l3_code===x.l3_code&&r.in_date===x.in_date);
    if(cur&&cur.name===x.name&&cur.l1_code===x.l1_code&&cur.l2_code===x.l2_code&&cur.out_date===x.out_date){duplicates++;continue;}
    const id=randomUUID();
    if(cur){
     cur.status='superseded';cur.superseded_by=id;superseded++;
     changed.push({old_id:cur.id,new_id:id,nullToDate:cur.out_date===null&&x.out_date!==null&&cur.name===x.name&&cur.l1_code===x.l1_code&&cur.l2_code===x.l2_code});
    }else inserted++;
    s.sources.set(id,{id,scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',source:x.source,ts_code:x.ts_code,name:x.name,l1_code:x.l1_code,l2_code:x.l2_code,l3_code:x.l3_code,in_date:x.in_date,out_date:x.out_date,
     observed_at:new Date(x.observed_at).toISOString(),batch_id:batch,raw_hash:x.raw_hash,locator:clone(x.locator),status:'current',superseded_by:null,issuer_id:null,resolution:{},resolution_error:null});
   }
   return {inserted,superseded,duplicates,changed};
  }),
  async currentSourceMemberships(o){
   return clone([...st.sources.values()].filter(r=>r.status==='current'&&(o.l1Code===undefined||r.l1_code===o.l1Code)&&(!o.unresolvedOnly||r.issuer_id===null))
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ts_code,b.ts_code)||cmp(a.l3_code,b.l3_code)||cmp(a.in_date,b.in_date)||cmp(a.id,b.id)));
  },
  async recordResolutionError(ids,error){
   if(!error||typeof error.code!=='string'||!error.code)unknown('invalid_error');
   let n=0;for(const id of new Set(ids)){const r=st.sources.get(id);if(r&&r.status==='current'&&r.issuer_id===null){r.resolution_error=clone(error);n++;}}
   return n;
  },

  applyMemberships:(batch,issuer,scheme,version,input,sourceIds,resolution)=>atomic(s=>{
   for(const id of sourceIds){
    const m=s.sources.get(id);
    if(!m||m.status!=='current'||m.scheme!==scheme||(m.issuer_id!==null&&m.issuer_id!==issuer))fail('membership_conflict','membership_conflict: source records must be current, of the scheme, and unresolved or resolved to this issuer');
   }
   // 1 preallocate
   const targets=input.map((t,ord)=>({...clone(t),membership_id:randomUUID(),ord}));
   // 2 supersede (transitive predecessors of the given records)
   const old=new Set<string>();let frontier=[...sourceIds];
   while(frontier.length){const next:string[]=[];for(const r of s.sources.values())if(r.superseded_by!==null&&frontier.includes(r.superseded_by)&&!old.has(r.id)){old.add(r.id);next.push(r.id);}frontier=next;}
   // successor = the target of the same source lineage (the current descendant of the old row's record) and level
   const heir=(origin:string):string|null=>{let cur=s.sources.get(origin)?.superseded_by??null;const seen=new Set<string>();
    while(cur!==null&&!sourceIds.includes(cur)&&!seen.has(cur)){seen.add(cur);cur=s.sources.get(cur)?.superseded_by??null;}
    return cur!==null&&sourceIds.includes(cur)?cur:null;};
   let superseded=0;const succ=new Set<string>();
   for(const m of [...s.memberships.values()]){
    if(m.issuer_id!==issuer||m.scheme!==scheme||m.version!==version||m.status!=='ok'||m.source_membership_id===null||!old.has(m.source_membership_id))continue;
    const h=heir(m.source_membership_id);
    const t=h===null?undefined:targets.find(x=>x.level===m.level&&(x.provenance as Record<string,unknown>).source_membership_id===h);if(!t)continue;
    m.status='superseded';m.superseded_by=t.membership_id;superseded++;succ.add(t.membership_id);
   }
   // 3 close / 4 insert
   let inserted=0,closed=0,duplicates=0;const ids:string[]=[];const used=new Set<string>();
   for(const t of targets){
    const ex=okRows(s).find(e=>e.issuer_id===issuer&&e.scheme===scheme&&e.version===version&&e.code===t.code&&e.valid_from===t.valid_from);
    if(ex){
     if(ex.valid_to===null&&t.valid_to!==null&&ex.level===t.level){
      if(t.valid_to<=ex.valid_from||t.valid_to_available_date===null||t.valid_to_available_date<ex.valid_from)unknown('append_only: issuer_industry_memberships valid_to may only go from null to a date after valid_from');
      ex.valid_to=t.valid_to;ex.valid_to_available_date=t.valid_to_available_date;closed++;ids.push(ex.membership_id);used.add(t.membership_id);
     }else if(ex.level===t.level&&ex.valid_to===t.valid_to&&ex.available_date===t.available_date&&ex.valid_to_available_date===t.valid_to_available_date&&ex.source===t.source){
      duplicates++;ids.push(ex.membership_id);used.add(t.membership_id);
     }else fail('membership_conflict',`membership_conflict: ${issuer} ${scheme} ${t.code} level ${t.level} from ${t.valid_from} differs from the stored row`);
     continue;
    }
    const prov=t.provenance as Record<string,unknown>;
    insertMembership(s,{membership_id:t.membership_id,issuer_id:issuer,scheme,version,code:t.code,level:t.level,valid_from:t.valid_from,valid_to:t.valid_to,
     available_date:t.available_date,valid_to_available_date:t.valid_to_available_date,source:t.source,source_membership_id:typeof prov.source_membership_id==='string'&&prov.source_membership_id?prov.source_membership_id:null,
     batch_id:batch,status:'ok',superseded_by:null,provenance:clone(t.provenance)});
    inserted++;ids.push(t.membership_id);
   }
   if([...succ].some(id=>used.has(id)))fail('membership_conflict','membership_conflict: a superseded row would point at a replacement that was not inserted');
   // 5 resolution bookkeeping
   for(const id of sourceIds){const r=s.sources.get(id)!;r.issuer_id=issuer;r.resolution={...clone(resolution??{}),membership_ids:[...ids]};r.resolution_error=null;}
   return {inserted,closed,superseded,duplicates,membership_ids:ids} as ApplyMembershipsResult;
  }),
  correctMembershipWindows:(batch,issuer,scheme,version,sourceId,input)=>atomic(s=>{
   const src=s.sources.get(sourceId);
   if(!src||src.status!=='current'||src.scheme!==scheme||src.issuer_id!==issuer)fail('membership_conflict',`membership_conflict: source record ${sourceId} is not current and resolved to issuer ${issuer}`);
   let inserted=0,superseded=0,duplicates=0,quarantined=0;const ids:string[]=[];
   for(const t of input){
    if((t.provenance as Record<string,unknown>).source_membership_id!==sourceId)fail('membership_conflict','membership_conflict: correction targets must carry the source record');
    const old=okRows(s).find(m=>m.issuer_id===issuer&&m.scheme===scheme&&m.version===version&&m.source_membership_id===sourceId&&m.level===t.level&&m.code===t.code&&m.valid_from===t.valid_from);
    if(!old)fail('membership_conflict',`membership_conflict: no ok row of source ${sourceId} at level ${t.level} from ${t.valid_from}`);
    if(t.valid_to!==null&&t.valid_to<=old!.valid_from){   // empty corrected window (R3-1): quarantine, no successor
     old!.status='quarantined';old!.provenance={...old!.provenance,quarantine:{reason:'membership_after_delist',valid_to:t.valid_to,batch_id:batch}};
     quarantined++;ids.push(old!.membership_id);continue;
    }
    if(old!.valid_to===t.valid_to&&old!.valid_to_available_date===t.valid_to_available_date){duplicates++;ids.push(old!.membership_id);continue;}
    const id=randomUUID();
    old!.status='superseded';old!.superseded_by=id;
    insertMembership(s,{membership_id:id,issuer_id:issuer,scheme,version,code:old!.code,level:old!.level,valid_from:old!.valid_from,valid_to:t.valid_to,available_date:old!.available_date,
     valid_to_available_date:t.valid_to_available_date,source:t.source,source_membership_id:sourceId,batch_id:batch,status:'ok',superseded_by:null,provenance:clone(t.provenance)});
    superseded++;inserted++;ids.push(id);
   }
   return {inserted,closed:0,superseded,duplicates,quarantined,membership_ids:ids} as CorrectWindowsResult;
  }),
  // lease fence (Codex round 2 R2-3): the scope row (in `tables`) must still be leased to fence.leaseBatch and unexpired
  async applySicMembership(batch,issuer,observed,code,provenance,fence){
   const [lease]=await tables.select('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:issuer,job:'sic'},{limit:1});
   if(!lease||lease.lease_batch_id!==fence.leaseBatch||lease.lease_until==null||Date.parse(String(lease.lease_until))<=Date.parse(now()))fail('lease_lost');
   const outcome=code===null?'none' as const:await applySicRow(batch,issuer,observed,code,provenance);
   if(fence.secSubmissions!=null){
    const [iss]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer},{limit:1});
    if(iss){const prov=(iss.provenance&&typeof iss.provenance==='object'?iss.provenance:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;await tables.update('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer},{provenance:{...prov,sec_submissions:clone(fence.secSubmissions)},updated_at:now()});}
   }
   return outcome;
  },
  async membershipCandidates(q){
   return clone([...st.memberships.values()].filter(m=>m.scheme===q.scheme&&m.version===q.version&&m.code===q.code&&m.level===q.level&&m.valid_from<=q.on)
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.issuer_id,b.issuer_id)||cmp(a.valid_from,b.valid_from)||cmp(a.membership_id,b.membership_id)));
  },
  async membershipsOfIssuer(issuer,q){
   return clone(sortMemberships([...st.memberships.values()].filter(m=>m.issuer_id===issuer&&(q.scheme===undefined||m.scheme===q.scheme)
    &&(q.on===undefined||(m.valid_from<=q.on&&(m.valid_to===null||m.valid_to>q.on))))));
  },

  async beginFetchEvent(job,params,batch){
   if(!params||typeof params!=='object'||Array.isArray(params))unknown('invalid_params');
   const id=randomUUID();st.events.set(id,{job,params:clone(params),batch_id:batch,attempt:1,started_at:now()});return id;
  },
  async retryFetchEvent(id){const e=st.events.get(id);if(!e)unknown('fetch_event_not_found');e!.attempt++;},
  async applyObservations(kind:'marks'|'official',fetchEventId:string,input:unknown[]):Promise<ObservationResult>{
   const items:Parameters<typeof quarantineAfter>[0]=[];
   const out=await atomic(s=>{
    const ev=s.events.get(fetchEventId);if(!ev)unknown('fetch_event_not_found');
    let inserted=0,duplicates=0,superseded=0;
    const keyOf=(x:MarkInput|OfficialInput)=>kind==='marks'?`${(x as MarkInput).ticker}:${x.trade_date}`:`${(x as OfficialInput).scheme}:${(x as OfficialInput).version}:${(x as OfficialInput).code}:${x.trade_date}:${(x as OfficialInput).metric}`;
    const rows=[...(input as (MarkInput|OfficialInput)[])].sort((a,b)=>cmp(keyOf(a),keyOf(b)));
    for(const x of rows){
     const key=keyOf(x);const at=now();
     let hash:string;let status:'ok'|'quarantined'='ok';
     if(kind==='marks'){
      const m=x as MarkInput;status=m.status??'ok';
      if(status!=='ok'&&status!=='quarantined')unknown('invalid_status');
      if(decSign(m.close)<=0)unknown('security_marks_close_check');
      if(decSign(m.total_share)<=0)unknown('security_marks_total_share_check');
      if(m.free_share!=null&&decSign(m.free_share)<=0)unknown('security_marks_free_share_check');
      hash=sha256(`${trimScale(m.close)}|${trimScale(m.total_share)}|${status}|${m.free_share==null?'':trimScale(m.free_share)}`);
     }else hash=sha256(trimScale((x as OfficialInput).value));
     const rk=`${fetchEventId}|${kind}|${key}`;const rc=s.receipts.get(rk);
     if(rc){if(rc.payload_hash!==hash)fail('fetch_event_payload_changed',`fetch_event_payload_changed: ${kind} ${key} in event ${fetchEventId}`);duplicates++;continue;}
     let outcome:'inserted'|'duplicate'|'superseded_previous';let obsId:string;
     if(kind==='marks'){
      const m=x as MarkInput;
      const cur=status==='ok'?[...s.marks.values()].find(r=>r.ticker===m.ticker&&r.trade_date===m.trade_date&&r.status==='ok'):undefined;
      const sameFree=(cur?.free_share??null)===null||(m.free_share??null)===null?(cur?.free_share??null)===(m.free_share??null):decEq(cur!.free_share!,m.free_share!);
      if(cur&&decEq(cur.close,m.close)&&decEq(cur.total_share,m.total_share)&&sameFree){outcome='duplicate';obsId=cur.observation_id;duplicates++;}
      else{
       if(cur)cur.status='superseded';
       obsId=randomUUID();
       s.marks.set(obsId,{observation_id:obsId,ticker:m.ticker,trade_date:m.trade_date,fetch_event_id:fetchEventId,observed_at:at,close:m.close,total_share:m.total_share,free_share:m.free_share??null,
        market_cap:mulDecimalText(m.close,m.total_share),source:m.source,upstream:m.upstream,raw_hash:m.raw_hash,locator:clone(m.locator),batch_id:ev!.batch_id,status,supersedes:cur?.observation_id??null});
       if(cur){outcome='superseded_previous';superseded++;items.push({dataset:'industry.marks',table:'security_marks',key,reason:'mark_revised',detail:{previous:cur.observation_id,current:obsId,fetch_event_id:fetchEventId},batch:ev!.batch_id});}
       else{outcome='inserted';inserted++;}
      }
     }else{
      const o=x as OfficialInput;
      const cur=[...s.officials.values()].find(r=>r.scheme===o.scheme&&r.version===o.version&&r.code===o.code&&r.trade_date===o.trade_date&&r.metric===o.metric&&r.status==='ok');
      if(cur&&decEq(cur.value,o.value)){outcome='duplicate';obsId=cur.observation_id;duplicates++;}
      else{
       if(cur)cur.status='superseded';
       obsId=randomUUID();
       s.officials.set(obsId,{observation_id:obsId,scheme:o.scheme,version:o.version,code:o.code,trade_date:o.trade_date,metric:o.metric,fetch_event_id:fetchEventId,value:o.value,observed_at:at,
        source:o.source,upstream:o.upstream,raw_hash:o.raw_hash,locator:clone(o.locator),batch_id:ev!.batch_id,status:'ok',supersedes:cur?.observation_id??null});
       if(cur){outcome='superseded_previous';superseded++;items.push({dataset:'industry.official',table:'industry_official_valuations',key,reason:'official_revised',detail:{previous:cur.observation_id,current:obsId,fetch_event_id:fetchEventId},batch:ev!.batch_id});}
       else{outcome='inserted';inserted++;}
      }
     }
     s.receipts.set(rk,{payload_hash:hash,outcome,observation_id:obsId});
    }
    return {inserted,duplicates,superseded};
   });
   await quarantineAfter(items);
   return out;
  },
  async currentMarksOn(tradeDate,tickers){
   const want=new Set(tickers);
   return clone([...st.marks.values()].filter(m=>m.trade_date===tradeDate&&m.status==='ok'&&want.has(m.ticker)).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ticker,b.ticker)));
  },

  createMetricRun:row=>atomic(s=>{
   if(!row.batch_id)unknown('invalid_batch');
   const generation=Math.max(0,...[...s.runs.values()].filter(r=>r.scheme===row.scheme&&r.version===row.version&&r.level===row.level).map(r=>r.generation))+1;
   const run_id=randomUUID();
   s.runs.set(run_id,{...clone(row),fingerprint_at:new Date(row.fingerprint_at).toISOString(),run_id,generation,status:'building',coverage_summary:{},created_at:now(),activated_at:null});
   s.cells.set(run_id,new Map());
   return {runId:run_id,generation};
  }),
  async setMetricRunCoverage(run,summary){
   if(!summary||typeof summary!=='object'||Array.isArray(summary))unknown('invalid_summary');
   const r=lockRun(st,run);if(r.status!=='building')fail('run_not_building');r.coverage_summary=clone(summary);
  },
  stageMetricRows:(run,input)=>atomic(s=>{
   const r=lockRun(s,run);if(r.status!=='building')fail('run_not_building');
   const cells=s.cells.get(run)!;
   for(const c of input as StagedMetricCell[]){
    if(!AGG_METRICS.includes(c.metric))unknown('industry_metrics_metric_check');
    if(c.missing_reason!==null&&!MISSING.includes(c.missing_reason))unknown('industry_metrics_missing_reason_check');
    if((c.status==='ok')!==(c.value!==null))unknown('industry_metrics_ok_value');
    if((c.status==='ok')!==(c.manifest_hash!==null))unknown('industry_metrics_ok_manifest');
    if((c.status==='missing')!==(c.missing_reason!==null))unknown('industry_metrics_missing_reason');
    if(c.manifest_hash!==null&&!s.manifests.has(c.manifest_hash))unknown('industry_metrics_manifest_hash_fkey');
    if(c.manifest_hash!==null&&s.manifests.get(c.manifest_hash)!.gc_claimed_at!==null)fail('manifest_gc_in_progress');
    cells.set(`${c.code}|${c.metric}|${c.period_start}|${c.period_end}`,{...clone(c),run_id:run,updated_at:null});
   }
   return input.length;
  }),
  stageRunDependencies:(run,kind,input)=>atomic(s=>{
   if(kind==='aggregate'){const r=lockRun(s,run);if(r.status!=='building')fail('run_not_building');}
   else{const v=s.vruns.get(run);if(!v)unknown('run_not_found');if(v!.status!=='building')fail('run_not_building');}
   const k=depKey(kind,run);const m=s.deps.get(k)??new Map<string,RunDependency>();s.deps.set(k,m);
   for(const d of input)m.set(`${d.cell_key}|${d.issuer_id}`,{cell_key:d.cell_key,issuer_id:d.issuer_id,state_rev:Number(d.state_rev)});
   return input.length;
  }),
  activateMetricRun:run=>atomic(s=>{
   const r=lockRun(s,run);if(r.status!=='building')fail('run_not_building');
   const cells=[...s.cells.get(run)!.values()];
   for(const code of r.expected_grid.codes)for(const pe of r.expected_grid.period_ends)for(const metric of r.expected_grid.metrics)
    for(const [duration,decOnly] of REQUIRED_DURATIONS[metric]){
     if(decOnly&&pe.slice(5)!=='12-31')continue;
     if(!cells.some(c=>c.code===code&&c.metric===metric&&c.duration===duration&&c.period_end===pe))fail('incomplete_run');
    }
   const deps=[...(s.deps.get(depKey('aggregate',run))?.values()??[])];
   const perCell=new Map<string,number>();
   for(const c of cells){const k=`${c.code}:${c.period_end}`;perCell.set(k,Math.max(perCell.get(k)??0,c.n_members));}
   for(const [k,n] of perCell)if(deps.filter(d=>d.cell_key===k).length!==n)fail('dependencies_incomplete');
   const active=[...s.runs.values()].find(a=>a.scheme===r.scheme&&a.version===r.version&&a.level===r.level&&a.status==='active');
   if(active){
    if(r.generation<=active.generation||r.facts_as_of<active.facts_as_of)fail('obsolete_run');
    const mine=new Map(deps.map(d=>[`${d.cell_key}|${d.issuer_id}`,d.state_rev]));
    for(const o of s.deps.get(depKey('aggregate',active.run_id))?.values()??[]){const n=mine.get(`${o.cell_key}|${o.issuer_id}`);if(n!==undefined&&n<o.state_rev)fail('dependency_regression');}
    active.status='superseded';
   }
   const t=tick();
   r.status='active';r.activated_at=t;
   for(const c of cells)c.updated_at=t;
   return {activatedAt:t};
  }),
  async failRun(kind,run,reason){
   if(kind==='aggregate'){
    const r=lockRun(st,run);if(r.status!=='building')fail('illegal_transition',`illegal_transition: aggregate run ${run} is ${r.status}`);
    r.status='failed';r.coverage_summary={...r.coverage_summary,failure_reason:reason};
   }else{
    const v=st.vruns.get(run);if(!v)unknown('run_not_found');
    if(v!.status!=='building'&&v!.status!=='published')fail('illegal_transition',`illegal_transition: valuation run ${run} is ${v!.status}`);
    v!.status='failed';v!.reconciliation={...v!.reconciliation,failure_reason:reason};
   }
  },
  async activeMetricRun(scheme,version,level){const r=[...st.runs.values()].find(x=>x.scheme===scheme&&x.version===version&&x.level===level&&x.status==='active');return r?clone(r):null;},
  async metricRun(run){const r=st.runs.get(run);return r?clone(r):null;},
  async metricRowsOfRun(run,filter={}){
   return clone([...(st.cells.get(run)?.values()??[])].filter(c=>(!filter.codes||filter.codes.includes(c.code))&&(!filter.metrics||filter.metrics.includes(c.metric))
    &&(!filter.periodEnds||filter.periodEnds.includes(c.period_end))&&(!filter.durations||filter.durations.includes(c.duration)))
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.code,b.code)||cmp(a.metric,b.metric)||cmp(a.period_end,b.period_end)||cmp(a.period_start,b.period_start)));
  },
  async runDependencies(kind,run){return clone([...(st.deps.get(depKey(kind,run))?.values()??[])].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.cell_key,b.cell_key)||cmp(a.issuer_id,b.issuer_id)));},

  async activeValuationRun(scheme,version,level){const r=[...st.vruns.values()].find(x=>x.scheme===scheme&&x.version===version&&x.level===level&&x.status==='active');return r?clone(r):null;},
  async publishedValuations(run,filter){
   return clone((st.vcells.get(run)??[]).filter(c=>c.published&&VAL_METRICS.includes(c.metric)&&(!filter.codes||filter.codes.includes(c.code))&&(filter.from===undefined||c.trade_date>=filter.from)&&(filter.to===undefined||c.trade_date<=filter.to))
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.code,b.code)||cmp(a.metric,b.metric)||cmp(a.trade_date,b.trade_date)));
  },

  async registerManifest(hash,kind,byteLength){
   if(!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(hash))unknown('industry_manifests_manifest_hash_check');
   if(!(byteLength>0))unknown('industry_manifests_byte_length_check');
   const e=st.manifests.get(hash);
   if(e){if(e.gc_claimed_at!==null)fail('manifest_gc_in_progress');e.created_at=now();return false;}
   st.manifests.set(hash,{manifest_hash:hash,kind,byte_length:byteLength,created_at:now(),object_path:`sha256/${hash}/${randomUUID()}.json.gz`,gc_claimed_at:null,gc_claim:null});return true;
  },
  async manifestObjectPath(hash){return st.manifests.get(hash)?.object_path??null;},
  async manifestGcCandidates(limit){
   if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1)unknown('invalid_limit');
   const t=now();const staleClaim=(c:string|null)=>c===null||Date.parse(c)<=Date.parse(t)-3_600_000;
   const picked=[...st.manifests.values()].filter(m=>oldEnough(m.created_at)&&staleClaim(m.gc_claimed_at)&&unreferenced(st,m.manifest_hash))
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.created_at,b.created_at)||cmp(a.manifest_hash,b.manifest_hash)).slice(0,limit);
   for(const m of picked){m.gc_claimed_at=t;m.gc_claim=randomUUID();}   // claim (tombstone) with a fresh token: see put_industry_manifest
   return picked.map(m=>({hash:m.manifest_hash,objectPath:m.object_path,claim:m.gc_claim!})) as ManifestGcClaim[];
  },
  async deleteManifestIndex(claims){
   let n=0;for(const c of claims){const m=st.manifests.get(c.hash);if(m&&m.gc_claim===c.claim&&m.gc_claimed_at!==null&&oldEnough(m.created_at)&&unreferenced(st,c.hash)){st.manifests.delete(c.hash);n++;}}
   return n;
  },
  async pruneRuns(keep){
   if(!Number.isInteger(keep)||keep<1)unknown('invalid_keep');
   let n=0;
   const families=new Map<string,MetricRunRow[]>();
   for(const r of st.runs.values())if(r.status==='superseded'){const k=`${r.scheme}|${r.version}|${r.level}`;families.set(k,[...(families.get(k)??[]),r]);}
   for(const rows of families.values())for(const r of rows.sort((a,b)=>b.generation-a.generation).slice(keep)){st.runs.delete(r.run_id);st.cells.delete(r.run_id);st.deps.delete(depKey('aggregate',r.run_id));n++;}
   const vfam=new Map<string,ValuationRunRow[]>();
   for(const r of st.vruns.values())if(r.status==='superseded'){const k=`${r.scheme}|${r.version}|${r.level}`;vfam.set(k,[...(vfam.get(k)??[]),r]);}
   for(const rows of vfam.values())for(const r of rows.sort((a,b)=>b.generation-a.generation).slice(keep)){st.vruns.delete(r.run_id);st.vcells.delete(r.run_id);st.deps.delete(depKey('valuation',r.run_id));n++;}
   for(const r of st.runs.values())if(r.reused_from_run!==null&&!st.runs.has(r.reused_from_run))r.reused_from_run=null;   // FK on delete set null
   for(const r of st.vruns.values())if(r.carried_from_run!==null&&!st.vruns.has(r.carried_from_run))r.carried_from_run=null;
   return n;
  },
  async stateFingerprint(market){
   const rows=opts.facts?await opts.facts.scopeAll(market):[];
   return {takenAt:tick(),revs:new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.issuer_id,r.state_rev]))};
  },
  async freshness():Promise<FreshnessRow[]>{
   const rows=(await tables.select('dq_freshness',{})).filter(r=>String(r.dataset).startsWith('industry.'));
   return rows.map(r=>({dataset:String(r.dataset),status:r.status as FreshnessRow['status'],last_ok_at:r.last_ok_at===null||r.last_ok_at===undefined?null:new Date(String(r.last_ok_at)).toISOString()}))
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.dataset,b.dataset));
  },
  async metricRunVisible(run){const r=st.runs.get(run);return !!r&&r.status==='active'&&st.licences.get(`scheme:${r.scheme}:${r.version}`)==='public';},
  async unresolvedCount(q){return distinctTsCodes(unresolvedOf(q));},
  async unresolvedOf(q){return unresolvedOf(q);},
 };
 // Every IndustryDb method runs through one promise chain per instance, so no call observes another's partial work.
 let chain:Promise<unknown>=Promise.resolve();
 const serialize=<A extends unknown[],T>(fn:(...a:A)=>Promise<T>)=>(...a:A):Promise<T>=>{const next=chain.then(()=>fn(...a));chain=next.catch(()=>undefined);return next;};
 const db={...raw} as MemoryIndustryDb;
 for(const k of ASYNC_METHODS){
  const f=raw[k] as unknown as (...a:unknown[])=>Promise<unknown>;
  (db as unknown as Record<string,unknown>)[k]=serialize(f);
 }
 return db;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Task 4: pgIndustryDb against the shared contract
async function pgHarness():Promise<IndustryContractHarness>{
 const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
 const pool=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,statement_timeout:8000});   // a regression that blocks fails cleanly instead of hanging afterAll
 const q=(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>pool.query(text,values);
 return {
  db:pgIndustryDb(pool),tables:pgTableClient(pool),
  issuer:async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_zh) values($1,'行业契约测试')`,[id]);return id;},
  batch:async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,'industry-test','industry.test')`,[id]);return id;},
  ticker:async()=>{const t=`ZZ${hex(4).toUpperCase()}`;await q(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,'Industry Contract','A')`,[t]);return t;},
  version:async()=>{const v=`t${hex(4)}`;await q(`insert into public.industry_dataset_licenses(dataset_key,status,decided_by) values($1,'internal','industry-test')`,[`scheme:sw2021:${v}`]);return v;},
  factScope:async(issuer,rev)=>{await q(`insert into public.fact_sync_scope(issuer_id,market,fetch_key,state_rev) values($1,'CN','x',$2)`,[issuer,rev]);},
  ageManifest:async(hash,seconds)=>{await q(`update public.industry_manifests set created_at=created_at-make_interval(secs=>$2) where manifest_hash=$1`,[hash,seconds]);},
  close:async()=>{await pool.end();},
 };
}

```ts
// src/lib/industry/pg-industry-db.ts
// TEST-ONLY IndustryDb over node-postgres that calls the same SQL functions supabaseIndustryDb calls
// through rpc, so the shared contract and the offline integration tests (Task 14) exercise the real
// schema: locks, triggers, exclusion constraints, generations, receipts. Nothing in src/app imports
// this. date/timestamptz come back as text (pg-table-client typeParsers), jsonb is parsed, numeric and
// bigint arrive as strings; every row goes through the db.ts normalisers (decimals from *_text,
// timestamps in toISOString() form) and errors through toIndustryDbError, exactly like the Supabase
// adapter. The pool's role is whatever the caller connected as (tests use the admin role).
import type {Pool} from 'pg';
import {chunkIds} from '../facts/db';
import type {PgErrorLike} from '../facts/db';
import {ident,typeParsers} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {
 DEPS_CHUNK,STAGE_CHUNK,addObservations,applyResult,classificationFromTable,correctResult,dependencyFromTable,distinctTsCodes,fingerprintFromJson,freshnessFromJson,gcClaimsFromJson,levelColumn,
 markFromTable,membershipFromTable,metricCellFromTable,metricRunFromTable,newRunArgs,observationResult,sameClassification,sourceArgs,sourceFromTable,
 stagedCellArgs,toIndustryDbError,unresolvedFromTable,upsertSourceResult,valuationCellFromTable,valuationRunFromTable,
} from './db';
import type {ClassificationRow,IndustryDb,ObservationResult} from './types';

const parts=<T>(rows:T[],size:number):T[][]=>{if(rows.length===0)return [[]];const out:T[][]=[];for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i+=size)out.push(rows.slice(i,i+size));return out;};

export function pgIndustryDb(pool:Pool):IndustryDb{
 const run=async(text:string,values:unknown[])=>{
  try{return await pool.query({text,values,types:typeParsers});}
  catch(e){throw toIndustryDbError(e as PgErrorLike);}
 };
 const fn=async<T>(call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>(await run(`select ${call} as v`,values)).rows[0].v as T;
 const rel=(table:string)=>`${ident('public')}.${ident(table)}`;
 const unresolvedOf=async(q:{code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string})=>{
  const col=ident(levelColumn(q.level));
  return (await run(`select id, ts_code, in_date, out_date from ${rel('industry_source_memberships')}
   where status = 'current' and issuer_id is null and ${col} = $1 and in_date <= $2::date and in_date <= $3::date and (out_date is null or out_date >= $2::date)
   order by ts_code, in_date, id`,[q.code,q.on,q.knownBy])).rows.map(unresolvedFromTable);
 };
 const db:IndustryDb={
  async upsertClassifications(_batch,input){
   let inserted=0,unchanged=0;const conflicts:ClassificationRow[]=[];
   const groups=new Map<string,ClassificationRow[]>();
   for(const r of input){const k=`${r.scheme}\u0000${r.version}`;groups.set(k,[...(groups.get(k)??[]),r]);}
   for(const group of groups.values()){
    const existing=new Map((await db.classificationTree(group[0].scheme,group[0].version)).map(r=>[r.code,r]));
    const fresh:ClassificationRow[]=[];
    for(const r of group){
     const e=existing.get(r.code);
     if(!e){if(!fresh.some(f=>f.code===r.code))fresh.push(r);continue;}
     if(sameClassification(e,r))unchanged++;else conflicts.push(r);
    }
    fresh.sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level||(a.code<b.code?-1:a.code>b.code?1:0));
    for(const r of fresh){
     await run(`insert into ${rel('industry_classifications')} (scheme, version, code, level, name_zh, name_en, parent_code, attributes) values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb)`,
      [r.scheme,r.version,r.code,r.level,r.name_zh,r.name_en,r.parent_code,JSON.stringify(r.attributes??{})]);
     inserted++;
    }
   }
   return {inserted,unchanged,conflicts};
  },
  async classificationTree(scheme,version){
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_classifications')} where scheme = $1 and version = $2 order by level, code`,[scheme,version])).rows.map(classificationFromTable);
  },
  async setDatasetLicense(key,status,by,note){await fn('public.set_industry_dataset_license($1,$2,$3,$4)',[key,status,by,note]);},
  isDatasetPublic:key=>fn<boolean>('public.industry_dataset_is_public($1)',[key]),
  async upsertSourceMemberships(batch,input){
   const out={inserted:0,superseded:0,duplicates:0,changed:[] as {old_id:string;new_id:string;nullToDate:boolean}[]};
   for(const part of parts(input,STAGE_CHUNK)){
    if(part.length===0)continue;
    const r=upsertSourceResult(await fn<unknown>('public.upsert_industry_source_memberships($1,$2::jsonb)',[batch,JSON.stringify(sourceArgs(part))]));
    out.inserted+=r.inserted;out.superseded+=r.superseded;out.duplicates+=r.duplicates;out.changed.push(...r.changed);
   }
   return out;
  },
  async currentSourceMemberships(opts){
   const values:unknown[]=[];let where=`status = 'current'`;
   if(opts.l1Code!==undefined){values.push(opts.l1Code);where+=` and l1_code = $${values.length}`;}
   if(opts.unresolvedOnly)where+=` and issuer_id is null`;
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_source_memberships')} where ${where} order by ts_code, l3_code, in_date, id`,values)).rows.map(sourceFromTable);
  },
  async recordResolutionError(ids,error){return Number(await fn<unknown>('public.record_industry_source_resolution_error($1::uuid[],$2::jsonb)',[ids,JSON.stringify(error)]));},
  async applyMemberships(batch,issuer,scheme,version,input,sourceIds,resolution){
   return applyResult(await fn<unknown>('public.apply_industry_memberships($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::uuid[],$7::jsonb)',[batch,issuer,scheme,version,JSON.stringify(input),sourceIds,JSON.stringify(resolution)]));
  },
  async correctMembershipWindows(batch,issuer,scheme,version,sourceId,rows){return correctResult(await fn<unknown>('public.correct_industry_membership_windows($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)',[batch,issuer,scheme,version,sourceId,JSON.stringify(rows)]));},
  async applySicMembership(batch,issuer,observed,code,provenance,fence){
   return (await fn<{outcome:'inserted'|'duplicate'|'changed'|'none'}>(`public.apply_sic_memberships($1,$2,'sec-current',$3::date,$4,$5::jsonb,$6,$7::jsonb)`,[batch,issuer,observed,code,JSON.stringify(provenance),fence.leaseBatch,fence.secSubmissions==null?null:JSON.stringify(fence.secSubmissions)])).outcome;
  },
  async membershipCandidates(q){
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('issuer_industry_memberships')} where scheme = $1 and version = $2 and code = $3 and level = $4 and valid_from <= $5::date order by issuer_id, valid_from, membership_id`,
    [q.scheme,q.version,q.code,q.level,q.on])).rows.map(membershipFromTable);
  },
  async membershipsOfIssuer(issuer,q){
   const values:unknown[]=[issuer];let where='issuer_id = $1';
   if(q.scheme!==undefined){values.push(q.scheme);where+=` and scheme = $${values.length}`;}
   if(q.on!==undefined){values.push(q.on);where+=` and valid_from <= $${values.length}::date and (valid_to is null or valid_to > $${values.length}::date)`;}
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('issuer_industry_memberships')} where ${where} order by scheme, version, level, valid_from, membership_id`,values)).rows.map(membershipFromTable);
  },
  beginFetchEvent:(job,params,batch)=>fn<string>('public.begin_industry_fetch_event($1,$2::jsonb,$3)',[job,JSON.stringify(params),batch]),
  async retryFetchEvent(id){await fn('public.retry_industry_fetch_event($1)',[id]);},
  async applyObservations(kind:'marks'|'official',fetchEventId:string,input:unknown[]){
   let out:ObservationResult={inserted:0,duplicates:0,superseded:0};
   for(const part of parts(input,STAGE_CHUNK)){
    if(part.length===0)continue;
    out=addObservations(out,observationResult(await fn<unknown>('public.apply_observations($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[kind,fetchEventId,JSON.stringify(part)])));
   }
   return out;
  },
  async currentMarksOn(tradeDate,tickers){
   const out=[];
   for(const part of chunkIds([...new Set(tickers)]))out.push(...(await run(`select * from ${rel('security_marks')} where trade_date = $1::date and status = 'ok' and ticker = any($2::text[]) order by ticker`,[tradeDate,part])).rows.map(markFromTable));
   return out.sort((a,b)=>a.ticker<b.ticker?-1:a.ticker>b.ticker?1:0);
  },
  async createMetricRun(row){
   const x=await fn<{run_id:string;generation:number|string}>('public.create_industry_metric_run($1::jsonb)',[JSON.stringify(newRunArgs(row))]);
   return {runId:String(x.run_id),generation:Number(x.generation)};
  },
  async setMetricRunCoverage(r,summary){await fn('public.set_industry_metric_run_coverage($1,$2::jsonb)',[r,JSON.stringify(summary)]);},
  async stageMetricRows(r,input){let n=0;for(const part of parts(input,STAGE_CHUNK))n+=Number(await fn<unknown>('public.stage_industry_metrics($1,$2::jsonb)',[r,JSON.stringify(stagedCellArgs(part))]));return n;},
  async stageRunDependencies(r,kind,input){let n=0;for(const part of parts(input,DEPS_CHUNK))n+=Number(await fn<unknown>('public.stage_industry_run_dependencies($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[r,kind,JSON.stringify(part)]));return n;},
  async activateMetricRun(r){const x=await fn<{activated_at:string}>('public.activate_industry_metric_run($1)',[r]);return {activatedAt:new Date(x.activated_at).toISOString()};},
  async failRun(kind,r,reason){await fn('public.fail_industry_run($1,$2,$3)',[kind,r,reason]);},
  async activeMetricRun(scheme,version,level){
   const rows=(await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_metric_runs')} where scheme = $1 and version = $2 and level = $3 and status = 'active'`,[scheme,version,level])).rows;
   return rows[0]?metricRunFromTable(rows[0]):null;
  },
  async metricRun(r){const rows=(await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_metric_runs')} where run_id = $1`,[r])).rows;return rows[0]?metricRunFromTable(rows[0]):null;},
  async metricRowsOfRun(r,filter={}){
   const values:unknown[]=[r];let where='run_id = $1';
   if(filter.codes){values.push(filter.codes);where+=` and code = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   if(filter.metrics){values.push(filter.metrics);where+=` and metric = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   if(filter.periodEnds){values.push(filter.periodEnds);where+=` and period_end = any($${values.length}::date[])`;}
   if(filter.durations){values.push(filter.durations);where+=` and duration = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_metrics')} where ${where} order by code, metric, period_end, period_start`,values)).rows.map(metricCellFromTable);
  },
  async runDependencies(kind,r){
   return (await run(`select cell_key, issuer_id, state_rev from ${rel('industry_run_dependencies')} where run_kind = $1 and run_id = $2 order by cell_key, issuer_id`,[kind,r])).rows.map(dependencyFromTable);
  },
  async activeValuationRun(scheme,version,level){
   const rows=(await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_valuation_runs')} where scheme = $1 and version = $2 and level = $3 and status = 'active'`,[scheme,version,level])).rows;
   return rows[0]?valuationRunFromTable(rows[0]):null;
  },
  async publishedValuations(r,filter){
   const values:unknown[]=[r];let where='run_id = $1 and published';
   if(filter.codes){values.push(filter.codes);where+=` and code = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   if(filter.from!==undefined){values.push(filter.from);where+=` and trade_date >= $${values.length}::date`;}
   if(filter.to!==undefined){values.push(filter.to);where+=` and trade_date <= $${values.length}::date`;}
   return (await run(`select * from ${rel('industry_valuations')} where ${where} order by code, metric, trade_date`,values)).rows.map(valuationCellFromTable);
  },
  registerManifest:(hash,kind,byteLength)=>fn<boolean>('public.put_industry_manifest($1,$2,$3)',[hash,kind,byteLength]),
  async manifestObjectPath(hash){return ((await run(`select object_path from ${rel('industry_manifests')} where manifest_hash = $1`,[hash])).rows[0]?.object_path as string|undefined)??null;},
  async manifestGcCandidates(limit){return gcClaimsFromJson(await fn<unknown>('public.gc_industry_manifest_candidates($1)',[limit]));},
  async deleteManifestIndex(claims){return Number(await fn<unknown>('public.delete_industry_manifests($1::jsonb)',[JSON.stringify(claims)]));},
  async pruneRuns(keep){return Number(await fn<unknown>('public.prune_industry_runs($1)',[keep]));},
  async stateFingerprint(market){return fingerprintFromJson(await fn<unknown>('public.industry_state_fingerprint($1)',[market]));},
  async freshness(){return freshnessFromJson(await fn<unknown>('public.industry_freshness()',[]));},
  metricRunVisible:r=>fn<boolean>('public.industry_metric_run_visible($1)',[r]),
  async unresolvedCount(q){return distinctTsCodes(await unresolvedOf(q));},
  unresolvedOf,
 };
 return db;
}
```

### Task 5: Tushare industry adapters, recorded fixtures, A-share issuer load

**Files:**
- Create (copy, byte-for-byte): `src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare/*.json` — 33 real Tushare recordings from `.claude/scratch/tushare-verify/fixtures/` (spec 7th draft K1–K3; evidence `docs/audits/2026-11-06-industry-research/03-tushare-verification.md`)
- Create (copy, byte-for-byte): `src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare/paging/index_member_all-801120.SI-Y-limit50-p{0,1,2}.json` (paging evidence)
- Create: `src/lib/industry/providers/tushare-industry.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/industry/load-a-share.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/providers/tushare-industry.test.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/load-a-share.test.ts`

The fixtures are **real** recordings (2026-11-06, `tushareCallRaw`, no token inside any file). Envelope: `{request:{api_name,params,fields}, response_sha256, request_id, code, msg, data:{fields,items,has_more}}`; `data` is the upstream payload unchanged and `response_sha256` hashes the original response bytes. What they contain:

- `index_classify-SW2021-L{1,2,3}.json`: the complete SW2021 tree, **31 / 134 / 346** nodes; `parent_code` is in the `industry_code` namespace (L1 `parent_code='0'`).
- `index_member_all-801120.SI-{Y,N}-p0.json` (食品饮料: 129 current / 58 historical rows) and `index_member_all-801780.SI-{Y,N}-p0.json` (银行: 42 / 0). `out_date` is the **last member day, inclusive** (K3); delisting does not close a window (`002770.SZ` 科迪, delisted 2022-06-23, is still `Y 20150119–null`); `000869.SZ` 张裕 has two adjacent records on the same L3 code; `600090.SH` left 食品饮料 on 2017-06-28 and delisted 2022-07-07.
- `paging/index_member_all-801120.SI-Y-limit50-p{0,1,2}.json`: the same 129 rows recorded with `limit=50` (50/50/29, `has_more` true/true/false).
- `stock_basic-<ts_code>.json` ×12: ten listed (`000001.SZ 000858.SZ 000869.SZ 600036.SH 600519.SH 600887.SH 601166.SH 601318.SH 601398.SH 603288.SH`) and two delisted (`002770.SZ` 2022-06-23, `600090.SH` 2022-07-07; recorded with `list_status='D'` — `stock_basic` returns only `L` unless asked). No `P` row exists upstream.
- `daily_basic-20261030-<ts_code>.json` ×10 (used by Task 13), `sw_daily-*.json` ×2, `trade_cal-SSE-202610.json`, `income-002770.SZ-delisted.json` (kept as evidence for the deferred I-3 and spec §17.1; no test reads them).

`fixtureTushareCall(dirs)` serves every recording in `dirs` whose `request.api_name` matches, merging rows (columns aligned by field name, identical rows once) and emulating the server filter and `limit/offset` paging. Cases real data cannot produce (an `out_date` correction, a key seen with different content, an `in_date` after the delisting date, an alias code, a quota error) are made **inside the tests** by small, labelled wrappers that edit a real response (`// synthetic edit of a real response:` comments); there is no synthetic fixture file.

  expect(pages[0].raw_hash).toBe(createHash('sha256').update(new Uint8Array([7])).digest('hex'));

describe('defaultTushareCall',()=>{
 const resp=(body:string,status=200)=>new Response(body,{status,headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}});
 it('passes limit/offset through, returns raw columns with numeric tokens and the response bytes',async()=>{
  const fetchFn=vi.fn(async(_u:unknown,init?:RequestInit)=>{
   const sent=JSON.parse(String(init!.body));
   expect(sent).toMatchObject({api_name:'index_member_all',params:{l1_code:'801080.SI',is_new:'Y',limit:2,offset:4},fields:'ts_code'});
   return resp('{"request_id":"r","code":0,"msg":"","data":{"fields":["ts_code","x"],"items":[["600584.SH",1.50]],"has_more":false}}');
  });
  const call=defaultTushareCall({fetch:fetchFn as unknown as typeof fetch,token:'t'});
  const out=await call('index_member_all',{l1_code:'801080.SI',is_new:'Y',limit:2,offset:4},'ts_code');
  expect(out.fields).toEqual(['ts_code','x']);
  expect(out.items).toEqual([['600584.SH',{__num:'1.50'}]]);
  expect(out.has_more).toBe(false);
  expect(new TextDecoder().decode(out.raw)).toContain('"600584.SH"');
 });
 it('maps quota messages and HTTP 429 to quota_exhausted, other API codes to tushare_error, never echoing the upstream message',async()=>{
  const quota=defaultTushareCall({fetch:(async()=>resp('{"request_id":"r","code":40203,"msg":"抱歉，您每分钟最多访问该接口200次","data":null}')) as unknown as typeof fetch,token:'t'});

  await expect(other('index_member_all',{},'ts_code')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'tushare_error',message:'api_code_40001'});

  const noToken=defaultTushareCall({fetch:(async()=>resp('{}')) as unknown as typeof fetch,token:''});
  await expect(noToken('index_member_all',{},'ts_code')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'tushare_unavailable',message:'tushare_-1'});

```ts
// src/lib/industry/providers/tushare-industry.ts
// Tushare adapters of the industry module (spec §2 field lists, §4.2, §4.4, §4.7, §6.1). Adapters only
// produce immutable page records (decoded rows + raw_hash of the page bytes + row locator); they never
// write. Calls go through IndustryDeps.tushare (contract: raw columns/items as returned by the landed
// tushareCallRaw, numbers still {__num} tokens); defaultTushareCall wraps tushareCallRaw, and
// fixtureTushareCall serves the real recordings of fixtures/tushare (spec 7th draft K1–K3) emulating the
// server's param filter and limit/offset paging, so has_more paging is exercised offline.
// Decoding: stock_basic / index_classify / index_member_all are text APIs (codes and YYYYMMDD dates):
// every cell decodes to a string (a numeric token keeps its literal text, so '000001' or '0926'-like
// values are never reformatted); daily_basic decodes with the landed decodeColumns and a decimal schema.
// Errors carry fixed codes only (a Tushare msg never reaches an Error message).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {existsSync,readdirSync,readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {TushareError,tushareCallRaw} from '../../data/sources/tushare';
import {isTushareQuotaMessage} from '../../facts/providers/tushare-statements';
import type {NumberSchema} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {decodeColumns,isNumToken,scanJsonNumbers} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import type {IndustryDeps} from '../types';

export type TushareCall=NonNullable<IndustryDeps['tushare']>;
export type IndustryProviderErrorCode='quota_exhausted'|'tushare_unavailable'|'tushare_error'|'paging_not_advancing'|'too_many_pages'|'row_shape'|'fixture_missing';
export class IndustryProviderError extends Error{constructor(public code:IndustryProviderErrorCode,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='IndustryProviderError';}}

export const STOCK_BASIC_FIELDS=['ts_code','symbol','name','fullname','exchange','list_status','list_date','delist_date'] as const;
export const INDEX_CLASSIFY_FIELDS=['index_code','industry_name','parent_code','level','industry_code','is_pub','src'] as const;
export const INDEX_MEMBER_FIELDS=['l1_code','l1_name','l2_code','l2_name','l3_code','l3_name','ts_code','name','in_date','out_date','is_new'] as const;
export const DAILY_BASIC_FIELDS=['ts_code','trade_date','close','total_share','free_share','total_mv'] as const;
/** daily_basic numbers stay canonical decimal strings (spec §6.1; total_share/free_share in 万股, total_mv in 万元; K2: total_share = all classes A+H+B). */
export const DAILY_BASIC_SCHEMA:NumberSchema={control:[],decimal:['close','total_share','free_share','total_mv']};
/** Documented single-call row caps (spec §2): index_member_all 2000, daily_basic 6000; stock_basic/index_classify are small. */
export const PAGE_SIZE:Record<string,number>={stock_basic:5000,index_classify:2000,index_member_all:2000,daily_basic:6000};
export const TUSHARE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS=350;
const MAX_PAGES=200;

export interface TusharePage<T>{api:string;params:Record<string,unknown>;page:number;offset:number;has_more:boolean;raw_hash:string;fetched_at:string;rows:T[]}
/** Row locator stored with every source record (spec §4.4: raw_hash + locator). */
export interface RowLocator{api:string;params:Record<string,unknown>;page:number;offset:number;row:number}
export const locatorOf=(p:TusharePage<unknown>,row:number):RowLocator=>({api:p.api,params:p.params,page:p.page,offset:p.offset,row});

export interface FetchOptions{sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;minIntervalMs?:number;pageSize?:number;now?:()=>Date}
const sha256Hex=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const defaultSleep=(ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));

/** Text decode: strings stay, null stays, a numeric token keeps its literal text. */
export function decodeText(fields:string[],items:unknown[][]):Record<string,string|null>[]{
 return items.map(row=>{
  if(row.length!==fields.length)throw new IndustryProviderError('row_shape',`row_width:${row.length}`);
  return Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f,i)=>{
   const v=row[i];
   if(v===null||v===undefined)return [f,null];
   if(typeof v==='string')return [f,v];
   if(isNumToken(v))return [f,v.__num];
   throw new IndustryProviderError('row_shape',`cell_type:${f}`);
  }));
 });
}

/** 'YYYYMMDD' → 'YYYY-MM-DD' when it is a real calendar date; null/'' → null; anything else → undefined (invalid). */
export function ymdToIso(v:string|null):string|null|undefined{
 if(v===null||v==='')return null;
 const m=/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/.exec(v);
 if(!m)return undefined;
 const iso=`${m[1]}-${m[2]}-${m[3]}`;
 const ms=Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`);
 return Number.isNaN(ms)||new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==iso?undefined:iso;
}

/** Wraps the landed tushareCallRaw; API-level errors → quota_exhausted / tushare_error, HTTP 429 → quota_exhausted. */
export function defaultTushareCall(opts:{fetch?:typeof fetch;token?:string}={}):TushareCall{
 return async(api,params,fields)=>{
  const {limit,offset,...rest}=params as Record<string,unknown>&{limit?:number;offset?:number};
  let raw;
  try{raw=await tushareCallRaw(api,rest,fields,{fetch:opts.fetch,token:opts.token,limit,offset});}
  catch(e){
   if(e instanceof TushareError&&e.code===429)throw new IndustryProviderError('quota_exhausted','http_429');
   if(e instanceof TushareError)throw new IndustryProviderError('tushare_unavailable',`tushare_${e.code}`);
   throw new IndustryProviderError('tushare_unavailable','request_failed');
  }
  if(raw.code!==0)throw new IndustryProviderError(isTushareQuotaMessage(raw.msg)?'quota_exhausted':'tushare_error',`api_code_${raw.code}`);
  return {fields:raw.fields,items:raw.items,has_more:raw.hasMore,raw:raw.bytes};
 };
}

// Paths from the repo root (tests and scripts run there), NOT new URL(dir, import.meta.url): Next bundles this module into
// the cron route and webpack cannot resolve a directory URL as an asset (`next build` fails — Codex round 1 #1 build gate).
export const INDUSTRY_FIXTURE_DIR=join(process.cwd(),'src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare');
export const INDUSTRY_PAGING_DIR=join(process.cwd(),'src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare/paging');
/** Serializes a scanJsonNumbers value back to JSON text, numeric tokens as their original literals. */
function serializeTokens(v:unknown):string{
 if(isNumToken(v))return v.__num;
 if(Array.isArray(v))return `[${v.map(serializeTokens).join(',')}]`;
 if(v!==null&&typeof v==='object')return `{${Object.entries(v as Record<string,unknown>).map(([k,x])=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${serializeTokens(x)}`).join(',')}}`;
 return JSON.stringify(v);
}
interface FixtureDoc{request?:{api_name?:unknown};data:{fields:string[];items:unknown[][]}}

/**
 * Serves the recordings in `dirs` (every `*.json` directly inside; envelope {request:{api_name,params,fields},
 * response_sha256, request_id, code, msg, data}) whose request.api_name is `api`. Emulates the server: each
 * recording's rows are filtered by every param whose name is one of its fields (level, src, l1_code, is_new,
 * list_status, trade_date, ts_code); the rows of all recordings are merged in file-name order (projected onto the
 * requested fields; an identical row is kept once), then sliced by limit/offset; has_more = rows remain after the
 * slice. `raw` are the bytes of a synthesized page response, so raw_hash differs per page like upstream.
 */
export function fixtureTushareCall(dirs:string|readonly string[]=INDUSTRY_FIXTURE_DIR):TushareCall{
 const list=typeof dirs==='string'?[dirs]:[...dirs];
 return async(api,params,fields)=>{
  const docs:FixtureDoc[]=[];
  for(const dir of list){
   if(!existsSync(dir))continue;
   for(const f of readdirSync(dir).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.json')).sort()){
    const doc=scanJsonNumbers(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(dir,f)))) as FixtureDoc;
    if(doc.request?.api_name===api)docs.push(doc);
   }
  }
  if(docs.length===0)throw new IndustryProviderError('fixture_missing',api);
  const want=fields.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const text=(v:unknown)=>v===null||v===undefined?null:isNumToken(v)?v.__num:String(v);
  const rows:unknown[][]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();
  for(const doc of docs){
   const all=doc.data.fields;
   for(const f of want)if(!all.includes(f))throw new IndustryProviderError('row_shape',`fixture_field_missing:${f}`);
   const filters=Object.entries(params).filter(([k])=>k!=='limit'&&k!=='offset'&&all.includes(k));
   for(const r of doc.data.items){
    if(!filters.every(([k,v])=>text(r[all.indexOf(k)])===String(v)))continue;
    const out=want.map(f=>r[all.indexOf(f)]);const sig=serializeTokens(out);
    if(!seen.has(sig)){seen.add(sig);rows.push(out);}
   }
  }
  const offset=Number(params.offset??0),limit=params.limit===undefined?rows.length:Number(params.limit);
  const slice=rows.slice(offset,offset+limit);
  const has_more=offset+limit<rows.length;
  const body={request_id:'fixture',code:0,msg:'',data:{fields:want,items:slice,has_more}};
  return {fields:want,items:slice,has_more,raw:new TextEncoder().encode(serializeTokens(body))};
 };
}

/** limit/offset paging until has_more=false; one TusharePage per response. A page identical to the previous one stops with paging_not_advancing. */
async function fetchPaged<T>(call:TushareCall,api:string,params:Record<string,unknown>,fields:readonly string[],decode:(f:string[],items:unknown[][])=>T[],opts:FetchOptions):Promise<TusharePage<T>[]>{
 const size=opts.pageSize??PAGE_SIZE[api]??2000;const wait=opts.sleep??defaultSleep;const gap=opts.minIntervalMs??TUSHARE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS;const now=opts.now??(()=>new Date());
 const out:TusharePage<T>[]=[];let prev:string|null=null;
 for(let page=1,offset=0;;page++){
  if(page>MAX_PAGES)throw new IndustryProviderError('too_many_pages',api);
  if(page>1)await wait(gap);
  const res=await call(api,{...params,limit:size,offset},fields.join(','));
  for(const f of fields)if(!res.fields.includes(f))throw new IndustryProviderError('row_shape',`missing_field:${f}`);
  const ordered=res.items.map(r=>fields.map(f=>r[res.fields.indexOf(f)]));
  const sig=JSON.stringify(ordered);
  if(page>1&&(sig===prev||(res.items.length===0&&res.has_more)))throw new IndustryProviderError('paging_not_advancing',api);
  prev=sig;
  out.push({api,params,page,offset,has_more:res.has_more,raw_hash:sha256Hex(res.raw),fetched_at:now().toISOString(),rows:decode([...fields],ordered)});
  if(!res.has_more)return out;
  offset+=res.items.length;
 }
}

export interface StockBasicRow{ts_code:string;symbol:string|null;name:string|null;fullname:string|null;exchange:string|null;list_status:string|null;list_date:string|null;delist_date:string|null}
export interface IndexClassifyRow{index_code:string;industry_name:string|null;parent_code:string|null;level:string|null;industry_code:string|null;is_pub:string|null;src:string|null}
export interface IndexMemberRow{l1_code:string;l1_name:string|null;l2_code:string;l2_name:string|null;l3_code:string;l3_name:string|null;ts_code:string;name:string|null;in_date:string|null;out_date:string|null;is_new:string|null}
export interface DailyBasicRow{ts_code:string;trade_date:string;close:string|null;total_share:string|null;free_share:string|null;total_mv:string|null}

const asText=<T>(f:string[],items:unknown[][])=>decodeText(f,items) as unknown as T[];

/** stock_basic for one list_status ('L' listed, 'D' delisted, 'P' paused). */
export function fetchStockBasic(call:TushareCall,q:{listStatus:'L'|'D'|'P'},opts:FetchOptions={}):Promise<TusharePage<StockBasicRow>[]>{
 return fetchPaged(call,'stock_basic',{list_status:q.listStatus},STOCK_BASIC_FIELDS,asText<StockBasicRow>,opts);
}
/** index_classify for one level of SW2021 (src defaults to SW2014 upstream, so it is always passed). */
export function fetchIndexClassify(call:TushareCall,q:{level:'L1'|'L2'|'L3';src?:'SW2021'},opts:FetchOptions={}):Promise<TusharePage<IndexClassifyRow>[]>{
 return fetchPaged(call,'index_classify',{level:q.level,src:q.src??'SW2021'},INDEX_CLASSIFY_FIELDS,asText<IndexClassifyRow>,opts);
}
/** index_member_all for one L1 and one is_new pass ('Y' current, 'N' historical), has_more paging. */
export function fetchIndexMembers(call:TushareCall,q:{l1Code:string;isNew:'Y'|'N'},opts:FetchOptions={}):Promise<TusharePage<IndexMemberRow>[]>{
 return fetchPaged(call,'index_member_all',{l1_code:q.l1Code,is_new:q.isNew},INDEX_MEMBER_FIELDS,asText<IndexMemberRow>,opts);
}
/** daily_basic for one trade date (YYYYMMDD); close/total_share/free_share/total_mv as canonical decimal strings. */
export function fetchDailyBasic(call:TushareCall,q:{tradeDate:string},opts:FetchOptions={}):Promise<TusharePage<DailyBasicRow>[]>{
 if(!/^\d{8}$/.test(q.tradeDate))throw new IndustryProviderError('row_shape','bad_trade_date');
 return fetchPaged(call,'daily_basic',{trade_date:q.tradeDate},DAILY_BASIC_FIELDS,(f,items)=>decodeColumns(f,items,DAILY_BASIC_SCHEMA).map(r=>({...r,ts_code:String(r.ts_code),trade_date:String(r.trade_date)})) as unknown as DailyBasicRow[],opts);
}
```
