- [ ] **Step 8: Implement the loader**

Call signatures are as landed (V10):

- `fileClaim(tables,{issuer_id,id_type,value,source})` (`src/lib/entities/claims.ts:16`)
- `attachSecurity(tables,{issuer_id,…})` (`src/lib/entities/securities.ts:19`)
- `recordAttempt(tables,dataset,{ok,cadence})` (`src/lib/dq/freshness.ts:34`)
- `resolveOrgId(code,{fetch})` (`src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/cninfo.ts:24`; it creates a client with `minIntervalMs: 0`, so this loader paces at 500 ms itself)

`issuer_securities.ticker` references `stocks_universe(ticker)`. That is why only tickers of the active `a_stock` universe are loaded: `security_universe_memberships.ticker` references the same table.

```ts
// src/lib/industry/load-a-share.ts
// A-share whole-universe issuer load (spec §4.7, V10 call signatures, V11 issuers_cninfo_idx). Does NOT use
// upsertIssuerByIdentifiers (it requires LEI/CIK/USCI). Per stock_basic row of the a_stock universe:
//  1. orgId = lookupOrgId(symbol) (巨潮 topSearch, landed collectors/cninfo.ts::resolveOrgId; paced here,
//     resolveOrgId itself does not pace); none → skipped_summary(no_org_id).
//  2. match: (a) issuers.cninfo_org_id = orgId; (b) the issuer owning the CURRENT issuer_securities row of
//     ts_code: null cninfo_org_id → backfilled (guarded update + provenance), a different one → no write,
//     fileClaim(issuer of that security, cninfo_org_id) + skipped_summary(org_id_mismatch); (c) new issuer
//     {canonical_name_zh: fullname ?? name, cninfo_org_id, status active}; a 23505 from issuers_cninfo_idx
//     (concurrent creator) → re-read and continue as (a).
//  3. attachSecurity(tables,{issuer_id, ticker: ts_code, share_class 'A', is_primary true, valid_from: list_date ??
//     observed date, source 'tushare:stock_basic', provenance {list_date, exchange, list_status}}): 'duplicate' never
//     backfills valid_from (spec 3 F3-2 owns that); 'conflict' (another issuer holds the ticker) → fileClaim(…,
//     source 'tushare:stock_basic') + skipped_summary(claim_pending). The issuer already holds another current
//     A-share ticker (code change) → not attached, fileClaim + skipped_summary(claim_pending).
//  4. list_status 'D' → skipped_summary(delisted) only (window closing is spec 3's valid_to_method='delisting').
//  5. receipt producer 'load-a-share', dataset 'issuers.a_stock', recordAttempt cadence daily (cron 30 22 * * *).
// Fast path: a ts_code whose current security row belongs to an issuer that already has a cninfo_org_id is a
// duplicate without a network lookup (re-checking orgIds is the job of a full run: opts.recheckOrgIds).
// Outcome per row: inserted (security attached), duplicates (already attached), skipped (reason, informational),
// failed (exception). Issuer creations/backfills are reported in `issuers` (not BatchCounts).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {TableError,selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {fileClaim} from '../entities/claims';
import {attachSecurity} from '../entities/securities';
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '../entities/resolve';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome,summarizeSkips,withSkippedSummary} from '../entities/load-sec';
import {resolveOrgId} from '../research/ingest/collectors/cninfo';
import type {OrgLookup} from '../research/ingest/collectors/cninfo';
import type {IndustryDeps} from './types';
import type {StockBasicRow,TusharePage} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {defaultTushareCall,fetchStockBasic,ymdToIso} from './providers/tushare-industry';

export const A_SHARE_DATASET='issuers.a_stock';
export const A_SHARE_PRODUCER='load-a-share';
export const STOCK_BASIC_SOURCE='tushare:stock_basic';
export const CNINFO_SOURCE='cninfo:topSearch';
export const ORG_LOOKUP_INTERVAL_MS=500;
const TS_CODE=/^(\d{6})\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/;
const B_SHARE=/^(900\d{3}\.SH|200\d{3}\.SZ)$/;
const CN_TICKER=/^\d{6}\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/;

export interface AShareCandidate{ts_code:string;symbol:string;name_zh:string;list_date:string|null;exchange:string|null;list_status:string}
export interface AShareLoadPlan{observedDate:string;candidates:AShareCandidate[];skipped:string[];rejected:string[];fetched:number}

/** Pure: stock_basic rows (all list statuses) + the active a_stock universe → candidates, skips, rejects. */
export function planAShareLoad(rows:StockBasicRow[],universe:ReadonlySet<string>,observedDate:string):AShareLoadPlan{
 const plan:AShareLoadPlan={observedDate,candidates:[],skipped:[],rejected:[],fetched:rows.length};
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 for(const r of rows){
  const ts=(r.ts_code??'').trim().toUpperCase();
  const m=TS_CODE.exec(ts);
  if(!m){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_ts_code:${r.ts_code}`);continue;}
  if(seen.has(ts)){plan.skipped.push(`repeated_row:${ts}`);continue;}
  seen.add(ts);
  if(r.list_status==='D'){plan.skipped.push(`delisted:${ts}`);continue;}
  if(B_SHARE.test(ts)){plan.skipped.push(`b_share:${ts}`);continue;}
  if(!universe.has(ts)){plan.skipped.push(`not_in_universe:${ts}`);continue;}
  const listDate=ymdToIso(r.list_date);
  if(listDate===undefined){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_list_date:${ts}`);continue;}
  const name=r.fullname?.trim()||r.name?.trim();
  if(!name){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_name:${ts}`);continue;}
  plan.candidates.push({ts_code:ts,symbol:r.symbol?.trim()||m[1],name_zh:name,list_date:listDate,exchange:r.exchange??null,list_status:r.list_status??'L'});
 }
 return plan;
}

export interface AShareApplyOptions{batchId:string;observedAt:string;lookupOrgId:(symbol:string)=>Promise<OrgLookup|null>;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;maxLookups?:number;recheckOrgIds?:boolean}
export interface AShareApplyResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];skippedSummary:Record<string,number>;rejectedSummary:Record<string,number>;issuers:{created:number;backfilled:number};lookups:number}

const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>0?v:null;
const provOf=(row:Row|undefined)=>(row?.provenance&&typeof row.provenance==='object'?row.provenance:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
const isUniqueViolation=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof TableError&&e.code==='23505';

async function issuerByOrgId(tables:TableClient,orgId:string):Promise<Row|null>{
 return (await tables.select('issuers',{cninfo_org_id:orgId},{limit:1}))[0]??null;
}
/** The issuer owning ts_code's current security row (landed validity predicate), with that row. */
async function currentOwner(tables:TableClient,ts:string,today:string):Promise<{issuer:Row;security:Row}|null>{
 const sec=(await tables.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:ts})).find(r=>isCurrentSecurity(r,today));
 if(!sec)return null;
 const issuer=(await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:String(sec.issuer_id)},{limit:1}))[0];
 return issuer?{issuer,security:sec}:null;
}

/** Writes the plan (spec §4.7 steps 1–4). The caller owns the batch. */
export async function applyAShareLoad(tables:TableClient,plan:AShareLoadPlan,opts:AShareApplyOptions):Promise<AShareApplyResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();counts.fetched=plan.fetched;
 const errors:BatchError[]=[];const skips=[...plan.skipped];
 const issuers={created:0,backfilled:0};
 const wait=opts.sleep??((ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)));
 const maxLookups=opts.maxLookups??Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 const today=plan.observedDate;
 let lookups=0;
 for(const c of plan.candidates){
  try{
   const owner=await currentOwner(tables,c.ts_code,today);
   if(owner&&str(owner.issuer.cninfo_org_id)&&!opts.recheckOrgIds){counts.duplicates++;continue;}   // fast path, no network
   if(lookups>=maxLookups){skips.push(`lookup_deferred:${c.ts_code}`);continue;}
   if(lookups>0)await wait(ORG_LOOKUP_INTERVAL_MS);
   lookups++;
   const hit=await opts.lookupOrgId(c.symbol);
   if(!hit){skips.push(`no_org_id:${c.ts_code}`);continue;}
   const orgId=hit.orgId;
   // (a) / (b) / (c)
   let issuer=await issuerByOrgId(tables,orgId);
   if(!issuer&&owner){
    const stored=str(owner.issuer.cninfo_org_id);
    if(stored&&stored!==orgId){
     await fileClaim(tables,{issuer_id:String(owner.issuer.issuer_id),id_type:'cninfo_org_id',value:orgId,source:CNINFO_SOURCE});
     skips.push(`org_id_mismatch:${c.ts_code}`);continue;
    }
    // backfill a null cninfo_org_id; a lost race (row changed or orgId taken) re-reads by orgId
    const id=String(owner.issuer.issuer_id);
    let n=0;
    try{
     n=await tables.update('issuers',{issuer_id:id,status:'active',cninfo_org_id:null},
      {cninfo_org_id:orgId,provenance:{...provOf(owner.issuer),cninfo_org_id:{source:CNINFO_SOURCE,observed_at:opts.observedAt}},updated_at:opts.observedAt});
    }catch(e){if(!isUniqueViolation(e))throw e;}
    if(n>0){issuers.backfilled++;issuer={...owner.issuer,cninfo_org_id:orgId};}
    else{
     issuer=await issuerByOrgId(tables,orgId);
     if(!issuer){skips.push(`issuer_not_active:${c.ts_code}`);continue;}
    }
   }
   if(!issuer){
    const now=opts.observedAt;
    const row:Row={issuer_id:randomUUID(),canonical_name_zh:c.name_zh,canonical_name_en:null,country_code:null,lei:null,cik:null,usci:null,cninfo_org_id:orgId,
     hkex_stock_code_primary:null,status:'active',merged_into:null,created_at:now,updated_at:now,
     provenance:{cninfo_org_id:{source:CNINFO_SOURCE,observed_at:now},canonical_name_zh:{source:STOCK_BASIC_SOURCE,observed_at:now}}};
    try{await tables.insert('issuers',row);issuer=row;issuers.created++;}
    catch(e){
     if(!isUniqueViolation(e))throw e;
     issuer=await issuerByOrgId(tables,orgId);   // issuers_cninfo_idx: a concurrent creator won → continue as (a)
     if(!issuer)throw e;
    }
   }
   const issuerId=String(issuer.issuer_id);
   if(issuer.status!=='active'){skips.push(`issuer_not_active:${c.ts_code}`);continue;}
   // code change: the issuer already has another current A-share ticker → never auto-attach a second one
   const other=(await tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:issuerId})).find(r=>isCurrentSecurity(r,today)&&CN_TICKER.test(String(r.ticker))&&!B_SHARE.test(String(r.ticker))&&String(r.ticker)!==c.ts_code);
   if(other){
    await fileClaim(tables,{issuer_id:issuerId,id_type:'cninfo_org_id',value:orgId,source:STOCK_BASIC_SOURCE});
    skips.push(`claim_pending:${c.ts_code}`);continue;
   }
   const res=await attachSecurity(tables,{issuer_id:issuerId,ticker:c.ts_code,share_class:'A',is_primary:true,valid_from:c.list_date??today,source:STOCK_BASIC_SOURCE,
    provenance:{list_date:c.list_date,exchange:c.exchange,list_status:c.list_status}});
   if(res==='inserted')counts.inserted++;
   else if(res==='duplicate')counts.duplicates++;
   else{
    await fileClaim(tables,{issuer_id:issuerId,id_type:'cninfo_org_id',value:orgId,source:STOCK_BASIC_SOURCE});
    skips.push(`claim_pending:${c.ts_code}`);
   }
  }catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'a_share_error',key:c.ts_code,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 }
 const skippedSummary=summarizeSkips(skips);
 const rejectedSummary=summarizeSkips(plan.rejected);
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary(errors,skippedSummary,rejectedSummary),skippedSummary,rejectedSummary,issuers,lookups};
}

export interface RunLoadAShareOptions{apply:boolean;triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;today?:string;maxLookups?:number;recheckOrgIds?:boolean;lookupOrgId?:(symbol:string)=>Promise<OrgLookup|null>;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>}
export interface RunLoadAShareResult{status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';batchId:string|null;plan:{candidates:number;skipped:Record<string,number>;rejected:Record<string,number>};apply:AShareApplyResult|null;exitCode:0|1}

/** Reads the active a_stock universe (security_universe_memberships; PK (ticker, universe) → ticker unique within it). */
export async function aStockUniverse(tables:TableClient):Promise<Set<string>>{
 return new Set((await selectAll(tables,'security_universe_memberships',{universe:'a_stock',is_active:true},'ticker')).map(r=>String(r.ticker).trim().toUpperCase()));
}

/** Job entry (cron / script): stock_basic L, P and D passes → plan → (apply) → receipt + freshness. */
export async function runLoadAShare(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:RunLoadAShareOptions):Promise<RunLoadAShareResult>{
 const call=deps.tushare??defaultTushareCall({fetch:deps.fetch});
 const now=deps.now();const today=opts.today??now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const pages:TusharePage<StockBasicRow>[]=[];
 for(const s of ['L','P','D'] as const)pages.push(...await fetchStockBasic(call,{listStatus:s},{sleep:opts.sleep,now:deps.now}));
 const plan=planAShareLoad(pages.flatMap(p=>p.rows),await aStockUniverse(deps.tables),today);
 const planSummary={candidates:plan.candidates.length,skipped:summarizeSkips(plan.skipped),rejected:summarizeSkips(plan.rejected)};
 if(!opts.apply)return {status:'dry_run',batchId:null,plan:planSummary,apply:null,exitCode:0};
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:A_SHARE_PRODUCER,dataset:A_SHARE_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 let result:AShareApplyResult;
 try{
  result=await applyAShareLoad(deps.tables,plan,{batchId,observedAt:now.toISOString(),lookupOrgId:opts.lookupOrgId??(symbol=>resolveOrgId(symbol,{fetch:deps.fetch})),sleep:opts.sleep,maxLookups:opts.maxLookups,recheckOrgIds:opts.recheckOrgIds});
 }catch(e){
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:{...emptyCounts(),fetched:plan.fetched,failed:Math.max(1,plan.candidates.length)},errors:[{code:'a_share_error',message:errorMessage(e)}]},deps.now());
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,A_SHARE_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now()});
  throw e;
 }
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:result.counts,errors:result.errors},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,result.counts,result.rejectedSummary);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,A_SHARE_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{issuers:result.issuers,lookups:result.lookups}});
 return {status,batchId,plan:planSummary,apply:result,exitCode:outcome.exitCode};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `facts-scope.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/facts-scope.ts
// Industry fact universe for the CN facts scope (spec §4.10, V3/V4; owner decision E). It is NOT a separate
// upsert job: src/lib/facts/scope.ts::desiredCn merges industryCnUniverse into the authoritative CN desired set
// inside its `// INDUSTRY` block, only when FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE=1 (flag off → desiredCn is plan 2's).
// Universe = issuers resolved from CURRENT industry_source_memberships rows (issuer_id not null; historical
// members included, so delisted issuers too; unresolved rows stay out — they are counted in n_unresolved)
// ∪ issuers currently owning an active `a_stock` universe ticker. Reasons per issuer: 'universe:sw2021' and/or
// 'universe:a_stock'; mergeDesired unions them with the cohort's ['cohort'] per issuer (sorted), so
// reconcile_fact_sync_scope (which REPLACES reasons) receives the union and retires only issuers outside it.
// fetch_key: the current A-share ticker (landed chooseCnTicker); an issuer without one (historical member)
// takes the ticker of its most recently CLOSED A-share window (chooseCnTicker over the rows with the largest
// valid_to); still none → skipped.no_cn_ticker. Merged issuers are skipped (industry_issuer_merged).
// Inputs are read to exhaustion: industry_source_memberships pages on its unique `id`, the a_stock memberships
// on `ticker` (unique within one universe: PK (ticker, universe)), securities through scope.ts::currentSecurities.
// Reads go through the service-role TableClient (industry_source_memberships grants service_role SELECT), so a
// memory harness must hold the source rows in its TableClient too.
import {selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {SCOPE_PRIORITY,chooseCnTicker,currentSecurities,fetchKey} from '../facts/scope';
import type {ScopeInputRow} from '../facts/scope';

export const INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE_FLAG='FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE';
export const REASON_SW2021='universe:sw2021';
export const REASON_A_STOCK='universe:a_stock';
const CN_TICKER=/\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/;
const B_SHARE=/^(900\d{3}\.SH|200\d{3}\.SZ)$/;
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>0?v:null;
const norm=(t:unknown)=>String(t).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
const bump=(m:Record<string,number>,k:string)=>{m[k]=(m[k]??0)+1;};

export const industryUniverseEnabled=(env:Record<string,string|undefined>=process.env)=>env[INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE_FLAG]==='1';

/** The ticker of the issuer's most recently closed A-share window (rows with the largest valid_to), or a reason. */
export function closedWindowTicker(secs:Row[]):{ticker:string}|{reason:'no_cn_ticker'|'ambiguous_cn_ticker'}{
 const closed=secs.filter(r=>str(r.valid_to)!==null&&CN_TICKER.test(norm(r.ticker))&&!B_SHARE.test(norm(r.ticker)));
 if(closed.length===0)return {reason:'no_cn_ticker'};
 const last=closed.reduce((m,r)=>String(r.valid_to)>m?String(r.valid_to):m,'');
 return chooseCnTicker(closed.filter(r=>String(r.valid_to)===last));
}

/** Desired CN scope rows of the industry universe (spec §4.10). `skipped` is the caller's counter map. */
export async function industryCnUniverse(tables:TableClient,today:string,skipped:Record<string,number>):Promise<ScopeInputRow[]>{
 const reasons=new Map<string,Set<string>>();
 const add=(id:string,r:string)=>{(reasons.get(id)??reasons.set(id,new Set()).get(id)!).add(r);};
 for(const s of await selectAll(tables,'industry_source_memberships',{status:'current',scheme:'sw2021'},'id')){
  const id=str(s.issuer_id);if(id)add(id,REASON_SW2021);
 }
 const current=await currentSecurities(tables,today);
 const ownerByTicker=new Map<string,string>();
 const byIssuer=new Map<string,Row[]>();
 for(const s of current){
  const id=str(s.issuer_id);if(!id)continue;
  ownerByTicker.set(norm(s.ticker),id);
  (byIssuer.get(id)??byIssuer.set(id,[]).get(id)!).push(s);
 }
 for(const m of await selectAll(tables,'security_universe_memberships',{universe:'a_stock',is_active:true},'ticker')){
  const id=ownerByTicker.get(norm(m.ticker));
  if(id)add(id,REASON_A_STOCK);else bump(skipped,'industry_unknown_ticker');
 }
 const issuers=new Map((await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{},'issuer_id')).map(i=>[String(i.issuer_id),i]));
 const out:ScopeInputRow[]=[];
 for(const id of [...reasons.keys()].sort()){
  const issuer=issuers.get(id);
  if(!issuer){bump(skipped,'industry_unknown_issuer');continue;}
  if(issuer.status==='merged'){bump(skipped,'industry_issuer_merged');continue;}
  let choice=chooseCnTicker(byIssuer.get(id)??[]);
  if('reason' in choice&&choice.reason==='no_cn_ticker')choice=closedWindowTicker(await tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:id}));
  if('reason' in choice){bump(skipped,choice.reason);continue;}
  out.push({issuer_id:id,reasons:[...reasons.get(id)!].sort(),priority:SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:fetchKey('CN',{ticker:choice.ticker})});
 }
 return out;
}

/** Per-issuer union: reasons merged and sorted; the cohort row's fetch_key and priority win when both exist. */
export function mergeDesired(cohort:ScopeInputRow[],industry:ScopeInputRow[]):ScopeInputRow[]{
 const out=new Map<string,ScopeInputRow>();
 for(const r of cohort)out.set(r.issuer_id,{...r,reasons:[...r.reasons]});
 for(const r of industry){
  const have=out.get(r.issuer_id);
  if(!have){out.set(r.issuer_id,{...r,reasons:[...r.reasons]});continue;}
  have.reasons=[...new Set([...have.reasons,...r.reasons])].sort();
 }
 return [...out.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:0);
}
```

### Task 7: SW2021 classification nodes and source records

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/industry/sw2021.ts` (code alias table, spec 7th draft K3; Task 10 puts it into `METHOD_CONFIG`)
- Create: `src/lib/industry/classifications.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/industry/source-memberships.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/classifications.test.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/source-memberships.test.ts`

Depends on Task 1 (`weekly` cadence), Task 3 (`memoryIndustryDb`) and Task 5 (adapters and recorded fixtures).

Spec 7th draft K3 rules implemented here: `parent_code` is in the `industry_code` namespace → mapped to the parent's `index_code` within the batch, the raw upstream value kept in `attributes.parent_industry_code`; member codes go through `SW2021_CODE_ALIASES = {'850412.SI':'850401.SI'}` (特钢Ⅲ: the member API and the classification API disagree; the original code is kept in the record's `locator.code_aliases`); a member row whose (aliased) L1/L2/L3 code is not in the classification tree is quarantined `classification_code_unknown` and not written; `out_date` is the last member day (inclusive), so `out_date = in_date` is a valid one-day record and only `out_date < in_date` is rejected.

- [ ] **Step 0: The alias table `src/lib/industry/sw2021.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/sw2021.ts
// SW2021 code aliases (spec 7th draft K3, evidence docs/audits/2026-11-06-industry-research/03-tushare-verification.md
// §1.2 item 6): index_member_all reports 特钢Ⅲ as 850412.SI while index_classify (the tree) has 850401.SI. Member
// codes are mapped to the tree's code before keying a source record. Part of METHOD_CONFIG (Task 10), so a change
// is a method-version change.
export const SW2021_CODE_ALIASES:Readonly<Record<string,string>>=Object.freeze({'850412.SI':'850401.SI'});
/** The tree's code for a member code (identity when no alias). */
export const canonicalSwCode=(code:string):string=>SW2021_CODE_ALIASES[code]??code;
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `classifications.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/classifications.ts
// SW2021 classification nodes (spec §4.2). Three index_classify calls (L1/L2/L3, src=SW2021); code = index_code.
// parent_code namespace (spec 7th draft K3, verified 2026-11-06): upstream parent_code is the parent's
// industry_code (134/134 L2 and 346/346 L3); an index_code is still accepted defensively.
// planClassificationNodes maps each node's parent within the SAME batch: an index_code of level-1 → used as is;
// an industry_code of a level-1 node → translated to that node's index_code (attributes.parent_via records which;
// the raw upstream value is kept in attributes.parent_industry_code);
// level 1 must have a root parent ('0' / '' / null). Anything else, and every descendant of an unmapped node, is
// quarantined `classification_parent_unmapped` and not written (the FK on parent_code would reject it anyway).
// Nodes are only added (upsertClassifications); a node whose stored name/level/parent differs is returned as a
// conflict and quarantined `classification_name_conflict` (never overwritten). attributes hold only stable upstream
// fields (no raw_hash / locator: a re-fetch must compare equal); the batch receipt is the node's evidence.
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome,parkConflict,summarizeSkips,withSkippedSummary} from '../entities/load-sec';
import type {ClassificationRow,IndustryDeps} from './types';
import type {IndexClassifyRow,RowLocator,TusharePage} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {defaultTushareCall,fetchIndexClassify,locatorOf} from './providers/tushare-industry';

export const SW_CLASSIFY_DATASET='industry.sw2021.classifications';
export const SW_CLASSIFY_PRODUCER='industry-sw-classify';
const LEVEL:Record<string,number>={L1:1,L2:2,L3:3};
const ROOT=new Set(['','0']);

export interface ClassifyInputRow extends IndexClassifyRow{raw_hash:string;locator:RowLocator}
export interface UnmappedNode{code:string;level:number;raw_parent_code:string|null;reason:'parent_not_found'|'parent_level_mismatch'|'parent_unmapped'|'root_with_parent';raw_hash:string;locator:RowLocator}
export interface ClassificationPlan{nodes:ClassificationRow[];unmapped:UnmappedNode[];rejected:string[]}

/** Pure. Rows of all three levels of ONE batch → nodes ordered parents first. */
export function planClassificationNodes(rows:ClassifyInputRow[]):ClassificationPlan{
 const plan:ClassificationPlan={nodes:[],unmapped:[],rejected:[]};
 const valid:(ClassifyInputRow&{lvl:number})[]=[];
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 for(const r of rows){
  const lvl=LEVEL[r.level??''];
  if(!r.index_code||!lvl){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_row_shape:${r.index_code??''}`);continue;}
  if(r.src!=='SW2021'){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_src:${r.index_code}`);continue;}
  if(!r.industry_name){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_name:${r.index_code}`);continue;}
  if(seen.has(r.index_code)){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_repeated:${r.index_code}`);continue;}
  seen.add(r.index_code);valid.push({...r,lvl});
 }
 const byIndex=new Map(valid.map(r=>[r.index_code,r]));
 const byIndustry=new Map(valid.filter(r=>r.industry_code).map(r=>[r.industry_code!,r]));
 const written=new Set<string>();
 for(const lvl of [1,2,3]){
  for(const r of valid.filter(v=>v.lvl===lvl)){
   const raw=r.parent_code;
   const miss=(reason:UnmappedNode['reason'])=>plan.unmapped.push({code:r.index_code,level:lvl,raw_parent_code:raw,reason,raw_hash:r.raw_hash,locator:r.locator});
   let parent:string|null=null;let via:'root'|'index_code'|'industry_code'='root';
   if(lvl===1){if(raw!==null&&!ROOT.has(raw)){miss('root_with_parent');continue;}}
   else{
    if(raw===null||ROOT.has(raw)){miss('parent_not_found');continue;}
    const direct=byIndex.get(raw),viaIndustry=byIndustry.get(raw);
    const hit=direct??viaIndustry;
    if(!hit){miss('parent_not_found');continue;}
    if(hit.lvl!==lvl-1){miss('parent_level_mismatch');continue;}
    if(!written.has(hit.index_code)){miss('parent_unmapped');continue;}
    parent=hit.index_code;via=direct?'index_code':'industry_code';
   }
   plan.nodes.push({scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:r.index_code,level:lvl,name_zh:r.industry_name,name_en:null,parent_code:parent,
    attributes:{industry_code:r.industry_code,parent_industry_code:raw,parent_via:via,is_pub:r.is_pub,src:r.src}});
   written.add(r.index_code);
  }
 }
 return plan;
}

export interface ClassificationApplyResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];skippedSummary:Record<string,number>;rejectedSummary:Record<string,number>}

/** Writes nodes via IndustryDb.upsertClassifications; unmapped and name conflicts are quarantined under `dataset`. */
export async function applyClassificationNodes(deps:Pick<IndustryDeps,'tables'|'db'>,batchId:string,plan:ClassificationPlan,dataset:string,fetched:number):Promise<ClassificationApplyResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();counts.fetched=fetched;const errors:BatchError[]=[];
 for(const u of plan.unmapped)
  await parkConflict(deps.tables,{dataset,table:'industry_classifications',naturalKey:`${u.level}:${u.code}`,reasonCode:'classification_parent_unmapped',detail:{reason:u.reason,raw_parent_code:u.raw_parent_code},payload:{code:u.code,level:u.level,raw_hash:u.raw_hash,locator:u.locator},batchId},counts,errors,{code:'classification_parent_unmapped',key:u.code,message:u.reason});
 if(plan.nodes.length){
  const res=await deps.db.upsertClassifications(batchId,plan.nodes);
  counts.inserted+=res.inserted;counts.duplicates+=res.unchanged;
  for(const c of res.conflicts)
   await parkConflict(deps.tables,{dataset,table:'industry_classifications',naturalKey:`${c.scheme}:${c.version}:${c.code}`,reasonCode:'classification_name_conflict',detail:{incoming:{name_zh:c.name_zh,name_en:c.name_en,level:c.level,parent_code:c.parent_code}},payload:{...c},batchId},counts,errors,{code:'classification_name_conflict',key:c.code});
 }
 const skippedSummary={};const rejectedSummary=summarizeSkips(plan.rejected);
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary(errors,skippedSummary,rejectedSummary),skippedSummary,rejectedSummary};
}

export interface RunClassificationsOptions{triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>}
export interface RunResult{status:BatchStatus;batchId:string;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];exitCode:0|1}

/** Job step: L1, L2, L3 index_classify → plan → apply; receipt + weekly freshness. */
export async function runClassificationsSw(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:RunClassificationsOptions={}):Promise<RunResult>{
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const call=deps.tushare??defaultTushareCall({fetch:deps.fetch});
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:SW_CLASSIFY_PRODUCER,dataset:SW_CLASSIFY_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 let result:ClassificationApplyResult;
 try{
  const pages:TusharePage<IndexClassifyRow>[]=[];
  for(const level of ['L1','L2','L3'] as const)pages.push(...await fetchIndexClassify(call,{level},{sleep:opts.sleep,now:deps.now}));
  const rows:ClassifyInputRow[]=pages.flatMap(p=>p.rows.map((r,i)=>({...r,raw_hash:p.raw_hash,locator:locatorOf(p,i)})));
  result=await applyClassificationNodes(deps,batchId,planClassificationNodes(rows),SW_CLASSIFY_DATASET,rows.length);
 }catch(e){
  const code=(e as {code?:unknown}).code;
  const errors=[{code:typeof code==='string'?code:'classification_error',message:errorMessage(e)}];
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:emptyCounts(),errors},deps.now());
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SW_CLASSIFY_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now()});
  return {status,batchId,counts:emptyCounts(),errors,exitCode:1};
 }
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:result.counts,errors:result.errors},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,result.counts,result.rejectedSummary);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SW_CLASSIFY_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now()});
 return {status,batchId,counts:result.counts,errors:result.errors,exitCode:outcome.exitCode};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement `source-memberships.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/source-memberships.ts
// SW2021 source records (spec §4.4): immutable import evidence in industry_source_memberships, separate from
// resolved memberships. Two passes per L1 (is_new 'Y' current, 'N' historical), has_more paging, one raw_hash
// per page and a row locator per record. Record key (scheme, version, source, ts_code, l3_code, in_date);
// content = name, l1_code, l2_code, out_date (raw_hash / locator / observed_at are evidence, not content).
// planSourceMemberships (pure): normalizes dates, rejects malformed rows (rejected_summary), de-duplicates the
// same key within one fetch (identical content → one input), parks a key seen with DIFFERENT content within one
// fetch as `source_membership_ambiguous` (nothing written for it), and classifies each input against the
// current records: new key / unchanged / out_date null→date / other change (expected counts for dry runs).
// Spec 7th draft K3: member codes go through SW2021_CODE_ALIASES; a row whose L1/L2/L3 code is not in the
// classification tree is quarantined classification_code_unknown (not written); out_date is inclusive, so only
// out_date < in_date is rejected. Coverage of moves holds only over all 31 L1 × {Y, N} passes (K3).
// runMembershipsSw writes through IndustryDb.upsertSourceMemberships (rpc upsert_industry_source_memberships;
// the SQL decides duplicates/supersession and returns `changed`); every change that is not null→date is
// quarantined `source_membership_changed` (payload old + new content) and makes the batch partial.
// The resolver (resolve-memberships.ts) runs after this as its own step.
import type {BatchError,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome,summarizeSkips,withSkippedSummary} from '../entities/load-sec';
import type {IndustryDeps,SourceMembershipInput,SourceMembershipRow} from './types';
import type {IndexMemberRow,RowLocator,TusharePage} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {IndustryProviderError,defaultTushareCall,fetchIndexMembers,locatorOf,ymdToIso} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import type {RunResult} from './classifications';
import {canonicalSwCode} from './sw2021';

export const SW_MEMBER_SOURCE='tushare:index_member_all';
export const SW_SOURCE_DATASET='industry.sw2021.source';
export const SW_SOURCE_PRODUCER='industry-sw-members';

export interface FetchedMember extends IndexMemberRow{raw_hash:string;locator:RowLocator;fetched_at:string}
type KeyFields=Pick<SourceMembershipInput,'source'|'ts_code'|'l3_code'|'in_date'>;
type ContentFields=Pick<SourceMembershipInput,'name'|'l1_code'|'l2_code'|'out_date'>;
export const sourceKey=(r:KeyFields)=>['sw2021','2021',r.source,r.ts_code,r.l3_code,r.in_date].join(':');
export const sameContent=(a:ContentFields,b:ContentFields)=>a.name===b.name&&a.l1_code===b.l1_code&&a.l2_code===b.l2_code&&a.out_date===b.out_date;
/** True when b differs from a only by out_date going from null to a date. */
export const isNullToDate=(a:ContentFields,b:ContentFields)=>a.out_date===null&&b.out_date!==null&&sameContent({...a,out_date:b.out_date},b);

export interface SourceChange{key:string;old:SourceMembershipRow;next:SourceMembershipInput;nullToDate:boolean}
export interface SourcePlan{
 inputs:SourceMembershipInput[];duplicatesInFetch:number;ambiguous:{key:string;rows:SourceMembershipInput[]}[];rejected:string[];
 /** member rows whose (aliased) L1/L2/L3 code is not in the classification tree (spec 7th draft K3) */
 unknownCodes:{tag:string;codes:string[];row:SourceMembershipInput}[];
 expected:{newKeys:number;unchanged:number;nullToDate:number;changed:number};changes:SourceChange[];
}

/**
 * Pure. `rows` = every record of one fetch (both passes of the L1s covered); `current` = current records of those L1s;
 * `known` = codes of the classification tree (omitted → no code check). Member codes are mapped through
 * SW2021_CODE_ALIASES first (the original code is kept in locator.code_aliases).
 */
export function planSourceMemberships(rows:FetchedMember[],current:SourceMembershipRow[],known?:ReadonlySet<string>):SourcePlan{
 const plan:SourcePlan={inputs:[],duplicatesInFetch:0,ambiguous:[],rejected:[],unknownCodes:[],expected:{newKeys:0,unchanged:0,nullToDate:0,changed:0},changes:[]};
 const groups=new Map<string,SourceMembershipInput[]>();
 for(const r of rows){
  const ts=(r.ts_code??'').trim().toUpperCase();
  const tag=`${ts}:${r.l3_code??''}:${r.in_date??''}`;
  if(!ts||!r.l1_code||!r.l2_code||!r.l3_code){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_row_shape:${tag}`);continue;}
  const inDate=ymdToIso(r.in_date),outDate=ymdToIso(r.out_date);
  if(!inDate||outDate===undefined){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_date:${tag}`);continue;}
  if(outDate!==null&&outDate<inDate){plan.rejected.push(`rejected_window:${tag}`);continue;}   // out_date is the last member day (inclusive, K3)
  const codes={l1_code:canonicalSwCode(r.l1_code),l2_code:canonicalSwCode(r.l2_code),l3_code:canonicalSwCode(r.l3_code)};
  const aliased=Object.fromEntries((['l1_code','l2_code','l3_code'] as const).filter(f=>codes[f]!==r[f]).map(f=>[f,r[f]]));
  const locator:Record<string,unknown>={...r.locator,...(Object.keys(aliased).length?{code_aliases:aliased}:{})};
  const input:SourceMembershipInput={source:SW_MEMBER_SOURCE,ts_code:ts,name:r.name,...codes,in_date:inDate,out_date:outDate,observed_at:r.fetched_at,raw_hash:r.raw_hash,locator};
  if(known){
   const missing=[codes.l1_code,codes.l2_code,codes.l3_code].filter(c=>!known.has(c));
   if(missing.length){plan.unknownCodes.push({tag,codes:missing,row:input});continue;}
  }
  const k=sourceKey(input);
  (groups.get(k)??groups.set(k,[]).get(k)!).push(input);
 }
 const currentByKey=new Map(current.filter(c=>c.status==='current').map(c=>[sourceKey(c),c]));
 for(const [key,list] of groups){
  if(list.some(x=>!sameContent(x,list[0]))){plan.ambiguous.push({key,rows:list});continue;}
  plan.duplicatesInFetch+=list.length-1;
  const next=list[0];plan.inputs.push(next);
  const old=currentByKey.get(key);
  if(!old){plan.expected.newKeys++;continue;}
  if(sameContent(old,next)){plan.expected.unchanged++;continue;}
  const nullToDate=isNullToDate(old,next);
  plan.expected[nullToDate?'nullToDate':'changed']++;
  plan.changes.push({key,old,next,nullToDate});
 }
 return plan;
}

export interface RunMembershipsSwOptions{apply:boolean;l1Codes?:string[];triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;pageSize?:number}
export interface RunMembershipsSwResult extends Omit<RunResult,'status'|'batchId'>{status:RunResult['status']|'dry_run';batchId:string|null;plans:{l1:string;expected:SourcePlan['expected'];inputs:number;ambiguous:number;rejected:number;unknownCodes:number}[]}

/** Job step after runClassificationsSw: both passes per L1 → plan → upsert → quarantine changes; weekly freshness. */
export async function runMembershipsSw(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:RunMembershipsSwOptions):Promise<RunMembershipsSwResult>{
 if(opts.apply&&!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const call=deps.tushare??defaultTushareCall({fetch:deps.fetch});
 const tree=await deps.db.classificationTree('sw2021','2021');
 const l1s=tree.filter(n=>n.level===1).map(n=>n.code).filter(c=>!opts.l1Codes||opts.l1Codes.includes(c)).sort();
 const known=new Set(tree.map(n=>n.code));
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const rejected:string[]=[];const plans:RunMembershipsSwResult['plans']=[];
 const batchId=opts.apply?(await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:SW_SOURCE_PRODUCER,dataset:SW_SOURCE_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion!,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'})).batchId:null;
 if(l1s.length===0)errors.push({code:'no_classifications',message:'run classifications first'});
 for(const l1 of l1s){
  let pages:TusharePage<IndexMemberRow>[];
  try{
   pages=[];
   for(const isNew of ['Y','N'] as const)pages.push(...await fetchIndexMembers(call,{l1Code:l1,isNew},{sleep:opts.sleep,now:deps.now,pageSize:opts.pageSize}));
  }catch(e){
   errors.push({code:e instanceof IndustryProviderError?e.code:'fetch_error',key:l1,message:errorMessage(e)});
   if(e instanceof IndustryProviderError&&e.code==='quota_exhausted')break;
   continue;
  }
  const rows:FetchedMember[]=pages.flatMap(p=>p.rows.map((r,i)=>({...r,raw_hash:p.raw_hash,locator:locatorOf(p,i),fetched_at:p.fetched_at})));
  counts.fetched+=rows.length;
  const current=await deps.db.currentSourceMemberships({l1Code:l1});
  const plan=planSourceMemberships(rows,current,known);
  rejected.push(...plan.rejected);
  plans.push({l1,expected:plan.expected,inputs:plan.inputs.length,ambiguous:plan.ambiguous.length,rejected:plan.rejected.length,unknownCodes:plan.unknownCodes.length});
  if(!batchId)continue;
  counts.duplicates+=plan.duplicatesInFetch;
  for(const u of plan.unknownCodes){
   await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_SOURCE_DATASET,table:'industry_source_memberships',naturalKey:sourceKey(u.row),reasonCode:'classification_code_unknown',detail:{codes:u.codes},payload:{row:u.row},batchId});
   counts.quarantined++;errors.push({code:'classification_code_unknown',key:u.tag});
  }
  for(const a of plan.ambiguous){
   await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_SOURCE_DATASET,table:'industry_source_memberships',naturalKey:a.key,reasonCode:'source_membership_ambiguous',detail:{rows:a.rows.length},payload:{rows:a.rows},batchId});
   counts.quarantined+=a.rows.length;
  }
  if(plan.inputs.length===0)continue;
  try{
   const res=await deps.db.upsertSourceMemberships(batchId,plan.inputs);
   counts.inserted+=res.inserted;counts.versioned+=res.superseded;counts.duplicates+=res.duplicates;
   const oldById=new Map(current.map(c=>[c.id,c]));
   for(const ch of res.changed){
    if(ch.nullToDate)continue;
    const old=oldById.get(ch.old_id);
    const key=old?sourceKey(old):ch.old_id;
    const next=plan.inputs.find(x=>sourceKey(x)===key)??null;
    await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_SOURCE_DATASET,table:'industry_source_memberships',naturalKey:key,reasonCode:'source_membership_changed',
     detail:{old_id:ch.old_id,new_id:ch.new_id},payload:{old:old?{name:old.name,l1_code:old.l1_code,l2_code:old.l2_code,out_date:old.out_date,raw_hash:old.raw_hash}:null,next:next?{name:next.name,l1_code:next.l1_code,l2_code:next.l2_code,out_date:next.out_date,raw_hash:next.raw_hash}:null},batchId});
    errors.push({code:'source_membership_changed',key});
   }
  }catch(e){counts.failed+=plan.inputs.length;errors.push({code:'upsert_error',key:l1,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 }
 const rejectedSummary=summarizeSkips(rejected);
 const allErrors=withSkippedSummary(errors,{},rejectedSummary);
 if(!batchId)return {status:'dry_run',batchId:null,counts,errors:allErrors,exitCode:0,plans};
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:allErrors},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts,rejectedSummary);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SW_SOURCE_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now()});
 return {status,batchId,counts,errors:allErrors,exitCode:outcome.exitCode,plans};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `memberships.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/memberships.ts
// Point-in-time membership estimator (spec §4.6). Industry X on day `on` = the issuers that, by the evidence
// known at `knownBy`, are valid on `on`:
//   effective_valid_to(knownBy) = valid_to when valid_to is not null and valid_to_available_date <= knownBy, else null
//   member(on, knownBy) ⇔ status='ok' ∧ available_date <= knownBy ∧ valid_from <= on
//                         ∧ (effective_valid_to(knownBy) is null ∨ effective_valid_to(knownBy) > on)
// Aggregation/valuation use knownBy = facts_as_of; pages default knownBy = today. All dates 'YYYY-MM-DD'
// (text order = date order). The pure functions are the reference the SQL/memory implementations must match;
// membersAt reads candidates through IndustryDb.membershipCandidates and filters here.
// countUnresolved applies the same estimator to CURRENT source records with issuer_id null (spec §5.2
// n_unresolved), using the v1 assumptions available_date = in_date and valid_to_available_date = out_date,
// and counts distinct ts_code.
import type {IndustryDb,MembersAtQuery,MembershipRow,SourceMembershipRow} from './types';

const DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const assertDate=(v:string,name:string)=>{if(!DATE.test(v))throw new Error(`invalid_date:${name}`);};

export function effectiveValidTo(r:Pick<MembershipRow,'valid_to'|'valid_to_available_date'>,knownBy:string):string|null{
 return r.valid_to!==null&&r.valid_to_available_date!==null&&r.valid_to_available_date<=knownBy?r.valid_to:null;
}

export function isMemberAt(r:Pick<MembershipRow,'status'|'available_date'|'valid_from'|'valid_to'|'valid_to_available_date'>,on:string,knownBy:string):boolean{
 if(r.status!=='ok'||r.available_date>knownBy||r.valid_from>on)return false;
 const end=effectiveValidTo(r,knownBy);
 return end===null||end>on;
}

/** Rows of the queried (scheme, version, code, level) that are members at (on, knownBy); one row per issuer (latest valid_from), sorted by issuer_id. */
export function membersAtPure(rows:MembershipRow[],q:MembersAtQuery):MembershipRow[]{
 assertDate(q.on,'on');assertDate(q.knownBy,'knownBy');
 const best=new Map<string,MembershipRow>();
 for(const r of rows){
  if(r.scheme!==q.scheme||r.version!==q.version||r.code!==q.code||r.level!==q.level||!isMemberAt(r,q.on,q.knownBy))continue;
  const have=best.get(r.issuer_id);
  if(!have||r.valid_from>have.valid_from)best.set(r.issuer_id,r);
 }
 return [...best.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:0);
}

export async function membersAt(db:IndustryDb,q:MembersAtQuery):Promise<MembershipRow[]>{
 return membersAtPure(await db.membershipCandidates({scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:q.level,on:q.on}),q);
}

const codeAt=(r:SourceMembershipRow,level:number)=>level===1?r.l1_code:level===2?r.l2_code:level===3?r.l3_code:null;

/** Distinct ts_code of current, unresolved source records of the code that are members at (on, knownBy). */
export function unresolvedAt(rows:SourceMembershipRow[],q:{code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string}):SourceMembershipRow[]{
 assertDate(q.on,'on');assertDate(q.knownBy,'knownBy');
 const byTs=new Map<string,SourceMembershipRow>();
 for(const r of rows){
  if(r.status!=='current'||r.issuer_id!==null||codeAt(r,q.level)!==q.code)continue;
  // spec 7th draft §5.2 (K3): in_date <= on, in_date <= knownBy, out_date null or out_date >= on (out_date is the last member day)
  if(r.in_date>q.on||r.in_date>q.knownBy||(r.out_date!==null&&r.out_date<q.on))continue;
  if(!byTs.has(r.ts_code))byTs.set(r.ts_code,r);
 }
 return [...byTs.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.ts_code<b.ts_code?-1:a.ts_code>b.ts_code?1:0);
}
export const countUnresolved=(rows:SourceMembershipRow[],q:{code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string}):number=>unresolvedAt(rows,q).length;
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/resolve-memberships.ts
// Resolution of SW2021 source records into issuer memberships (spec §4.4–§4.5, V10). For every CURRENT source
// record with issuer_id null (records with a resolution_error are retried, never skipped): resolveIssuer(tables,
// {ticker: ts_code}, {today}) (landed entities/resolve.ts; spec 3's asOf option is not landed, so
// resolution.method = 'today'). Records resolving to one issuer are applied together in ONE
// IndustryDb.applyMemberships call (rpc apply_industry_memberships: one transaction per issuer; three target
// rows per record — L1/L2/L3 with valid_from = available_date = in_date and, spec 7th draft K3 (out_date is the
// last member day, inclusive; delisting does not close an upstream window), valid_to = valid_to_available_date =
// min(out_date + 1 day, stock_basic.delist_date) (both null → null); provenance {availability:'effective_date_assumed',
// source_membership_id, raw_hash, locator}). A record with in_date >= delist_date is not applied: quarantined
// membership_after_delist + resolution_error (the window would be empty or after the delisting). delist dates come
// from stock_basic(list_status='D') fetched once per run (Task 5 adapter). reconcileDelistings then closes the
// still-open rows of records resolved in earlier runs whose stock has since delisted (same apply function).
// Correction path (a): a record that superseded an older one is applied like any other; the SQL function moves
// the older record's ok rows to 'superseded' (superseded_by → the new rows) in the same transaction.
// Failures: no issuer → recordResolutionError {code:'no_issuer'} + skipped_summary(no_issuer) (counted in
// n_unresolved); an IndustryDbError (membership_overlap / membership_conflict / …) → the issuer's transaction
// rolled back, recordResolutionError {code, at, detail} on its records + quarantine (reason = the error code)
// + skipped_summary(apply_failed); any other error → failed. Correction path (b) (asOf re-resolution →
// membership_reassigned) waits for spec 3's asOf and is not implemented here.
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../entities/resolve';
import {defaultTushareCall,fetchStockBasic,ymdToIso} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome,summarizeSkips,withSkippedSummary} from '../entities/load-sec';
import type {IndustryDeps,MembershipTarget,SourceMembershipRow} from './types';
import {IndustryDbError} from './types';

export const SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET='industry.sw2021.memberships';
export const SW_RESOLVE_PRODUCER='industry-sw-resolve';

const nextDay=(d:string)=>new Date(Date.parse(`${d}T00:00:00Z`)+86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
/** K3 window end: min(out_date + 1 day, delist_date); null when both are null. */
export function windowEnd(outDate:string|null,delistDate:string|null):string|null{
 const a=outDate===null?null:nextDay(outDate);
 return a===null?delistDate:delistDate===null?a:(a<delistDate?a:delistDate);
}
/** The three membership rows (L1, L2, L3) one source record stands for (spec 7th draft K3 window). */
export function targetsFor(s:SourceMembershipRow,delistDate:string|null=null):MembershipTarget[]{
 const provenance={availability:'effective_date_assumed' as const,source_membership_id:s.id,raw_hash:s.raw_hash,locator:s.locator};
 const end=windowEnd(s.out_date,delistDate);
 return ([[1,s.l1_code],[2,s.l2_code],[3,s.l3_code]] as const).map(([level,code])=>({code,level,valid_from:s.in_date,valid_to:end,available_date:s.in_date,valid_to_available_date:end,source:s.source,provenance:{...provenance}}));
}

export interface ResolutionGroup{issuer_id:string;sourceIds:string[];tsCodes:string[];rows:MembershipTarget[]}
export interface ResolutionPlan{groups:ResolutionGroup[];unresolved:{id:string;ts_code:string;code:string}[];afterDelist:{id:string;ts_code:string;in_date:string;delist_date:string;issuer_id:string}[]}

/** Pure: unresolved current records + ts_code → issuer (null = none, or an error code string) + delist dates → per-issuer groups. */
export function resolveSourceMemberships(sources:SourceMembershipRow[],resolved:Map<string,string|null|{error:string}>,delist:ReadonlyMap<string,string>=new Map()):ResolutionPlan{
 const plan:ResolutionPlan={groups:[],unresolved:[],afterDelist:[]};
 const byIssuer=new Map<string,ResolutionGroup>();
 const ordered=[...sources].filter(s=>s.status==='current'&&s.issuer_id===null).sort((a,b)=>a.ts_code.localeCompare(b.ts_code)||a.in_date.localeCompare(b.in_date)||a.l3_code.localeCompare(b.l3_code));
 for(const s of ordered){
  const r=resolved.get(s.ts_code);
  if(r===undefined||r===null){plan.unresolved.push({id:s.id,ts_code:s.ts_code,code:'no_issuer'});continue;}
  if(typeof r==='object'){plan.unresolved.push({id:s.id,ts_code:s.ts_code,code:r.error});continue;}
  const d=delist.get(s.ts_code)??null;
  if(d!==null&&s.in_date>=d){plan.afterDelist.push({id:s.id,ts_code:s.ts_code,in_date:s.in_date,delist_date:d,issuer_id:r});continue;}
  const g=byIssuer.get(r)??byIssuer.set(r,{issuer_id:r,sourceIds:[],tsCodes:[],rows:[]}).get(r)!;
  g.sourceIds.push(s.id);if(!g.tsCodes.includes(s.ts_code))g.tsCodes.push(s.ts_code);g.rows.push(...targetsFor(s,d));
 }
 plan.groups=[...byIssuer.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:0);
 return plan;
}

export interface ApplyResolutionsResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];skippedSummary:Record<string,number>;records:{applied:number;unresolved:number;failed:number;afterDelist:number;delistClosed:number;delistCorrected:number;delistConflicts:number}}

/** Applies a plan: one applyMemberships per issuer; records errors on the source rows. Caller owns the batch. */
export async function applyResolutions(deps:Pick<IndustryDeps,'tables'|'db'|'now'>,batchId:string,plan:ResolutionPlan,opts:{today:string}):Promise<ApplyResolutionsResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const skips:string[]=[];
 const records={applied:0,unresolved:0,failed:0,afterDelist:0,delistClosed:0,delistCorrected:0,delistConflicts:0};
 const at=()=>deps.now().toISOString();
 const byCode=new Map<string,string[]>();
 for(const u of plan.unresolved)(byCode.get(u.code)??byCode.set(u.code,[]).get(u.code)!).push(u.id);
 for(const [code,ids] of byCode){
  await deps.db.recordResolutionError(ids,{code,at:at()});
  skips.push(...ids.map(()=>code));records.unresolved+=ids.length;
 }
 for(const a of plan.afterDelist){
  await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sw2021:2021:${a.ts_code}:${a.in_date}`,reasonCode:'membership_after_delist',
   detail:{in_date:a.in_date,delist_date:a.delist_date},payload:{source_id:a.id,issuer_id:a.issuer_id},batchId});
  await deps.db.recordResolutionError([a.id],{code:'membership_after_delist',at:at(),detail:`in_date ${a.in_date} >= delist_date ${a.delist_date}`});
  counts.quarantined++;records.afterDelist++;skips.push('membership_after_delist');
 }
 for(const g of plan.groups){
  counts.fetched+=g.sourceIds.length;
  try{
   const res=await deps.db.applyMemberships(batchId,g.issuer_id,'sw2021','2021',g.rows,g.sourceIds,{method:'today',resolved_at:at(),as_of:opts.today});
   records.applied+=g.sourceIds.length;
   if(res.inserted+res.closed+res.superseded===0)counts.duplicates+=g.sourceIds.length;
   else if(res.closed+res.superseded>0)counts.versioned+=g.sourceIds.length;
   else counts.inserted+=g.sourceIds.length;
  }catch(e){
   const code=e instanceof IndustryDbError?e.code:'apply_error';
   await deps.db.recordResolutionError(g.sourceIds,{code,at:at(),detail:errorMessage(e).slice(0,500)});
   records.failed+=g.sourceIds.length;
   if(e instanceof IndustryDbError){
    await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sw2021:2021:${g.issuer_id}`,reasonCode:code,
     detail:{message:errorMessage(e).slice(0,500)},payload:{issuer_id:g.issuer_id,source_ids:g.sourceIds,ts_codes:g.tsCodes},batchId});
    counts.quarantined+=g.sourceIds.length;skips.push(...g.sourceIds.map(()=>'apply_failed'));
    errors.push({code,key:g.issuer_id});
   }else{counts.failed+=g.sourceIds.length;errors.push({code,key:g.issuer_id,message:errorMessage(e)});}
  }
 }
 const skippedSummary=summarizeSkips(skips);
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary(errors,skippedSummary),skippedSummary,records};
}

/**
 * K3 for records resolved in EARLIER runs (Codex plan audit round 1 #3): upstream keeps a delisted stock's window
 * open (out_date null, same payload), so a delisting that happens after resolution never reaches the resolver.
 * For every current, resolved record whose ts_code has a delist_date: when its ok rows are still open and the K3
 * window now ends (windowEnd(out_date, delist_date) not null), re-apply the SAME record with the bounded targets —
 * apply_industry_memberships step 3 closes open ok rows (valid_to, valid_to_available_date) in one transaction,
 * keeping the stored issuer and membership ids. A stored, already-closed window that differs from the K3 end
 * (the delisting was learned after the window closed) is superseded through IndustryDb.correctMembershipWindows —
 * the old rows become superseded (superseded_by → the corrected rows), so no incorrect ok row stays eligible
 * (Codex plan audit round 2 R2-2); a correction the DB rejects is quarantined membership_delist_conflict. A K3 end on or
 * before the window start (no valid interval, open or closed) makes the same call quarantine the ok rows atomically
 * (status quarantined, so aggregation excludes them) and records dq_quarantine membership_after_delist (round 3 R3-1).
 */
export async function reconcileDelistings(deps:Pick<IndustryDeps,'tables'|'db'|'now'>,batchId:string,delist:ReadonlyMap<string,string>,result:ApplyResolutionsResult):Promise<void>{
 if(delist.size===0)return;
 const resolvedCurrent=(await deps.db.currentSourceMemberships({})).filter(s=>s.issuer_id!==null&&delist.has(s.ts_code));
 const byIssuer=new Map<string,SourceMembershipRow[]>();
 for(const s of resolvedCurrent)(byIssuer.get(s.issuer_id!)??byIssuer.set(s.issuer_id!,[]).get(s.issuer_id!)!).push(s);
 for(const [issuer,records] of [...byIssuer].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0)){
  const rows=(await deps.db.membershipsOfIssuer(issuer,{scheme:'sw2021'})).filter(m=>m.status==='ok');
  for(const s of records){
   const end=windowEnd(s.out_date,delist.get(s.ts_code)!);
   const mine=rows.filter(m=>m.source_membership_id===s.id);
   if(end===null||mine.length===0||mine.every(m=>m.valid_to===end&&m.valid_to_available_date===end))continue;
   const empty=end<=s.in_date;   // delisted on or before the window start: no valid interval remains (Codex round 3 R3-1)
   if(empty||mine.some(m=>m.valid_to!==null&&m.valid_to!==end)){
    // an already-closed window that ends after the K3 end (delisting learned late; Codex round 2 R2-2): the stored rows
    // are superseded by a corrected, K3-bounded version of the same record in one transaction (lineage kept)
    try{
     const res=await deps.db.correctMembershipWindows(batchId,issuer,'sw2021','2021',s.id,targetsFor(s,delist.get(s.ts_code)!));
     if(res.superseded>0){result.counts.versioned++;result.records.delistCorrected++;}
     if(res.quarantined>0){   // the ok rows were quarantined in that transaction: aggregation no longer counts them
      await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sw2021:2021:${s.ts_code}:${s.in_date}`,reasonCode:'membership_after_delist',
       detail:{in_date:s.in_date,delist_date:delist.get(s.ts_code)!,membership_ids:res.membership_ids},payload:{source_id:s.id,issuer_id:issuer},batchId});
      result.counts.quarantined++;result.records.afterDelist++;
     }
     continue;
    }catch(e){
     if(!(e instanceof IndustryDbError))throw e;
    }
    await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sw2021:2021:${s.ts_code}:${s.in_date}`,reasonCode:'membership_delist_conflict',
     detail:{stored_valid_to:mine.map(m=>m.valid_to),k3_end:end},payload:{source_id:s.id,issuer_id:issuer},batchId});
    result.counts.quarantined++;result.records.delistConflicts++;result.errors.push({code:'membership_delist_conflict',key:s.ts_code});
    continue;
   }
   try{
    const res=await deps.db.applyMemberships(batchId,issuer,'sw2021','2021',targetsFor(s,delist.get(s.ts_code)!),[s.id],{...s.resolution,delist_reconciled_at:deps.now().toISOString()});
    result.counts.versioned+=res.closed>0?1:0;result.records.delistClosed+=res.closed>0?1:0;
   }catch(e){
    result.counts.failed++;result.errors.push({code:e instanceof IndustryDbError?e.code:'apply_error',key:s.ts_code,message:errorMessage(e).slice(0,500)});
   }
  }
 }
}

export interface RunResolveOptions{triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;today?:string}
export interface RunResolveResult{status:BatchStatus;batchId:string;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];records:ApplyResolutionsResult['records'];exitCode:0|1}

/** Job step after runMembershipsSw: resolve every unresolved current record, apply per issuer, weekly freshness. */
export async function runResolveMemberships(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:RunResolveOptions={}):Promise<RunResolveResult>{
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const today=opts.today??deps.now().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:SW_RESOLVE_PRODUCER,dataset:SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 const sources=await deps.db.currentSourceMemberships({unresolvedOnly:true});
 // K3: delisting dates (stock_basic returns only L unless asked) bound every window
 const delist=new Map<string,string>();
 {   // always: already-resolved records are reconciled against later delistings too (Codex plan audit round 1 #3)
  try{
   const call=deps.tushare??defaultTushareCall({fetch:deps.fetch});
   for(const page of await fetchStockBasic(call,{listStatus:'D'},{now:deps.now}))for(const r of page.rows){const d=ymdToIso(r.delist_date);if(d)delist.set(r.ts_code.trim().toUpperCase(),d);}
  }catch(e){
   const code=typeof (e as {code?:unknown}).code==='string'?(e as {code:string}).code:'delist_fetch_error';
   const errors=[{code,message:errorMessage(e)}];
   const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:emptyCounts(),errors},deps.now());
   await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now()});
   return {status,batchId,counts:emptyCounts(),errors,records:{applied:0,unresolved:0,failed:0,afterDelist:0,delistClosed:0,delistCorrected:0,delistConflicts:0},exitCode:1};
  }
 }
 const resolved=new Map<string,string|null|{error:string}>();
 for(const ts of [...new Set(sources.map(s=>s.ts_code))].sort()){
  try{resolved.set(ts,(await resolveIssuer(deps.tables,{ticker:ts},{today}))?.issuer_id??null);}
  catch(e){resolved.set(ts,{error:errorMessage(e)==='ambiguous_owner'?'ambiguous_owner':'resolve_error'});}
 }
 const result=await applyResolutions(deps,batchId,resolveSourceMemberships(sources,resolved,delist),{today});
 await reconcileDelistings(deps,batchId,delist,result);
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts:result.counts,errors:result.errors},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,result.counts);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SW_MEMBERSHIPS_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now(),detail:{records:result.records}});
 return {status,batchId,counts:result.counts,errors:result.errors,records:result.records,exitCode:outcome.exitCode};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the adapter**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/providers/sec-sic.ts
// SEC SIC adapter (spec §4.1, §4.2, §4.4 SIC; primary source, no token). Two inputs:
//  - submissions JSON per CIK (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json): `sic` (string, may be ''),
//    `sicDescription`, `fiscalYearEnd` ('MMDD'), `name`; raw_hash = sha256 of the response bytes.
//  - the SIC code list page (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/standard-industrial-classification-sic-code-list):
//    one HTML table "SIC Code | Office | Industry Title"; codes below 1000 are shown with three digits and are
//    left-padded to four (0100). Recorded 2026-11-06: 430 rows, 5 three-digit codes.
// Both requests declare the User-Agent (env EDGAR_USER_AGENT, else the landed DEFAULT_USER_AGENT of
// collectors/shared.ts). Fair access (≤ 10 req/s) is the caller's pacing (sic.ts). Outcomes are values, not
// throws: 404 → not_found (no_submissions); 429 / 5xx / network → unavailable (sec_unavailable).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/shared';

export const SIC_CODE_LIST_URL='https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/standard-industrial-classification-sic-code-list';
export const submissionsUrl=(cik:string)=>`https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK${normalizeCik10(cik)}.json`;
export const secUserAgent=()=>process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT||DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
const sha256Hex=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');

export function normalizeCik10(cik:string):string{
 const t=cik.trim();
 if(!/^\d{1,10}$/.test(t)||/^0+$/.test(t))throw new Error('invalid_cik');
 return t.padStart(10,'0');
}
/** 1–4 digit SIC → 4 digits; anything else → null. */
export function padSic(v:string):string|null{
 const t=v.trim();
 return /^\d{1,4}$/.test(t)&&!/^0+$/.test(t)?t.padStart(4,'0'):null;
}

export interface SubmissionsSic{cik:string;name:string|null;sic:string|null;sicRaw:string|null;sicDescription:string|null;fiscalYearEnd:string|null}
/** Pure parse of a submissions document; an empty or malformed `sic` is null (sicRaw keeps what was sent). */
export function parseSubmissionsSic(bytes:Uint8Array):SubmissionsSic{
 let doc:Record<string,unknown>;
 try{doc=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes)) as Record<string,unknown>;}catch{throw new Error('submissions_json_invalid');}
 if(!doc||typeof doc!=='object'||Array.isArray(doc))throw new Error('submissions_json_invalid');
 const s=(k:string)=>typeof doc[k]==='string'?(doc[k] as string):doc[k]===null||doc[k]===undefined?null:String(doc[k]);
 const cikRaw=s('cik');
 if(!cikRaw)throw new Error('submissions_no_cik');
 const sicRaw=s('sic');
 const fye=s('fiscalYearEnd');
 return {cik:String(Number(cikRaw)),name:s('name'),sic:sicRaw===null?null:padSic(sicRaw),sicRaw,sicDescription:s('sicDescription')||null,fiscalYearEnd:fye&&/^\d{4}$/.test(fye)?fye:null};
}

export type SubmissionsFetch={kind:'ok';url:string;fetchedAt:string;rawHash:string;parsed:SubmissionsSic}|{kind:'not_found';url:string;status:number}|{kind:'unavailable';url:string;status:number|null};
export async function fetchSubmissionsSic(cik:string,opts:{fetch?:typeof fetch;userAgent?:string;now?:()=>Date}={}):Promise<SubmissionsFetch>{
 const url=submissionsUrl(cik);
 let res:Response;
 try{res=await (opts.fetch??fetch)(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':opts.userAgent??secUserAgent(),Accept:'application/json'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30_000)});}
 catch{return {kind:'unavailable',url,status:null};}
 if(res.status===404)return {kind:'not_found',url,status:404};
 if(!res.ok)return {kind:'unavailable',url,status:res.status};
 const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
 return {kind:'ok',url,fetchedAt:(opts.now??(()=>new Date()))().toISOString(),rawHash:sha256Hex(bytes),parsed:parseSubmissionsSic(bytes)};
}

export interface SicCodeRow{code:string;office:string;title:string}
const ENTITIES:Record<string,string>={amp:'&',lt:'<',gt:'>',quot:'"',apos:"'",nbsp:' '};
const decodeEntities=(s:string)=>s.replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|[a-z]+);/gi,(m,e:string)=>e[0]==='#'?String.fromCodePoint(e[1].toLowerCase()==='x'?parseInt(e.slice(2),16):parseInt(e.slice(1),10)):(ENTITIES[e.toLowerCase()]??m));
const cellText=(s:string)=>decodeEntities(s.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'')).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();

/** Pure parse of the SIC code table: header row skipped, codes left-padded, duplicates and malformed rows rejected. */
export function parseSicCodeTable(html:string):{rows:SicCodeRow[];rejected:string[]}{
 const table=/<table[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/table>/i.exec(html.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g,''));
 if(!table)throw new Error('sic_table_not_found');
 const rows:SicCodeRow[]=[];const rejected:string[]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();
 const trs=[...table[1].matchAll(/<tr[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/tr>/gi)].map(m=>[...m[1].matchAll(/<t[dh][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/t[dh]>/gi)].map(c=>cellText(c[1])));
 trs.forEach((cells,i)=>{
  if(i===0&&cells[0]&&!/^\d+$/.test(cells[0]))return;   // header
  const code=cells.length===3?padSic(cells[0]):null;
  if(!code||!cells[2]){rejected.push(`row_${i}`);return;}
  if(seen.has(code)){rejected.push(`duplicate_${code}`);return;}
  seen.add(code);rows.push({code,office:cells[1],title:cells[2]});
 });
 if(rows.length===0)throw new Error('sic_table_empty');
 return {rows,rejected};
}

export type SicTableFetch={kind:'ok';url:string;fetchedAt:string;rawHash:string;rows:SicCodeRow[];rejected:string[]}|{kind:'unavailable';url:string;status:number|null};
export async function fetchSicCodeTable(opts:{fetch?:typeof fetch;userAgent?:string;now?:()=>Date}={}):Promise<SicTableFetch>{
 const url=SIC_CODE_LIST_URL;
 let res:Response;
 try{res=await (opts.fetch??fetch)(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':opts.userAgent??secUserAgent(),Accept:'text/html'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30_000)});}
 catch{return {kind:'unavailable',url,status:null};}
 if(!res.ok)return {kind:'unavailable',url,status:res.status};
 const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
 const {rows,rejected}=parseSicCodeTable(new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes));
 return {kind:'ok',url,fetchedAt:(opts.now??(()=>new Date()))().toISOString(),rawHash:sha256Hex(bytes),rows,rejected};
}

// repo-root relative (see tushare-industry.ts: a directory URL breaks `next build` of the cron route)
export const SEC_FIXTURE_DIR=join(process.cwd(),'src/lib/industry/fixtures/sec')+'/';
/** Recorded fixture bytes (fixtures/sec/submissions-<cik10>.json, fixtures/sec/sic-codes.html). */
export const secFixture=(name:string)=>new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`${SEC_FIXTURE_DIR}${name}`));
/** A fetch stand-in that serves the recorded fixtures by URL (404 for any other CIK); used by tests and offline runs. */
export function fixtureSecFetch(overrides:Record<string,Response|(()=>Response)>={}):typeof fetch{
 return (async(input:RequestInfo|URL)=>{
  const url=String(input);
  const o=overrides[url];if(o)return typeof o==='function'?o():o;
  if(url===SIC_CODE_LIST_URL)return new Response(secFixture('sic-codes.html'),{status:200,headers:{'content-type':'text/html'}});
  const m=/CIK(\d{10})\.json$/.exec(url);
  if(m){try{return new Response(secFixture(`submissions-${m[1]}.json`),{status:200,headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}});}catch{return new Response('',{status:404});}}
  return new Response('',{status:404});
 }) as typeof fetch;
}
```

```ts
  await tables.insert('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:AAPL,job:'sic',next_due_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',lease_until:'2026-11-08T02:10:00.000Z',lease_batch_id:'other-batch',last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:'2026-11-08T01:59:00.000Z'});

  await facts.reconcileScope('US',[{issuer_id:RETIRED,reasons:['universe:sp500'],priority:10,fetch_key:'0000000003'}]);
```
