```ts
// src/lib/industry/sic.ts
// SEC SIC classification and memberships (spec §4.1, §4.2, §4.4 SIC; no history → never aggregated).
//  - runClassificationsSic: SIC code list page → industry_classifications (scheme 'sic', version 'sec-current',
//    flat: level SIC_LEVEL = 1, parent null, name_en = Industry Title, attributes {office}); only-add, a renamed
//    code is quarantined classification_name_conflict.
//  - syncSicScope: the US facts scope (FactsDb.scopeAll('US'), priority > 0) → industry_sync_scope rows (job 'sic');
//    new issuers are INSERTED due now (a conflicting concurrent insert is ignored — an existing row and its lease are
//    never overwritten); rows of issuers that left the scope are retired (next_due_at = RETIRED_DUE, compare-and-swap,
//    never while leased) and re-activated when they come back, so they can never fill the due window (Codex plan
//    audit round 1 #7).
//  - runMembershipsSic: due scope rows, paged until `limit` ELIGIBLE rows (active, lease free) are found; each claimed by
//    compare-and-swap on (updated_at, lease_batch_id) (claimSicScopeRow: exactly one concurrent worker wins) and completed fenced by
//    lease_batch_id (finishSicScopeRow: a worker whose lease was taken over cannot clear it — lease_lost; Codex plan
//    audit round 1 #6); paced ≤ 10 req/s → submissions `sic` → IndustryDb.applySicMembership
//    (rpc apply_sic_memberships: same code → duplicate; another code → old row closed at the observation date and a new
//    one opened; a second change on the same day → same_day_change). valid_from = available_date = observation date;
//    provenance {availability:'observed', raw_hash, locator}. fiscalYearEnd (+ sic, sicDescription) is added to
//    issuers.provenance.sec_submissions (optimistic, guarded by updated_at; rewritten only when a value changed).
//    Skips (informational): no_cik, no_submissions (404), no_sic; sec_unavailable (429/5xx/network) is an error entry
//    (batch partial, retried next day); quarantined: unknown_sic_code (code not in the classification table), same_day_change. Batch dataset industry.sic.memberships,
//    freshness cadence weekly (cron 0 2 * * 0).
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {TableError,selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import type {BatchError,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome,parkConflict,summarizeSkips,withSkippedSummary} from '../entities/load-sec';
import type {RunResult} from './classifications';
import type {ClassificationRow,IndustryDeps} from './types';
import {IndustryDbError} from './types';
import type {SicCodeRow} from './providers/sec-sic';
import {fetchSicCodeTable,fetchSubmissionsSic} from './providers/sec-sic';

export const SIC_LEVEL=1;
export const SIC_VERSION='sec-current';
export const SIC_CLASSIFY_DATASET='industry.sic.classifications';
export const SIC_DATASET='industry.sic.memberships';
export const SIC_SOURCE='sec:submissions';
export const SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS=150;
const DAY=86_400_000;
const RETRY_UNAVAILABLE_MS=DAY,NEXT_RUN_MS=7*DAY,LEASE_MS=15*60_000,DUE_PAGE=500;
const iso=(ms:number)=>new Date(ms).toISOString();
/** next_due_at of a retired scope row (issuer left the US facts scope): never due. */
export const RETIRED_DUE='9999-12-31T00:00:00.000Z';
const ms=(v:unknown)=>v==null?null:Date.parse(String(v));
const isRetired=(r:Row)=>ms(r.next_due_at)===Date.parse(RETIRED_DUE);
const leaseFree=(r:Row,now:Date)=>{const l=ms(r.lease_until);return l===null||l<now.getTime();};

/** Atomic claim of one scope row: compare-and-swap on (updated_at, lease_batch_id) as read, so of two workers that read the same row exactly one wins (the winner's lease_batch_id is new, even when both clocks agree). */
export async function claimSicScopeRow(tables:TableClient,row:Row,batchId:string,now:Date):Promise<boolean>{
 if(!leaseFree(row,now)||row.updated_at==null)return false;
 return (await tables.update('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:String(row.issuer_id),job:'sic',updated_at:row.updated_at as string,lease_batch_id:(row.lease_batch_id as string|null)??null},
  {lease_until:iso(now.getTime()+LEASE_MS),lease_batch_id:batchId,updated_at:now.toISOString()}))===1;
}
/** Completion fenced by the lease: only the batch that holds the lease can write the outcome and release it. */
export async function finishSicScopeRow(tables:TableClient,issuerId:string,batchId:string,patch:Row):Promise<boolean>{
 return (await tables.update('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:issuerId,job:'sic',lease_batch_id:batchId},{...patch,lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null}))===1;
}

export function planSicClassifications(rows:SicCodeRow[]):ClassificationRow[]{
 return rows.map(r=>({scheme:'sic',version:SIC_VERSION,code:r.code,level:SIC_LEVEL,name_zh:null,name_en:r.title,parent_code:null,attributes:{office:r.office}}));
}

export async function runClassificationsSic(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:{triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;userAgent?:string}={}):Promise<RunResult>{
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'industry-sic-classify',dataset:SIC_CLASSIFY_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];let rejected:Record<string,number>={};
 try{
  const page=await fetchSicCodeTable({fetch:deps.fetch,userAgent:opts.userAgent,now:deps.now});
  if(page.kind!=='ok')errors.push({code:'sec_unavailable',message:`status_${page.status??'network'}`});
  else{
   counts.fetched=page.rows.length+page.rejected.length;
   rejected=summarizeSkips(page.rejected.map(r=>`rejected_${r.split('_')[0]}`));
   const res=await deps.db.upsertClassifications(batchId,planSicClassifications(page.rows));
   counts.inserted=res.inserted;counts.duplicates=res.unchanged;
   for(const c of res.conflicts)
    await parkConflict(deps.tables,{dataset:SIC_CLASSIFY_DATASET,table:'industry_classifications',naturalKey:`sic:${SIC_VERSION}:${c.code}`,reasonCode:'classification_name_conflict',detail:{incoming:{name_en:c.name_en}},payload:{...c,raw_hash:page.rawHash},batchId},counts,errors,{code:'classification_name_conflict',key:c.code});
  }
 }catch(e){errors.push({code:'sic_table_error',message:errorMessage(e)});}
 const all=withSkippedSummary(errors,{},rejected);
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:all},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts,rejected);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SIC_CLASSIFY_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now()});
 return {status,batchId,counts,errors:all,exitCode:outcome.exitCode};
}

/** Active US facts scope → industry_sync_scope (job 'sic'): insert new (never overwrite), retire departed, re-activate returning. */
export async function syncSicScope(deps:Pick<IndustryDeps,'tables'|'facts'|'now'>):Promise<{added:number;retired:number;reactivated:number;active:Set<string>}>{
 const active=new Set((await deps.facts.scopeAll('US')).filter(r=>Number(r.priority)>0).map(r=>String(r.issuer_id)));
 const have=new Map((await selectAll(deps.tables,'industry_sync_scope',{job:'sic'},'issuer_id')).map(r=>[String(r.issuer_id),r]));
 const at=deps.now();const now=at.toISOString();let added=0,retired=0,reactivated=0;
 for(const id of [...active].sort()){
  const r=have.get(id);
  if(!r){
   try{await deps.tables.insert('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:id,job:'sic',next_due_at:now,lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:now});added++;}
   catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TableError&&e.code==='23505'))throw e;}   // a concurrent worker inserted it: keep its row and lease
   continue;
  }
  if(isRetired(r)&&await deps.tables.update('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:id,job:'sic',updated_at:r.updated_at as string},{next_due_at:now,updated_at:now})===1)reactivated++;
 }
 for(const [id,r] of have){
  if(active.has(id)||isRetired(r)||!leaseFree(r,at))continue;
  if(await deps.tables.update('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:id,job:'sic',updated_at:r.updated_at as string},{next_due_at:RETIRED_DUE,updated_at:now})===1)retired++;
 }
 return {added,retired,reactivated,active};
}

const provOf=(row:Row)=>(row.provenance&&typeof row.provenance==='object'?row.provenance:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;

export interface RunMembershipsSicOptions{limit?:number;triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;userAgent?:string;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>}
export interface RunMembershipsSicResult extends RunResult{processed:number;added:number;retired:number}

export async function runMembershipsSic(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:RunMembershipsSicOptions={}):Promise<RunMembershipsSicResult>{
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_missing');
 const wait=opts.sleep??((ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)));
 const limit=opts.limit??200;
 const {added,retired,active}=await syncSicScope(deps);
 const known=new Set((await deps.db.classificationTree('sic',SIC_VERSION)).map(n=>n.code));
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'industry-sic',dataset:SIC_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const skips:string[]=[];
 if(known.size===0)errors.push({code:'no_classifications',message:'run sic classifications first'});
 const start=deps.now();
 // eligibility (in scope, lease free) is applied while paging, so ineligible due rows can never fill the window (#7)
 const due:Row[]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();
 for(let offset=0;known.size>0&&due.length<limit;offset+=DUE_PAGE){
  const page=await deps.tables.select('industry_sync_scope',{job:'sic'},{lt:{next_due_at:iso(start.getTime()+1)},orderBy:'next_due_at',limit:DUE_PAGE,offset});
  for(const r of page){const id=String(r.issuer_id);if(due.length<limit&&!seen.has(id)&&active.has(id)&&leaseFree(r,start)){seen.add(id);due.push(r);}}
  if(page.length<DUE_PAGE)break;
 }
 let processed=0;
 for(const s of due){
  const issuerId=String(s.issuer_id);
  if(!await claimSicScopeRow(deps.tables,s,batchId,deps.now()))continue;   // another worker won the row
  if(processed>0)await wait(SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS);
  processed++;
  const at=deps.now();const observed=at.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  let ok=false;let retryMs=NEXT_RUN_MS;
  try{
   const [issuer]=await deps.tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuerId},{limit:1});
   const cik=issuer&&typeof issuer.cik==='string'?issuer.cik:null;
   if(!issuer||!cik){skips.push('no_cik');}
   else{
    counts.fetched++;
    const sub=await fetchSubmissionsSic(cik,{fetch:deps.fetch,userAgent:opts.userAgent,now:deps.now});
    if(sub.kind==='not_found')skips.push('no_submissions');
    else if(sub.kind==='unavailable'){errors.push({code:'sec_unavailable',key:issuerId,message:`status_${sub.status??'network'}`});retryMs=RETRY_UNAVAILABLE_MS;}
    else{
     const p=sub.parsed;
     // issuers.provenance.sec_submissions (only when a value changed) — written by applySicMembership inside its
     // lease-fenced transaction, never directly (Codex plan audit round 2 R2-3)
     const prov=provOf(issuer);const prev=(prov.sec_submissions??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
     const secSubmissions=prev.fiscal_year_end!==p.fiscalYearEnd||prev.sic!==p.sicRaw||prev.sic_description!==p.sicDescription
      ?{source:SIC_SOURCE,url:sub.url,observed_at:sub.fetchedAt,raw_hash:sub.rawHash,fiscal_year_end:p.fiscalYearEnd,sic:p.sicRaw,sic_description:p.sicDescription}:null;
     const fence={leaseBatch:batchId,secSubmissions};
     if(!p.sic||!known.has(p.sic))await deps.db.applySicMembership(batchId,issuerId,observed,null,{},fence);   // provenance only (throws lease_lost)
     if(!p.sic){skips.push('no_sic');ok=true;}
     else if(!known.has(p.sic)){
      await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SIC_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sic:${issuerId}:${p.sic}`,reasonCode:'unknown_sic_code',detail:{sic:p.sic,sic_description:p.sicDescription},payload:{issuer_id:issuerId,cik,raw_hash:sub.rawHash,url:sub.url},batchId});
      counts.quarantined++;errors.push({code:'unknown_sic_code',key:issuerId,message:p.sic});
     }else{
      try{
       const res=await deps.db.applySicMembership(batchId,issuerId,observed,p.sic,{availability:'observed',raw_hash:sub.rawHash,locator:{url:sub.url,field:'sic',cik},sic_description:p.sicDescription},fence);
       if(res==='inserted')counts.inserted++;else if(res==='duplicate')counts.duplicates++;else if(res==='changed')counts.versioned++;
       ok=true;
      }catch(e){
       if(!(e instanceof IndustryDbError)||e.code==='lease_lost')throw e;
       await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:SIC_DATASET,table:'issuer_industry_memberships',naturalKey:`sic:${issuerId}:${observed}`,reasonCode:e.code==='unknown'?'sic_apply_error':e.code,detail:{sic:p.sic,message:errorMessage(e).slice(0,500)},payload:{issuer_id:issuerId,cik,raw_hash:sub.rawHash},batchId});
       counts.quarantined++;errors.push({code:e.code,key:issuerId});
      }
     }
    }
   }
  }catch(e){
   // lease_lost: another worker holds the row now — nothing was written by this worker, its outcome stands; no finish
   if(e instanceof IndustryDbError&&e.code==='lease_lost'){errors.push({code:'lease_lost',key:issuerId});continue;}
   counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'sic_error',key:issuerId,message:errorMessage(e)});
  }
  const doneAt=deps.now().toISOString();
  if(!await finishSicScopeRow(deps.tables,issuerId,batchId,{next_due_at:iso(deps.now().getTime()+retryMs),last_attempt_at:doneAt,...(ok?{last_success_at:doneAt}:{}),last_status:ok?'success':'failed',updated_at:doneAt}))
   errors.push({code:'lease_lost',key:issuerId});   // the lease expired and another worker took the row: its outcome stands
 }
 const skippedSummary=summarizeSkips(skips);
 const all=withSkippedSummary(errors,skippedSummary);
 const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:all},deps.now());
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts);
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SIC_DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now(),detail:{processed,added,retired}});
 return {status,batchId,counts,errors:all,exitCode:outcome.exitCode,processed,added,retired};
}
```

- Create: `src/lib/industry/decimal.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/industry/canonical-json.ts`（文件表把它记在 Task 11；`CONFIG_HASH` 需要它，故在此创建，Task 11 只使用）

要点（实现者必读）：
- 数值全程是规范十进制字符串。`decimal.ts` 是 `src/lib/facts/derive.ts` 私有 `Dec` 算术的逐字复制（`derive.ts` 不改）：加减乘精确，除法保留 `RATIO_SCALE=10` 位、四舍五入远离零、多一位保护位，与 `derive.ts::div` 相同。

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `decimal.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/decimal.ts
// Exact decimal arithmetic on canonical decimal strings (plan §共享契约 补充; spec §5.1). A copy of the
// BigInt `Dec` arithmetic of src/lib/facts/derive.ts, whose helpers are private and which this module
// must not edit: value = n / 10^s; add/sub/mul are exact; division rounds half away from zero to
// RATIO_SCALE places with one guard digit, exactly like derive.ts div(). Every result is a
// canonicalDecimal string. Inputs must be plain decimals (no exponent, no '+', no spaces): anything
// else throws invalid_decimal. No JS number ever carries a money or ratio value in this module.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {RATIO_SCALE} from '../facts/derive';
export {RATIO_SCALE};

interface Dec{n:bigint;s:number}
const DEC_RE=/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/;
const pow10=(k:number)=>10n**BigInt(k);
/** True for a plain decimal string ('-12.50', '0', '7'); exponents and signs other than '-' are rejected. */
export const isDecimal=(v:unknown):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&DEC_RE.test(v);
function parse(v:string):Dec{
 if(!isDecimal(v))throw new Error(`invalid_decimal:${String(v).slice(0,40)}`);
 const neg=v.startsWith('-'),body=neg?v.slice(1):v,[i,f='']=body.split('.');
 const n=BigInt(i+f);return {n:neg?-n:n,s:f.length};
}
function align(a:Dec,b:Dec):[bigint,bigint,number]{const s=Math.max(a.s,b.s);return [a.n*pow10(s-a.s),b.n*pow10(s-b.s),s];}
function toStr(d:Dec):string{
 const neg=d.n<0n;let digits=(neg?-d.n:d.n).toString();
 if(d.s>0){digits=digits.padStart(d.s+1,'0');digits=`${digits.slice(0,-d.s)}.${digits.slice(-d.s)}`;}
 return canonicalDecimal((neg?'-':'')+digits);
}
const addD=(a:Dec,b:Dec):Dec=>{const [x,y,s]=align(a,b);return {n:x+y,s};};

export const decAdd=(a:string,b:string):string=>toStr(addD(parse(a),parse(b)));
export const decSub=(a:string,b:string):string=>{const [x,y,s]=align(parse(a),parse(b));return toStr({n:x-y,s});};
/** Σ xs, exact; the empty sum is '0' (callers decide whether an empty set is missing). */
export const decSum=(xs:readonly string[]):string=>toStr(xs.reduce<Dec>((acc,x)=>addD(acc,parse(x)),{n:0n,s:0}));
export const decMul=(a:string,b:string):string=>{const x=parse(a),y=parse(b);return toStr({n:x.n*y.n,s:x.s+y.s});};
export const decAbs=(a:string):string=>{const x=parse(a);return toStr({n:x.n<0n?-x.n:x.n,s:x.s});};
export const decCmp=(a:string,b:string):-1|0|1=>{const [x,y]=align(parse(a),parse(b));return x<y?-1:x>y?1:0;};
export const decIsZero=(a:string):boolean=>parse(a).n===0n;
/** a / b rounded half away from zero to RATIO_SCALE places (derive.ts div semantics); null when b is zero. */
export function decDiv(a:string,b:string):string|null{
 const p=parse(a),q=parse(b);
 if(q.n===0n)return null;
 const [x,y]=align(p,q);
 const t=(x*pow10(RATIO_SCALE+1))/y;      // one guard digit; BigInt division truncates toward zero
 const r=t<0n?-((-t+5n)/10n):(t+5n)/10n;
 return toStr({n:r,s:RATIO_SCALE});
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `canonical-json.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/industry/canonical-json.ts
// Canonical JSON (spec §5.3 content addressing). One rendering for hashing and storage: object keys
// sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every depth, no whitespace, array order kept (callers sort arrays by
// the manifest's total orders before rendering), undefined object members dropped (like
// JSON.stringify), strings rendered with JSON.stringify and otherwise UNTOUCHED (decimal strings such
// as '1.50' are evidence and are never re-formatted here). Numbers must be safe integers (counts,
// levels, state_rev, mapping_gen): a fractional, non-finite or unsafe number throws
// canonical_json_number, so money and ratios can only travel as decimal strings. Non-plain objects
// (Date, Map, class instances), bigint, functions and undefined array items throw canonical_json_type.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
function render(v:unknown,path:string):string{
 if(v===null)return 'null';
 if(typeof v==='boolean')return v?'true':'false';
 if(typeof v==='number'){
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(v))throw new Error(`canonical_json_number:${path}`);
  return String(v===0?0:v);   // -0 → 0
 }
 if(typeof v==='string')return JSON.stringify(v);
 if(Array.isArray(v))return `[${v.map((x,i)=>{if(x===undefined)throw new Error(`canonical_json_type:${path}[${i}]`);return render(x,`${path}[${i}]`);}).join(',')}]`;
 if(typeof v==='object'){
  const proto=Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
  if(proto!==Object.prototype&&proto!==null)throw new Error(`canonical_json_type:${path}`);
  const entries=Object.entries(v as Record<string,unknown>).filter(([,x])=>x!==undefined).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a[0],b[0]));
  return `{${entries.map(([k,x])=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${render(x,`${path}.${k}`)}`).join(',')}}`;
 }
 throw new Error(`canonical_json_type:${path}`);
}
export function canonicalJson(value:unknown):string{return render(value,'$');}
/** Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of a string, or of raw bytes. */
export function sha256Hex(input:string|Uint8Array):string{return createHash('sha256').update(input).digest('hex');}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/method.ts
// Aggregation method definition (spec §5.1–§5.2). METHOD_CONFIG is the complete, versioned
// description of how a cell is computed; CONFIG_HASH = sha256(canonicalJson(METHOD_CONFIG)) is
// stored on every run and manifest, so any edit to the config changes the hash (and must come with a
// METHOD_VERSION bump; the pinned hash in method.test.ts makes an accidental edit fail CI).
// AGG_CONCEPTS is plan 2's DERIVE_CONCEPTS.CN: one readFacts per issuer per run reads the union of
// every concept any metric needs (V6). Cell layout per period_end (cellSpecs):
//  - revenue_sum / net_income_parent_sum: 3M (q_single_*) at every quarter end; 12M (direct annual
//    fact) only at a December 31 period_end — A-share 12M facts are fiscal years, a 12M cell at
//    another quarter end would always be empty;
//  - gross_margin: 12M at December 31 only (spec: no single quarter);
//  - roe: TTM at every quarter end (window = the four quarters ending at period_end);
//  - revenue_yoy / net_income_yoy: 3M at every quarter end, 12M at December 31;
//  - member_count: INSTANT at every period_end.
// So the expected grid is codes × quarter ends × AGG_METRICS, except gross_margin, which has rows only
// at '-12-31' period_ends (the completeness rule of activate_industry_metric_run must match; see the
// plan skeleton's 跨任务接口约定 A1). Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' UTC calendar dates.
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,FORMULA_VERSION,addDays} from '../facts/derive';
import {canonicalJson,sha256Hex} from './canonical-json';
import {decCmp,decMul} from './decimal';
import {DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED,DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE,METHOD_VERSION} from './method-constants';
import {SW2021_CODE_ALIASES} from './sw2021';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric,ClassificationRow,MetricRunRow} from './types';

export {DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED,DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE,METHOD_VERSION};
export {FORMULA_VERSION};
export const AGG_METRICS:readonly AggMetric[]=['revenue_sum','net_income_parent_sum','gross_margin','roe','revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy','member_count'];
/** Concepts read once per issuer per run (plan 2 DERIVE_CONCEPTS.CN, V6). */
export const AGG_CONCEPTS:readonly string[]=[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS.CN];
export const AGG_CURRENCY='CNY';
/** Default first period_end of the grid (SW2021 effective; verification item 3 may move it; a run parameter, not config). */
export const DEFAULT_HISTORY_START='2021-12-31';
/** Readiness gate (spec §4.10): at least this percentage of the run's member issuers must have fact_sync_scope.last_success_at. */
export const READINESS_MIN_PERCENT=95;

export const METHOD_CONFIG={
 method_version:METHOD_VERSION,
 approach:'whole_method',
 market:'CN',currency:AGG_CURRENCY,consolidation:'consolidated',
 concepts:AGG_CONCEPTS,
 membership:'members_at(on=period_end,known_by=facts_as_of)',
 facts_read:'one_read_facts_envelope_per_issuer_per_run(history=true,as_of=facts_as_of)',
 metrics:{
  revenue_sum:{'12M':'sum(fact:revenue@12M)','3M':'sum(derived:q_single_revenue)',unit:'CNY'},
  net_income_parent_sum:{'12M':'sum(fact:net_income_parent@12M)','3M':'sum(derived:q_single_net_income_parent)',unit:'CNY'},
  gross_margin:{'12M':'(sum(fact:revenue_operating)-sum(fact:cost_of_revenue))/sum(fact:revenue_operating)',unit:'ratio'},
  roe:{TTM:'sum(derived:ttm_net_income_parent)/sum(avg(fact:equity_parent@window_start-1d,fact:equity_parent@period_end))',non_positive_denominator:'zero_denominator',unit:'ratio'},
  revenue_yoy:{'12M':'yoy(fact:revenue@12M)','3M':'yoy(derived:q_single_revenue)',unit:'ratio'},
  net_income_yoy:{'12M':'yoy(fact:net_income_parent@12M)','3M':'yoy(derived:q_single_net_income_parent)',unit:'ratio'},
  member_count:{INSTANT:'count(members)',unit:'count'},
 },
 twelve_month_period_end:'12-31',
 yoy:{comparable_set:'members_with_current_and_prior',prior:'same_period_one_year_earlier',formula:'(sum_t-sum_prior)/abs(sum_prior)'},
 match:'exact_period_and_unit',
 financial_l1_codes:['801780','801790'],
 display_min_coverage:DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE,display_max_unresolved:DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED,
 ratio_scale:10,rounding:'half_away_from_zero',
 percentile_sampling:'month_end_published',
 total_share_basis:'all_classes_incl_h_b',   // spec 7th draft K2: daily_basic.total_share = A+H+B issued shares
 code_aliases:SW2021_CODE_ALIASES,           // spec 7th draft K3: member-API code → tree code (Task 7 sw2021.ts)
} as const;
export const CONFIG_HASH=sha256Hex(canonicalJson(METHOD_CONFIG));

export interface CellSpec{metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;period_start:string;period_end:string;unit:'CNY'|'ratio'|'count'}

const DAY=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
export function assertDay(name:string,v:string):void{
 const t=typeof v==='string'&&DAY.test(v)?Date.parse(`${v}T00:00:00Z`):Number.NaN;
 if(Number.isNaN(t)||new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==v)throw new Error(`invalid_date:${name}`);
}
const QUARTER_START:Record<string,string>={'03-31':'01-01','06-30':'04-01','09-30':'07-01','12-31':'10-01'};
export const isQuarterEnd=(d:string)=>DAY.test(d)&&d.slice(5) in QUARTER_START;
/** First day of the calendar quarter ending at `pe` (a quarter end). */
export function quarterStart(pe:string):string{
 const s=QUARTER_START[pe.slice(5)];if(!s)throw new Error(`not_quarter_end:${pe}`);
 return `${pe.slice(0,4)}-${s}`;
}
/** Same month-day `n` years later (n may be negative); quarter ends and Jan 1 never hit Feb 29. */
export function shiftYears(d:string,n:number):string{
 assertDay('date',d);
 const out=`${String(Number(d.slice(0,4))+n).padStart(4,'0')}${d.slice(4)}`;
 assertDay('shifted',out);return out;
}
/** Every calendar quarter end q with from <= q <= to, ascending. */
export function quarterEnds(from:string,to:string):string[]{
 assertDay('from',from);assertDay('to',to);
 const out:string[]=[];
 for(let y=Number(from.slice(0,4));y<=Number(to.slice(0,4));y++)for(const md of ['03-31','06-30','09-30','12-31']){const q=`${y}-${md}`;if(q>=from&&q<=to)out.push(q);}
 return out;
}
const DURATION_ORDER:Record<AggDuration,number>={'12M':0,'3M':1,TTM:2,INSTANT:3};
/** The cells of one (code, period_end), in AGG_METRICS then duration order. */
export function cellSpecs(pe:string):CellSpec[]{
 const qs=quarterStart(pe),dec=pe.endsWith('-12-31'),ys=`${pe.slice(0,4)}-01-01`;
 const out:CellSpec[]=[];
 const add=(metric:AggMetric,duration:AggDuration,period_start:string,unit:CellSpec['unit'])=>out.push({metric,duration,period_start,period_end:pe,unit});
 for(const m of ['revenue_sum','net_income_parent_sum'] as const){if(dec)add(m,'12M',ys,'CNY');add(m,'3M',qs,'CNY');}
 if(dec)add('gross_margin','12M',ys,'ratio');
 add('roe','TTM',addDays(shiftYears(pe,-1),1),'ratio');
 for(const m of ['revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy'] as const){if(dec)add(m,'12M',ys,'ratio');add(m,'3M',qs,'ratio');}
 add('member_count','INSTANT',pe,'count');
 return out.sort((a,b)=>AGG_METRICS.indexOf(a.metric)-AGG_METRICS.indexOf(b.metric)||DURATION_ORDER[a.duration]-DURATION_ORDER[b.duration]);
}
/** expected_grid of a run: sorted unique codes × quarter ends from historyStart to factsAsOf × AGG_METRICS. */
export function expectedGrid(codes:readonly string[],historyStart:string,factsAsOf:string):MetricRunRow['expected_grid']{
 assertDay('historyStart',historyStart);assertDay('factsAsOf',factsAsOf);
 if(historyStart>factsAsOf)throw new Error('invalid_grid:history_start_after_facts_as_of');
 const uniq=[...new Set(codes)].sort();
 if(uniq.length===0)throw new Error('invalid_grid:no_codes');
 return {codes:uniq,period_ends:quarterEnds(historyStart,factsAsOf),metrics:[...AGG_METRICS]};
}
/**
 * Every (code, metric, duration, period_end) the grid requires a row for = cellSpecs restricted to the
 * grid's metrics. This is exactly the completeness rule of activate_industry_metric_run (Task 2 SQL
 * values table; Task 3 memory REQUIRED_DURATIONS): 3M at every period end for the sums and YoY, 12M only
 * on December 31 (sums, YoY, gross_margin), TTM for roe, INSTANT for member_count.
 */
export function expectedCells(grid:MetricRunRow['expected_grid']):{code:string;metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;period_end:string}[]{
 const out:{code:string;metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;period_end:string}[]=[];
 for(const code of grid.codes)for(const pe of grid.period_ends)for(const c of cellSpecs(pe))if(grid.metrics.includes(c.metric))out.push({code,metric:c.metric,duration:c.duration,period_end:pe});
 return out;
}
export const cellKey=(code:string,periodEnd:string)=>`${code}:${periodEnd}`;
/** Financial L1 code ('801780.SI' or '801780'): gross margin is not computed (spec §5.1). */
export const isFinancialCode=(code:string)=>(METHOD_CONFIG.financial_l1_codes as readonly string[]).includes(code.replace(/\.SI$/i,''));
/** Walks parent_code up to the level-1 ancestor and applies isFinancialCode; an unknown or cyclic chain is not financial. */
export function isFinancialNode(code:string,tree:readonly ClassificationRow[]):boolean{
 const byCode=new Map(tree.map(r=>[r.code,r]));
 let cur=byCode.get(code);const seen=new Set<string>();
 while(cur&&cur.level>1&&cur.parent_code&&!seen.has(cur.code)){seen.add(cur.code);cur=byCode.get(cur.parent_code);}
 return !!cur&&cur.level===1&&isFinancialCode(cur.code);
}
/** Display thresholds (spec §5.2): never change a cell's status, only how the page labels it. */
export function displayFlags(c:{n_members:number;n_with_data:number;n_unresolved:number}):{coverageOk:boolean;unresolvedOk:boolean}{
 const total=String(c.n_members+c.n_unresolved);
 if(total==='0')return {coverageOk:false,unresolvedOk:true};
 return {coverageOk:decCmp(String(c.n_with_data),decMul(DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE,total))>=0,unresolvedOk:decCmp(String(c.n_unresolved),decMul(DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED,total))<=0};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/aggregate.test.ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {deriveMetrics} from '../facts/derive';
import type {Duration,FactRow} from '../facts/types';
import {computeAggregateCell} from './aggregate';
import type {AggregateCellInput,IssuerFacts} from './aggregate';
import type {ManifestCell} from './types';

const A='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a',B='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b',C='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c';
let n=0;
const DUR:Record<string,Duration>={'03':'3M','06':'6M','09':'9M','12':'12M'};
/** One current CN fact; filing per (issuer, period_end) unless given. */
function fact(issuer:string,concept:string,periodEnd:string,value:string,o:Partial<FactRow>={}):FactRow{
 const instant=concept==='equity_parent';
 const id=`f${String(++n).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 return {fact_id:id,issuer_id:issuer,market:'CN',filing_id:`${issuer}:${periodEnd}`,run_id:'r',concept,source_concept:concept,statement:instant?'BS':'IS',
  period_start:instant?null:`${periodEnd.slice(0,4)}-01-01`,period_end:periodEnd,duration:instant?'INSTANT':DUR[periodEnd.slice(5,7)],value,value_text:value,unit:'CNY',consolidation:'consolidated',
  available_date:'2025-04-30',mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',status:'ok',raw_hash:`h${id}`,created_at:'2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z',disclosure_seq:1,is_current:true,is_revision:false,...o};
}
/** YTD series of one concept for one year: values for Q1 (3M), H1 (6M), 9M, FY (12M); null skips a report. */
const ytd=(issuer:string,concept:string,year:number,values:(string|null)[])=>values.flatMap((v,i)=>v===null?[]:[fact(issuer,concept,`${year}-${['03-31','06-30','09-30','12-31'][i]}`,v)]);
const issuer=(id:string,rows:FactRow[],o:Partial<IssuerFacts>={}):IssuerFacts=>({issuer_id:id,stateRev:3,truncated:false,rows,derived:deriveMetrics(rows,{market:'CN',asOf:'2025-05-15',basedOnRev:3}),...o});
/** A and B: full 2023–2024 data; numbers chosen so every expected value below is checkable by hand. */
const dataA=()=>[
 ...ytd(A,'revenue',2023,[null,null,'600','800']),...ytd(A,'revenue',2024,[null,null,'700.25','1000.5']),
 ...ytd(A,'revenue_operating',2024,[null,null,null,'900']),...ytd(A,'cost_of_revenue',2024,[null,null,null,'600']),
 ...ytd(A,'net_income_parent',2023,[null,null,'35','50']),...ytd(A,'net_income_parent',2024,['10','25','45','70']),
 fact(A,'equity_parent','2023-12-31','500'),fact(A,'equity_parent','2024-12-31','600'),
];
const dataB=()=>[
 ...ytd(B,'revenue',2023,[null,null,'1200','1600']),...ytd(B,'revenue',2024,[null,null,'1500','2000']),
 ...ytd(B,'revenue_operating',2024,[null,null,null,'1800']),...ytd(B,'cost_of_revenue',2024,[null,null,null,'1000']),
 ...ytd(B,'net_income_parent',2023,[null,null,'50','70']),...ytd(B,'net_income_parent',2024,['20','40','60','90']),
 fact(B,'equity_parent','2023-12-31','900'),fact(B,'equity_parent','2024-12-31','1100'),
];
const input=(issuers:IssuerFacts[],o:Partial<AggregateCellInput>={}):AggregateCellInput=>({code:'801120.SI',period_end:'2024-12-31',financial:false,members:issuers.map(i=>i.issuer_id),nUnresolved:0,issuers:new Map(issuers.map(i=>[i.issuer_id,i])),...o});
const cell=(cells:ManifestCell[],metric:string,duration:string)=>cells.find(c=>c.metric===metric&&c.duration===duration)!;
const roleOf=(r:ReturnType<typeof computeAggregateCell>,id:string,metric:string,duration:string)=>r.roles.find(x=>x.issuer_id===id&&x.metric===metric&&x.duration===duration);

describe('computeAggregateCell',()=>{
 it('computes every cell of a December group by the whole method with exact decimals',()=>{
  const r=computeAggregateCell(input([issuer(A,dataA()),issuer(B,dataB())],{nUnresolved:1}));
  const v=(m:string,d:string)=>cell(r.cells,m,d).value_text;
  expect(v('revenue_sum','12M')).toBe('3000.5');                 // 1000.5 + 2000
  expect(v('revenue_sum','3M')).toBe('800.25');                  // (1000.5-700.25) + (2000-1500)
  expect(v('net_income_parent_sum','12M')).toBe('160');
  expect(v('net_income_parent_sum','3M')).toBe('55');            // 25 + 30
  expect(v('gross_margin','12M')).toBe('0.4074074074');          // (2700-1600)/2700
  expect(v('roe','TTM')).toBe('0.1032258065');                   // 2·160 / (500+600+900+1100)
  expect(v('revenue_yoy','12M')).toBe('0.2502083333');           // (3000.5-2400)/2400
  expect(v('revenue_yoy','3M')).toBe('0.33375');                 // (800.25-600)/600
  expect(v('net_income_yoy','12M')).toBe('0.3333333333');        // (160-120)/120
  expect(v('net_income_yoy','3M')).toBe('0.5714285714');         // (55-35)/35
  expect(v('member_count','INSTANT')).toBe('2');
  for(const c of r.cells){expect(c).toMatchObject({status:'ok',n_members:2,n_unresolved:1,n_with_data:2});expect(c.missing_reason).toBeUndefined();}
  expect(cell(r.cells,'roe','TTM')).toMatchObject({period_start:'2024-01-01',unit:'ratio'});
  expect(cell(r.cells,'revenue_sum','12M').unit).toBe('CNY');expect(cell(r.cells,'member_count','INSTANT').unit).toBe('count');
  expect(r.roles.every(x=>x.role==='included')).toBe(true);

  expect(r.derived.map(d=>`${d.issuer_id===A?'A':'B'}:${d.metric}:${d.period_start}`).sort()).toEqual([

   'B:q_single_net_income_parent:2023-10-01','B:q_single_net_income_parent:2024-10-01','B:q_single_revenue:2023-10-01','B:q_single_revenue:2024-10-01','B:ttm_net_income_parent:2024-01-01']);

  expect(r.facts.some(f=>f.concept==='net_income_parent'&&f.duration==='3M'&&f.period_end==='2024-03-31')).toBe(true);   // TTM input
  expect(r.warnings).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('missing stays missing: a member without facts is excluded (never 0) and an all-empty set is missing:empty_set',()=>{
  const r=computeAggregateCell(input([issuer(A,dataA()),issuer(C,[])]));
  expect(cell(r.cells,'revenue_sum','12M')).toMatchObject({status:'ok',value_text:'1000.5',n_members:2,n_with_data:1});

  expect(cell(r.cells,'member_count','INSTANT')).toMatchObject({value_text:'2',n_with_data:2});
  const empty=computeAggregateCell(input([issuer(C,[])]));
  for(const c of empty.cells.filter(x=>x.metric!=='member_count')){expect(c).toMatchObject({status:'missing',missing_reason:'empty_set',n_with_data:0});expect(c.value_text).toBeUndefined();}
 });

  const rows=dataB().map(f=>f.concept==='revenue'&&f.period_end==='2024-12-31'?{...f,unit:'USD'}:f);

   .map(f=>f.concept==='revenue'&&f.period_end==='2024-12-31'&&f.filing_id===`${A}:2024-12-31`?{...f,is_current:false}:f);
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/aggregate.ts
// One (code, period_end) group of industry cells, pure (spec §5.1–§5.2). Input: the group's members
// (issuer ids, point-in-time at period_end known by facts_as_of), the unresolved count, the financial
// flag, and per member ONE IssuerFacts = the issuer's single readFacts envelope of this run plus
// deriveMetrics(envelope.rows, {market:'CN', asOf: facts_as_of, basedOnRev: envelope.stateRev}) (V5/V6).
// Output: every cell of cellSpecs(period_end) (ok or missing + reason), one role per member per cell
// (included / excluded + reason), and the facts and derived rows actually used (the manifest's inputs).
// Rules ("missing stays missing"; never 0, never a proxy):
//  - inputs match exactly (period_start, period_end, duration, unit 'CNY', consolidated, current
//    disclosure); a non-unique match counts as absent; another unit → excluded:unit_excluded;
//  - a truncated envelope excludes the issuer from every value cell (read_truncated), never partially;
//  - 3M values are plan-2 q_single_* rows; when the YTD pair exists but derive produced no quarter the
//    reason is version_inconsistent (derive refuses incompatible disclosure versions), else missing_concept;
//  - yoy uses the comparable set: members with both the current and the prior-year value; a member
//    with only the current value is excluded:not_in_comparable_set;
//  - gross_margin of a financial industry is missing:financial_excluded (all members excluded);
//  - status precedence: no members → missing (unresolved_over_limit when every constituent is
//    unresolved, else no_members) → member_count ok → financial_excluded → empty_set → arithmetic
//    (zero or, for roe, non-positive denominator → zero_denominator).
// pickInputs / finalizeCell are shared with replay.ts so a manifest replays through the same code.
import type {FactRow,MetricRow} from '../facts/types';
import {addDays} from '../facts/derive';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {decAbs,decAdd,decCmp,decDiv,decMul,decSub,decSum} from './decimal';
import {AGG_CURRENCY,cellSpecs,shiftYears} from './method';
import type {CellSpec} from './method';
import type {AggMetric,ManifestCell,ManifestRole,MissingReason,RoleReason} from './types';

export interface IssuerFacts{issuer_id:string;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean;rows:FactRow[];derived:MetricRow[]}
export interface AggregateCellInput{code:string;period_end:string;financial:boolean;members:readonly string[];nUnresolved:number;issuers:ReadonlyMap<string,IssuerFacts>}
export interface AggregateCellResult{cells:ManifestCell[];roles:ManifestRole[];facts:FactRow[];derived:MetricRow[];warnings:string[]}

// ---- input pool shared with replay ----
export interface PoolFact{issuer_id:string;concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:string;unit:string;value:string}
export interface PoolDerived{issuer_id:string;metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;duration:string;unit:string;value:string}
interface Req{kind:'fact'|'derived';name:string;duration:string;ps:string|null;pe:string;prior:boolean}
const k=(kind:string,issuer:string,name:string,duration:string,ps:string|null,pe:string,unit:string|null)=>[kind,issuer,name,duration,ps??'',pe,unit??'*'].join('\u0000');
/** Index of facts and derived rows by exact (issuer, name, duration, period, unit) and by the same key without unit. */
export class InputIndex<F extends PoolFact,D extends PoolDerived>{
 private exact=new Map<string,(F|D)[]>();private anyUnit=new Map<string,(F|D)[]>();
 constructor(facts:readonly F[],derived:readonly D[]){
  const put=(m:Map<string,(F|D)[]>,key:string,x:F|D)=>{const l=m.get(key);if(l)l.push(x);else m.set(key,[x]);};
  for(const f of facts){put(this.exact,k('fact',f.issuer_id,f.concept,f.duration,f.period_start,f.period_end,f.unit),f);put(this.anyUnit,k('fact',f.issuer_id,f.concept,f.duration,f.period_start,f.period_end,null),f);}
  for(const d of derived){put(this.exact,k('derived',d.issuer_id,d.metric,d.duration,d.period_start,d.period_end,d.unit),d);put(this.anyUnit,k('derived',d.issuer_id,d.metric,d.duration,d.period_start,d.period_end,null),d);}
 }
 get(r:Req,issuer:string,unit:string|null):(F|D)[]{return (unit===null?this.anyUnit:this.exact).get(k(r.kind,issuer,r.name,r.duration,r.ps,r.pe,unit))??[];}
}
const CONCEPT:Partial<Record<AggMetric,string>>={revenue_sum:'revenue',net_income_parent_sum:'net_income_parent',revenue_yoy:'revenue',net_income_yoy:'net_income_parent'};
/** The exact inputs one issuer must have for one cell (empty for member_count). */
function requirements(spec:CellSpec):Req[]{
 const {metric,duration,period_start:ps,period_end:pe}=spec;
 const c=CONCEPT[metric];
 const fact=(name:string,dur:string,s:string|null,e:string,prior=false):Req=>({kind:'fact',name,duration:dur,ps:s,pe:e,prior});
 const der=(name:string,dur:string,s:string,e:string,prior=false):Req=>({kind:'derived',name,duration:dur,ps:s,pe:e,prior});
 switch(metric){
  case 'revenue_sum':case 'net_income_parent_sum':return duration==='12M'?[fact(c!,'12M',ps,pe)]:[der(`q_single_${c}`,'3M',ps,pe)];
  case 'gross_margin':return [fact('revenue_operating','12M',ps,pe),fact('cost_of_revenue','12M',ps,pe)];
  case 'roe':return [der('ttm_net_income_parent','TTM',ps,pe),fact('equity_parent','INSTANT',null,addDays(ps,-1)),fact('equity_parent','INSTANT',null,pe)];
  case 'revenue_yoy':case 'net_income_yoy':{
   const py=(d:string)=>shiftYears(d,-1);
   return duration==='12M'?[fact(c!,'12M',ps,pe),fact(c!,'12M',py(ps),py(pe),true)]:[der(`q_single_${c}`,'3M',ps,pe),der(`q_single_${c}`,'3M',py(ps),py(pe),true)];
  }
  case 'member_count':return [];
 }
}
export type Picked<F,D>={ok:true;values:string[];facts:F[];derived:D[]}|{ok:false;failed:Req};
/** The issuer's unique CNY inputs for the cell, or the first requirement that is absent or ambiguous. */
export function pickInputs<F extends PoolFact,D extends PoolDerived>(spec:CellSpec,issuer:string,idx:InputIndex<F,D>):Picked<F,D>{
 const values:string[]=[];const facts:F[]=[];const derived:D[]=[];
 for(const r of requirements(spec)){
  const hits=idx.get(r,issuer,AGG_CURRENCY);
  if(hits.length!==1)return {ok:false,failed:r};
  values.push(hits[0].value);
  if(r.kind==='fact')facts.push(hits[0] as F);else derived.push(hits[0] as D);
 }
 return {ok:true,values,facts,derived};
}
/** Combines the included issuers' input tuples (pickInputs order) into a value or a missing reason. */
function combine(metric:AggMetric,inc:readonly string[][]):{value:string}|{missing:MissingReason}{
 const col=(i:number)=>inc.map(v=>v[i]);
 switch(metric){
  case 'revenue_sum':case 'net_income_parent_sum':return {value:decSum(col(0))};
  case 'gross_margin':{const ro=decSum(col(0)),cor=decSum(col(1));const v=decDiv(decSub(ro,cor),ro);return v===null?{missing:'zero_denominator'}:{value:v};}
  case 'roe':{
   // Σ ttm / Σ avg(e0,e1) = 2·Σ ttm / Σ (e0+e1); a non-positive denominator is not meaningful
   const den=decSum(inc.map(v=>decAdd(v[1],v[2])));
   if(decCmp(den,'0')<=0)return {missing:'zero_denominator'};
   return {value:decDiv(decMul('2',decSum(col(0))),den)!};
  }
  case 'revenue_yoy':case 'net_income_yoy':{const cur=decSum(col(0)),prior=decSum(col(1));const v=decDiv(decSub(cur,prior),decAbs(prior));return v===null?{missing:'zero_denominator'}:{value:v};}
  case 'member_count':throw new Error('combine_member_count');
 }
}
/**
 * The cell from structural counts and the included inputs (shared by aggregate and replay).
 * included = input tuples of included issuers; financial = gross_margin of a financial industry.
 */
export function finalizeCell(spec:CellSpec,nMembers:number,nUnresolved:number,financial:boolean,included:readonly string[][]):ManifestCell{
 const base={metric:spec.metric,duration:spec.duration,period_start:spec.period_start,n_members:nMembers,n_unresolved:nUnresolved,unit:spec.unit};
 const missing=(reason:MissingReason,nWith=0):ManifestCell=>({...base,status:'missing',missing_reason:reason,n_with_data:nWith});
 if(nMembers===0)return missing(nUnresolved>0?'unresolved_over_limit':'no_members');
 if(spec.metric==='member_count')return {...base,status:'ok',value_text:String(nMembers),n_with_data:nMembers};
 if(financial&&spec.metric==='gross_margin')return missing('financial_excluded');
 if(included.length===0)return missing('empty_set');
 const r=combine(spec.metric,included);
 return 'missing' in r?missing(r.missing,included.length):{...base,status:'ok',value_text:canonicalDecimal(r.value),n_with_data:included.length};
}

// ---- aggregate (run side) ----
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const STEP:Record<string,string>={'6M':'3M','9M':'6M','12M':'9M'};
const YTD_BY_MONTH:Record<string,string>={'03':'3M','06':'6M','09':'9M','12':'12M'};
interface Indexed{idx:InputIndex<PoolFact&{row:FactRow},PoolDerived&{row:MetricRow}>;byId:Map<string,FactRow>}
const cache=new WeakMap<IssuerFacts,Indexed>();
function indexOf(f:IssuerFacts):Indexed{
 let x=cache.get(f);if(x)return x;
 // current ok consolidated disclosures only (one per natural key under readFacts history=true)
 const cur=f.rows.filter(r=>r.is_current===true&&r.status==='ok'&&r.consolidation==='consolidated');
 const facts=cur.map(r=>({issuer_id:r.issuer_id,concept:r.concept,period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,duration:r.duration,unit:r.unit,value:r.value,row:r}));
 const derived=f.derived.map(m=>({issuer_id:m.issuer_id,metric:m.metric,period_start:m.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,duration:m.duration,unit:m.unit,value:m.value,row:m}));
 x={idx:new InputIndex(facts,derived),byId:new Map(f.rows.map(r=>[r.fact_id,r]))};
 cache.set(f,x);return x;
}
/** Why an issuer has no value for the cell (run side only; replay reads roles from the manifest). */
function reasonOf(failed:Req,issuer:string,ix:Indexed):RoleReason{
 if(failed.prior)return 'not_in_comparable_set';
 if(ix.idx.get(failed,issuer,null).length>0&&ix.idx.get(failed,issuer,AGG_CURRENCY).length===0)return 'unit_excluded';
 if(failed.kind==='derived'&&failed.name.startsWith('q_single_')){
  // the YTD pair derive would difference: a = YTD ending pe, b = the previous YTD step
  const concept=failed.name.slice('q_single_'.length),pe=failed.pe,ys=`${pe.slice(0,4)}-01-01`;
  const aDur=YTD_BY_MONTH[pe.slice(5,7)],bDur=STEP[aDur];
  if(bDur){
   const one=(dur:string,end:string)=>ix.idx.get({kind:'fact',name:concept,duration:dur,ps:ys,pe:end,prior:false},issuer,AGG_CURRENCY).length===1;
   if(one(aDur,pe)&&one(bDur,addDays(failed.ps!,-1)))return 'version_inconsistent';
  }
 }
 return 'missing_concept';
}
export function computeAggregateCell(input:AggregateCellInput):AggregateCellResult{
 const members=[...new Set(input.members)].sort(cmp);
 const warnings:string[]=[];
 const usedFacts=new Map<string,FactRow>();const usedDerived=new Map<string,MetricRow>();
 const roles:ManifestRole[]=[];const cells:ManifestCell[]=[];
 const facts=(id:string)=>{const f=input.issuers.get(id);if(!f)throw new Error(`missing_envelope:${id}`);if(f.issuer_id!==id)throw new Error(`envelope_issuer_mismatch:${id}`);return f;};
 for(const spec of cellSpecs(input.period_end)){
  const included:string[][]=[];
  const role=(issuer_id:string,r:RoleReason|null)=>roles.push(r===null?{issuer_id,metric:spec.metric,duration:spec.duration,role:'included'}:{issuer_id,metric:spec.metric,duration:spec.duration,role:'excluded',reason:r});
  for(const id of members){
   if(spec.metric==='member_count'){role(id,null);continue;}
   if(spec.metric==='gross_margin'&&input.financial){role(id,'financial_excluded');continue;}
   const f=facts(id);
   if(f.truncated){role(id,'read_truncated');continue;}
   const ix=indexOf(f);
   const p=pickInputs(spec,id,ix.idx);
   if(!p.ok){role(id,reasonOf(p.failed,id,ix));continue;}
   role(id,null);included.push(p.values);
   for(const x of p.facts)usedFacts.set(x.row.fact_id,x.row);
   for(const d of p.derived){
    usedDerived.set([d.issuer_id,d.metric,d.period_start,d.period_end,d.duration,d.unit,d.row.basis].join('|'),d.row);
    for(const i of d.row.inputs){const r=ix.byId.get(i.fact_id);if(r)usedFacts.set(r.fact_id,r);else warnings.push(`derived_input_not_in_envelope:${i.fact_id}`);}
   }
  }
  cells.push(finalizeCell(spec,members.length,input.nUnresolved,input.financial,included));
 }
 for(const id of members)if(facts(id).truncated)warnings.push(`read_truncated:${id}`);
 return {cells,roles,facts:[...usedFacts.values()],derived:[...usedDerived.values()],warnings:[...new Set(warnings)].sort(cmp)};
}
```

### Task 11: 内容寻址清单 `manifest.ts`、离线回放 `replay.ts`（规格 §5.3、§5.5 original）

依赖：Task 10。`canonical-json.ts` 已由 Task 10 创建，本任务只使用。

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/industry/manifest.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/industry/replay.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/manifest.test.ts`、`src/lib/industry/replay.test.ts`

要点：
- `buildAggregateManifest` 纯：按规格 §5.3 的全序（加上 `roles` 的 `duration`）排序全部数组，因此输入顺序打乱后规范字节与哈希不变；`derived[].inputs` = 计划二 `MetricRow.inputs` 原样（含 `ytd_rule`、`quarter`，V5）；`facts[].source_ref/citation` 只经调用方传入的 `filings`（`FactsDb.filingsOfIssuer` 结果）查得，查不到 → `null` + `warnings: filing_not_found:<filing_id>`。`citation`：EDGAR → `'edgar'`；Tushare 有 `document_ref` → `'linked'`，否则 `'pending'`。
- `manifest_hash = sha256(未压缩规范 JSON)`；桶 `industry-manifests`，路径 = 索引行的 `object_path`（`sha256/<hash>/<登记 uuid>.json.gz`，按代次区分，Codex 第 2 轮 R2-1；读写都经 `manifestObjectPath`），`upsert:false`，**先** `registerManifest`（`put_industry_manifest`：GC 已认领（tombstone）的哈希在这里被拒 `manifest_gc_in_progress`）、**再上传对象**；409 = 已存在（同哈希即同字节）。GC 协议见骨架《跨任务接口约定》A7（Codex 计划审计第 1 轮 #4）。`get` 解压后复核哈希与规范性。
- `gcManifests`：`manifestGcCandidates` → `ManifestStore.remove` → 只对删成功的哈希 `deleteManifestIndex`（迁移不能引用 `storage.objects`，删失败的保留索引行，下次再试）。
- `replayFromManifest` 纯：只用清单的 `facts/derived/roles`（结构计数来自 `members/unresolved`），经 Task 10 的 `pickInputs`/`finalizeCell` 重算每格并与存储的 `cells` 做规范 JSON 比较；不查库、不读时钟、不读当前 `METHOD_CONFIG`。

```ts
 memberStateRevs:[{issuer_id:I2,state_rev:3},{issuer_id:I1,state_rev:4}],
 result:result(),
 filings:new Map([['g0',filing('g0',I1,{source_ref:'600001.SH:20240930:1:20241030',document_ref:'cninfo:123'})],['g1',filing('g1',I1)]]),
});
const fakeDb=()=>{const index=new Map<string,{kind:string;bytes:number;path:string}>();const calls:string[]=[];let k=0;
 const db:Pick<IndustryDb,'registerManifest'|'manifestObjectPath'|'manifestGcCandidates'|'deleteManifestIndex'>={
  async registerManifest(h,kind,bytes){calls.push(`register:${h.slice(0,8)}`);if(index.has(h))return false;index.set(h,{kind,bytes,path:`sha256/${h}/00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(++k).padStart(12,'0')}.json.gz`});return true;},
  async manifestObjectPath(h){return index.get(h)?.path??null;},
  async manifestGcCandidates(limit){calls.push(`candidates:${limit}`);return [...index].slice(0,limit).map(([hash,v])=>({hash,objectPath:v.path,claim:`claim-${hash.slice(0,4)}`}));},
  async deleteManifestIndex(cs){calls.push(`delete:${cs.length}`);let n=0;for(const c of cs)if(index.delete(c.hash))n++;return n;},
 };return {db,index,calls};};

describe('buildAggregateManifest',()=>{
 it('sorts every array by its total order, keeps MetricRow.inputs verbatim and resolves source_ref/citation through the filings map',()=>{
  const m=buildAggregateManifest(input());
  expect(m).toMatchObject({schema:'industry-manifest/2',kind:'aggregate',scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:'801120.SI',level:1,period_end:'2024-12-31',facts_as_of:'2025-05-15',knowledge_date:'2025-05-15',history_class:'reconstruction',code_version:'abc123'});
  expect(m.members.map(x=>x.issuer_id)).toEqual([I1,I2]);
  expect(m.unresolved.map(x=>x.ts_code)).toEqual(['000999.SZ','600999.SH']);
  expect(m.member_state_revs).toEqual([{issuer_id:I1,state_rev:4},{issuer_id:I2,state_rev:3}]);
  expect(m.facts.map(f=>f.fact_id)).toEqual(['f-9m','f-12m','f-x']);   // same issuer, concept and period_start: period_end decides
  expect(m.roles.map(r=>`${r.metric}:${r.duration}:${r.issuer_id===I1?1:2}`)).toEqual(['member_count:INSTANT:1','revenue_sum:3M:1','revenue_sum:3M:2']);
  expect(m.cells.map(c=>`${c.metric}:${c.duration}`)).toEqual(['member_count:INSTANT','revenue_sum:12M','revenue_sum:3M']);
  expect(m.derived[0].inputs).toEqual(derived.inputs);
  expect(m.derived[0]).not.toHaveProperty('based_on_rev');
  const f12=m.facts.find(f=>f.fact_id==='f-12m')!,f9=m.facts.find(f=>f.fact_id==='f-9m')!,fx=m.facts.find(f=>f.fact_id==='f-x')!;
  expect(f12).toMatchObject({value_text:'1000.5',source_ref:'600001.SH:20241231:1:20250328',citation:'pending',raw_hash:'raw-f-12m',mapping_gen:1,filing_id:'g1',available_date:'2025-03-28'});
  expect(f9).toMatchObject({citation:'linked',source_ref:'600001.SH:20240930:1:20241030'});
  expect(fx).toMatchObject({source_ref:null,citation:null});
  expect(m.warnings).toEqual(['aa','filing_not_found:g-missing','zz']);
 });
});

describe('encode / decode / stores / gc',()=>{
 it('encodes canonical JSON, hashes the uncompressed bytes, and decodes only matching canonical content',()=>{
  const m=buildAggregateManifest(input());
  const e=encodeManifest(m);
  expect(e.canonical).toBe(canonicalJson(m));
  expect(e.hash).toBe(sha256Hex(e.canonical));
  expect(decodeManifest(e.gzip,e.hash)).toEqual(m);
  expect(()=>decodeManifest(e.gzip,'0'.repeat(64))).toThrow('manifest_hash_mismatch');
  expect(()=>decodeManifest(new Uint8Array(gzipSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(m,null,1)))))).toThrow('manifest_not_canonical');
  expect(()=>decodeManifest(new Uint8Array(gzipSync(Buffer.from(canonicalJson({...m,schema:'x'})))))).toThrow('unsupported_manifest');
  expect(isManifestObjectPath(`sha256/${e.hash}/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.json.gz`,e.hash)).toBe(true);
  expect(isManifestObjectPath(`sha256/${e.hash}.json.gz`,e.hash)).toBe(false);
 });
 it('memory store: put is idempotent and registers the index row; get verifies; non-canonical input is refused',async()=>{
  const {db,index}=fakeDb();
  const store=memoryManifestStore(db);
  const e=encodeManifest(buildAggregateManifest(input()));
  expect(await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).toEqual({hash:e.hash,existed:false});
  expect(await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).toEqual({hash:e.hash,existed:true});
  expect(index.get(e.hash)).toMatchObject({kind:'aggregate',bytes:store.objects.get(index.get(e.hash)!.path)!.byteLength});
  expect(await store.get(e.hash)).toEqual(JSON.parse(e.canonical));
  await expect(store.put('aggregate',JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(e.canonical),null,2))).rejects.toThrow('manifest_not_canonical');
  await expect(store.get('f'.repeat(64))).rejects.toThrow('manifest_not_found');
  await expect(store.get('../x')).rejects.toThrow('invalid_manifest_hash');
 });
 it('supabase store: registers FIRST, then uploads gzip at the incarnation path with upsert:false; 409 = existed; other errors fail',async()=>{
  const {db,calls,index}=fakeDb();
  const objects=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();const ops:string[]=[];let failUpload:string|null=null;let failRemove=false;
  const client={storage:{from:(b:string)=>{expect(b).toBe(MANIFEST_BUCKET);return {
   async upload(path:string,body:Uint8Array,o:{contentType:string;upsert:boolean}){ops.push(`upload:${path.slice(0,15)}:${o.contentType}:${o.upsert}`);calls.push('upload');
    if(failUpload)return {error:{message:failUpload,statusCode:'500'}};if(objects.has(path))return {error:{message:'The resource already exists',statusCode:'409'}};objects.set(path,body);return {error:null};},
   async download(path:string){const b=objects.get(path);return b?{data:new Blob([Buffer.from(b)]),error:null}:{data:null,error:{message:'not found'}};},
   async remove(paths:string[]){ops.push(`remove:${paths.length}`);if(failRemove)return {data:null,error:{message:'boom'}};for(const p of paths)objects.delete(p);return {data:[],error:null};},
  };}}} as unknown as SupabaseClient;
  const store=supabaseManifestStore(client,db);
  const e=encodeManifest(buildAggregateManifest(input()));
  expect(await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).toEqual({hash:e.hash,existed:false});
  expect(calls.slice(0,2)).toEqual([`register:${e.hash.slice(0,8)}`,'upload']);
  expect(ops[0]).toBe('upload:sha256/'+e.hash.slice(0,8)+':application/gzip:false');
  expect(objects.has(index.get(e.hash)!.path)).toBe(true);
  expect(await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).toEqual({hash:e.hash,existed:true});
  expect(await store.get(e.hash)).toEqual(JSON.parse(e.canonical));
  failUpload='quota';
  const other=encodeManifest({...buildAggregateManifest(input()),code:'801780.SI'});
  await expect(store.put('aggregate',other.canonical)).rejects.toThrow('manifest_upload_failed:quota');
  const obj={hash:e.hash,objectPath:index.get(e.hash)!.path};
  failRemove=true;
  expect(await store.remove([obj])).toEqual({removed:[],failed:[e.hash]});
  failRemove=false;
  expect(await store.remove([obj])).toEqual({removed:[e.hash],failed:[]});
  await expect(store.get(e.hash)).rejects.toThrow('manifest_not_found');
 });
 it('gcManifests: candidates → bucket remove → index delete; failed removals keep their index rows',async()=>{
  const {db,index,calls}=fakeDb();
  const store=memoryManifestStore(db);
  const a=encodeManifest(buildAggregateManifest(input())),b=encodeManifest({...buildAggregateManifest(input()),code:'801780.SI'});
  await store.put('aggregate',a.canonical);await store.put('aggregate',b.canonical);
  const failing={...store,async remove(os:{hash:string;objectPath:string}[]){const r=await store.remove(os.filter(o=>o.hash!==b.hash));return {removed:r.removed,failed:os.filter(o=>o.hash===b.hash).map(o=>o.hash)};}};
  const pathA=index.get(a.hash)!.path;
  calls.length=0;
  const r=await gcManifests({db,manifests:failing},10);
  expect(r).toEqual({candidates:2,removed:[a.hash],failed:[b.hash],deleted:1});
  expect(calls).toEqual(['candidates:10','delete:1']);
  expect([...index.keys()]).toEqual([b.hash]);
  expect(store.objects.has(pathA)).toBe(false);
  expect(await gcManifests({db,manifests:store},10)).toEqual({candidates:1,removed:[b.hash],failed:[],deleted:1});
  expect(await gcManifests({db,manifests:store},10)).toEqual({candidates:0,removed:[],failed:[],deleted:0});
  await expect(gcManifests({db,manifests:store},0)).rejects.toThrow('invalid_limit');
 });
 it('GC race on memoryIndustryDb (Codex round 1 #4): a hash claimed by GC cannot be re-put before deletion; afterwards a put registers anew and re-uploads',async()=>{
  const mdb=memoryIndustryDb();const store=memoryManifestStore(mdb);
  const e=encodeManifest(buildAggregateManifest(input()));
  mdb.setNow('2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical);
  mdb.setNow('2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z');
  const claims=await mdb.manifestGcCandidates(10);
  expect(claims.map(c=>c.hash)).toEqual([e.hash]);                                                    // selected = claimed
  await expect(store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'manifest_gc_in_progress'});   // refused before any upload
  expect(await gcManifests({db:{manifestGcCandidates:async()=>claims,deleteManifestIndex:c=>mdb.deleteManifestIndex(c)},manifests:store},10)).toEqual({candidates:1,removed:[e.hash],failed:[],deleted:1});
  expect(store.objects.has(claims[0].objectPath)).toBe(false);
  expect(await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical)).toEqual({hash:e.hash,existed:false});
  expect(await store.get(e.hash)).toEqual(JSON.parse(e.canonical));
 });
 it('stale collector after a reclaim (Codex round 2 R2-1): reclaim → delete → re-upload → the old collector deletes; the new incarnation survives',async()=>{
  const mdb=memoryIndustryDb();const store=memoryManifestStore(mdb);
  const e=encodeManifest(buildAggregateManifest(input()));
  mdb.setNow('2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical);
  mdb.setNow('2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z');
  const a=await mdb.manifestGcCandidates(10);                    // collector A claims, then pauses before its storage delete
  mdb.setNow('2026-11-03T02:00:00.000Z');
  const b=await mdb.manifestGcCandidates(10);                    // A's claim is stale (> 1 h): collector B reclaims
  expect(b.map(c=>c.hash)).toEqual([e.hash]);expect(b[0].claim).not.toBe(a[0].claim);
  expect(await gcManifests({db:{manifestGcCandidates:async()=>b,deleteManifestIndex:c=>mdb.deleteManifestIndex(c)},manifests:store},10)).toMatchObject({deleted:1});
  await store.put('aggregate',e.canonical);                     // a writer registers and re-uploads: a NEW incarnation path
  const fresh=(await mdb.manifestObjectPath(e.hash))!;
  expect(fresh).not.toBe(a[0].objectPath);
  // collector A resumes: it can only delete the incarnation it claimed, and its index delete is fenced by its token
  expect(await gcManifests({db:{manifestGcCandidates:async()=>a,deleteManifestIndex:c=>mdb.deleteManifestIndex(c)},manifests:store},10)).toEqual({candidates:1,removed:[e.hash],failed:[],deleted:0});
  expect(store.objects.has(fresh)).toBe(true);
  expect(await store.get(e.hash)).toEqual(JSON.parse(e.canonical));
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/manifest.ts
// Content-addressed input manifests (spec §5.3). buildAggregateManifest is pure: it assembles one
// (code, period_end) manifest from the run header, members, unresolved records, member state
// revisions and the aggregate result, maps each fact's filing to source_ref/citation through an
// explicit FactsDb.filingsOfIssuer lookup (FactRow carries neither; not found → null + warning), keeps
// plan 2 MetricRow.inputs verbatim (V5), and sorts every array by its total order:
//   members (issuer_id, valid_from); unresolved (ts_code, in_date, source_membership_id);
//   member_state_revs (issuer_id); facts (issuer_id, concept, period_start, period_end, unit, fact_id);
//   derived (issuer_id, metric, period_start, period_end, duration, unit); roles (metric, duration,
//   issuer_id); cells (metric, duration, period_start); warnings (unique, sorted).
// So shuffled inputs give byte-identical canonical JSON and the same hash. manifest_hash =
// sha256(canonical JSON, uncompressed). Storage key = the index row's object_path, an INCARNATION path
// 'sha256/<hash>/<uuid>.json.gz' chosen by put_industry_manifest when the row is created (Codex plan audit round 2
// R2-1): every re-registration after GC gets a new path, so a stale collector that claimed an earlier incarnation can
// only ever delete that earlier object. The object is uploaded AFTER the index row is registered
// (put_industry_manifest refuses a hash GC has claimed — round 1 #4), never overwritten (upsert:false; an existing
// object is the same bytes by construction). get() reads the CURRENT object_path from the index and verifies the
// hash of the decompressed bytes. gcManifests: claims {hash, objectPath, claim} → bucket remove of exactly those paths
// → index delete fenced by the claim token; a hash whose object removal failed keeps its index row.
import {gunzipSync,gzipSync} from 'node:zlib';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type {FactRow,FilingRow,MetricRow} from '../facts/types';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {canonicalJson,sha256Hex} from './canonical-json';
import type {AggregateCellResult} from './aggregate';
import type {AggregateManifest,HistoryClass,IndustryDb,ManifestCell,ManifestDerived,ManifestFact,ManifestMember,ManifestRole,ManifestStore,ManifestUnresolved,RunKind,Scheme,SchemeVersion} from './types';

export const MANIFEST_SCHEMA='industry-manifest/2';
export const MANIFEST_BUCKET='industry-manifests';
const HASH=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
/** An incarnation path of `hash` as put_industry_manifest creates it. */
export const isManifestObjectPath=(path:string,hash:string)=>new RegExp(`^sha256/${hash}/[0-9a-f-]{36}\\.json\\.gz$`).test(path);

export interface ManifestHeader{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;level:number;period_end:string;facts_as_of:string;knowledge_date:string;history_class:HistoryClass;method_version:string;config_hash:string;formula_version:string;code_version:string}
export interface BuildManifestInput{
 header:ManifestHeader;members:ManifestMember[];unresolved:ManifestUnresolved[];memberStateRevs:{issuer_id:string;state_rev:number}[];
 result:AggregateCellResult;
 /** filing_id → filing of every issuer that has facts in `result` (FactsDb.filingsOfIssuer, complete set) */
 filings:ReadonlyMap<string,FilingRow>;
}

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const by=<T>(...keys:((x:T)=>string)[])=>(a:T,b:T)=>{for(const f of keys){const c=cmp(f(a),f(b));if(c!==0)return c;}return 0;};
const citationOf=(g:FilingRow):ManifestFact['citation']=>g.source==='edgar'?'edgar':g.document_ref!==null&&g.document_ref!==undefined?'linked':'pending';

function factOf(r:FactRow,filings:ReadonlyMap<string,FilingRow>,warnings:string[]):ManifestFact{
 const g=filings.get(r.filing_id);
 if(!g)warnings.push(`filing_not_found:${r.filing_id}`);
 return {issuer_id:r.issuer_id,concept:r.concept,period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,duration:r.duration,fact_id:r.fact_id,value_text:canonicalDecimal(r.value),unit:r.unit,consolidation:r.consolidation,
  available_date:r.available_date,mapping_gen:r.mapping_gen,filing_id:r.filing_id,source_ref:g?g.source_ref:null,raw_hash:r.raw_hash,citation:g?citationOf(g):null};
}
const derivedOf=(m:MetricRow):ManifestDerived=>({issuer_id:m.issuer_id,metric:m.metric,period_start:m.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,duration:m.duration,value:m.value,unit:m.unit,basis:m.basis,formula_version:m.formula_version,inputs:structuredClone(m.inputs)});

export function buildAggregateManifest(input:BuildManifestInput):AggregateManifest{
 const warnings=[...input.result.warnings];
 const facts=input.result.facts.map(r=>factOf(r,input.filings,warnings));
 const h=input.header;
 return {
  schema:MANIFEST_SCHEMA,kind:'aggregate',scheme:h.scheme,version:h.version,code:h.code,level:h.level,period_end:h.period_end,
  facts_as_of:h.facts_as_of,knowledge_date:h.knowledge_date,history_class:h.history_class,method_version:h.method_version,config_hash:h.config_hash,formula_version:h.formula_version,code_version:h.code_version,
  members:input.members.map(x=>({...x,locator:x.locator===null?null:structuredClone(x.locator)})).sort(by(x=>x.issuer_id,x=>x.valid_from)),
  unresolved:input.unresolved.map(x=>({...x})).sort(by(x=>x.ts_code,x=>x.in_date,x=>x.source_membership_id)),
  member_state_revs:input.memberStateRevs.map(x=>({issuer_id:x.issuer_id,state_rev:x.state_rev})).sort(by(x=>x.issuer_id)),
  facts:facts.sort(by(x=>x.issuer_id,x=>x.concept,x=>x.period_start??'',x=>x.period_end,x=>x.unit,x=>x.fact_id)),
  derived:input.result.derived.map(derivedOf).sort(by(x=>x.issuer_id,x=>x.metric,x=>x.period_start,x=>x.period_end,x=>x.duration,x=>x.unit)),
  roles:input.result.roles.map((x):ManifestRole=>({...x})).sort(by(x=>x.metric,x=>x.duration,x=>x.issuer_id)),
  cells:input.result.cells.map((x):ManifestCell=>({...x})).sort(by(x=>x.metric,x=>x.duration,x=>x.period_start)),
  warnings:[...new Set(warnings)].sort(cmp),
 };
}

export interface EncodedManifest{canonical:string;hash:string;gzip:Uint8Array}
export function encodeManifest(m:AggregateManifest):EncodedManifest{
 const canonical=canonicalJson(m);
 return {canonical,hash:sha256Hex(canonical),gzip:new Uint8Array(gzipSync(Buffer.from(canonical,'utf8')))};
}
export const manifestHash=(m:AggregateManifest)=>sha256Hex(canonicalJson(m));
/** gzip bytes → manifest; the decompressed bytes must hash to expectedHash and be canonical. */
export function decodeManifest(gz:Uint8Array,expectedHash?:string):AggregateManifest{
 const text=gunzipSync(Buffer.from(gz)).toString('utf8');
 const hash=sha256Hex(text);
 if(expectedHash!==undefined&&hash!==expectedHash)throw new Error(`manifest_hash_mismatch:${expectedHash}`);
 const m=JSON.parse(text) as AggregateManifest;
 if(m?.schema!==MANIFEST_SCHEMA||m.kind!=='aggregate')throw new Error('unsupported_manifest');
 if(canonicalJson(m)!==text)throw new Error('manifest_not_canonical');
 return m;
}
function checkCanonical(canonical:string):string{
 let parsed:unknown;
 try{parsed=JSON.parse(canonical);}catch{throw new Error('manifest_not_canonical');}
 if(canonicalJson(parsed)!==canonical)throw new Error('manifest_not_canonical');
 return sha256Hex(canonical);
}

type Registry=Pick<IndustryDb,'registerManifest'|'manifestObjectPath'>;
/** The current incarnation path of a registered hash (throws when the index row is missing). */
async function currentPath(db:Registry,hash:string):Promise<string>{
 const path=await db.manifestObjectPath(hash);
 if(path===null)throw new Error(`manifest_not_found:${hash}`);
 if(!isManifestObjectPath(path,hash))throw new Error(`invalid_manifest_object_path:${hash}`);
 return path;
}
/** Bytes kept in memory by object path (unit tests, offline integration); the index row still goes through `db`. */
export function memoryManifestStore(db:Registry):ManifestStore&{objects:Map<string,Uint8Array>}{
 const objects=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();
 return {
  objects,
  async put(kind:RunKind,canonical:string){
   const hash=checkCanonical(canonical);
   const gz=new Uint8Array(gzipSync(Buffer.from(canonical,'utf8')));
   const created=await db.registerManifest(hash,kind,gz.byteLength);   // FIRST: refused while GC holds a claim
   const path=await currentPath(db,hash);                             // this incarnation's key
   const stored=objects.has(path);
   if(!stored)objects.set(path,gz);
   return {hash,existed:stored||!created};
  },
  async get(hash){
   if(!HASH.test(hash))throw new Error('invalid_manifest_hash');
   const gz=objects.get(await currentPath(db,hash));if(!gz)throw new Error(`manifest_not_found:${hash}`);
   return decodeManifest(gz,hash);
  },
  async remove(objs){for(const o of objs)objects.delete(o.objectPath);return {removed:objs.map(o=>o.hash),failed:[]};},
 };
}

interface StorageError{message:string;statusCode?:string|number;status?:number}
const isExists=(e:StorageError)=>String(e.statusCode??e.status??'')==='409'||/already exists|duplicate/i.test(e.message);
/** Supabase Storage (private bucket industry-manifests) + put_industry_manifest index row. */
export function supabaseManifestStore(admin:SupabaseClient,db:Registry):ManifestStore{
 const bucket=()=>admin.storage.from(MANIFEST_BUCKET);
 return {
  async put(kind,canonical){
   const hash=checkCanonical(canonical);
   const gz=new Uint8Array(gzipSync(Buffer.from(canonical,'utf8')));
   // register FIRST (Codex plan audit round 1 #4): a hash claimed by GC is refused here (manifest_gc_in_progress),
   // before any upload; a successful registration makes the row young, so no GC can claim it before its rows are
   // staged. A failed upload after it leaves an unreferenced young index row that a later GC pass removes.
   const created=await db.registerManifest(hash,kind,gz.byteLength);
   const {error}=await bucket().upload(await currentPath(db,hash),gz,{contentType:'application/gzip',upsert:false});
   let stored=false;
   if(error){if(isExists(error as StorageError))stored=true;else throw new Error(`manifest_upload_failed:${(error as StorageError).message}`);}
   return {hash,existed:stored||!created};
  },
  async get(hash){
   if(!HASH.test(hash))throw new Error('invalid_manifest_hash');
   const {data,error}=await bucket().download(await currentPath(db,hash));
   if(error||!data)throw new Error(`manifest_not_found:${hash}`);
   return decodeManifest(new Uint8Array(await data.arrayBuffer()),hash);
  },
  async remove(objs){
   if(objs.length===0)return {removed:[],failed:[]};
   const {error}=await bucket().remove(objs.map(o=>o.objectPath));   // exactly the claimed incarnations, never "the hash"
   // Storage remove is idempotent (absent paths are not an error): success means every object is gone.
   return error?{removed:[],failed:objs.map(o=>o.hash)}:{removed:objs.map(o=>o.hash),failed:[]};
  },
 };
}

export interface GcResult{candidates:number;removed:string[];failed:string[];deleted:number}
/** One GC pass: claims (gc_industry_manifest_candidates) → the claimed object paths → index rows fenced by the claim token. */
export async function gcManifests(deps:{db:Pick<IndustryDb,'manifestGcCandidates'|'deleteManifestIndex'>;manifests:ManifestStore},limit:number):Promise<GcResult>{
 if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1)throw new Error('invalid_limit');
 const claims=await deps.db.manifestGcCandidates(limit);
 if(claims.length===0)return {candidates:0,removed:[],failed:[],deleted:0};
 const {removed,failed}=await deps.manifests.remove(claims.map(c=>({hash:c.hash,objectPath:c.objectPath})));
 const done=new Set(removed);
 const deleted=removed.length===0?0:await deps.db.deleteManifestIndex(claims.filter(c=>done.has(c.hash)).map(c=>({hash:c.hash,claim:c.claim})));
 return {candidates:claims.length,removed,failed,deleted};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/replay.ts
// replayFromManifest (spec §5.3, §5.5 mode=original), pure: recomputes every cell of an aggregate
// manifest from the manifest alone — facts, derived and roles — through the same pickInputs /
// finalizeCell code the run used, and compares each recomputed cell with the stored one by canonical
// JSON. Structural counts come from the manifest: n_members = distinct members[].issuer_id,
// n_unresolved = distinct unresolved[].ts_code; the financial flag is "every role of the
// gross_margin cell is excluded:financial_excluded". An included issuer whose inputs are absent or
// ambiguous in the manifest yields missing:manifest_mismatch for that cell (so it cannot reproduce).
// No database, no clock, no METHOD_CONFIG: an old manifest replays under the code that reads it.
import {InputIndex,finalizeCell,pickInputs} from './aggregate';
import type {PoolDerived,PoolFact} from './aggregate';
import {canonicalJson} from './canonical-json';
import type {CellSpec} from './method';
import type {AggregateManifest,ManifestCell} from './types';

export interface ReplayResult{cells:ManifestCell[];reproduced:boolean;mismatches:string[]}
const cellId=(c:Pick<ManifestCell,'metric'|'duration'|'period_start'>)=>`${c.metric}:${c.duration}:${c.period_start}`;

export function replayFromManifest(m:AggregateManifest):ReplayResult{
 if(m.schema!=='industry-manifest/2'||m.kind!=='aggregate')throw new Error('unsupported_manifest');
 const nMembers=new Set(m.members.map(x=>x.issuer_id)).size;
 const nUnresolved=new Set(m.unresolved.map(u=>u.ts_code)).size;
 const facts:PoolFact[]=m.facts.map(f=>({issuer_id:f.issuer_id,concept:f.concept,period_start:f.period_start,period_end:f.period_end,duration:f.duration,unit:f.unit,value:f.value_text}));
 const derived:PoolDerived[]=m.derived.map(d=>({issuer_id:d.issuer_id,metric:d.metric,period_start:d.period_start,period_end:d.period_end,duration:d.duration,unit:d.unit,value:d.value}));
 const idx=new InputIndex(facts,derived);
 const cells:ManifestCell[]=[];const mismatches:string[]=[];
 for(const stored of m.cells){
  const spec:CellSpec={metric:stored.metric,duration:stored.duration,period_start:stored.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,unit:stored.unit as CellSpec['unit']};
  const roles=m.roles.filter(r=>r.metric===stored.metric&&r.duration===stored.duration);
  const financial=stored.metric==='gross_margin'&&roles.length>0&&roles.every(r=>r.role==='excluded'&&r.reason==='financial_excluded');
  const included:string[][]=[];let broken=false;
  if(stored.metric!=='member_count'){
   for(const r of roles){
    if(r.role!=='included')continue;
    const p=pickInputs(spec,r.issuer_id,idx);
    if(!p.ok){broken=true;break;}
    included.push(p.values);
   }
  }
  const cell:ManifestCell=broken
   ?{metric:stored.metric,duration:stored.duration,period_start:stored.period_start,status:'missing',missing_reason:'manifest_mismatch',n_members:nMembers,n_with_data:0,n_unresolved:nUnresolved,unit:stored.unit}
   :finalizeCell(spec,nMembers,nUnresolved,financial,included);
  cells.push(cell);
  if(canonicalJson(cell)!==canonicalJson(stored))mismatches.push(cellId(stored));
 }
 return {cells,reproduced:mismatches.length===0,mismatches};
}
```

### Task 12: 聚合编排 `runIndustryAggregation`（规格 §5.4 第 1–7 步、§4.6、§4.10 就绪门）

依赖：Task 3（`memoryIndustryDb`、`IndustryDbError`）、Task 8（`memberships.ts::membersAtPure`）、Task 11；`src/lib/dq/freshness.ts` 已含 `weekly`（Task 1）。

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/industry/run-aggregation.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/run-aggregation.test.ts`

要点：
- 顺序：`code_version` 缺失 → `rejected`（不开批次、不写任何东西）→ `startBatch(industry-agg, industry.agg.<scheme>)` → 分类码（`level`，可选 `codes` 过滤）→ `expectedGrid` → 每 (code, period_end) 的成员（`membershipCandidates` → `membersAtPure`，`knownBy = facts_as_of`）与未解析记录（`unresolvedOf`）→ `history_class`（只有全部成员行 `provenance.availability='evidenced'` 且来源记录 `resolution.method='as_of'` 才是 `point_in_time`）→ `FactsDb.scopeAll('CN')`（状态指纹 + `last_success_at`）→ 上一活跃 run 的行与清单 → 复用判定 → `createMetricRun` → 就绪门 → 逐组计算或复用 → `setMetricRunCoverage` → `stageMetricRows` → `stageRunDependencies`（整格分块）→ `activateMetricRun` → `recordAttempt(weekly)` → `finishBatch`。
- V6：每个发行人每个 run 至多一次 `readFacts`（`concepts = AGG_CONCEPTS`，`history:true`，`asOf = facts_as_of`），信封缓存到最后一个用到它的行业代码之后释放；`truncated` 信封 → 该发行人在本 run 全部值格 `excluded:read_truncated`。
- 复用条件（全部成立）：上一活跃 run 的 `facts_as_of`、`knowledge_date`、`history_class`、`method_version`、`config_hash`、`formula_version` 相同；该组行恰好一个清单哈希且无 `manifest_mismatch` 行；清单 `members`/`unresolved` 与当前逐字段相同（规范 JSON）；清单 `member_state_revs` 每项等于当前 `state_rev`（无 scope 行按 0）。复用组的依赖从清单 `member_state_revs` 复制；重算组的依赖取本 run 信封的 `stateRev`。
- 自检：`replayFromManifest` 不一致的格 → `missing(manifest_mismatch)` + `dq_quarantine`（`industry_metrics`，`<run>:<code>:<period_end>:<metric>:<duration>:<period_start>`），run 照常激活；清单上传失败 → run `failed(manifest_upload_failed)`。
- 激活拒绝 `obsolete_run`/`dependency_regression`/`incomplete_run`/`dependencies_incomplete` → `failRun` 写同名原因，批次 `failed`；其他错误 → `failRun(<code>)`。
- 另导出 `buildCellManifest(deps,q)`（规格 §5.5 `mode=recompute`，Task 15 的 `/replay` 用）：与 run 内同一条代码路径（`loadGroup` → `readIssuerFacts` → `computeGroup`）现算一个 (code, period_end) 组的清单，不上传、不登记、不建 run。

```ts
 {key:'F1',ts:TICKER.F1,l1:FOOD,in:'2021-12-13'},{key:'F2',ts:TICKER.F2,l1:FOOD,in:'2021-12-13'},{key:'F3',ts:TICKER.F3,l1:FOOD,in:'2024-07-01'},

async function publish(facts:MemoryFactsDb,tables:TableClient,key:Key,reports:Report[],tag='1'){

}

async function seedMemberships(){
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'test-industry',dataset:'industry.test'});
 // issuer rows, in case the memory implementation checks them like the SQL function's issuer lock
 for(const k of Object.keys(ISSUERS) as Key[])await tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id:ISSUERS[k],canonical_name_zh:k,status:'active',cninfo_org_id:null,provenance:{}});
 await db.upsertClassifications(batchId,TREE);
 await db.upsertSourceMemberships(batchId,MEMBERS.map(m=>({source:'tushare:index_member_all',ts_code:m.ts,name:null,l1_code:m.l1,l2_code:L23[m.l1][0],l3_code:L23[m.l1][1],in_date:m.in,out_date:null,observed_at:'2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z',raw_hash:`raw:${m.ts}`,locator:{api:'index_member_all',ts_code:m.ts}})));
 const current=await db.currentSourceMemberships({});
 for(const m of MEMBERS){
  const src=current.find(s=>s.ts_code===m.ts)!;sourceIds.set(m.ts,src.id);
  if(m.key===null)continue;
  const prov={availability:'effective_date_assumed' as const,source_membership_id:src.id,raw_hash:src.raw_hash,locator:src.locator};
  await db.applyMemberships(batchId,ISSUERS[m.key],'sw2021','2021',[[m.l1,1],[L23[m.l1][0],2],[L23[m.l1][1],3]].map(([code,level])=>({code:code as string,level:level as number,valid_from:m.in,valid_to:null,available_date:m.in,valid_to_available_date:null,source:'tushare:index_member_all',provenance:prov})),[src.id],{method:'today',resolved_at:'2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
 }
}
```
