```ts
// src/lib/industry/run-aggregation.ts
// runIndustryAggregation (spec §5.4 steps 1–7, §4.6 history_class, §4.10 readiness gate, V6 one
// envelope per issuer per run, U4 dependencies, U6 activation time). Sequence:
//  1. code_version required (else rejected, nothing written); startBatch(industry-agg,
//     industry.agg.<scheme>); classification codes at `level` (optionally filtered by opts.codes);
//     expected grid; every (code, period_end) group's members (membershipCandidates → membersAtPure,
//     knownBy = facts_as_of) and unresolved records; history_class = point_in_time only when every
//     member row is provenance.availability 'evidenced' AND its source record resolved 'as_of',
//     else reconstruction (all v1 sw2021 runs);
//  2. state fingerprint = FactsDb.scopeAll('CN') (state_rev and last_success_at per issuer, read once;
//     fingerprint_at = the client time of that read, orchestration metadata only); previous active
//     run, its rows and manifests → per-group reuse decision; createMetricRun (reused_from_run = the
//     previous active run when at least one group is reused);
//  3. readiness gate: >= READINESS_MIN_PERCENT of the run's member issuers (every member of every
//     group) have last_success_at → else coverage {facts_scope_ready:false} + failRun
//     facts_scope_not_ready;
//  4. per code, per period_end: a reused group copies the manifest's cells and its
//     member_state_revs (dependencies); a recomputed group reads each member's envelope at most once
//     per run (cached until the last code that needs it), derives, computes, builds and self-checks
//     the manifest (replayFromManifest; mismatching cells → missing:manifest_mismatch + quarantine),
//     uploads it when a cell is ok (failure → manifest_upload_failed), and records one dependency
//     per member with that envelope's stateRev;
//  5. setMetricRunCoverage, stageMetricRows (updated_at null), stageRunDependencies (whole cells per
//     call), activateMetricRun; obsolete_run / dependency_regression / incomplete_run /
//     dependencies_incomplete → failRun with that code;
//  6. any other error after the run exists → failRun(<code>) (rows stay, invisible);
//  7. recordAttempt(industry.agg.<scheme>, weekly) and finishBatch.
// Reuse conditions (all): previous active run has the same facts_as_of, knowledge_date,
// history_class, method_version, config_hash, formula_version; its rows of the group carry exactly one
// manifest hash and no manifest_mismatch; the manifest's members and unresolved records equal the
// current ones (canonical JSON, statuses and windows included) and every member_state_revs entry
// equals the current state_rev (an issuer without a scope row counts as 0). code_version is not a
// reuse key: reused rows keep the manifest's code_version inside the manifest.
import type {TriggeredBy,BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {FORMULA_VERSION,deriveMetrics} from '../facts/derive';
import type {FactsDb,FilingRow,ScopeRow} from '../facts/types';
import {computeAggregateCell} from './aggregate';
import type {IssuerFacts} from './aggregate';
import {canonicalJson} from './canonical-json';
import {buildAggregateManifest,encodeManifest} from './manifest';
import type {ManifestHeader} from './manifest';
import {membersAtPure} from './memberships';
import {AGG_CONCEPTS,CONFIG_HASH,DEFAULT_HISTORY_START,METHOD_VERSION,READINESS_MIN_PERCENT,assertDay,cellKey,expectedGrid,isFinancialNode} from './method';
import {replayFromManifest} from './replay';
import type {ReplayResult} from './replay';
import {IndustryDbError} from './types';
import type {AggregateManifest,HistoryClass,IndustryDb,IndustryDeps,ManifestMember,ManifestUnresolved,MembershipRow,MetricCellRow,MetricRunRow,RunDependency,Scheme,SchemeVersion,SourceMembershipRow,StagedMetricCell} from './types';

export interface AggregationOptions{
 scheme:Extract<Scheme,'sw2021'>;version:Extract<SchemeVersion,'2021'>;level:number;factsAsOf:string;
 historyStart?:string;
 /** Restricts the run to these classification codes (scripts, tests); default every code at `level`. */
 codes?:string[];
 triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;
}
export interface AggregationReceipt{
 status:'active'|'failed'|'rejected';code?:string;
 batchId:string|null;batchStatus:BatchStatus|null;runId:string|null;generation:number|null;activatedAt:string|null;
 historyClass:HistoryClass|null;groups:number;reusedGroups:number;cells:{ok:number;missing:number};manifestMismatches:number;truncatedIssuers:string[];
}
/** Test seam: replaces the manifest self-check (default replayFromManifest). */
export interface AggregationHooks{replay?:(m:AggregateManifest)=>ReplayResult}

export class AggregationError extends Error{constructor(public code:string,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='AggregationError';}}
const ACTIVATION_CODES=new Set(['obsolete_run','dependency_regression','incomplete_run','dependencies_incomplete']);
const STAGE_CHUNK=500;
const DEPENDENCY_CHUNK=2000;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const errCode=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof AggregationError||e instanceof IndustryDbError?e.code:'compute_failed';
const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,300);

interface Group{code:string;period_end:string;key:string;members:ManifestMember[];memberRows:MembershipRow[];unresolved:ManifestUnresolved[];financial:boolean;duplicateRows:boolean}
interface Reuse{hash:string;manifest:AggregateManifest}

function memberOf(row:MembershipRow,src:SourceMembershipRow|undefined):ManifestMember{
 const p=row.provenance;
 return {issuer_id:row.issuer_id,ticker:src?.ts_code??null,valid_from:row.valid_from,valid_to:row.valid_to,available_date:row.available_date,valid_to_available_date:row.valid_to_available_date,
  source_membership_id:row.source_membership_id,raw_hash:typeof p.raw_hash==='string'?p.raw_hash:null,locator:p.locator&&typeof p.locator==='object'?structuredClone(p.locator as Record<string,unknown>):null,resolution_method:src?.resolution.method??null};
}
const sortMembers=(xs:ManifestMember[])=>[...xs].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.issuer_id,b.issuer_id)||cmp(a.valid_from,b.valid_from));
const sortUnresolved=(xs:ManifestUnresolved[])=>[...xs].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ts_code,b.ts_code)||cmp(a.in_date,b.in_date)||cmp(a.source_membership_id,b.source_membership_id));

/** One (code, period_end) group: point-in-time members (one row per issuer, latest valid_from) and unresolved records (spec §4.6, §5.2). */
async function loadGroup(db:Pick<IndustryDb,'membershipCandidates'|'unresolvedOf'>,q:{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;level:number;code:string;periodEnd:string;knownBy:string},financial:boolean,sources:ReadonlyMap<string,SourceMembershipRow>):Promise<Group>{
 const mq={scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:q.level,on:q.periodEnd,knownBy:q.knownBy};
 const rows=membersAtPure(await db.membershipCandidates({scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:q.level,on:q.periodEnd}),mq);
 const byIssuer=new Map<string,MembershipRow>();
 for(const r of [...rows].sort((a,b)=>cmp(b.valid_from,a.valid_from)))if(!byIssuer.has(r.issuer_id))byIssuer.set(r.issuer_id,r);
 const memberRows=[...byIssuer.values()];
 return {code:q.code,period_end:q.periodEnd,key:cellKey(q.code,q.periodEnd),financial,memberRows,duplicateRows:byIssuer.size!==rows.length,
  members:sortMembers(memberRows.map(r=>memberOf(r,r.source_membership_id===null?undefined:sources.get(r.source_membership_id)))),
  unresolved:sortUnresolved(await db.unresolvedOf({code:q.code,level:q.level,on:q.periodEnd,knownBy:q.knownBy}))};
}
/** One issuer's envelope (V6: the caller guarantees at most one read per issuer per run) and its derived metrics. */
async function readIssuerFacts(facts:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'>,id:string,asOf:string):Promise<IssuerFacts>{
 const env=await facts.readFacts(id,'CN',{concepts:[...AGG_CONCEPTS],asOf,history:true});
 if(env.rows.some(r=>r.issuer_id!==id||r.market!=='CN'))throw new AggregationError('envelope_scope_mismatch',id);
 return {issuer_id:id,stateRev:env.stateRev,truncated:env.truncated,rows:env.truncated?[]:env.rows,derived:env.truncated?[]:deriveMetrics(env.rows,{market:'CN',asOf,basedOnRev:env.stateRev})};
}
/** The computation of one group, shared by runIndustryAggregation and buildCellManifest: cells, roles, manifest. */
async function computeGroup(header:ManifestHeader,g:Group,issuers:ReadonlyMap<string,IssuerFacts>,filingsOf:(ids:string[])=>Promise<ReadonlyMap<string,FilingRow>>):Promise<{manifest:AggregateManifest;memberStateRevs:{issuer_id:string;state_rev:number}[]}>{
 const ids=g.members.map(x=>x.issuer_id);
 const result=computeAggregateCell({code:g.code,period_end:g.period_end,financial:g.financial,members:ids,nUnresolved:new Set(g.unresolved.map(u=>u.ts_code)).size,issuers});
 const memberStateRevs=ids.map(id=>({issuer_id:id,state_rev:issuers.get(id)!.stateRev}));
 const manifest=buildAggregateManifest({header,members:g.members,unresolved:g.unresolved,memberStateRevs,result,filings:await filingsOf([...new Set(result.facts.map(f=>f.issuer_id))])});
 return {manifest,memberStateRevs};
}

export interface CellManifestQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;level:number;code:string;periodEnd:string;factsAsOf:string;knowledgeDate:string;historyClass:HistoryClass}
/**
 * Spec §5.5 replay mode=recompute: the manifest of ONE (code, period_end) group recomputed now from the
 * current database (members as known by factsAsOf, the issuers' current envelopes), through the same
 * loadGroup / readIssuerFacts / computeGroup path as runIndustryAggregation. Writes nothing (no upload,
 * no index row, no run). `db` needs service-role reads (source records for ticker/resolution method).
 */
export async function buildCellManifest(deps:{db:Pick<IndustryDb,'classificationTree'|'currentSourceMemberships'|'membershipCandidates'|'unresolvedOf'>;facts:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'|'filingsOfIssuer'>;codeVersion:string|null},q:CellManifestQuery):Promise<AggregateManifest>{
 assertDay('periodEnd',q.periodEnd);assertDay('factsAsOf',q.factsAsOf);assertDay('knowledgeDate',q.knowledgeDate);
 const tree=await deps.db.classificationTree(q.scheme,q.version);
 const sources=new Map((await deps.db.currentSourceMemberships({})).map(x=>[x.id,x]));
 const g=await loadGroup(deps.db,{scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,level:q.level,code:q.code,periodEnd:q.periodEnd,knownBy:q.factsAsOf},isFinancialNode(q.code,tree),sources);
 const issuers=new Map<string,IssuerFacts>();
 for(const x of g.members)issuers.set(x.issuer_id,await readIssuerFacts(deps.facts,x.issuer_id,q.factsAsOf));
 const filingsOf=async(ids:string[])=>{const out=new Map<string,FilingRow>();for(const id of ids)for(const f of await deps.facts.filingsOfIssuer(id,'CN',{}))out.set(f.filing_id,f);return out;};
 const header:ManifestHeader={scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:q.level,period_end:q.periodEnd,facts_as_of:q.factsAsOf,knowledge_date:q.knowledgeDate,history_class:q.historyClass,
  method_version:METHOD_VERSION,config_hash:CONFIG_HASH,formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,code_version:deps.codeVersion??'unknown'};
 return (await computeGroup(header,g,issuers,filingsOf)).manifest;
}

function reusable(prev:MetricRunRow,header:{facts_as_of:string;history_class:HistoryClass},rows:MetricCellRow[]|undefined):string|null{
 if(prev.facts_as_of!==header.facts_as_of||prev.knowledge_date!==header.facts_as_of||prev.history_class!==header.history_class||prev.method_version!==METHOD_VERSION||prev.config_hash!==CONFIG_HASH||prev.formula_version!==FORMULA_VERSION)return null;
 if(!rows||rows.length===0||rows.some(r=>r.missing_reason==='manifest_mismatch'))return null;
 const hashes=new Set(rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok').map(r=>r.manifest_hash));
 if(hashes.size!==1)return null;
 const [h]=[...hashes];return h??null;
}
const rowOf=(code:string,periodEnd:string,c:AggregateManifest['cells'][number],hash:string|null):StagedMetricCell=>({
 code,metric:c.metric,period_start:c.period_start,period_end:periodEnd,duration:c.duration,status:c.status,missing_reason:c.status==='missing'?c.missing_reason??null:null,
 value:c.status==='ok'?c.value_text??null:null,unit:c.unit,n_members:c.n_members,n_with_data:c.n_with_data,n_unresolved:c.n_unresolved,manifest_hash:c.status==='ok'?hash:null});

export async function runIndustryAggregation(deps:IndustryDeps,opts:AggregationOptions,hooks:AggregationHooks={}):Promise<AggregationReceipt>{
 const receipt:AggregationReceipt={status:'rejected',batchId:null,batchStatus:null,runId:null,generation:null,activatedAt:null,historyClass:null,groups:0,reusedGroups:0,cells:{ok:0,missing:0},manifestMismatches:0,truncatedIssuers:[]};
 assertDay('factsAsOf',opts.factsAsOf);
 const historyStart=opts.historyStart??DEFAULT_HISTORY_START;assertDay('historyStart',historyStart);
 if(!Number.isInteger(opts.level)||opts.level<1||opts.level>4)throw new Error('invalid_level');
 if(!deps.codeVersion)return {...receipt,code:'code_version_missing'};
 const {tables,db,facts,manifests}=deps;const codeVersion=deps.codeVersion;
 const dataset=`industry.agg.${opts.scheme}`;
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'industry-agg',dataset,toolVersions:{method:METHOD_VERSION,config:CONFIG_HASH,formula:FORMULA_VERSION},codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 receipt.batchId=batchId;
 const errors:BatchError[]=[];let counts:BatchCounts=emptyCounts();
 let runId:string|null=null;let ok=false;
 try{
  // ---- 1. grid, members, history class ----
  const tree=await db.classificationTree(opts.scheme,opts.version);
  const codes=tree.filter(r=>r.level===opts.level&&(opts.codes===undefined||opts.codes.includes(r.code))).map(r=>r.code).sort(cmp);
  if(codes.length===0)throw new AggregationError('no_classifications');
  const grid=expectedGrid(codes,historyStart,opts.factsAsOf);
  const sources=new Map((await db.currentSourceMemberships({})).map(s=>[s.id,s]));
  const groups:Group[]=[];
  for(const code of grid.codes){
   const financial=isFinancialNode(code,tree);
   for(const pe of grid.period_ends){
    const g=await loadGroup(db,{scheme:opts.scheme,version:opts.version,level:opts.level,code,periodEnd:pe,knownBy:opts.factsAsOf},financial,sources);
    if(g.duplicateRows)errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:g.key,message:'duplicate_member_rows'});
    groups.push(g);
   }
  }
  const allMembers=groups.flatMap(g=>g.memberRows);
  const historyClass:HistoryClass=allMembers.length>0&&allMembers.every(r=>r.provenance.availability==='evidenced'&&r.source_membership_id!==null&&sources.get(r.source_membership_id)?.resolution.method==='as_of')?'point_in_time':'reconstruction';
  receipt.historyClass=historyClass;receipt.groups=groups.length;
  // ---- 2. fingerprint, previous run, reuse plan, run header ----
  const scope=await facts.scopeAll('CN');const fingerprintAt=deps.now().toISOString();
  const scopeOf=new Map<string,ScopeRow>(scope.map(s=>[s.issuer_id,s]));
  const revOf=(id:string)=>scopeOf.get(id)?.state_rev??0;
  const prev=await db.activeMetricRun(opts.scheme,opts.version,opts.level);
  const reuse=new Map<string,Reuse>();
  if(prev){
   const prevRows=new Map<string,MetricCellRow[]>();
   for(const r of await db.metricRowsOfRun(prev.run_id,{codes:grid.codes,periodEnds:grid.period_ends})){const k=cellKey(r.code,r.period_end);const l=prevRows.get(k);if(l)l.push(r);else prevRows.set(k,[r]);}
   const loaded=new Map<string,AggregateManifest|null>();
   for(const g of groups){
    const hash=reusable(prev,{facts_as_of:opts.factsAsOf,history_class:historyClass},prevRows.get(g.key));
    if(hash===null)continue;
    if(!loaded.has(hash))loaded.set(hash,await manifests.get(hash).catch(()=>null));
    const m=loaded.get(hash);
    if(!m||m.code!==g.code||m.period_end!==g.period_end||m.level!==opts.level||m.facts_as_of!==opts.factsAsOf||m.history_class!==historyClass||m.config_hash!==CONFIG_HASH||m.method_version!==METHOD_VERSION||m.formula_version!==FORMULA_VERSION)continue;
    if(canonicalJson(m.members)!==canonicalJson(g.members)||canonicalJson(m.unresolved)!==canonicalJson(g.unresolved))continue;
    const ids=new Set(g.members.map(x=>x.issuer_id));
    if(m.member_state_revs.length!==ids.size||m.member_state_revs.some(x=>!ids.has(x.issuer_id)||x.state_rev!==revOf(x.issuer_id)))continue;
    reuse.set(g.key,{hash,manifest:m});
   }
  }
  receipt.reusedGroups=reuse.size;
  const run=await db.createMetricRun({scheme:opts.scheme,version:opts.version,level:opts.level,facts_as_of:opts.factsAsOf,knowledge_date:opts.factsAsOf,history_class:historyClass,
   method_version:METHOD_VERSION,config_hash:CONFIG_HASH,formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,code_version:codeVersion,expected_grid:grid,fingerprint_at:fingerprintAt,
   reused_from_run:reuse.size>0&&prev?prev.run_id:null,batch_id:batchId});
  runId=run.runId;receipt.runId=run.runId;receipt.generation=run.generation;
  // ---- 3. readiness gate ----
  const universe=[...new Set(allMembers.map(r=>r.issuer_id))].sort(cmp);
  const readyN=universe.filter(id=>scopeOf.get(id)?.last_success_at!=null).length;
  const ready=universe.length>0&&readyN*100>=READINESS_MIN_PERCENT*universe.length;
  if(!ready){
   await db.setMetricRunCoverage(run.runId,{facts_scope_ready:false,universe:universe.length,ready:readyN,min_percent:READINESS_MIN_PERCENT});
   throw new AggregationError('facts_scope_not_ready',`${readyN}/${universe.length}`);
  }
  // ---- 4. cells ----
  const lastUse=new Map<string,number>();
  grid.codes.forEach((code,i)=>{for(const g of groups)if(g.code===code&&!reuse.has(g.key))for(const x of g.members)lastUse.set(x.issuer_id,i);});
  const envelopes=new Map<string,IssuerFacts>();const envRev=new Map<string,number>();const filingCache=new Map<string,Map<string,FilingRow>>();
  const truncated=new Set<string>();
  const envelope=async(id:string)=>{
   let f=envelopes.get(id);if(f)return f;
   if(envRev.has(id))throw new AggregationError('envelope_evicted',id);   // never read twice in one run (V6)
   f=await readIssuerFacts(facts,id,opts.factsAsOf);
   if(f.truncated)truncated.add(id);
   envelopes.set(id,f);envRev.set(id,f.stateRev);return f;
  };
  const filingsOf=async(ids:string[])=>{
   const out=new Map<string,FilingRow>();
   for(const id of ids){
    let m=filingCache.get(id);
    if(!m){m=new Map((await facts.filingsOfIssuer(id,'CN',{})).map(g=>[g.filing_id,g]));filingCache.set(id,m);}
    for(const [k,v] of m)out.set(k,v);
   }
   return out;
  };
  const staged:StagedMetricCell[]=[];const dependencies:RunDependency[]=[];
  for(const [i,code] of grid.codes.entries()){
   for(const g of groups.filter(x=>x.code===code)){
    const r=reuse.get(g.key);
    if(r){
     for(const c of r.manifest.cells)staged.push(rowOf(g.code,g.period_end,c,r.hash));
     for(const x of r.manifest.member_state_revs)dependencies.push({cell_key:g.key,issuer_id:x.issuer_id,state_rev:x.state_rev});
     counts.duplicates+=r.manifest.cells.length;continue;
    }
    const ids=g.members.map(x=>x.issuer_id);
    const issuers=new Map<string,IssuerFacts>();
    for(const id of ids)issuers.set(id,await envelope(id));
    const {manifest,memberStateRevs}=await computeGroup({scheme:opts.scheme,version:opts.version,code:g.code,level:opts.level,period_end:g.period_end,facts_as_of:opts.factsAsOf,knowledge_date:opts.factsAsOf,
      history_class:historyClass,method_version:METHOD_VERSION,config_hash:CONFIG_HASH,formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,code_version:codeVersion},g,issuers,filingsOf);
    const check=(hooks.replay??replayFromManifest)(manifest);
    const bad=new Set(check.mismatches);
    let hash:string|null=null;
    if(manifest.cells.some(c=>c.status==='ok'&&!bad.has(`${c.metric}:${c.duration}:${c.period_start}`))){
     try{hash=(await manifests.put('aggregate',encodeManifest(manifest).canonical)).hash;}
     catch(e){throw new AggregationError('manifest_upload_failed',errMsg(e));}
    }
    for(const c of manifest.cells){
     const id=`${c.metric}:${c.duration}:${c.period_start}`;
     if(bad.has(id)){
      staged.push({...rowOf(g.code,g.period_end,c,null),status:'missing',missing_reason:'manifest_mismatch',value:null,manifest_hash:null});
      await quarantine(tables,{dataset,table:'industry_metrics',naturalKey:`${run.runId}:${g.code}:${g.period_end}:${id}`,reasonCode:'manifest_mismatch',detail:{run_id:run.runId,code:g.code,period_end:g.period_end,cell:id},batchId});
      counts.quarantined++;receipt.manifestMismatches++;
     }else{staged.push(rowOf(g.code,g.period_end,c,hash));counts.inserted++;}
    }
    for(const x of memberStateRevs)dependencies.push({cell_key:g.key,issuer_id:x.issuer_id,state_rev:x.state_rev});
   }
   for(const [id,last] of lastUse)if(last<=i){envelopes.delete(id);filingCache.delete(id);}   // free memory; envRev keeps the revision
  }
  counts.fetched=staged.length;
  receipt.cells={ok:staged.filter(r=>r.status==='ok').length,missing:staged.filter(r=>r.status==='missing').length};
  receipt.truncatedIssuers=[...truncated].sort(cmp);
  // ---- 5. coverage, stage, activate ----
  const summary={facts_scope_ready:true,universe:universe.length,ready:readyN,history_class:historyClass,groups:groups.length,reused_groups:reuse.size,cells_ok:receipt.cells.ok,cells_missing:receipt.cells.missing,
   manifest_mismatch:receipt.manifestMismatches,read_truncated:receipt.truncatedIssuers.slice(0,100),read_truncated_count:truncated.size};
  await db.setMetricRunCoverage(run.runId,summary);
  for(let k=0;k<staged.length;k+=STAGE_CHUNK)await db.stageMetricRows(run.runId,staged.slice(k,k+STAGE_CHUNK));
  // whole cells per call: the function checks each cell's dependency set against its members
  const depsOf=new Map<string,RunDependency[]>();
  for(const d of dependencies){const l=depsOf.get(d.cell_key);if(l)l.push(d);else depsOf.set(d.cell_key,[d]);}
  let part:RunDependency[]=[];
  for(const g of groups){
   const rows=depsOf.get(g.key)??[];
   if(part.length>0&&part.length+rows.length>DEPENDENCY_CHUNK){await db.stageRunDependencies(run.runId,'aggregate',part);part=[];}
   part.push(...rows);
  }
  if(part.length>0)await db.stageRunDependencies(run.runId,'aggregate',part);
  if(truncated.size>0)errors.push({code:'coverage_summary',key:'read_truncated',message:JSON.stringify({issuers:receipt.truncatedIssuers.slice(0,20),n:truncated.size})});
  errors.push({code:'coverage_summary',key:run.runId,message:JSON.stringify({ok:receipt.cells.ok,missing:receipt.cells.missing,reused_groups:reuse.size})});
  try{receipt.activatedAt=(await db.activateMetricRun(run.runId)).activatedAt;}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof IndustryDbError&&ACTIVATION_CODES.has(e.code))throw new AggregationError(e.code,e.message);throw e;}
  receipt.status='active';ok=true;
 }catch(e){
  const code=errCode(e);
  receipt.status='failed';receipt.code=code;
  if(runId!==null){try{await db.failRun('aggregate',runId,code);}catch(f){errors.push({code:'fail_run_failed',key:runId,message:errMsg(f)});}}
  errors.push({code,key:runId??undefined,message:errMsg(e)});
  counts={...emptyCounts(),failed:1};
 }finally{
  try{await recordAttempt(tables,dataset,{ok,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now(),detail:{run_id:runId,status:receipt.status,code:receipt.code??null,cells:receipt.cells,reused_groups:receipt.reusedGroups}});}
  catch(e){errors.push({code:'freshness_failed',message:errMsg(e)});}
  receipt.batchStatus=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
 }
 return receipt;
}
```

### Task 13: 证券级标记采集 `marks.ts`（真实 `daily_basic` 录制夹具；规格 §6.1、V7、第 7 稿 K1/K2）

依赖：Task 3、Task 5（录制夹具已由 Task 5 拷入 `src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare/`；测试用 Task 5 的 `fixtureTushareCall` + `fetchDailyBasic` 读它们）。`marks.ts` 本身不 import Task 5：抓取函数经 `MarksDeps.fetchDailyBasic` 注入（生产由 Task 16 的 `jobs.ts::marksFetcher` 适配）。估值计算、`trade_cal`、`sw_daily` 不在本任务（I-3 延后）。

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/industry/marks.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/industry/marks.test.ts`

要点：
- 每个交易日**一次** `beginFetchEvent('marks',{trade_date},batch)`；应用失败的重试用**同一个**事件（`retryFetchEvent`，`attempt+1`），绝不为同一份已取得的载荷开新事件；`fetch_event_payload_changed` 不重试。
- `total_share`、`free_share` 万股 × 10000、`total_mv` 万元 × 10000 全用十进制；`total_share` 是 A+H+B 全部股份（K2，`METHOD_CONFIG.total_share_basis='all_classes_incl_h_b'`）；`free_share` 可空，非正视为缺失（null），存入 `security_marks.free_share`（K1，供将来申万口径对照）。上游按后缀 `SH→sse`、`SZ→szse`、`BJ→bse`；不在 `stocks_universe` 的代码跳过（`skipped_summary`）；`close`/`total_share` 缺失或非正 → 拒绝（表 CHECK `> 0`）。
- 观测内容 = `close`、`total_share`、`free_share`：`free_share` 的修订也是新观测（Task 2 `apply_observations` 比较三者，`free_share` 用 `is not distinct from`）。
- 规则：`identityRule('mcap_vs_tushare', close×total_share, total_mv×10000, 0.001)`、`rangeRule('close_range', close, 0.01, 100000)`（`src/lib/dq/rules.ts`，取 JS number 只用于规则判定）；失败行以 `status:'quarantined'` 写入观测并隔离 `mcap_mismatch`/`close_range`。
- 与当前观测内容不同的行由 `apply_observations` 自己（Task 2 SQL / Task 3 内存实现，同一事务内）隔离 `mark_revised`（同键开放项复用）；`marks.ts` **不**再写这一项、也不预读当前观测。
- 期望日期由调用方显式给出（`runMarks(deps,{tradeDates})`）；空响应 → `skipped_summary(no_rows)`；`quota_exhausted` → 作业停止。

```ts
// src/lib/industry/marks.test.ts
import {describe,it,expect,beforeEach} from 'vitest';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {decMul} from './decimal';
import {memoryIndustryDb} from './memory-industry-db';
import {fetchDailyBasic,fixtureTushareCall} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {planMarkRows,runMarks,upstreamOf} from './marks';
import type {DailyBasicFetch,DailyBasicRow,MarksDeps} from './marks';
import {IndustryDbError} from './types';
import type {IndustryDb} from './types';

const DATE='2026-10-30';
/** Test loader: the ten recorded daily_basic rows of 2026-10-30 through the Task 5 adapter (lossless decimals). */
async function loadFixture(edit:(r:DailyBasicRow)=>DailyBasicRow=r=>r):Promise<DailyBasicFetch>{
 const pages=await fetchDailyBasic(fixtureTushareCall(),{tradeDate:'20261030'},{sleep:async()=>{}});
 return {trade_date:DATE,pages:pages.length,rows:pages.flatMap(p=>p.rows.map((r,row)=>edit({...r,page:p.page,row,page_sha256:p.raw_hash})))};
}
// synthetic edits of real responses (the real rows all pass every rule): 600036.SH market value off by 2%,
// 000001.SZ close above the range (total_mv kept consistent), 600887.SH close missing; 601398.SH is left out of the universe
const RULE_CASES=(r:DailyBasicRow):DailyBasicRow=>r.ts_code==='600036.SH'?{...r,total_mv:decMul(r.total_mv!,'1.02')}:r.ts_code==='000001.SZ'?{...r,close:'150000',total_mv:decMul('150000',r.total_share!)}:r.ts_code==='600887.SH'?{...r,close:null}:r;
const UNIVERSE=['000001.SZ','000858.SZ','000869.SZ','600036.SH','600519.SH','600887.SH','601166.SH','601318.SH','603288.SH'];
const rowsOf=(t:TableClient,table:string)=>(t as unknown as {rows(x:string):Record<string,unknown>[]}).rows(table);

describe('planMarkRows',()=>{
 it('converts 万股 to shares exactly (total_share and free_share), maps the exchange, applies the identity and range rules, skips and rejects',async()=>{
  const p=planMarkRows(await loadFixture(RULE_CASES),new Set(UNIVERSE));
  expect(p.rows.map(r=>[r.ticker,r.close,r.total_share,r.free_share,r.upstream,r.status])).toEqual([
   ['000001.SZ','150000','19405918198','8160565553','szse','quarantined'],   // close above the 100000 range
   ['000858.SZ','74.7','3881608005','1706512403','szse','ok'],
   ['000869.SZ','16.91','643280128','109581764','szse','ok'],
   ['600036.SH','43.55','25219845601','11718361832','sse','quarantined'],   // total_mv edited +2%: mcap_vs_tushare fails
   ['600519.SH','1392.05','1250081601','568798666','sse','ok'],
   ['601166.SH','19.65','21162864665','16540719840','sse','ok'],
   ['601318.SH','52.8','18107641995','9697345981','sse','ok'],
   ['603288.SH','34.86','5843973444','1452954658','sse','ok'],
  ]);
  expect(p.quarantined.map(q=>[q.ticker,q.reason])).toEqual([['000001.SZ','close_range'],['600036.SH','mcap_mismatch']]);
  expect(p.quarantined[1].detail).toMatchObject({rule:'mcap_vs_tushare',market_cap:'1098324275923.55',tushare_market_cap:'1120290761397.6'});
  expect(p.skipped).toEqual({not_in_universe:1});
  expect(p.rejected).toEqual([{ticker:'600887.SH',reason:'invalid_value'}]);
  const r=p.rows.find(x=>x.ticker==='600519.SH')!;
  expect(r).toMatchObject({trade_date:DATE,source:'tushare:daily_basic',locator:{api:'daily_basic',trade_date:DATE,page:1,row:4,transform:'wan_to_unit'}});
  expect(r.raw_hash).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(planMarkRows(await loadFixture(RULE_CASES),new Set(UNIVERSE)).rows.map(x=>x.raw_hash)).toEqual(p.rows.map(x=>x.raw_hash));
  // the real rows pass every rule (K2: total_mv = close × total_share exactly)
  expect(planMarkRows(await loadFixture(),new Set([...UNIVERSE,'601398.SH'])).quarantined).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('free_share missing or non-positive is stored as null; upstream from the suffix only; date mismatches and duplicate rows are rejected',async()=>{
  const nf=planMarkRows(await loadFixture(r=>r.ts_code==='600519.SH'?{...r,free_share:null}:r.ts_code==='000858.SZ'?{...r,free_share:'0'}:r),new Set(UNIVERSE));
  expect(nf.rows.filter(x=>x.ticker==='600519.SH'||x.ticker==='000858.SZ').map(x=>x.free_share)).toEqual([null,null]);
  expect([upstreamOf('600001.sh'),upstreamOf('000002.SZ'),upstreamOf('830003.BJ'),upstreamOf('00700.HK')]).toEqual(['sse','szse','bse',null]);
  const f=await loadFixture();
  const p=planMarkRows({...f,rows:[{...f.rows[0],trade_date:'20261029'},f.rows[1],f.rows[1]]},new Set(UNIVERSE));
  expect(p.rejected).toEqual([{ticker:'000001.SZ',reason:'date_mismatch'},{ticker:'000858.SZ',reason:'duplicate_row'}]);
  expect(p.rows).toHaveLength(1);

describe('runMarks',()=>{
 let tables:TableClient;let db:IndustryDb;
 const deps=(fetch:()=>DailyBasicFetch|Promise<DailyBasicFetch>,over:Partial<MarksDeps>={}):MarksDeps=>({tables,db,now:()=>new Date('2026-10-31T02:00:00.000Z'),codeVersion:'b'.repeat(40),fetchDailyBasic:async()=>fetch(),...over});
 beforeEach(async()=>{
  tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_freshness:['dataset'],dq_quarantine:['id'],stocks_universe:['ticker']});
  for(const t of UNIVERSE)await tables.insert('stocks_universe',{ticker:t,name:t,market:'A'});
  db=memoryIndustryDb({tables});
 });
 it('first run: rule failures are stored as quarantined observations and parked; the invalid row is rejected',async()=>{
  const r1=await runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture(RULE_CASES)),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  expect(r1).toMatchObject({status:'done',batchStatus:'partial'});   // the invalid row is a rejection
  expect(r1.dates[0]).toMatchObject({fetched:10,attempts:1,result:{inserted:8,duplicates:0,superseded:0}});
  expect(r1.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:10,inserted:8,quarantined:2,failed:1});
  const q=rowsOf(tables,'dq_quarantine');
  expect(q.filter(x=>x.reason_code==='mcap_mismatch').map(x=>x.natural_key)).toEqual([`600036.SH:${DATE}`]);
  expect(q.filter(x=>x.reason_code==='close_range').map(x=>x.natural_key)).toEqual([`000001.SZ:${DATE}`]);
  expect(await db.currentMarksOn(DATE,['600036.SH','000001.SZ'])).toEqual([]);                    // quarantined observations are never current
  expect((await db.currentMarksOn(DATE,['600519.SH']))[0]).toMatchObject({close:'1392.05',total_share:'1250081601',free_share:'568798666',upstream:'sse'});
  expect(rowsOf(tables,'dq_freshness').find(x=>x.dataset==='industry.marks')).toMatchObject({expected_cadence:'weekly',consecutive_errors:0});
 });
 // The A→B→A and V7 cases use three real tickers; B is a synthetic edit of a real response (600519.SH close revised).
 const CLEAN=['600519.SH','000858.SZ','603288.SH'];
 const A=async()=>{const f=await loadFixture();return {...f,rows:f.rows.filter(r=>CLEAN.includes(r.ts_code))};};
 const B=async()=>{const f=await loadFixture(r=>r.ts_code==='600519.SH'?{...r,close:'1392.06',total_mv:decMul('1392.06',r.total_share!)}:r);return {...f,rows:f.rows.filter(r=>CLEAN.includes(r.ts_code))};};
 const F=async()=>{const f=await loadFixture(r=>r.ts_code==='600519.SH'?{...r,free_share:'56880'}:r);return {...f,rows:f.rows.filter(r=>CLEAN.includes(r.ts_code))};};
 it('A → B → A: three fetch events, three observations, the third current; apply_observations quarantines each revision as mark_revised',async()=>{
  const r1=await runMarks(deps(A),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  expect(r1.dates[0].result).toEqual({inserted:3,duplicates:0,superseded:0});
  const r2=await runMarks(deps(B),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  expect(r2.dates[0].result).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:2,superseded:1});
  const r3=await runMarks(deps(A),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  expect(r3.dates[0].result).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:2,superseded:1});   // A again is a new version, not a duplicate of the superseded A
  const events=[r1,r2,r3].map(r=>r.dates[0].fetch_event_id);
  expect(new Set(events).size).toBe(3);
  const cur=await db.currentMarksOn(DATE,['600519.SH']);
  expect(cur).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(cur[0]).toMatchObject({close:'1392.05',total_share:'1250081601',fetch_event_id:events[2],upstream:'sse',status:'ok'});
  expect(r2.counts).toMatchObject({versioned:1,duplicates:2,inserted:0});
  expect(rowsOf(tables,'dq_quarantine').filter(x=>x.reason_code==='mark_revised').map(x=>x.natural_key)).toEqual([`600519.SH:${DATE}`]);   // one open item per key (reused)
 });
 it('a free_share revision alone is a new observation (content = close, total_share, free_share)',async()=>{
  await runMarks(deps(A),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  const r=await runMarks(deps(F),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  expect(r.dates[0].result).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:2,superseded:1});
  expect((await db.currentMarksOn(DATE,['600519.SH']))[0]).toMatchObject({close:'1392.05',free_share:'568800000'});
 });
 it('V7: a retried event whose content is unchanged stays a duplicate even after a later event changed the current observation',async()=>{
  await runMarks(deps(A),{tradeDates:[DATE]});                       // E1: A
  const e2=(await runMarks(deps(A),{tradeDates:[DATE]})).dates[0];    // E2: A again → all duplicates
  expect(e2.result).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:3,superseded:0});
  await runMarks(deps(B),{tradeDates:[DATE]});                       // E3: B
  await db.retryFetchEvent(e2.fetch_event_id!);                       // retry E2 with its own payload A
  const rowsA=planMarkRows(await A(),new Set(UNIVERSE)).rows;
  expect(await db.applyObservations('marks',e2.fetch_event_id!,rowsA)).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:3,superseded:0});
  expect((await db.currentMarksOn(DATE,['600519.SH']))[0].close).toBe('1392.06');   // B stays current
  await expect(db.applyObservations('marks',e2.fetch_event_id!,planMarkRows(await B(),new Set(UNIVERSE)).rows)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'fetch_event_payload_changed'});
 });
 it('retries a failed apply with the same fetch event (attempt + 1), never begins a second event for the date',async()=>{
  const calls:string[]=[];let fail=1;
  const flaky={...db,
   beginFetchEvent:async(j:string,p:Record<string,unknown>,b:string)=>{const id=await db.beginFetchEvent(j,p,b);calls.push(`begin:${id}`);return id;},
   retryFetchEvent:async(id:string)=>{calls.push(`retry:${id}`);await db.retryFetchEvent(id);},
   applyObservations:(async(k:'marks',id:string,rows:never[])=>{calls.push(`apply:${id}`);if(fail-->0)throw new Error('network reset');return db.applyObservations(k,id,rows);}) as IndustryDb['applyObservations'],
  } as IndustryDb;
  const r=await runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture(),{db:flaky}),{tradeDates:[DATE]});
  const id=r.dates[0].fetch_event_id!;
  expect(calls).toEqual([`begin:${id}`,`apply:${id}`,`retry:${id}`,`apply:${id}`]);
  expect(r.dates[0]).toMatchObject({attempts:2,result:{inserted:9}});
  fail=5;
  const bad=await runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture(),{db:flaky}),{tradeDates:[DATE],maxApplyAttempts:2});
  expect(bad.dates[0]).toMatchObject({error:'apply_failed',attempts:2});
  expect(bad.batchStatus).toBe('failed');
  const payload={...db,applyObservations:(async()=>{throw new IndustryDbError('fetch_event_payload_changed');}) as IndustryDb['applyObservations']} as IndustryDb;
  expect((await runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture(),{db:payload}),{tradeDates:[DATE]})).dates[0]).toMatchObject({error:'fetch_event_payload_changed',attempts:1});
 });
 it('empty days are skipped_summary(no_rows); quota stops the job; no code version → rejected',async()=>{
  const r=await runMarks(deps(()=>({trade_date:DATE,rows:[],pages:1})),{tradeDates:[DATE,'2026-10-23']});
  expect(r.dates.map(d=>d.skipped)).toEqual([{no_rows:1},{no_rows:1}]);
  expect(r.batchStatus).toBe('success');
  // synthetic: the fetch answers a quota error
  const quota=Object.assign(new Error('积分不足'),{code:'quota_exhausted'});
  const q=await runMarks(deps(()=>{throw quota;}),{tradeDates:['2026-10-23',DATE]});
  expect(q.dates).toHaveLength(1);expect(q.dates[0].error).toBe('quota_exhausted');expect(q.batchStatus).toBe('failed');
  expect(await runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture(),{codeVersion:null}),{tradeDates:[DATE]})).toMatchObject({status:'rejected',code:'code_version_missing',batchId:null});
  await expect(runMarks(deps(()=>loadFixture()),{tradeDates:['2026-10-3']})).rejects.toThrow('invalid_date');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/marks.ts
// Security-level marks (spec §6.1): close and total share per A-share ticker per trade date, written
// only through apply_observations('marks') as versioned observations. runMarks, per trade date (the
// caller passes the expected dates explicitly; trade_cal is deferred with I-3):
//  1. beginFetchEvent('marks', {trade_date}, batch) ONCE — a new network fetch is a new event;
//  2. fetchDailyBasic(date) (injected: Task 5's providers/tushare-industry.ts adapter in production,
//     fixtures in tests); an empty response → skipped_summary(no_rows);
//  3. planMarkRows (pure): tickers not in stocks_universe → skipped (not_in_universe); unknown
//     exchange suffix → skipped (unknown_exchange); missing/non-positive close or total_share →
//     rejected (the table CHECKs close > 0, total_share > 0); total_share 万股 × 10000 → shares
//     (transform wan_to_unit, exact decimal; total_share = all classes A+H+B, spec 7th draft K2); free_share
//     万股 × 10000 into security_marks.free_share (null when missing/non-positive; K1) — part of the observation
//     content, so a free_share revision is a new observation; upstream from the ts_code suffix SH→sse, SZ→szse, BJ→bse;
//     rules identityRule('mcap_vs_tushare', close×total_share, total_mv×10000, 0.001) (same-source
//     arithmetic consistency, not an independent check) and rangeRule('close_range', close, 0.01,
//     100000) — a failure keeps the row as an observation with status 'quarantined' and parks a
//     dq_quarantine item (mcap_mismatch / close_range); rule evaluation is the only place a JS number
//     is used (rules.ts takes numbers), stored values stay decimal strings; raw_hash =
//     sha256(canonical {api, page_sha256, page, row}) is evidence only, never identity;
//  4. revisions (content differs from the current ok observation) are quarantined as mark_revised by
//     apply_observations itself, in the same transaction (Task 2 SQL / Task 3 memory) — not here;
//  5. applyObservations('marks', event, rows) in chunks; a failed chunk is retried with the SAME event
//     (retryFetchEvent, attempt + 1) up to maxApplyAttempts: receipts make already-applied keys
//     duplicates (V7); fetch_event_payload_changed is never retried.
// recordAttempt('industry.marks', weekly) and finishBatch close the receipt. Counts: fetched = rows
// received; inserted/versioned/duplicates from the apply results; quarantined = rule failures
// parked (those rows are also observations); failed = rejected rows and failed dates.
import type {TriggeredBy,BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus} from '../dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {identityRule,rangeRule} from '../dq/rules';
import type {RuleResult} from '../dq/rules';
import {selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {canonicalJson,sha256Hex} from './canonical-json';
import {decCmp,decMul,isDecimal} from './decimal';
import {assertDay} from './method';
import {IndustryDbError} from './types';
import type {IndustryDeps,MarkInput,ObservationResult} from './types';

export const MARKS_DATASET='industry.marks';
export const MARKS_SOURCE='tushare:daily_basic';
export const MARKS_JOB='marks';
const APPLY_CHUNK=500;

/** One daily_basic row as the adapter decoded it (numbers as canonical decimal strings, never JS numbers). */
export interface DailyBasicRow{ts_code:string;trade_date:string;close:string|null;total_share:string|null;free_share:string|null;total_mv:string|null;page:number;row:number;page_sha256:string}
export interface DailyBasicFetch{trade_date:string;rows:DailyBasicRow[];pages:number}
export type MarksDeps=Pick<IndustryDeps,'tables'|'db'|'now'|'codeVersion'>&{fetchDailyBasic:(tradeDate:string)=>Promise<DailyBasicFetch>};
export interface MarksOptions{tradeDates:string[];triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;maxApplyAttempts?:number}
export interface PlannedQuarantine{ticker:string;trade_date:string;reason:'mcap_mismatch'|'close_range';detail:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface MarkPlan{rows:MarkInput[];quarantined:PlannedQuarantine[];skipped:Record<string,number>;rejected:{ticker:string;reason:string}[]}
export interface MarksDateOutcome{trade_date:string;fetch_event_id:string|null;fetched:number;result:ObservationResult|null;attempts:number;skipped:Record<string,number>;error?:string}
export interface MarksReceipt{status:'done'|'rejected';code?:string;batchId:string|null;batchStatus:BatchStatus|null;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];dates:MarksDateOutcome[]}

const RULE_REASON:Record<string,PlannedQuarantine['reason']>={mcap_vs_tushare:'mcap_mismatch',close_range:'close_range'};
const norm=(t:string)=>t.trim().toUpperCase();
/** Exchange of an A-share ts_code from its suffix; null for anything else. */
export function upstreamOf(tsCode:string):'sse'|'szse'|'bse'|null{
 const t=norm(tsCode);return t.endsWith('.SH')?'sse':t.endsWith('.SZ')?'szse':t.endsWith('.BJ')?'bse':null;
}
const ymd=(d:string)=>/^\d{8}$/.test(d)?`${d.slice(0,4)}-${d.slice(4,6)}-${d.slice(6,8)}`:d;
const positive=(v:string|null):v is string=>v!==null&&isDecimal(v)&&decCmp(v,'0')>0;

/** Pure: one fetched day → observation rows, rule outcomes, skips and rejections (sorted by ticker). */
export function planMarkRows(fetch:DailyBasicFetch,universe:ReadonlySet<string>):MarkPlan{
 const plan:MarkPlan={rows:[],quarantined:[],skipped:{},rejected:[]};
 const skip=(k:string)=>{plan.skipped[k]=(plan.skipped[k]??0)+1;};
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 for(const r of fetch.rows){
  const ticker=norm(r.ts_code);
  if(!universe.has(ticker)){skip('not_in_universe');continue;}
  const upstream=upstreamOf(ticker);
  if(!upstream){skip('unknown_exchange');continue;}
  if(ymd(r.trade_date)!==fetch.trade_date){plan.rejected.push({ticker,reason:'date_mismatch'});continue;}
  if(seen.has(ticker)){plan.rejected.push({ticker,reason:'duplicate_row'});continue;}
  seen.add(ticker);
  if(!positive(r.close)||!positive(r.total_share)){plan.rejected.push({ticker,reason:'invalid_value'});continue;}
  const close=canonicalDecimal(r.close),totalShare=decMul(r.total_share,'10000');   // 万股 → shares (A+H+B, K2)
  const freeShare=positive(r.free_share)?decMul(r.free_share,'10000'):null;          // 万股 → shares; missing/non-positive → null (K1)
  const mcap=decMul(close,totalShare);
  const tushareMcap=r.total_mv!==null&&isDecimal(r.total_mv)?decMul(r.total_mv,'10000'):null;   // 万元 → yuan
  const results:RuleResult[]=[identityRule('mcap_vs_tushare',Number(mcap),tushareMcap===null?null:Number(tushareMcap),0.001),rangeRule('close_range',Number(close),0.01,100000)];
  const failed=results.filter(x=>!x.passed);
  for(const f of failed)plan.quarantined.push({ticker,trade_date:fetch.trade_date,reason:RULE_REASON[f.ruleId],detail:{rule:f.ruleId,...(f.detail??{}),close,total_share:totalShare,market_cap:mcap,tushare_market_cap:tushareMcap}});
  const locator={api:'daily_basic',trade_date:fetch.trade_date,page:r.page,row:r.row,page_sha256:r.page_sha256,transform:'wan_to_unit'};
  plan.rows.push({ticker,trade_date:fetch.trade_date,close,total_share:totalShare,free_share:freeShare,source:MARKS_SOURCE,upstream,raw_hash:sha256Hex(canonicalJson({api:'daily_basic',page_sha256:r.page_sha256,page:r.page,row:r.row})),locator,status:failed.length>0?'quarantined':'ok'});
 }
 plan.rows.sort((a,b)=>a.ticker<b.ticker?-1:a.ticker>b.ticker?1:0);
 return plan;
}

const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,300);
const add=(a:ObservationResult,b:ObservationResult):ObservationResult=>({inserted:a.inserted+b.inserted,duplicates:a.duplicates+b.duplicates,superseded:a.superseded+b.superseded});

export async function runMarks(deps:MarksDeps,opts:MarksOptions):Promise<MarksReceipt>{
 const dates=[...new Set(opts.tradeDates)].sort();
 for(const d of dates)assertDay('tradeDate',d);
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const outcomes:MarksDateOutcome[]=[];
 if(!deps.codeVersion)return {status:'rejected',code:'code_version_missing',batchId:null,batchStatus:null,counts,errors,dates:[]};
 const maxAttempts=Math.max(1,opts.maxApplyAttempts??2);
 const {tables,db}=deps;
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'industry-marks',dataset:MARKS_DATASET,toolVersions:{source:MARKS_SOURCE,transform:'wan_to_unit'},codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'});
 let hardFailures=0;
 try{
  const universe=new Set((await selectAll(tables,'stocks_universe',{},'ticker')).map(r=>norm(String(r.ticker))));
  for(const date of dates){
   const out:MarksDateOutcome={trade_date:date,fetch_event_id:null,fetched:0,result:null,attempts:0,skipped:{}};outcomes.push(out);
   const eventId=await db.beginFetchEvent(MARKS_JOB,{trade_date:date},batchId);out.fetch_event_id=eventId;
   let fetched:DailyBasicFetch;
   try{fetched=await deps.fetchDailyBasic(date);}
   catch(e){
    const code=typeof (e as {code?:unknown}).code==='string'?(e as {code:string}).code:'fetch_failed';
    out.error=code;errors.push({code,key:date,message:errMsg(e)});counts.failed++;hardFailures++;
    if(code==='quota_exhausted')break;   // spec §11: the job stops on quota
    continue;
   }
   out.fetched=fetched.rows.length;counts.fetched+=fetched.rows.length;
   if(fetched.rows.length===0){out.skipped={no_rows:1};errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:date,message:JSON.stringify({no_rows:1})});continue;}
   const plan=planMarkRows({...fetched,trade_date:date},universe);
   out.skipped=plan.skipped;
   if(Object.keys(plan.skipped).length>0)errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:date,message:JSON.stringify(plan.skipped)});
   if(plan.rejected.length>0){counts.failed+=plan.rejected.length;errors.push({code:'rejected_summary',key:date,message:JSON.stringify(plan.rejected.slice(0,20))});}
   let result:ObservationResult={inserted:0,duplicates:0,superseded:0};let ok=true;
   for(let i=0;i<plan.rows.length&&ok;i+=APPLY_CHUNK){
    const chunk=plan.rows.slice(i,i+APPLY_CHUNK);
    for(let attempt=1;;attempt++){
     out.attempts++;
     try{result=add(result,await db.applyObservations('marks',eventId,chunk));break;}
     catch(e){
      const fatal=e instanceof IndustryDbError&&e.code==='fetch_event_payload_changed';
      if(fatal||attempt>=maxAttempts){ok=false;out.error=e instanceof IndustryDbError?e.code:'apply_failed';errors.push({code:out.error,key:date,message:errMsg(e)});counts.failed+=plan.rows.length-i;hardFailures++;break;}
      await db.retryFetchEvent(eventId);   // same event, attempt + 1: the retry carries the same fetched payload
     }
    }
   }
   out.result=result;
   counts.inserted+=result.inserted;counts.versioned+=result.superseded;counts.duplicates+=result.duplicates;
   if(!ok)continue;
   for(const q of plan.quarantined){
    await quarantine(tables,{dataset:MARKS_DATASET,table:'security_marks',naturalKey:`${q.ticker}:${q.trade_date}`,reasonCode:q.reason,detail:q.detail,batchId});
    counts.quarantined++;
   }
  }
 }catch(e){errors.push({code:'marks_failed',message:errMsg(e)});counts.failed++;hardFailures++;}
 try{await recordAttempt(tables,MARKS_DATASET,{ok:hardFailures===0,cadence:'weekly',now:deps.now(),detail:{dates:dates.length,inserted:counts.inserted,versioned:counts.versioned}});}
 catch(e){errors.push({code:'freshness_failed',message:errMsg(e)});}
 const batchStatus=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
 return {status:'done',batchId,batchStatus,counts,errors,dates:outcomes};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/sync.integration.test.ts
// Plan Task 14 / spec §13.3 offline integration on real PostgreSQL (critical; valuation parts excluded —
// I-3 is deferred). pgIndustryDb + pgFactsDb + pgTableClient over the test:db instance, manifests in a
// memory ManifestStore whose index rows go to industry_manifests through the real put_industry_manifest.
// Fixture fixtures/facts/cn-aggregate.json: two SW2021 test level-3 nodes (food under 801120.SI, banks
// under 801780.SI) × four period_ends, five issuers, one unresolved source record.
// Isolation (test:db runs suites in parallel on one database): every code, ticker, org id and issuer id
// is suite-specific (T14.*, 6889xx/3009xx/9209xx), and the runs use level 3 — the (sw2021, 2021, 3) run
// slot is reserved for this suite (other suites must not create level-3 metric runs).
// Membership seeding drives the IndustryDb contract (upsertSourceMemberships → applyMemberships), i.e.
// the same RPCs Task 7/8's runMembershipsSw / applyResolutions call; CN facts are published through the
// plan-2 write path (claimLease → beginRun → stageFilings → stageFacts → publishRun → releaseLease).
// The cases SHARE STATE and run in order: first run → manifest-only replay → later filing → reuse →
// out_date correction → marks. Do not reorder them.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {MAPPING_GEN,MAPPING_VERSION} from '../facts/concepts';
import {pgFactsDb} from '../facts/pg-facts-db';
import type {Duration,FactInsert,FactsDb,FilingInsert} from '../facts/types';
import {sha256Hex} from './canonical-json';
import {decCmp,decMul} from './decimal';
import {decodeManifest,memoryManifestStore} from './manifest';
import {planMarkRows,runMarks} from './marks';
import type {DailyBasicFetch} from './marks';
import {pgIndustryDb} from './pg-industry-db';
import {fetchDailyBasic,fixtureTushareCall} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {replayFromManifest} from './replay';
import {windowEnd} from './resolve-memberships';
import {claimSicScopeRow,finishSicScopeRow} from './sic';
import {runIndustryAggregation} from './run-aggregation';
import type {AggregationOptions,AggregationReceipt} from './run-aggregation';
import type {ClassificationRow,IndustryDb,IndustryDeps,MetricCellRow} from './types';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
interface Fixture{
 facts_as_of:string;history_start:string;level:number;
 classifications:{code:string;level:number;parent_code:string|null;name_zh:string}[];
 issuers:{key:string;issuer_id:string;ticker:string;name:string;org_id:string}[];
 source_memberships:{ts_code:string;issuer:string|null;l1_code:string;l2_code:string;l3_code:string;in_date:string;out_date:string|null}[];
 reports:Record<string,{period_end:string;available_date:string;values:Record<string,string>}[]>;
 later_filing:{issuer:string;report_type:string;period_end:string;available_date:string;values:Record<string,string>};
 out_date_correction:{ts_code:string;out_date:string};
}
const FX=JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('./fixtures/facts/cn-aggregate.json',import.meta.url),'utf8')) as Fixture;
const FOOD='T14.L3.FOOD',BANK='T14.L3.BANK';
const ID=Object.fromEntries(FX.issuers.map(i=>[i.key,i.issuer_id])) as Record<string,string>;
const TICKER=Object.fromEntries(FX.issuers.map(i=>[i.key,i.ticker])) as Record<string,string>;
const OPTS:AggregationOptions={scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',level:FX.level,factsAsOf:FX.facts_as_of,historyStart:FX.history_start,codes:[FOOD,BANK]};
const DUR:Record<string,Duration>={'03':'3M','06':'6M','09':'9M','12':'12M'};
const FORM={'03':'q1','06':'semiannual','09':'q3','12':'annual'} as const;
const FP={'03':'Q1','06':'H1','09':'9M','12':'FY'} as const;
const SOURCE='tushare:index_member_all';

/** Plan-2 write path for one issuer: lease → run → filings → facts → publish → release (an empty report list publishes an empty run). */
async function publishCn(facts:FactsDb,tables:TableClient,key:string,reports:Fixture['reports'][string],reportType='1'){
 const issuer=ID[key],ticker=TICKER[key];
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'test-industry-facts',dataset:'facts.cn.t14'});
 await facts.reconcileScope('CN',[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:['test:t14'],priority:10,fetch_key:ticker}]);
 expect(await facts.claimLease(issuer,'CN',batchId,600)).toBe(true);
 const run=await facts.beginRun(issuer,'CN',batchId,MAPPING_GEN);
 const filings:FilingInsert[]=reports.map(r=>{const mm=r.period_end.slice(5,7) as keyof typeof FORM;return {filing_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,
  sourceRef:`${ticker}:${r.period_end.replaceAll('-','')}:${reportType}:${r.available_date.replaceAll('-','')}`,market:'CN',source:'tushare',origin:ticker.endsWith('.SH')?'sse':ticker.endsWith('.SZ')?'szse':'bse',
  formType:reportType==='1'?FORM[mm]:'restatement',fiscalYear:Number(r.period_end.slice(0,4)),fiscalPeriod:FP[mm],periodEnd:r.period_end,availableDate:r.available_date,url:null};});
 const ids=filings.length>0?await facts.stageFilings(run,filings):new Map<string,string>();
 const rows:FactInsert[]=reports.flatMap((r,i)=>Object.entries(r.values).map(([concept,value])=>{const instant=concept==='equity_parent';return {fact_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,market:'CN' as const,filing_id:ids.get(filings[i].sourceRef)!,concept,
  source_concept:`t14.${concept}`,statement:instant?'BS' as const:'IS' as const,period_start:instant?null:`${r.period_end.slice(0,4)}-01-01`,period_end:r.period_end,duration:instant?'INSTANT' as const:DUR[r.period_end.slice(5,7)],
  value,unit:'CNY',consolidation:'consolidated' as const,available_date:r.available_date,mapping_gen:MAPPING_GEN,mapping_version:MAPPING_VERSION,raw_hash:sha256Hex(`t14:${ticker}:${r.period_end}:${concept}:${reportType}`)};}));
 if(rows.length>0)await facts.stageFacts(run,rows);
 await facts.publishRun(run,[...ids.values()]);
 await facts.releaseLease(issuer,'CN',batchId,'success',new Date(Date.now()+7*86_400_000).toISOString());
 await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts:{...emptyCounts(),fetched:rows.length,inserted:rows.length},errors:[]});
}
const cellOf=(rows:MetricCellRow[],code:string,metric:string,duration:string,pe:string)=>{const r=rows.find(x=>x.code===code&&x.metric===metric&&x.duration===duration&&x.period_end===pe);expect(r,`${code} ${metric} ${duration} ${pe}`).toBeDefined();return r!;};

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('industry offline integration on real PostgreSQL (Task 14)',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let tables:TableClient;let db:IndustryDb;let facts:FactsDb;let manifests:ReturnType<typeof memoryManifestStore>;let deps:IndustryDeps;let batch:string;
 const runs:AggregationReceipt[]=[];
 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
  tables=pgTableClient(admin);db=pgIndustryDb(admin);facts=pgFactsDb(admin);manifests=memoryManifestStore(db);
  deps={tables,db,facts,manifests,now:()=>new Date(),codeVersion:'t14-industry-sync'};
  // issuers, A-share securities and universe rows (FK order); the unresolved ticker gets a universe row only
  for(const i of FX.issuers){
   await admin.query(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,$2,'A') on conflict (ticker) do nothing`,[i.ticker,i.name]);
   await admin.query(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_zh,country_code,cninfo_org_id) values($1,$2,'CN',$3) on conflict do nothing`,[i.issuer_id,i.name,i.org_id]);
   await admin.query(`insert into public.issuer_securities(issuer_id,ticker,share_class,is_primary,valid_from,source) values($1,$2,'A',true,'2015-01-05','test:t14') on conflict do nothing`,[i.issuer_id,i.ticker]);
  }
  ({batchId:batch}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'test-industry',dataset:'industry.t14'}));
  const tree:ClassificationRow[]=FX.classifications.map(c=>({scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:c.code,level:c.level,name_zh:c.name_zh,name_en:null,parent_code:c.parent_code,attributes:{}}));
  await db.upsertClassifications(batch,tree);
  await db.upsertSourceMemberships(batch,FX.source_memberships.map(m=>({source:SOURCE,ts_code:m.ts_code,name:null,l1_code:m.l1_code,l2_code:m.l2_code,l3_code:m.l3_code,in_date:m.in_date,out_date:m.out_date,observed_at:'2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z',raw_hash:sha256Hex(`t14:member:${m.ts_code}`),locator:{api:'index_member_all',is_new:'Y',ts_code:m.ts_code}})));
  const current=await db.currentSourceMemberships({});
  for(const m of FX.source_memberships){
   if(m.issuer===null)continue;
   const src=current.find(s=>s.ts_code===m.ts_code&&s.l3_code===m.l3_code)!;
   const provenance={availability:'effective_date_assumed' as const,source_membership_id:src.id,raw_hash:src.raw_hash,locator:src.locator};
   await db.applyMemberships(batch,ID[m.issuer],'sw2021','2021',[[m.l1_code,1],[m.l2_code,2],[m.l3_code,3]].map(([code,level])=>({code:code as string,level:level as number,valid_from:m.in_date,valid_to:windowEnd(m.out_date,null),available_date:m.in_date,valid_to_available_date:windowEnd(m.out_date,null),source:SOURCE,provenance})),[src.id],{method:'today',resolved_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  }
  for(const i of FX.issuers)await publishCn(facts,tables,i.key,FX.reports[i.key]);
 },120_000);
 afterAll(async()=>{
  // retire this suite's scope rows so no scheduled CN path of another suite picks them up (facts are append-only)
  if(facts)await facts.reconcileScope('CN',FX.issuers.map(i=>({issuer_id:i.issuer_id,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:i.ticker}))).catch(()=>{});
  await admin?.end();
 });

 it('first run: point-in-time members, whole-method cells, missing stays missing, one dependency per member, activated',async()=>{
  const r=await runIndustryAggregation(deps,OPTS);runs.push(r);
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'active',batchStatus:'success',historyClass:'reconstruction',groups:8,manifestMismatches:0});
  const run=(await db.metricRun(r.runId!))!;
  expect(run).toMatchObject({status:'active',level:3,facts_as_of:FX.facts_as_of,knowledge_date:FX.facts_as_of,history_class:'reconstruction',code_version:'t14-industry-sync'});
  expect(run.coverage_summary).toMatchObject({facts_scope_ready:true,universe:5,ready:5});
  const rows=await db.metricRowsOfRun(r.runId!);
  expect(rows).toHaveLength(2*(6+6+11+6));
  expect(rows.every(x=>x.updated_at!==null&&new Date(x.updated_at).toISOString()===new Date(run.activated_at!).toISOString())).toBe(true);
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31')).toMatchObject({status:'ok',value:'2640',unit:'CNY',n_members:3,n_with_data:2,n_unresolved:1});
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'revenue_sum','3M','2024-12-31').value).toBe('690');
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'gross_margin','12M','2024-12-31').value).toBe('0.3720930233');
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'roe','TTM','2024-12-31').value).toBe('0.0846153846');
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'roe','TTM','2025-03-31').value).toBe('0.0867924528');
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'revenue_yoy','3M','2025-03-31').value).toBe('0.0952380952');
  expect(cellOf(rows,FOOD,'member_count','INSTANT','2024-06-30')).toMatchObject({value:'2',n_members:2,n_unresolved:1});
  expect(cellOf(rows,BANK,'gross_margin','12M','2024-12-31')).toMatchObject({status:'missing',missing_reason:'financial_excluded',value:null,manifest_hash:null});
  expect(cellOf(rows,BANK,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31').value).toBe('2080');
  expect(cellOf(rows,BANK,'revenue_sum','3M','2024-12-31')).toMatchObject({status:'missing',missing_reason:'empty_set',value:null});
  const dependencies=await db.runDependencies('aggregate',r.runId!);
  expect(dependencies.filter(d=>d.cell_key===`${FOOD}:2024-12-31`).map(d=>d.issuer_id).sort()).toEqual([ID.F1,ID.F2,ID.F3].sort());
  const revs=new Map((await facts.scopeRows('CN',Object.values(ID))).map(s=>[s.issuer_id,s.state_rev]));
  for(const d of dependencies)expect(d.state_rev).toBe(revs.get(d.issuer_id));
 },120_000);

 it('replays every stored cell from the manifests alone (no database reads): reproduced and equal to the stored values',async()=>{
  const rows=await db.metricRowsOfRun(runs[0].runId!);
  // "drop the database": copy the manifest objects out of the store, then use nothing but those bytes
  const pathOf=new Map<string,string>();
  for(const h of new Set(rows.filter(x=>x.status==='ok').map(x=>x.manifest_hash!)))pathOf.set(h,(await db.manifestObjectPath(h))!);   // incarnation keys, read before "dropping" the database
  const offline=new Map([...manifests.objects].map(([p,b])=>[p,new Uint8Array(b)]));
  const byHash=new Map<string,ReturnType<typeof replayFromManifest>>();
  for(const row of rows.filter(x=>x.status==='ok')){
   const h=row.manifest_hash!;
   if(!byHash.has(h))byHash.set(h,replayFromManifest(decodeManifest(offline.get(pathOf.get(h)!)!,h)));
   const rep=byHash.get(h)!;
   expect(rep.reproduced).toBe(true);
   expect(rep.cells.find(c=>c.metric===row.metric&&c.duration===row.duration&&c.period_start===row.period_start)?.value_text).toBe(row.value);
  }
  expect(byHash.size).toBe(8);
  // every ok manifest hash has an index row in industry_manifests
  const idx=await admin.query(`select manifest_hash from public.industry_manifests where manifest_hash = any($1::text[])`,[[...byHash.keys()]]);
  expect(idx.rowCount).toBe(8);
 },120_000);

 it('a later filing changes the recompute: new run, new values, later updated_at; untouched groups keep their manifests; the old manifest still replays the old value',async()=>{
  const lf=FX.later_filing;
  await publishCn(facts,tables,lf.issuer,[{period_end:lf.period_end,available_date:lf.available_date,values:lf.values}],lf.report_type);
  const r=await runIndustryAggregation(deps,OPTS);runs.push(r);
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'active',generation:runs[0].generation!+1});
  const before=await db.metricRowsOfRun(runs[0].runId!),after=await db.metricRowsOfRun(r.runId!);
  const oldCell=cellOf(before,FOOD,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31'),newCell=cellOf(after,FOOD,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31');
  expect(newCell).toMatchObject({value:'2660',n_with_data:2});                                   // 900 + 1760
  expect(newCell.manifest_hash).not.toBe(oldCell.manifest_hash);
  expect(Date.parse(newCell.updated_at!)).toBeGreaterThan(Date.parse(oldCell.updated_at!));
  expect(cellOf(after,FOOD,'revenue_yoy','12M','2024-12-31').value).toBe('0.1083333333');        // (2660-2400)/2400
  expect(cellOf(after,FOOD,'revenue_sum','3M','2024-12-31')).toMatchObject({value:'460',n_with_data:1});   // F1's Q4 is version-inconsistent now
  const m=await manifests.get(cellOf(after,FOOD,'revenue_sum','3M','2024-12-31').manifest_hash!);
  expect(m.roles.find(x=>x.issuer_id===ID.F1&&x.metric==='revenue_sum'&&x.duration==='3M')).toMatchObject({role:'excluded',reason:'version_inconsistent'});
  // the old run's manifest is immutable evidence: it still replays to the old value
  const old=replayFromManifest(await manifests.get(oldCell.manifest_hash!));
  expect(old.reproduced).toBe(true);
  expect(old.cells.find(c=>c.metric==='revenue_sum'&&c.duration==='12M')?.value_text).toBe('2640');
  // banks did not change: same manifests (reused)
  expect(cellOf(after,BANK,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31').manifest_hash).toBe(cellOf(before,BANK,'revenue_sum','12M','2024-12-31').manifest_hash);
  expect((await db.metricRun(runs[0].runId!))?.status).toBe('superseded');
 },120_000);

  expect((await db.metricRowsOfRun(r.runId!)).map(key).sort()).toEqual((await db.metricRowsOfRun(runs[1].runId!)).map(key).sort());
  const dk=(d:{cell_key:string;issuer_id:string;state_rev:number})=>`${d.cell_key}|${d.issuer_id}|${d.state_rev}`;
  expect((await db.runDependencies('aggregate',r.runId!)).map(dk).sort()).toEqual((await db.runDependencies('aggregate',runs[1].runId!)).map(dk).sort());
 },120_000);

 it('an out_date correction supersedes the old membership rows and changes membership in the next run',async()=>{

  expect(decCmp(cur[0].market_cap,'1740176092672.05')).toBe(0);                                   // generated close × total_share
  const all=await admin.query(`select status, fetch_event_id from public.security_marks where ticker = $1 and trade_date = $2 order by created_at`,[TICKER.F1,day]);
  expect(all.rows.map(x=>x.status)).toEqual(['superseded','superseded','ok']);
  expect(new Set(all.rows.map(x=>x.fetch_event_id)).size).toBe(3);
  // V7: retrying E2 (unchanged A) after E3/E4 is a duplicate and changes nothing

  const universe=new Set(Object.values(TICKER));
  expect(await db.applyObservations('marks',e2.fetch_event_id!,planMarkRows(A(),universe).rows)).toEqual({inserted:0,duplicates:3,superseded:0});
  expect((await db.currentMarksOn(day,[TICKER.F1]))[0].fetch_event_id).toBe(e4.fetch_event_id);
  await expect(db.applyObservations('marks',e2.fetch_event_id!,planMarkRows(B(),universe).rows)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'fetch_event_payload_changed'});
 },120_000);

 it('SIC scope leases on two connections (Codex round 1 #6): one concurrent claim wins; the loser can neither complete nor clear the lease',async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  const p1=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,max:1}),p2=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,max:1});
  try{
   const t1=pgTableClient(p1),t2=pgTableClient(p2);
   const issuer=ID.B2;const now=new Date();
   await admin.query(`delete from public.industry_sync_scope where issuer_id=$1 and job='sic'`,[issuer]);
   await t1.insert('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:issuer,job:'sic',next_due_at:new Date(now.getTime()-60_000).toISOString(),lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:new Date(now.getTime()-60_000).toISOString()});
   const [r1]=await t1.select('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:issuer,job:'sic'});const [r2]=await t2.select('industry_sync_scope',{issuer_id:issuer,job:'sic'});
   const a=randomUUID(),b=randomUUID();
   const won=await Promise.all([claimSicScopeRow(t1,r1,a,now),claimSicScopeRow(t2,r2,b,now)]);
   expect(won.filter(Boolean)).toHaveLength(1);
   const [winner,loser,lt]=won[0]?[a,b,t2]:[b,a,t1];
   expect(await finishSicScopeRow(lt,issuer,loser,{last_status:'success',last_attempt_at:now.toISOString(),updated_at:now.toISOString()})).toBe(false);
   expect((await admin.query(`select lease_batch_id::text b, last_status s from public.industry_sync_scope where issuer_id=$1 and job='sic'`,[issuer])).rows[0]).toEqual({b:winner,s:null});
   expect(await finishSicScopeRow(won[0]?t1:t2,issuer,winner,{last_status:'success',last_attempt_at:now.toISOString(),updated_at:now.toISOString()})).toBe(true);
   expect((await admin.query(`select lease_batch_id b, lease_until u, last_status s from public.industry_sync_scope where issuer_id=$1 and job='sic'`,[issuer])).rows[0]).toEqual({b:null,u:null,s:'success'});
   await admin.query(`delete from public.industry_sync_scope where issuer_id=$1 and job='sic'`,[issuer]);
  }finally{await p1.end();await p2.end();}
 },60_000);
});
```

约定（本任务内全部遵守）：
- 路由只用 anon 客户端完成授权链：数据集未公开 → 403 `unlicensed`（`no-store`）；`/replay` 的顺序是 数据集公开 → `metricRunVisible(runId)` 且 run 的 scheme/version 与路径一致（否则 404 `unknown_run`）→ 该格存在且 `status='ok'`（否则 404 `unknown_cell`）→ 才用 service role 读私有桶里的清单。
- 返回体顶层带 `methodVersion / runId / factsAsOf / historyClass / freshness`（规格 §9 共同约定；不适用时为 `null`）。
- 只复用计划二已落地的 `src/lib/facts/public-route.ts` 助手：`readParams`、`dateParam`、`intParam`、`listParam`、`QueryError`、`errorResponse`、`paramErrorResponse`、`successHeaders`、`utcDate`、`UUID_RE`（文件第 17–108 行）。
- 路由文件只导出 `GET`/`POST` 与 `dynamic`/`maxDuration`（Next 15 构建会拒绝其他导出），辅助函数一律不导出。
- `/replay` 新增可选参数 `duration`（规格 §9 只列 `metric` + `periodEnd`；但 `revenue_sum` 等在同一 `period_end` 有 12M 与 3M 两格，主键含 `period_start`）：多于一格而未给 `duration` → 400 `invalid_parameter:duration`。记入 Task 20 的 §18 偏差。
- 估值格（`tradeDate`）：本计划不实施估值流水线，因此不读估值清单（`replay:'deferred_i3'`）；但授权顺序（anon `publishedValuations` 已经施加 `industry_valuation_run_visible` 与 `published`）与 `officialValue` 字段规则（只在 `isDatasetPublic('official:tushare-sw_daily')` 时经 service role 读 `industry_valuation_pairs` 的 `within` 对照值并附带，否则字段缺省）照规格实现并测试。

```ts
// src/lib/industry/display.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

describe('exact threshold comparison',()=>{
 it('compares as rationals (12/15 = 0.8 exactly; 0.8*15 in floating point is 12.000000000000002)',()=>{
  expect(ratioAtLeast(12,15,0.8)).toBe(true);
  expect(ratioAtLeast(11,15,'0.8')).toBe(false);
  expect(ratioAbove(1,20,0.05)).toBe(false);
  expect(ratioAbove(2,20,0.05)).toBe(true);
 });
});

describe('cellDisplay (spec §5.2 display thresholds)',()=>{
 const c=(p:Partial<{status:'ok'|'missing';n_members:number;n_with_data:number;n_unresolved:number}>)=>({status:'ok' as const,n_members:10,n_with_data:10,n_unresolved:0,...p});
 it('missing cells are missing whatever their counts',()=>expect(cellDisplay(c({status:'missing'}))).toBe('missing'));
 it('coverage below 0.8 of (members + unresolved) is insufficient',()=>{
  expect(cellDisplay(c({n_with_data:8}))).toBe('value');
  expect(cellDisplay(c({n_with_data:7}))).toBe('insufficient');
  expect(cellDisplay(c({n_members:12,n_with_data:12,n_unresolved:3}))).toBe('unresolved');   // 3/15 > 0.05
 });
 it('unresolved share above 0.05 wins over coverage',()=>{

  expect(cellDisplay(c({n_members:9,n_with_data:3,n_unresolved:1}))).toBe('unresolved');
 });
});
```

`src/lib/industry/display.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/display.ts
// Presentation rules shared by the read models, the routes and the components (spec §5.2 display
// thresholds, §8.2 cell states, §11 "missing is never shown as 0"). Thresholds are compared as exact
// rationals and values are formatted by string arithmetic: no value passes through a JS number
// (plan contract: decimal strings end to end).
import {DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED,DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE} from './method-constants';   // NOT ./method: it hashes via node:crypto and this file is rendered by client components
import type {AggMetric,CellStatus,ValuationCellRow} from './types';

export type CellDisplay='value'|'insufficient'|'unresolved'|'missing';
export type Locale='zh'|'en';

function fraction(x:number|string):{n:bigint;d:bigint}{
 const s=typeof x==='number'?String(x):x;
 const m=/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(s);
 if(!m)throw new Error(`invalid_threshold:${s}`);
 const f=m[2]??'';
 return {n:BigInt(m[1]+f),d:10n**BigInt(f.length)};
}
/** num/den >= t exactly (den > 0); t as a decimal literal or number ('0.8' | 0.8 → 8/10). */
export function ratioAtLeast(num:number,den:number,t:number|string):boolean{const f=fraction(t);return BigInt(num)*f.d>=f.n*BigInt(den);}
/** num/den > t exactly (den > 0). */
export function ratioAbove(num:number,den:number,t:number|string):boolean{const f=fraction(t);return BigInt(num)*f.d>f.n*BigInt(den);}

export interface CountedCell{status:CellStatus;n_members:number;n_with_data:number;n_unresolved:number}
/**
 * Spec §5.2: an ok cell is shown as its value only when coverage n_with_data/(n_members+n_unresolved)
 * >= DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE and the unresolved share <= DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED; otherwise the page shows
 * the counts ("x/y" or "z unresolved") and the value stays in the API. Unresolved wins over coverage.
 */
export function cellDisplay(c:CountedCell):CellDisplay{
 if(c.status!=='ok')return 'missing';
 const den=c.n_members+c.n_unresolved;
 if(den===0)return 'value';
 if(ratioAbove(c.n_unresolved,den,DISPLAY_MAX_UNRESOLVED))return 'unresolved';
 if(!ratioAtLeast(c.n_with_data,den,DISPLAY_MIN_COVERAGE))return 'insufficient';
 return 'value';
}

/**
 * Decimal text → display text: move the point by `shift` (2 = percent, -8 = 亿), round half away from
 * zero to `digits`, optionally group thousands with ','. Unparseable input is returned unchanged.
 */
export function formatDecimal(value:string,opts:{shift?:number;digits:number;group?:boolean}):string{
 const m=/^(-?)(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(value);
 if(!m)return value;
 const neg=m[1]==='-',keep=opts.digits;
 let digits=m[2]+(m[3]??''),point=m[2].length+(opts.shift??0);
 if(point<=0){digits='0'.repeat(1-point)+digits;point=1;}
 if(point>digits.length)digits=digits+'0'.repeat(point-digits.length);
 const int=digits.slice(0,point),frac=digits.slice(point);
 const padded=frac+'0'.repeat(keep+1);
 let q=BigInt(int+padded.slice(0,keep));
 if(padded[keep]>='5')q+=1n;
 const s=q.toString().padStart(keep+1,'0');
 let ip=s.slice(0,s.length-keep).replace(/^0+(?=\d)/,'');
 const fp=s.slice(s.length-keep);
 if(opts.group)ip=ip.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',');
 const out=keep>0?`${ip}.${fp}`:ip;
 return neg&&/[1-9]/.test(out)?`-${out}`:out;
}

export interface ValueFormat{shift:number;digits:number;group:boolean;signed:boolean;suffix:Record<Locale,string>}
const PCT:ValueFormat={shift:2,digits:1,group:false,signed:false,suffix:{zh:'%',en:'%'}};
const PCT_SIGNED:ValueFormat={...PCT,signed:true};
const CNY_YI:ValueFormat={shift:-8,digits:2,group:true,signed:false,suffix:{zh:' 亿元',en:' × 1e8 CNY'}};
const USD_BN:ValueFormat={shift:-9,digits:2,group:true,signed:false,suffix:{zh:' 十亿美元',en:' bn USD'}};
const COUNT:ValueFormat={shift:0,digits:0,group:true,signed:false,suffix:{zh:'',en:''}};
const MULTIPLE:ValueFormat={shift:0,digits:2,group:true,signed:false,suffix:{zh:'',en:''}};
export const METRIC_FORMAT:Record<AggMetric,ValueFormat>={revenue_sum:CNY_YI,net_income_parent_sum:CNY_YI,gross_margin:PCT,roe:PCT,revenue_yoy:PCT_SIGNED,net_income_yoy:PCT_SIGNED,member_count:COUNT};
export const VALUATION_FORMAT:Record<ValuationCellRow['metric'],ValueFormat>={pe_ttm:MULTIPLE,pe_static:MULTIPLE,pb:MULTIPLE,market_cap:CNY_YI};

export function formatWith(f:ValueFormat,value:string,locale:Locale):string{
 const body=formatDecimal(value,{shift:f.shift,digits:f.digits,group:f.group});
 const signed=f.signed&&!body.startsWith('-')&&/[1-9]/.test(body)?`+${body}`:body;
 return `${signed}${f.suffix[locale]}`;
}
export const formatMetricValue=(metric:AggMetric,value:string,locale:Locale)=>formatWith(METRIC_FORMAT[metric],value,locale);
export const formatValuation=(metric:ValuationCellRow['metric'],value:string,locale:Locale)=>formatWith(VALUATION_FORMAT[metric],value,locale);
/** Fact money in the constituents table: CNY in 亿, USD in billions; any other unit verbatim. */
export function formatMoney(value:string,unit:string,locale:Locale):string{
 if(unit==='CNY')return formatWith(CNY_YI,value,locale);
 if(unit==='USD')return formatWith(USD_BN,value,locale);
 return `${value} ${unit}`;
}
/** Percent text (one decimal) of a 0..1 ratio string: '0.382' → '38.2'. */
export const percentText=(ratio:string)=>formatDecimal(ratio,{shift:2,digits:1});
```

```ts
export interface StubData{public?:ReadonlySet<string>;tree?:ClassificationRow[];runs?:MetricRunRow[];cells?:MetricCellRow[];memberships?:MembershipRow[];freshness?:FreshnessRow[];valuationRuns?:ValuationRunRow[];valuations?:ValuationCellRow[]}
/** Read-side IndustryDb over arrays; `public` plays the RLS licence gate (default: both schemes public). */
export function stubIndustryDb(d:StubData):ReadDb{
 const pub=d.public??new Set(['scheme:sw2021:2021','scheme:sic:sec-current']);
 const runs=d.runs??[],cells=d.cells??[],members=d.memberships??[];
 const db:ReadDb={
  isDatasetPublic:async k=>pub.has(k),
  classificationTree:async(s,v)=>(d.tree??[]).filter(r=>r.scheme===s&&r.version===v),
  freshness:async()=>d.freshness??[],
  activeMetricRun:async(s,v,l)=>runs.find(r=>r.scheme===s&&r.version===v&&r.level===l&&r.status==='active')??null,
  metricRun:async id=>runs.find(r=>r.run_id===id)??null,
  metricRunVisible:async id=>{const r=runs.find(x=>x.run_id===id);return !!r&&r.status==='active'&&pub.has(`scheme:${r.scheme}:${r.version}`);},
  metricRowsOfRun:async(id,f={})=>cells.filter(c=>c.run_id===id&&(!f.codes||f.codes.includes(c.code))&&(!f.metrics||f.metrics.includes(c.metric))&&(!f.periodEnds||f.periodEnds.includes(c.period_end))&&(!f.durations||f.durations.includes(c.duration))),
  activeValuationRun:async(s,v,l)=>(d.valuationRuns??[]).find(r=>r.scheme===s&&r.version===v&&r.level===l&&r.status==='active')??null,
  publishedValuations:async(id,f)=>(d.valuations??[]).filter(r=>r.run_id===id&&r.published&&(!f.codes||f.codes.includes(r.code))&&(!f.from||r.trade_date>=f.from)&&(!f.to||r.trade_date<=f.to)),
  membershipCandidates:async q=>members.filter(m=>m.scheme===q.scheme&&m.version===q.version&&m.code===q.code&&m.level===q.level&&m.valid_from<=q.on),
  membershipsOfIssuer:async(i,q)=>members.filter(m=>m.issuer_id===i&&(!q.scheme||m.scheme===q.scheme)&&(!q.on||m.valid_from<=q.on)),
 };
 return db;
}

/** ReadDeps around a stub db; unresolved counts, issuer cards and facts are overridable. */
export function readDepsOf(db:ReadDb,p:Partial<ReadDeps>={}):ReadDeps{
 return {db,unresolved:{unresolvedCount:async()=>0},issuers:async()=>new Map(),now:new Date('2026-11-05T08:00:00.000Z'),preview:false,...p};
}
```
