```ts
 it('original: per-cell filtered manifest (members in full, roles/facts of the metric only), reproduced=true',async()=>{
  const v=await replayView(deps(),q);
  if(v.state!=='ok'||v.mode!=='original')throw new Error(v.state);
  expect(v.reproduced).toBe(true);
  expect(v.manifest.members).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(v.manifest.member_state_revs).toEqual([{issuer_id:ISSUER_A,state_rev:4}]);
  expect(v.manifest.roles.map(r=>r.metric)).toEqual(['gross_margin']);
  expect(v.manifest.facts.map(f=>f.concept).sort()).toEqual(['cost_of_revenue','revenue_operating']);
  expect(v.manifest.cells.map(c=>c.metric)).toEqual(['gross_margin']);
  expect(v.replay).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(v.header.runId).toBe(RUN_ID);
 });
 it('original: reproduced=false when the replayed value differs (canonical decimal compare; 0.4780 equals 0.478)',async()=>{
  vi.mocked(replayFromManifest).mockReturnValueOnce({cells:[{metric:'gross_margin',duration:'12M',period_start:'2025-01-01',status:'ok',value_text:'0.4780',n_members:10,n_with_data:9,n_unresolved:0,unit:'ratio'}],reproduced:true,mismatches:[]});
  const same=await replayView(deps(),q);
  expect(same.state==='ok'&&same.mode==='original'&&same.reproduced).toBe(true);
  vi.mocked(replayFromManifest).mockReturnValueOnce({cells:[{metric:'gross_margin',duration:'12M',period_start:'2025-01-01',status:'ok',value_text:'0.476',n_members:10,n_with_data:9,n_unresolved:0,unit:'ratio'}],reproduced:true,mismatches:[]});
  const diff=await replayView(deps(),q);
  expect(diff.state==='ok'&&diff.mode==='original'&&diff.reproduced).toBe(false);
 });
 it('recompute: match on identical evidence; changed lists the new fact, the state_rev move and the cell',async()=>{
  const match=await replayView(deps(),{...q,mode:'recompute'});
  expect(match.state==='ok'&&match.mode==='recompute'&&match.result).toBe('match');
  const later=manifestOf();
  later.member_state_revs=[{issuer_id:ISSUER_A,state_rev:5}];
  later.facts=[...later.facts,{...later.facts[1],fact_id:'f-cost-2',value_text:'50'}];
  later.cells=[{...later.cells[0],value_text:'0.5'},later.cells[1]];
  const r=await replayView(deps({recompute:vi.fn(async()=>later)}),{...q,mode:'recompute'});
  if(r.state!=='ok'||r.mode!=='recompute')throw new Error(r.state);
  expect(r.result).toBe('changed');
  expect(r.diff.facts).toEqual({added:['f-cost-2'],removed:[]});
  expect(r.diff.stateRevs).toEqual([{issuerId:ISSUER_A,from:4,to:5}]);
  expect(r.diff.cells.map(c=>[c.metric,c.stored?.value_text,c.recomputed?.value_text])).toEqual([['gross_margin','0.478','0.5']]);
 });
});
```

`src/lib/industry/read.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/read.ts
// Read models of the industry pages and public routes (spec §8, §9): list, detail, constituents,
// an issuer's industries, and replay (original | recompute, spec §5.5). `deps.db` is the anon
// IndustryDb: the RLS licence gate (spec §4.8) makes rows of a non-public dataset read as nothing, so
// every view asks isDatasetPublic first and answers 'unlicensed'. Only the admin internal preview
// (spec §8.1) passes the service-role IndustryDb with preview=true. Source records are service-role
// only and reach the views as counts through deps.unresolved; the manifest bucket is private and is
// read only after the anon authorization chain passed (dataset public → run visible → cell exists).
// Values stay decimal strings; a missing cell keeps its reason and is never turned into 0.
import {computeFreshness} from '../dq/freshness';
import type {FreshnessStatus} from '../dq/freshness';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import type {FactRow,FactsDb,Market} from '../facts/types';
import {cellDisplay} from './display';
import type {CellDisplay} from './display';
import {schemeDatasetKey} from './licenses';
import {isMemberAt} from './memberships';
import {CONFIG_HASH,METHOD_CONFIG,METHOD_VERSION} from './method';
import {replayFromManifest} from './replay';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric,AggregateManifest,CellStatus,ClassificationRow,DatasetKey,FreshnessRow,HistoryClass,IndustryDb,ManifestCell,ManifestStore,ManifestUnresolved,MembershipRow,MetricCellRow,MetricRunRow,MissingReason,Scheme,SchemeVersion,ValuationCellRow} from './types';

export const SCHEME_VERSION:Record<Scheme,SchemeVersion>={sw2021:'2021',sic:'sec-current'};
export const AGG_METRICS:readonly AggMetric[]=['revenue_sum','net_income_parent_sum','gross_margin','roe','revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy','member_count'];
export const AGG_DURATIONS:readonly AggDuration[]=['12M','3M','TTM','INSTANT'];
/** Spec §5.2: the durations each metric is computed for (first = page default). */
export const METRIC_DURATIONS:Record<AggMetric,readonly AggDuration[]>={revenue_sum:['12M','3M'],net_income_parent_sum:['12M','3M'],gross_margin:['12M'],roe:['TTM'],revenue_yoy:['12M','3M'],net_income_yoy:['12M','3M'],member_count:['INSTANT']};
/** The stored YoY metric shown next to a sum in the table view (no page-side arithmetic). */
export const YOY_COMPANION:Partial<Record<AggMetric,AggMetric>>={revenue_sum:'revenue_yoy',net_income_parent_sum:'net_income_yoy'};
/** Spec §5.2 inputs per metric: plan-2 concepts and derived metric names (replay filtering, spec §9). */
export const METRIC_INPUTS:Record<AggMetric,{facts:readonly string[];derived:readonly string[]}>={
 revenue_sum:{facts:['revenue'],derived:['q_single_revenue']},
 net_income_parent_sum:{facts:['net_income_parent'],derived:['q_single_net_income_parent']},
 gross_margin:{facts:['revenue_operating','cost_of_revenue'],derived:[]},
 roe:{facts:['equity_parent'],derived:['ttm_net_income_parent']},
 revenue_yoy:{facts:['revenue'],derived:['q_single_revenue']},
 net_income_yoy:{facts:['net_income_parent'],derived:['q_single_net_income_parent']},
 member_count:{facts:[],derived:[]},
};
/** dq_freshness datasets written by the jobs (Task 12 aggregate, Task 7 SW memberships, Task 9 SIC). */
export const AGG_FRESHNESS:Record<Scheme,string>={sw2021:'industry.agg.sw2021',sic:'industry.sic.memberships'};
export const MEMBERSHIP_FRESHNESS:Record<Scheme,string>={sw2021:'industry.sw2021.memberships',sic:'industry.sic.memberships'};
export type SourceId='sw_via_tushare'|'exchange_via_tushare'|'tushare_statements'|'sec_submissions'|'edgar_companyfacts';
export const SOURCES:Record<Scheme,readonly SourceId[]>={sw2021:['sw_via_tushare','exchange_via_tushare','tushare_statements'],sic:['sec_submissions','edgar_companyfacts']};
export const OFFICIAL_DATASET:DatasetKey='official:tushare-sw_daily';
export type Window='5y'|'10y'|'all';
export const utcDate=(d:Date)=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);

export type ReadDb=Pick<IndustryDb,'isDatasetPublic'|'classificationTree'|'freshness'|'activeMetricRun'|'metricRun'|'metricRowsOfRun'|'metricRunVisible'|'activeValuationRun'|'publishedValuations'|'membershipCandidates'|'membershipsOfIssuer'>;
export interface IssuerCard{issuerId:string;nameZh:string|null;nameEn:string|null;ticker:string|null}
export interface ReadDeps{
 db:ReadDb;
 /** service role: industry_source_memberships is not public (spec §4.3); only counts leave it */
 unresolved:Pick<IndustryDb,'unresolvedCount'>;
 issuers:(ids:string[],today:string)=>Promise<Map<string,IssuerCard>>;
 facts?:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'>;
 memberCounts?:(scheme:Scheme,version:SchemeVersion,on:string)=>Promise<Map<string,number>>;
 now:Date;
 /** admin internal preview over the service-role db: the licence gate is skipped and the page says so */
 preview:boolean;
}

export interface NodeView{code:string;level:number;nameZh:string|null;nameEn:string|null;parentCode:string|null}
export interface RunHeader{methodVersion:string;runId:string;generation:number;level:number;factsAsOf:string;knowledgeDate:string;historyClass:HistoryClass;activatedAt:string|null;configHash:string;formulaVersion:string;codeVersion:string}
export interface PublicCell{code:string;metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;status:CellStatus;missingReason:MissingReason|null;value:string|null;unit:string;nMembers:number;nWithData:number;nUnresolved:number;manifestHash:string|null;updatedAt:string|null;display:CellDisplay}
export interface PublicValuation{code:string;tradeDate:string;metric:ValuationCellRow['metric'];value:string;factsAsOf:string;nMembers:number|null;nWithData:number|null;nUnresolved:number|null;mcapCoverage:string|null;manifestHash:string|null;updatedAt:string|null}
export type ValuationBlock=
 |{state:'not_enabled'}
 |{state:'unpublished';runId:string;reconciliation:Record<string,unknown>}
 |{state:'published';runId:string;methodVersion:string;reconciliation:Record<string,unknown>;cells:PublicValuation[]};
interface Base{datasetKey:DatasetKey;preview:boolean;freshness:FreshnessStatus}

export interface ListQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;level:number;metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;periods:number}
export type ListView=
 |{state:'unlicensed';datasetKey:DatasetKey}
 |(Base&{state:'empty';kind:'aggregate';nodes:NodeView[]})
 |(Base&{state:'ok';kind:'aggregate';header:RunHeader;nodes:NodeView[];metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;periodEnds:string[];cells:PublicCell[];companion:PublicCell[];valuation:ValuationBlock})
 |(Base&{state:'ok';kind:'navigation';nodes:(NodeView&{members:number|null})[]});

export interface MethodInfo{methodVersion:string;configHash:string;formulaVersion:string|null;codeVersion:string|null;config:unknown}
export interface DetailQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;metrics:AggMetric[];durations:AggDuration[]|null;window:Window}
export type DetailView=
 |{state:'unlicensed';datasetKey:DatasetKey}
 |{state:'unknown_industry'}
 |(Base&{state:'ok';node:NodeView;ancestors:NodeView[];children:NodeView[];header:RunHeader|null;aggregated:boolean;members:{count:number;unresolved:number;lastAddition:string|null};periodEnds:string[];series:PublicCell[];valuation:ValuationBlock;method:MethodInfo;sources:readonly SourceId[]});

export interface FactCellView{factId:string;concept:string;value:string;unit:string;periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;duration:string;availableDate:string;filingId:string;rawHash:string}
export interface MembershipView{membershipId:string;code:string;level:number;validFrom:string;validTo:string|null;availableDate:string;validToAvailableDate:string|null;source:string;sourceMembershipId:string|null;batchId:string;availability:string;rawHash:string|null;locator:Record<string,unknown>|null}
export interface ConstituentRow{issuerId:string;ticker:string|null;nameZh:string|null;nameEn:string|null;membership:MembershipView;path:NodeView[];revenue:FactCellView|null;netIncome:FactCellView|null}
export interface ConstituentsQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;on:string;page:number;pageSize:number}
export type ConstituentsView=
 |{state:'unlicensed';datasetKey:DatasetKey}
 |{state:'unknown_industry'}
 |(Base&{state:'ok';node:NodeView;on:string;knownBy:string;total:number;page:number;pageSize:number;unresolvedCount:number;currentOnly:boolean;rows:ConstituentRow[]});

export interface IssuerIndustry{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;datasetKey:DatasetKey;currentOnly:boolean;since:string;membershipId:string;path:NodeView[]}
export type IssuerIndustriesView=
 |{state:'unknown_issuer'}
 |{state:'ok';issuerId:string;on:string;industries:IssuerIndustry[];schemes:{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;datasetKey:DatasetKey;public:boolean}[]};

const nodeView=(r:ClassificationRow):NodeView=>({code:r.code,level:r.level,nameZh:r.name_zh,nameEn:r.name_en,parentCode:r.parent_code});
const byCode=(a:{code:string},b:{code:string})=>a.code<b.code?-1:a.code>b.code?1:0;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;

export function runHeader(r:MetricRunRow):RunHeader{
 return {methodVersion:r.method_version,runId:r.run_id,generation:Number(r.generation),level:r.level,factsAsOf:r.facts_as_of,knowledgeDate:r.knowledge_date,historyClass:r.history_class,activatedAt:r.activated_at,configHash:r.config_hash,formulaVersion:r.formula_version,codeVersion:r.code_version};
}
export function publicCell(r:MetricCellRow):PublicCell{
 return {code:r.code,metric:r.metric,duration:r.duration,periodStart:r.period_start,periodEnd:r.period_end,status:r.status,missingReason:r.missing_reason,value:r.value,unit:r.unit,nMembers:r.n_members,nWithData:r.n_with_data,nUnresolved:r.n_unresolved,manifestHash:r.manifest_hash,updatedAt:r.updated_at,display:cellDisplay(r)};
}
const publicValuation=(r:ValuationCellRow):PublicValuation=>({code:r.code,tradeDate:r.trade_date,metric:r.metric,value:r.value??'',factsAsOf:r.facts_as_of,nMembers:r.n_members,nWithData:r.n_with_data,nUnresolved:r.n_unresolved,mcapCoverage:r.mcap_coverage,manifestHash:r.manifest_hash,updatedAt:r.updated_at});
const factView=(r:FactRow):FactCellView=>({factId:r.fact_id,concept:r.concept,value:r.value_text,unit:r.unit,periodStart:r.period_start,periodEnd:r.period_end,duration:r.duration,availableDate:r.available_date,filingId:r.filing_id,rawHash:r.raw_hash});
const membershipView=(m:MembershipRow):MembershipView=>({membershipId:m.membership_id,code:m.code,level:m.level,validFrom:m.valid_from,validTo:m.valid_to,availableDate:m.available_date,validToAvailableDate:m.valid_to_available_date,source:m.source,sourceMembershipId:m.source_membership_id,batchId:m.batch_id,availability:m.provenance.availability,rawHash:m.provenance.raw_hash??null,locator:m.provenance.locator??null});

/** Stored status, recomputed against the weekly window when not error (a stopped job never writes again; spec §4.6). */
export function effectiveFreshness(rows:FreshnessRow[],dataset:string,now:Date):FreshnessStatus{
 const r=rows.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);
 if(!r)return 'missing';
 if(r.status==='error')return 'error';
 return computeFreshness({cadence:'weekly',lastOkAt:r.last_ok_at?new Date(r.last_ok_at):null,consecutiveErrors:0,now});
}
async function licensed(deps:ReadDeps,key:DatasetKey):Promise<boolean>{return deps.preview||await deps.db.isDatasetPublic(key);}
export function windowStart(w:Window,today:string):string|null{
 if(w==='all')return null;
 return `${Number(today.slice(0,4))-(w==='5y'?5:10)}-01-01`;
}
/** Grid period ends for a duration: annual (12M) cells live on 12-31 only; others on every grid end. */
export function periodEndsFor(run:MetricRunRow,duration:AggDuration|null,opts:{count?:number;from?:string|null}):string[]{
 const all=[...new Set(run.expected_grid.period_ends)].sort(cmp).filter(e=>duration!=='12M'||e.endsWith('-12-31')).filter(e=>!opts.from||e>=opts.from);
 return opts.count===undefined?all:all.slice(-opts.count);
}

async function valuationBlock(deps:ReadDeps,scheme:Scheme,version:SchemeVersion,level:number,filter:{codes?:string[];from?:string}):Promise<ValuationBlock>{
 if(scheme!=='sw2021')return {state:'not_enabled'};
 const run=await deps.db.activeValuationRun(scheme,version,level);
 if(!run)return {state:'not_enabled'};
 const rows=(await deps.db.publishedValuations(run.run_id,filter)).filter(r=>r.published&&r.status==='ok'&&r.value!==null);
 if(rows.length===0)return {state:'unpublished',runId:run.run_id,reconciliation:run.reconciliation};
 return {state:'published',runId:run.run_id,methodVersion:run.method_version,reconciliation:run.reconciliation,cells:rows.map(publicValuation)};
}
/** Snapshot = the latest published date per (code, metric) within the last 45 days. */
function latestPerKey(b:ValuationBlock):ValuationBlock{
 if(b.state!=='published')return b;
 const latest=new Map<string,PublicValuation>();
 for(const c of b.cells){const k=`${c.code}:${c.metric}`;const p=latest.get(k);if(!p||c.tradeDate>p.tradeDate)latest.set(k,c);}
 return {...b,cells:[...latest.values()].sort((x,y)=>cmp(`${x.code}:${x.metric}`,`${y.code}:${y.metric}`))};
}
const daysBefore=(today:string,n:number)=>new Date(Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00Z`)-n*86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0,10);

export async function industryListView(deps:ReadDeps,q:ListQuery):Promise<ListView>{
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(q.scheme,q.version);
 if(!await licensed(deps,datasetKey))return {state:'unlicensed',datasetKey};
 const [tree,fresh]=await Promise.all([deps.db.classificationTree(q.scheme,q.version),deps.db.freshness()]);
 const today=utcDate(deps.now);
 if(q.scheme==='sic'){
  const counts=deps.memberCounts?await deps.memberCounts(q.scheme,q.version,today):null;
  const nodes=tree.map(nodeView).sort(byCode).map(n=>({...n,members:counts?counts.get(n.code)??0:null}));
  return {state:'ok',kind:'navigation',datasetKey,preview:deps.preview,freshness:effectiveFreshness(fresh,MEMBERSHIP_FRESHNESS.sic,deps.now),nodes};
 }
 const freshness=effectiveFreshness(fresh,AGG_FRESHNESS[q.scheme],deps.now);
 const nodes=tree.filter(n=>n.level===q.level).map(nodeView).sort(byCode);
 const run=await deps.db.activeMetricRun(q.scheme,q.version,q.level);
 if(!run)return {state:'empty',kind:'aggregate',datasetKey,preview:deps.preview,freshness,nodes};
 const periodEnds=periodEndsFor(run,q.duration,{count:q.periods});
 const companion=YOY_COMPANION[q.metric];
 const rows=periodEnds.length===0?[]:await deps.db.metricRowsOfRun(run.run_id,{metrics:companion?[q.metric,companion]:[q.metric],periodEnds,durations:[q.duration]});
 const valuation=latestPerKey(await valuationBlock(deps,q.scheme,q.version,q.level,{from:daysBefore(today,45)}));
 return {state:'ok',kind:'aggregate',datasetKey,preview:deps.preview,freshness,header:runHeader(run),nodes,metric:q.metric,duration:q.duration,periodEnds,
  cells:rows.filter(r=>r.metric===q.metric).map(publicCell),companion:companion?rows.filter(r=>r.metric===companion).map(publicCell):[],valuation};
}

function ancestorsOf(tree:ClassificationRow[],row:ClassificationRow):NodeView[]{
 const byId=new Map(tree.map(n=>[n.code,n]));const out:NodeView[]=[];
 for(let p=row.parent_code;p!==null&&out.length<4;){const n=byId.get(p);if(!n)break;out.unshift(nodeView(n));p=n.parent_code;}
 return out;
}
async function currentMembers(deps:ReadDeps,q:{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;level:number;on:string;knownBy:string}):Promise<MembershipRow[]>{
 return (await deps.db.membershipCandidates({scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:q.level,on:q.on})).filter(m=>m.code===q.code&&isMemberAt(m,q.on,q.knownBy));
}
const seriesOrder=(a:PublicCell,b:PublicCell)=>cmp(a.metric,b.metric)||cmp(a.duration,b.duration)||cmp(a.periodEnd,b.periodEnd);

export async function industryDetailView(deps:ReadDeps,q:DetailQuery):Promise<DetailView>{
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(q.scheme,q.version);
 if(!await licensed(deps,datasetKey))return {state:'unlicensed',datasetKey};
 const tree=await deps.db.classificationTree(q.scheme,q.version);
 const row=tree.find(n=>n.code===q.code);
 if(!row)return {state:'unknown_industry'};
 const today=utcDate(deps.now);
 const [fresh,members,unresolved,run]=await Promise.all([
  deps.db.freshness(),
  currentMembers(deps,{scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:row.level,on:today,knownBy:today}),
  q.scheme==='sw2021'?deps.unresolved.unresolvedCount({code:q.code,level:row.level,on:today,knownBy:today}):Promise.resolve(0),
  q.scheme==='sw2021'?deps.db.activeMetricRun(q.scheme,q.version,row.level):Promise.resolve(null),
 ]);
 const from=windowStart(q.window,today);
 let periodEnds:string[]=[],series:PublicCell[]=[];
 if(run){
  periodEnds=periodEndsFor(run,null,{from});
  if(periodEnds.length>0)series=(await deps.db.metricRowsOfRun(run.run_id,{codes:[q.code],metrics:q.metrics,periodEnds,durations:q.durations??undefined})).filter(r=>r.code===q.code).map(publicCell).sort(seriesOrder);
 }
 const valuation=await valuationBlock(deps,q.scheme,q.version,row.level,{codes:[q.code],from:from??undefined});
 const lastAddition=members.reduce<string|null>((m,r)=>m===null||r.valid_from>m?r.valid_from:m,null);
 return {
  state:'ok',datasetKey,preview:deps.preview,freshness:effectiveFreshness(fresh,run?AGG_FRESHNESS[q.scheme]:MEMBERSHIP_FRESHNESS[q.scheme],deps.now),
  node:nodeView(row),ancestors:ancestorsOf(tree,row),children:tree.filter(n=>n.parent_code===q.code).map(nodeView).sort(byCode),
  header:run?runHeader(run):null,aggregated:run!==null,members:{count:new Set(members.map(m=>m.issuer_id)).size,unresolved,lastAddition},
  periodEnds,series,valuation,
  method:{methodVersion:run?.method_version??METHOD_VERSION,configHash:run?.config_hash??CONFIG_HASH,formulaVersion:run?.formula_version??null,codeVersion:run?.code_version??null,config:METHOD_CONFIG},
  sources:SOURCES[q.scheme],
 };
}

async function mapLimit<T,R>(items:T[],limit:number,fn:(t:T)=>Promise<R>):Promise<R[]>{
 const out=new Array<R>(items.length);let next=0;
 await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(limit,items.length)},async()=>{while(next<items.length){const i=next++;out[i]=await fn(items[i]);}}));
 return out;
}
/** Latest 12M revenue / net_income_parent visible on `on` (anon read_facts: ok rows only). */
async function latestAnnual(facts:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'>,issuer:string,market:Market,on:string):Promise<{revenue:FactCellView|null;netIncome:FactCellView|null}>{
 const env=await facts.readFacts(issuer,market,{concepts:['revenue','net_income_parent'],asOf:on,from:`${Number(on.slice(0,4))-2}-01-01`,to:on});
 if(env.truncated)return {revenue:null,netIncome:null};
 const pick=(c:string)=>{const r=env.rows.filter(x=>x.concept===c&&x.duration==='12M'&&x.status==='ok').sort((a,b)=>cmp(b.period_end,a.period_end))[0];return r?factView(r):null;};
 return {revenue:pick('revenue'),netIncome:pick('net_income_parent')};
}
function pathOf(rows:MembershipRow[],on:string,knownBy:string,tree:Map<string,ClassificationRow>):NodeView[]{
 return rows.filter(m=>isMemberAt(m,on,knownBy)).sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level).map(m=>{const n=tree.get(m.code);return n?nodeView(n):{code:m.code,level:m.level,nameZh:null,nameEn:null,parentCode:null};});
}

export async function constituentsView(deps:ReadDeps,q:ConstituentsQuery):Promise<ConstituentsView>{
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(q.scheme,q.version);
 if(!await licensed(deps,datasetKey))return {state:'unlicensed',datasetKey};
 const tree=await deps.db.classificationTree(q.scheme,q.version);
 const row=tree.find(n=>n.code===q.code);
 if(!row)return {state:'unknown_industry'};
 const today=utcDate(deps.now);
 const [fresh,members,unresolvedCount]=await Promise.all([
  deps.db.freshness(),
  currentMembers(deps,{scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,level:row.level,on:q.on,knownBy:today}),
  q.scheme==='sw2021'?deps.unresolved.unresolvedCount({code:q.code,level:row.level,on:q.on,knownBy:today}):Promise.resolve(0),
 ]);
 const sorted=[...members].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.valid_from,b.valid_from)||cmp(a.issuer_id,b.issuer_id));
 const pageRows=sorted.slice((q.page-1)*q.pageSize,q.page*q.pageSize);
 const cards=pageRows.length?await deps.issuers([...new Set(pageRows.map(m=>m.issuer_id))],today):new Map<string,IssuerCard>();
 const treeMap=new Map(tree.map(n=>[n.code,n]));
 const market:Market=q.scheme==='sw2021'?'CN':'US';
 const rows=await mapLimit(pageRows,8,async(m):Promise<ConstituentRow>=>{
  const card=cards.get(m.issuer_id);
  const path=q.scheme==='sw2021'?pathOf(await deps.db.membershipsOfIssuer(m.issuer_id,{scheme:q.scheme,on:q.on}),q.on,today,treeMap):[nodeView(row)];
  const f=deps.facts?await latestAnnual(deps.facts,m.issuer_id,market,q.on):{revenue:null,netIncome:null};
  return {issuerId:m.issuer_id,ticker:card?.ticker??null,nameZh:card?.nameZh??null,nameEn:card?.nameEn??null,membership:membershipView(m),path,revenue:f.revenue,netIncome:f.netIncome};
 });
 return {state:'ok',datasetKey,preview:deps.preview,freshness:effectiveFreshness(fresh,MEMBERSHIP_FRESHNESS[q.scheme],deps.now),node:nodeView(row),on:q.on,knownBy:today,total:sorted.length,page:q.page,pageSize:q.pageSize,unresolvedCount,currentOnly:q.scheme==='sic',rows};
}

/** Industries of one issuer on `on`, public schemes only (spec §7.3: GET /api/entities/[issuerId]/industries). */
export async function issuerIndustriesView(deps:ReadDeps,q:{issuerId:string;on:string}):Promise<IssuerIndustriesView>{
 const today=utcDate(deps.now);
 if(!(await deps.issuers([q.issuerId],today)).has(q.issuerId))return {state:'unknown_issuer'};
 const schemes=await Promise.all((['sw2021','sic'] as const).map(async scheme=>{const version=SCHEME_VERSION[scheme];const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(scheme,version);return {scheme,version,datasetKey,public:await licensed(deps,datasetKey)};}));
 const industries:IssuerIndustry[]=[];
 for(const s of schemes){
  if(!s.public)continue;
  const [rows,tree]=await Promise.all([deps.db.membershipsOfIssuer(q.issuerId,{scheme:s.scheme,on:q.on}),deps.db.classificationTree(s.scheme,s.version)]);
  const current=rows.filter(m=>m.scheme===s.scheme&&m.version===s.version&&isMemberAt(m,q.on,today));
  if(current.length===0)continue;
  const treeMap=new Map(tree.map(n=>[n.code,n]));
  if(s.scheme==='sw2021'){
   const deepest=current.reduce((a,b)=>b.level>a.level?b:a);
   industries.push({scheme:s.scheme,version:s.version,datasetKey:s.datasetKey,currentOnly:false,since:deepest.valid_from,membershipId:deepest.membership_id,path:pathOf(current,q.on,today,treeMap)});
  }else{
   for(const m of current.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.code,b.code)))industries.push({scheme:s.scheme,version:s.version,datasetKey:s.datasetKey,currentOnly:true,since:m.valid_from,membershipId:m.membership_id,path:pathOf([m],q.on,today,treeMap)});
  }
 }
 return {state:'ok',issuerId:q.issuerId,on:q.on,industries,schemes};
}

// ---------- replay (spec §5.5, §9) ----------
export interface ReplayQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;runId:string;metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration|null;periodEnd:string;mode:'original'|'recompute'}
export interface RecomputeQuery{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;level:number;code:string;periodEnd:string;factsAsOf:string;knowledgeDate:string;historyClass:HistoryClass}
export interface ReplayDeps{
 /** anon: the authorization chain runs under RLS */
 db:Pick<IndustryDb,'isDatasetPublic'|'metricRun'|'metricRunVisible'|'metricRowsOfRun'|'freshness'>;
 /** service role: the manifest bucket is private */
 manifests:Pick<ManifestStore,'get'>;
 /** service role: the same per-group computation a run performs (Task 12 buildCellManifest), no writes */
 recompute:(q:RecomputeQuery)=>Promise<AggregateManifest>;
 now:Date;
}
export interface ReplayDiff{
 members:{added:string[];removed:string[]};unresolved:{added:string[];removed:string[]};facts:{added:string[];removed:string[]};
 stateRevs:{issuerId:string;from:number|null;to:number|null}[];
 cells:{metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;periodStart:string;stored:ManifestCell|null;recomputed:ManifestCell|null}[];
}
export type ReplayResult=
 |{state:'unlicensed';datasetKey:DatasetKey}
 |{state:'unknown_run'}|{state:'unknown_cell'}|{state:'ambiguous_duration'}
 |{state:'ok';mode:'original';header:RunHeader;freshness:FreshnessStatus;cell:PublicCell;manifestHash:string;manifest:AggregateManifest;replay:ManifestCell[];reproduced:boolean}
 |{state:'ok';mode:'recompute';header:RunHeader;freshness:FreshnessStatus;cell:PublicCell;manifestHash:string;result:'match'|'changed';diff:ReplayDiff};

function sameDecimal(a:string,b:string):boolean{try{return canonicalDecimal(a)===canonicalDecimal(b);}catch{return a===b;}}
/** The replayed cell equals the stored row: ok, same decimal value, same three counts. */
export function reproduces(c:ManifestCell|undefined,row:MetricCellRow):boolean{
 return !!c&&c.status==='ok'&&row.status==='ok'&&c.value_text!==undefined&&row.value!==null&&sameDecimal(c.value_text,row.value)&&c.n_members===row.n_members&&c.n_with_data===row.n_with_data&&c.n_unresolved===row.n_unresolved;
}
const sameCell=(c:ManifestCell,metric:AggMetric,duration:AggDuration,periodStart:string)=>c.metric===metric&&c.duration===duration&&c.period_start===periodStart;

/**
 * Spec §9 per-cell filtering: members / unresolved / member_state_revs in full; facts and derived only for
 * the metric (its input concepts, its derived metrics and the facts those derived rows cite); roles only for
 * the metric and the cell's duration (ManifestRole carries duration, plan contract change);
 * cells only the requested one.
 */
export function filterManifest(m:AggregateManifest,metric:AggMetric,cell:{duration:AggDuration;period_start:string}):AggregateManifest{
 const inputs=METRIC_INPUTS[metric];
 const derived=m.derived.filter(d=>inputs.derived.includes(d.metric));
 const cited=new Set(derived.flatMap(d=>d.inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id)));
 return {...m,facts:m.facts.filter(f=>inputs.facts.includes(f.concept)||cited.has(f.fact_id)),derived,roles:m.roles.filter(r=>r.metric===metric&&r.duration===cell.duration),cells:m.cells.filter(c=>sameCell(c,metric,cell.duration,cell.period_start))};
}
function setDiff(a:string[],b:string[]){const A=new Set(a),B=new Set(b);return {added:[...B].filter(x=>!A.has(x)).sort(cmp),removed:[...A].filter(x=>!B.has(x)).sort(cmp)};}
function sameManifestCell(a:ManifestCell,b:ManifestCell):boolean{
 return a.status===b.status&&(a.missing_reason??null)===(b.missing_reason??null)&&a.n_members===b.n_members&&a.n_with_data===b.n_with_data&&a.n_unresolved===b.n_unresolved&&a.unit===b.unit
  &&((a.value_text===undefined&&b.value_text===undefined)||(a.value_text!==undefined&&b.value_text!==undefined&&sameDecimal(a.value_text,b.value_text)));
}
/** What changed between the frozen manifest and a recompute on current evidence (spec §5.5 'changed'). */
export function manifestDiff(stored:AggregateManifest,now:AggregateManifest):ReplayDiff{
 const memberKey=(x:AggregateManifest['members'][number])=>`${x.issuer_id}:${x.valid_from}:${x.valid_to??''}:${x.valid_to_available_date??''}`;
 const unresolvedKey=(x:ManifestUnresolved)=>`${x.ts_code}:${x.in_date}:${x.out_date??''}:${x.source_membership_id}`;
 const revA=new Map(stored.member_state_revs.map(r=>[r.issuer_id,r.state_rev])),revB=new Map(now.member_state_revs.map(r=>[r.issuer_id,r.state_rev]));
 const stateRevs=[...new Set([...revA.keys(),...revB.keys()])].sort(cmp).filter(i=>revA.get(i)!==revB.get(i)).map(i=>({issuerId:i,from:revA.get(i)??null,to:revB.get(i)??null}));
 const cellKey=(c:ManifestCell)=>`${c.metric}:${c.duration}:${c.period_start}`;
 const cellsA=new Map(stored.cells.map(c=>[cellKey(c),c])),cellsB=new Map(now.cells.map(c=>[cellKey(c),c]));
 const cells=[...new Set([...cellsA.keys(),...cellsB.keys()])].sort(cmp).flatMap(k=>{
  const a=cellsA.get(k)??null,b=cellsB.get(k)??null;
  if(a&&b&&sameManifestCell(a,b))return [];
  const ref=(a??b)!;
  return [{metric:ref.metric,duration:ref.duration,periodStart:ref.period_start,stored:a,recomputed:b}];
 });
 return {members:setDiff(stored.members.map(memberKey),now.members.map(memberKey)),unresolved:setDiff(stored.unresolved.map(unresolvedKey),now.unresolved.map(unresolvedKey)),facts:setDiff(stored.facts.map(f=>f.fact_id),now.facts.map(f=>f.fact_id)),stateRevs,cells};
}
export const isEmptyDiff=(d:ReplayDiff)=>d.members.added.length+d.members.removed.length+d.unresolved.added.length+d.unresolved.removed.length+d.facts.added.length+d.facts.removed.length+d.stateRevs.length+d.cells.length===0;

/** Spec §9 authorization order: dataset public → run visible (active, same scheme/version) → cell exists and is ok; only then the private manifest. */
export async function replayView(deps:ReplayDeps,q:ReplayQuery):Promise<ReplayResult>{
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(q.scheme,q.version);
 if(!await deps.db.isDatasetPublic(datasetKey))return {state:'unlicensed',datasetKey};
 if(!await deps.db.metricRunVisible(q.runId))return {state:'unknown_run'};
 const run=await deps.db.metricRun(q.runId);
 if(!run||run.scheme!==q.scheme||run.version!==q.version)return {state:'unknown_run'};
 const rows=(await deps.db.metricRowsOfRun(q.runId,{codes:[q.code],metrics:[q.metric],periodEnds:[q.periodEnd],durations:q.duration?[q.duration]:undefined}))
  .filter(r=>r.code===q.code&&r.metric===q.metric&&r.period_end===q.periodEnd&&(q.duration===null||r.duration===q.duration));
 if(rows.length===0)return {state:'unknown_cell'};
 if(rows.length>1)return {state:'ambiguous_duration'};
 const cell=rows[0];
 if(cell.status!=='ok'||cell.manifest_hash===null)return {state:'unknown_cell'};
 const [fresh,stored]=await Promise.all([deps.db.freshness(),deps.manifests.get(cell.manifest_hash)]);
 const base={header:runHeader(run),freshness:effectiveFreshness(fresh,AGG_FRESHNESS[q.scheme],deps.now),cell:publicCell(cell),manifestHash:cell.manifest_hash};
 const original=filterManifest(stored,q.metric,cell);
 if(q.mode==='original'){
  const replay=replayFromManifest(stored).cells.filter(c=>sameCell(c,q.metric,cell.duration,cell.period_start));
  return {state:'ok',mode:'original',...base,manifest:original,replay,reproduced:reproduces(replay[0],cell)};
 }
 const recomputed=await deps.recompute({scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,level:run.level,code:q.code,periodEnd:q.periodEnd,factsAsOf:run.facts_as_of,knowledgeDate:run.knowledge_date,historyClass:run.history_class});
 const diff=manifestDiff(original,filterManifest(recomputed,q.metric,cell));
 return {state:'ok',mode:'recompute',...base,result:isEmptyDiff(diff)?'match':'changed',diff};
}

export type ValuationMetric=ValuationCellRow['metric'];
export interface ValuationReplayDeps{
 db:Pick<IndustryDb,'isDatasetPublic'|'publishedValuations'>;
 /** service role read of industry_valuation_pairs: the official value of a 'within' pair, else null */
 officialValue:(q:{runId:string;scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;tradeDate:string;metric:ValuationMetric})=>Promise<string|null>;
}
export type ValuationReplayResult=
 |{state:'unlicensed';datasetKey:DatasetKey}|{state:'unknown_cell'}
 |{state:'ok';kind:'valuation';cell:PublicValuation;manifestHash:string|null;replay:'deferred_i3';officialValue?:string};
/**
 * Valuation cells (spec §9): anon publishedValuations already applies industry_valuation_run_visible
 * and `published` (RLS), so a non-published or invisible cell is unknown_cell. officialValue is attached
 * only when the official dataset is public; the manifest replay of valuations is the deferred I-3 work.
 */
export async function valuationReplayView(deps:ValuationReplayDeps,q:{scheme:Scheme;version:SchemeVersion;code:string;runId:string;metric:ValuationMetric;tradeDate:string}):Promise<ValuationReplayResult>{
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(q.scheme,q.version);
 if(!await deps.db.isDatasetPublic(datasetKey))return {state:'unlicensed',datasetKey};
 const rows=(await deps.db.publishedValuations(q.runId,{codes:[q.code],from:q.tradeDate,to:q.tradeDate}))
  .filter(r=>r.scheme===q.scheme&&r.version===q.version&&r.code===q.code&&r.trade_date===q.tradeDate&&r.metric===q.metric&&r.published&&r.status==='ok'&&r.value!==null);
 if(rows.length!==1)return {state:'unknown_cell'};
 const out={state:'ok' as const,kind:'valuation' as const,cell:publicValuation(rows[0]),manifestHash:rows[0].manifest_hash,replay:'deferred_i3' as const};
 if(!await deps.db.isDatasetPublic(OFFICIAL_DATASET))return out;
 const officialValue=await deps.officialValue({runId:q.runId,scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,code:q.code,tradeDate:q.tradeDate,metric:q.metric});
 return officialValue===null?out:{...out,officialValue};
}

export interface AdminReplayDeps{db:Pick<IndustryDb,'metricRun'|'metricRowsOfRun'|'unresolvedOf'>;manifests:Pick<ManifestStore,'get'>}
export interface ReplayFocus{cell:PublicCell;manifestHash:string;manifest:AggregateManifest;replay:ManifestCell[];reproduced:boolean}
export type AdminReplayResult=
 |{state:'unknown_run'}|{state:'unknown_cell'}
 |{state:'ok';run:MetricRunRow;cells:(PublicCell&{reproduced:boolean|null})[];manifestHashes:string[];manifest:AggregateManifest|null;replay:ManifestCell[]|null;unresolved:ManifestUnresolved[];focus:ReplayFocus|null};
/** Admin replay (spec §9): any run status, the full manifest, every cell of the (code, period_end) group, the unresolved list. */
export async function adminReplayView(deps:AdminReplayDeps,q:{runId:string;code:string;periodEnd:string;metric:AggMetric|null;duration:AggDuration|null}):Promise<AdminReplayResult>{
 const run=await deps.db.metricRun(q.runId);
 if(!run)return {state:'unknown_run'};
 const rows=(await deps.db.metricRowsOfRun(q.runId,{codes:[q.code],periodEnds:[q.periodEnd]})).filter(r=>r.code===q.code&&r.period_end===q.periodEnd);
 if(rows.length===0)return {state:'unknown_cell'};
 const manifestHashes=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.manifest_hash).filter((h):h is string=>h!==null))].sort(cmp);
 const manifest=manifestHashes.length?await deps.manifests.get(manifestHashes[0]):null;   // one manifest per (code, period_end) group (spec §5.3)
 const replay=manifest?replayFromManifest(manifest).cells:null;
 const unresolved=await deps.db.unresolvedOf({code:q.code,level:run.level,on:q.periodEnd,knownBy:run.knowledge_date});
 const cells=rows.map(r=>({...publicCell(r),reproduced:r.status==='ok'&&replay?reproduces(replay.find(c=>sameCell(c,r.metric,r.duration,r.period_start)),r):null}));
 let focus:ReplayFocus|null=null;
 const pick=q.metric?rows.filter(r=>r.metric===q.metric&&(q.duration===null||r.duration===q.duration)):[];
 if(pick.length===1&&pick[0].status==='ok'&&pick[0].manifest_hash&&manifest&&replay){
  const c=pick[0];const rc=replay.filter(x=>sameCell(x,c.metric,c.duration,c.period_start));
  focus={cell:publicCell(c),manifestHash:c.manifest_hash!,manifest:filterManifest(manifest,c.metric,c),replay:rc,reproduced:reproduces(rc[0],c)};
 }
 return {state:'ok',run,cells,manifestHashes,manifest,replay,unresolved,focus};
}
```

要点（实现者核对用，不是额外代码）：`effectiveFreshness` 用 Task 1 加进 `freshness.ts` 的 `weekly`（7 天 + 2 天宽限）对存储状态重算，`error` 原样保留；`periodEndsFor` 的年度口径只取 `-12-31`；`YOY_COMPANION` 只取**存储的**同比指标，页面不做减法；`latestAnnual` 走 anon `readFacts`（只看得到 `ok` 行）；`filterManifest` 按规格 §9 只裁剪 `facts/derived/roles/cells`。

`src/lib/industry/route-params.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/route-params.ts
// Parameter parsing of the industry routes (spec §9) on top of the facts route conventions
// (readParams: a repeated parameter → 400 invalid_parameter:<name>; QueryError carries the name),
// plus the in-memory per-IP limiter of /replay (10 per minute; per server instance, best effort
// across instances as the spec allows). Pure: no clients, so pages reuse it for search params.
import {QueryError,UUID_RE,dateParam,listParam} from '../facts/public-route';
import {AGG_DURATIONS,AGG_METRICS,METRIC_DURATIONS,SCHEME_VERSION} from './read';
import type {ValuationMetric,Window} from './read';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric,Scheme,SchemeVersion} from './types';

export const CODE_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]{1,32}$/;
export const MAX_PERIODS=44;
export const MAX_PAGE_SIZE=200;
export const VALUATION_METRICS:readonly ValuationMetric[]=['pe_ttm','pe_static','pb','market_cap'];

export function schemeOf(raw:string):Scheme{if(raw==='sw2021'||raw==='sic')return raw;throw new QueryError('scheme');}
/** v1 has exactly one version per scheme; anything else is invalid. */
export function versionOf(p:Map<string,string>,scheme:Scheme):SchemeVersion{
 const v=p.get('version');
 if(v===undefined)return SCHEME_VERSION[scheme];
 if(v!==SCHEME_VERSION[scheme])throw new QueryError('version');
 return SCHEME_VERSION[scheme];
}
/** Path segment → industry code (percent-decoded, conservative charset). */
export function codeOf(raw:string):string{
 let s:string;
 try{s=decodeURIComponent(raw);}catch{throw new QueryError('code');}
 if(!CODE_RE.test(s))throw new QueryError('code');
 return s;
}
/** SW levels 1..3 (default 1); SIC is single-level and accepts only 1. */
export function levelOf(p:Map<string,string>,scheme:Scheme):number{
 const v=p.get('level');
 if(v===undefined)return 1;
 if(!/^[1-3]$/.test(v)||(scheme==='sic'&&v!=='1'))throw new QueryError('level');
 return Number(v);
}
export function metricOf(p:Map<string,string>,fallback:AggMetric|null='gross_margin'):AggMetric{
 const v=p.get('metric');
 if(v===undefined){if(fallback===null)throw new QueryError('metric');return fallback;}
 if(!(AGG_METRICS as readonly string[]).includes(v))throw new QueryError('metric');
 return v as AggMetric;
}
/** Default = the metric's first duration; a duration the metric is not computed for is invalid. */
export function durationOf(p:Map<string,string>,metric:AggMetric):AggDuration{
 const v=p.get('duration');
 if(v===undefined)return METRIC_DURATIONS[metric][0];
 if(!(METRIC_DURATIONS[metric] as readonly string[]).includes(v))throw new QueryError('duration');
 return v as AggDuration;
}
export function optionalDurationOf(p:Map<string,string>,metric:AggMetric):AggDuration|null{return p.has('duration')?durationOf(p,metric):null;}
export function metricsOf(p:Map<string,string>):AggMetric[]{return (listParam(p,'metrics',new Set(AGG_METRICS),AGG_METRICS.length) as AggMetric[]|undefined)??[...AGG_METRICS];}
export function durationsOf(p:Map<string,string>):AggDuration[]|null{return (listParam(p,'durations',new Set(AGG_DURATIONS),AGG_DURATIONS.length) as AggDuration[]|undefined)??null;}
export function windowOf(p:Map<string,string>):Window{
 const v=p.get('window');
 if(v===undefined)return '10y';
 if(v!=='5y'&&v!=='10y'&&v!=='all')throw new QueryError('window');
 return v;
}
export function modeOf(p:Map<string,string>):'original'|'recompute'{
 const v=p.get('mode');
 if(v===undefined)return 'original';
 if(v!=='original'&&v!=='recompute')throw new QueryError('mode');
 return v;
}
/** `on` defaults to today and may not be in the future (membership knowledge is as of today). */
export function onOf(p:Map<string,string>,today:string):string{
 const v=dateParam(p,'on');
 if(v===undefined)return today;
 if(v>today)throw new QueryError('on');
 return v;
}
export function uuidOf(p:Map<string,string>,name:string):string{
 const v=p.get(name);
 if(v===undefined||!UUID_RE.test(v))throw new QueryError(name);
 return v.toLowerCase();
}
export function valuationMetricOf(p:Map<string,string>):ValuationMetric{
 const v=p.get('metric');
 if(v===undefined||!(VALUATION_METRICS as readonly string[]).includes(v))throw new QueryError('metric');
 return v as ValuationMetric;
}

export interface RateLimiter{take(key:string,now?:number):boolean;reset():void}
/** Fixed window per key; at most `maxKeys` keys (expired windows are evicted first, then the oldest). */
export function createRateLimiter(limit:number,windowMs:number,maxKeys=10_000):RateLimiter{
 const hits=new Map<string,{count:number;resetAt:number}>();
 return {
  take(key,now=Date.now()){
   const h=hits.get(key);
   if(!h||h.resetAt<=now){
    if(hits.size>=maxKeys)for(const [k,v] of hits)if(v.resetAt<=now)hits.delete(k);
    if(hits.size>=maxKeys){const oldest=hits.keys().next().value;if(oldest!==undefined)hits.delete(oldest);}
    hits.set(key,{count:1,resetAt:now+windowMs});
    return true;
   }
   if(h.count>=limit)return false;
   h.count+=1;
   return true;
  },
  reset(){hits.clear();},
 };
}
/** Spec §9: /replay is limited to 10 requests per IP per minute. */
export const replayLimiter=createRateLimiter(10,60_000);
/** First X-Forwarded-For hop (Vercel sets it), else X-Real-IP, else one shared 'unknown' bucket. */
export function clientIp(req:Request):string{
 const first=req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim();
 if(first)return first;
 return req.headers.get('x-real-ip')?.trim()||'unknown';
}
```

无单测（全是客户端装配；路由测试整体替换它）；由 Step 16 的 typecheck 覆盖。`unstable_cache` 只包公开数据集的分类树（标签 `industries`，Task 16 的授权开关 `revalidateTag('industries')`）；`industry_valuation_pairs.official_value` 以 `::text` 读出，保持十进制字符串。

`src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts
// Production wiring of the industry read models (spec §8, §9). The anon IndustryDb (RLS licence gate)
// serves everything the public may see; the service role is used only for (a) counts of the
// non-public source records, (b) the private manifest bucket after the anon authorization chain,
// (c) the recompute path and (d) the official comparison value of a published 'within' pair. The
// classification tree of a PUBLIC dataset is cached under the 'industries' tag (spec §4.6/§4.8: the
// licence switch calls revalidateTag('industries')); reads of a non-public dataset are never cached.
// Ad-hoc reads (issuer cards, SIC member counts, pairs) use the client's from() directly: they are
// read-only, single-caller, and not part of the IndustryDb write contract.
import {unstable_cache} from 'next/cache';
import {supabaseFactsDb} from '../facts/db';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from './db';
import {schemeDatasetKey} from './licenses';
import {supabaseManifestStore} from './manifest';
import {buildCellManifest} from './run-aggregation';
import type {IssuerCard,ReadDb,ReadDeps,ReplayDeps,ValuationReplayDeps} from './read';
import type {IndustryDb} from './types';

interface PgResult<T>{data:T|null;error:{message?:string}|null}
interface Query<T> extends PromiseLike<PgResult<T>>{
 select(cols:string):Query<T>;eq(col:string,v:unknown):Query<T>;in(col:string,v:unknown[]):Query<T>;lte(col:string,v:unknown):Query<T>;
 or(filter:string):Query<T>;order(col:string):Query<T>;range(from:number,to:number):Query<T>;maybeSingle():PromiseLike<PgResult<T extends (infer U)[]?U:T>>;
}
type Loose={from<T=Record<string,unknown>[]>(table:string):Query<T>};
const loose=(sb:unknown)=>sb as Loose;

function cachedTree(db:IndustryDb):ReadDb['classificationTree']{
 return async(scheme,version)=>{
  if(!await db.isDatasetPublic(schemeDatasetKey(scheme,version)))return db.classificationTree(scheme,version);
  return unstable_cache(()=>db.classificationTree(scheme,version),['industry-tree',scheme,version],{tags:['industries'],revalidate:3600})();
 };
}
function readDb(db:IndustryDb,cacheTree:boolean):ReadDb{
 return {
  isDatasetPublic:k=>db.isDatasetPublic(k),
  classificationTree:cacheTree?cachedTree(db):(s,v)=>db.classificationTree(s,v),
  freshness:()=>db.freshness(),
  activeMetricRun:(s,v,l)=>db.activeMetricRun(s,v,l),
  metricRun:r=>db.metricRun(r),
  metricRowsOfRun:(r,f)=>db.metricRowsOfRun(r,f),
  metricRunVisible:r=>db.metricRunVisible(r),
  activeValuationRun:(s,v,l)=>db.activeValuationRun(s,v,l),
  publishedValuations:(r,f)=>db.publishedValuations(r,f),
  membershipCandidates:q=>db.membershipCandidates(q),
  membershipsOfIssuer:(i,q)=>db.membershipsOfIssuer(i,q),
 };
}

interface IssuerRec{issuer_id:string;canonical_name_zh:string|null;canonical_name_en:string|null}
interface SecurityRec{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;is_primary:boolean;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null}
/** Names and today's primary ticker (issuers / issuer_securities are anon-readable: 20261105091000_issuers.sql). */
export function issuerDirectory(sb:unknown):ReadDeps['issuers']{
 return async(ids,today)=>{
  const out=new Map<string,IssuerCard>();
  for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=100){
   const chunk=ids.slice(i,i+100);
   const [iss,secs]=await Promise.all([
    loose(sb).from<IssuerRec[]>('issuers').select('issuer_id,canonical_name_zh,canonical_name_en').in('issuer_id',chunk),
    loose(sb).from<SecurityRec[]>('issuer_securities').select('issuer_id,ticker,is_primary,valid_from,valid_to').in('issuer_id',chunk),
   ]);
   if(iss.error||secs.error)throw new Error('issuer_directory_failed');
   const current=(secs.data??[]).filter(s=>s.valid_from<=today&&(s.valid_to===null||s.valid_to>today));
   for(const r of iss.data??[]){
    const mine=current.filter(s=>s.issuer_id===r.issuer_id).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.is_primary)-Number(a.is_primary)||(a.ticker<b.ticker?-1:a.ticker>b.ticker?1:0));
    out.set(r.issuer_id,{issuerId:r.issuer_id,nameZh:r.canonical_name_zh,nameEn:r.canonical_name_en,ticker:mine[0]?.ticker??null});
   }
  }
  return out;
 };
}
/** SIC navigation counts: current ok memberships per code, paged until an empty page (PostgREST max_rows). */
export function memberCounter(sb:unknown):NonNullable<ReadDeps['memberCounts']>{
 return async(scheme,version,on)=>{
  const counts=new Map<string,number>();
  for(let from=0;;){
   const {data,error}=await loose(sb).from<{code:string}[]>('issuer_industry_memberships').select('code,membership_id').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).eq('status','ok')
    .lte('valid_from',on).or(`valid_to.is.null,valid_to.gt.${on}`).order('membership_id').range(from,from+999);
   if(error)throw new Error('member_count_failed');
   const page=data??[];
   if(page.length===0)return counts;
   for(const r of page)counts.set(r.code,(counts.get(r.code)??0)+1);
   from+=page.length;
  }
 };
}

/** Public pages and routes: anon reads; service role only for unresolved counts (lazy: no key needed until used). */
export function publicReadDeps(now:Date):ReadDeps{
 const anon=getAnonSupabase();
 return {db:readDb(supabaseIndustryDb(anon),true),unresolved:{unresolvedCount:q=>supabaseIndustryDb(getAdminSupabase()).unresolvedCount(q)},
  issuers:issuerDirectory(anon),facts:supabaseFactsDb(anon),memberCounts:memberCounter(anon),now,preview:false};
}
/** Admin internal preview only (the caller has passed requireAdminUser): service-role reads, licence gate skipped. */
export function adminReadDeps(now:Date):ReadDeps{
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();const db=supabaseIndustryDb(admin);
 return {db:readDb(db,false),unresolved:db,issuers:issuerDirectory(admin),facts:supabaseFactsDb(admin),memberCounts:memberCounter(admin),now,preview:true};
}
export function replayDeps(now:Date):ReplayDeps{
 return {
  db:supabaseIndustryDb(getAnonSupabase()),
  manifests:{get:h=>{const admin=getAdminSupabase();return supabaseManifestStore(admin,supabaseIndustryDb(admin)).get(h);}},
  recompute:q=>{const admin=getAdminSupabase();return buildCellManifest({db:supabaseIndustryDb(admin),facts:supabaseFactsDb(admin),codeVersion:process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA??null},q);},
  now,
 };
}
export function valuationReplayDeps():ValuationReplayDeps{
 return {
  db:supabaseIndustryDb(getAnonSupabase()),
  officialValue:async q=>{
   const {data,error}=await loose(getAdminSupabase()).from<{official_value:string|null;pair_status:string}[]>('industry_valuation_pairs').select('official_value::text,pair_status')
    .eq('run_id',q.runId).eq('scheme',q.scheme).eq('version',q.version).eq('code',q.code).eq('trade_date',q.tradeDate).eq('metric',q.metric).maybeSingle();
   if(error)throw new Error('official_value_failed');
   return data&&data.pair_status==='within'&&data.official_value!==null?data.official_value:null;   // ::text keeps the numeric exact (no JS number)
  },
 };
}
```

`src/app/api/industries/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/industries/route.ts
// GET /api/industries (spec §9): the active aggregate run's cells for one metric × duration over the
// last `periods` period ends (missing cells carry their reason), the stored YoY companion of a sum,
// the published valuation snapshot, and methodVersion / runId / factsAsOf / historyClass / freshness
// at the top level. SIC answers its navigation list (no aggregation, spec §1.2). A non-public scheme
// dataset is 403 unlicensed with no-store (spec §4.8, §11).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {errorResponse,intParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams,successHeaders} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {publicReadDeps} from '@/lib/industry/public-deps';
import {industryListView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {ListQuery} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {MAX_PERIODS,durationOf,levelOf,metricOf,schemeOf,versionOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['scheme','version','level','metric','duration','periods'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request){
 const now=new Date();
 let q:ListQuery;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  const scheme=schemeOf(p.get('scheme')??'sw2021');
  const metric=metricOf(p);
  q={scheme,version:versionOf(p,scheme),level:levelOf(p,scheme),metric,duration:durationOf(p,metric),periods:intParam(p,'periods',10,MAX_PERIODS)};
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const v=await industryListView(publicReadDeps(now),q);
  if(v.state==='unlicensed')return errorResponse('unlicensed',`dataset ${v.datasetKey} is not public`,403);
  const h=v.state==='ok'&&v.kind==='aggregate'?v.header:null;
  const body={methodVersion:h?.methodVersion??null,runId:h?.runId??null,factsAsOf:h?.factsAsOf??null,historyClass:h?.historyClass??null,scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,level:q.level,...v};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:successHeaders(now,undefined,v.state==='empty')});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[industries]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return errorResponse('internal','industries read failed',500);
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/industries/[scheme]/[code]/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/industries/[scheme]/[code]/route.ts
// GET /api/industries/[scheme]/[code] (spec §9): the node (ancestors, children), member summary
// (unresolved as a count only), the aggregate series of the active run inside `window`, published
// valuations with the run's reconciliation summary, the method block and the source list.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {errorResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,successHeaders} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {publicReadDeps} from '@/lib/industry/public-deps';
import {industryDetailView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {DetailQuery} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {codeOf,durationsOf,metricsOf,schemeOf,versionOf,windowOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['version','metrics','durations','window'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{scheme:string;code:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const raw=await params;
 let q:DetailQuery;
 try{
  const scheme=schemeOf(raw.scheme);
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  q={scheme,version:versionOf(p,scheme),code:codeOf(raw.code),metrics:metricsOf(p),durations:durationsOf(p),window:windowOf(p)};
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const v=await industryDetailView(publicReadDeps(now),q);
  if(v.state==='unlicensed')return errorResponse('unlicensed',`dataset ${v.datasetKey} is not public`,403);
  if(v.state==='unknown_industry')return errorResponse('unknown_industry','no such industry code',404);
  const reconciliationSummary=v.valuation.state==='not_enabled'?null:v.valuation.reconciliation;
  const body={methodVersion:v.method.methodVersion,runId:v.header?.runId??null,factsAsOf:v.header?.factsAsOf??null,historyClass:v.header?.historyClass??null,
   scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,window:q.window,reconciliationSummary,...v};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:successHeaders(now,undefined,false)});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[industries/detail]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return errorResponse('internal','industry read failed',500);
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/industries/[scheme]/[code]/constituents/route.ts
// GET …/constituents (spec §9): members on `on` known by today (spec §4.6), paged (pageSize ≤ 200),
// each with its membership evidence, L1>L2>L3 path, and the latest annual revenue / net income visible
// on `on`; unresolvedCount is a count only (source records are not public). SIC is current_only.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {errorResponse,intParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams,successHeaders,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {publicReadDeps} from '@/lib/industry/public-deps';
import {constituentsView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {ConstituentsQuery} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {MAX_PAGE_SIZE,codeOf,onOf,schemeOf,versionOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['version','on','page','pageSize'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{scheme:string;code:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const raw=await params;
 let q:ConstituentsQuery;
 try{
  const scheme=schemeOf(raw.scheme);
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  q={scheme,version:versionOf(p,scheme),code:codeOf(raw.code),on:onOf(p,today),page:intParam(p,'page',1,10_000),pageSize:intParam(p,'pageSize',50,MAX_PAGE_SIZE)};
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const v=await constituentsView(publicReadDeps(now),q);
  if(v.state==='unlicensed')return errorResponse('unlicensed',`dataset ${v.datasetKey} is not public`,403);
  if(v.state==='unknown_industry')return errorResponse('unknown_industry','no such industry code',404);
  return NextResponse.json({scheme:q.scheme,version:q.version,...v},{headers:successHeaders(now,q.on,v.rows.length===0)});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[industries/constituents]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return errorResponse('internal','constituents read failed',500);
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/industries/[scheme]/[code]/replay/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/industries/[scheme]/[code]/replay/route.ts
// GET …/replay (spec §5.5, §9). Rate limit first (10 per IP per minute, in-memory, best effort), then
// the authorization order dataset public → run visible → cell exists and is ok/published (else 404
// unknown_run / unknown_cell), then the private manifest. Aggregate cells: mode=original returns the
// per-cell filtered manifest, replayFromManifest's cell and `reproduced`; mode=recompute returns
// match|changed with the diff against current evidence. Valuation cells (tradeDate): the published row
// and, only when the official dataset is public, officialValue (deferred I-3: no valuation replay yet).
// Success: Cache-Control public, max-age=3600.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {QueryError,dateParam,errorResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {replayDeps,valuationReplayDeps} from '@/lib/industry/public-deps';
import {SCHEME_VERSION,replayView,valuationReplayView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {clientIp,codeOf,metricOf,modeOf,optionalDurationOf,replayLimiter,schemeOf,uuidOf,valuationMetricOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric,Scheme} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import type {ValuationMetric} from '@/lib/industry/read';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['runId','metric','duration','periodEnd','tradeDate','mode'] as const;
const CACHE={'Cache-Control':'public, max-age=3600'};
type Parsed={scheme:Scheme;code:string;runId:string;mode:'original'|'recompute'}&({kind:'aggregate';metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration|null;periodEnd:string}|{kind:'valuation';metric:ValuationMetric;tradeDate:string});

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{scheme:string;code:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 if(!replayLimiter.take(clientIp(req),now.getTime()))return errorResponse('rate_limited','at most 10 replay requests per minute',429);
 const raw=await params;
 let q:Parsed;
 try{
  const scheme=schemeOf(raw.scheme),code=codeOf(raw.code);
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  const runId=uuidOf(p,'runId'),mode=modeOf(p);
  const periodEnd=dateParam(p,'periodEnd'),tradeDate=dateParam(p,'tradeDate');
  if((periodEnd===undefined)===(tradeDate===undefined))throw new QueryError(periodEnd===undefined?'periodEnd':'tradeDate');
  if(tradeDate!==undefined){
   if(mode!=='original'||p.has('duration'))throw new QueryError(mode!=='original'?'mode':'duration');
   q={scheme,code,runId,mode,kind:'valuation',metric:valuationMetricOf(p),tradeDate};
  }else{
   const metric=metricOf(p,null);
   q={scheme,code,runId,mode,kind:'aggregate',metric,duration:optionalDurationOf(p,metric),periodEnd:periodEnd!};
  }
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const version=SCHEME_VERSION[q.scheme];
  if(q.kind==='valuation'){
   const v=await valuationReplayView(valuationReplayDeps(),{scheme:q.scheme,version,code:q.code,runId:q.runId,metric:q.metric,tradeDate:q.tradeDate});
   if(v.state==='unlicensed')return errorResponse('unlicensed',`dataset ${v.datasetKey} is not public`,403);
   if(v.state==='unknown_cell')return errorResponse('unknown_cell','no published valuation cell',404);
   return NextResponse.json({runId:q.runId,...v},{headers:CACHE});
  }
  const v=await replayView(replayDeps(now),{scheme:q.scheme,version,code:q.code,runId:q.runId,metric:q.metric,duration:q.duration,periodEnd:q.periodEnd,mode:q.mode});
  if(v.state==='unlicensed')return errorResponse('unlicensed',`dataset ${v.datasetKey} is not public`,403);
  if(v.state==='unknown_run')return errorResponse('unknown_run','no visible run',404);
  if(v.state==='unknown_cell')return errorResponse('unknown_cell','no replayable cell',404);
  if(v.state==='ambiguous_duration')return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:duration','several durations match; pass duration',400);
  return NextResponse.json({methodVersion:v.header.methodVersion,runId:v.header.runId,factsAsOf:v.header.factsAsOf,historyClass:v.header.historyClass,...v},{headers:CACHE});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[industries/replay]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return errorResponse('internal','replay failed',500);
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/entities/[issuerId]/industries/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/entities/[issuerId]/industries/route.ts
// GET /api/entities/[issuerId]/industries (spec §7.3, §9): the issuer's industries on `on`, public
// schemes only (the anon RLS gate hides the rest), plus which schemes are public so the stock page can
// say "licence pending" instead of guessing. Unknown issuer → 404 unknown_issuer.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,successHeaders,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {publicReadDeps} from '@/lib/industry/public-deps';
import {issuerIndustriesView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {onOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{issuerId:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const {issuerId}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(issuerId))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:issuerId','issuerId must be a uuid',400);
 let on:string;
 try{on=onOf(readParams(new URL(req.url),['on']),today);}
 catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const v=await issuerIndustriesView(publicReadDeps(now),{issuerId:issuerId.toLowerCase(),on});
  if(v.state==='unknown_issuer')return errorResponse('unknown_issuer','no such issuer',404);
  return NextResponse.json(v,{headers:successHeaders(now,on,v.industries.length===0)});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[entities/industries]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return errorResponse('internal','industries read failed',500);
 }
}
```

```ts
 });
```

`src/lib/industry/jobs.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/jobs.ts
// Job dispatch shared by /api/cron/industry-sync and scripts/industry/sync.ts (spec §9, §10), the
// production IndustryDeps, the activation gates of each job, argument parsing of the sync script, and
// the weekly replay sample of scripts/industry/replay-check.ts (spec §1.1 success criteria: 50 cells).
// `official` and `valuation` are the deferred I-3 pipeline (plan header: verification items 1/2 are
// open) and answer {skipped:'deferred_i3'} without touching anything. Gates (spec §4.10 V4, owner
// defaults A/E): Tushare jobs need TUSHARE_TOKEN; facts-scope needs FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE=1;
// aggregate needs FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1 (no CN facts feed → no aggregation in production).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus} from '../dq/batches';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {supabaseFactsDb} from '../facts/db';
import {reconcileScope} from '../facts/scope';
import type {FactsDb} from '../facts/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {runClassificationsSw} from './classifications';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from './db';
import {industryCnUniverse} from './facts-scope';
import {runLoadAShare} from './load-a-share';
import {supabaseManifestStore} from './manifest';
import {runMarks} from './marks';
import type {DailyBasicFetch} from './marks';
import {defaultTushareCall,fetchDailyBasic} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import type {TushareCall} from './providers/tushare-industry';
import {replayFromManifest} from './replay';
import {reproduces} from './read';
import {runResolveMemberships} from './resolve-memberships';
import {runIndustryAggregation} from './run-aggregation';
import {runClassificationsSic,runMembershipsSic} from './sic';
import {runMembershipsSw} from './source-memberships';
import type {IndustryDb,IndustryDeps,ManifestStore,MetricCellRow,Scheme,SchemeVersion} from './types';

export const INDUSTRY_JOBS=['load-a-share','facts-scope','memberships-sw','memberships-sic','marks','official','aggregate','valuation'] as const;
export type IndustryJob=typeof INDUSTRY_JOBS[number];
export const DEFERRED_JOBS:ReadonlySet<IndustryJob>=new Set<IndustryJob>(['official','valuation']);
export const TUSHARE_JOBS:ReadonlySet<IndustryJob>=new Set<IndustryJob>(['load-a-share','memberships-sw','marks']);
export const isIndustryJob=(s:string):s is IndustryJob=>(INDUSTRY_JOBS as readonly string[]).includes(s);

/** What every job answers. The runners of Tasks 5–13 keep their own receipts; runIndustryJob maps them here. */
export interface RunnerReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:'success'|'partial'|'failed'|'dry_run';counts:Record<string,number>;errors:{code:string;key?:string;message?:string}[]}
export interface IndustryJobOptions{dryRun:boolean;triggeredBy:'cron'|'script';limit?:number;factsAsOf?:string;tradeDates?:string[];l1Codes?:string[];today?:string}
export type IndustryJobResult={job:IndustryJob;skipped:'deferred_i3'}|{job:IndustryJob;receipt:RunnerReceipt};
/** IndustryDeps plus the full plan-2 FactsDb surface facts-scope needs (reconcileScope; IndustryDeps.facts is read-only). */
export interface IndustryJobDeps extends IndustryDeps{scopeDb:Pick<FactsDb,'reconcileScope'|'scopeAll'>}

const utcToday=(d:Date)=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const ORDER:RunnerReceipt['status'][]=['dry_run','success','partial','failed'];
const receiptStatus=(s:BatchStatus|'dry_run'|null):RunnerReceipt['status']=>s==='dry_run'?'dry_run':s==='success'?'success':s==='partial'?'partial':'failed';
const prefixed=(m:Record<string,number>,prefix:string):Record<string,number>=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m).map(([k,v])=>[prefix+k,v]));
const countsOf=(c:BatchCounts):Record<string,number>=>({...c});
/** Receipt of a runner that owns one batch (Tasks 5, 7, 8, 9). */
const batchReceipt=(r:{status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';batchId:string|null;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[]}):RunnerReceipt=>({batchId:r.batchId,status:receiptStatus(r.status),counts:countsOf(r.counts),errors:r.errors});
/** Jobs without a dry-run mode (their runners always write): a dry run reports this instead of running. */
const dryRunUnsupported=(job:IndustryJob):RunnerReceipt=>({batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts:{},errors:[{code:'dry_run_unsupported',key:job,message:`${job} has no dry run; pass --apply`}]});
/** Multi-step jobs (skeleton 跨任务接口约定 B3: each step owns its batch): the worst status wins; counts and error keys are prefixed by step. */
export function combineReceipts(steps:{name:string;receipt:RunnerReceipt}[]):RunnerReceipt{
 return {
  batchId:steps.length?steps[steps.length-1].receipt.batchId:null,
  status:steps.reduce<RunnerReceipt['status']>((a,x)=>ORDER.indexOf(x.receipt.status)>ORDER.indexOf(a)?x.receipt.status:a,'dry_run'),
  counts:Object.assign({},...steps.map(x=>prefixed(x.receipt.counts,`${x.name}.`))),
  errors:steps.flatMap(x=>x.receipt.errors.map(e=>({...e,key:e.key===undefined?x.name:`${x.name}:${e.key}`}))),
 };
}
const stepFailed=(r:RunnerReceipt)=>r.status==='failed';

/** Task 5's daily_basic adapter (YYYYMMDD → TusharePage[]) as Task 13's injected MarksDeps.fetchDailyBasic (spec §6.1 evidence: page sha256 + row index). */
export function marksFetcher(call:TushareCall):(tradeDate:string)=>Promise<DailyBasicFetch>{
 return async tradeDate=>{
  const pages=await fetchDailyBasic(call,{tradeDate:tradeDate.replaceAll('-','')});
  return {trade_date:tradeDate,pages:pages.length,
   rows:pages.flatMap(p=>p.rows.map((r,row)=>({ts_code:r.ts_code,trade_date:r.trade_date,close:r.close,total_share:r.total_share,free_share:r.free_share,total_mv:r.total_mv,page:p.page,row,page_sha256:p.raw_hash})))};
 };
}

export async function runIndustryJob(job:IndustryJob,deps:IndustryJobDeps,opts:IndustryJobOptions):Promise<IndustryJobResult>{
 if(DEFERRED_JOBS.has(job))return {job,skipped:'deferred_i3'};
 const triggeredBy=opts.triggeredBy;
 switch(job){
  case 'load-a-share':{
   // --limit caps the cninfo org-id lookups of one run (Task 5 maxLookups)
   const r=await runLoadAShare(deps,{apply:!opts.dryRun,triggeredBy,today:opts.today,maxLookups:opts.limit});
   return {job,receipt:{batchId:r.batchId,status:receiptStatus(r.status),counts:r.apply?countsOf(r.apply.counts):{candidates:r.plan.candidates,...prefixed(r.plan.skipped,'skipped.'),...prefixed(r.plan.rejected,'rejected.')},errors:r.apply?.errors??[]}};
  }
  case 'facts-scope':{
   // spec §4.10: not a separate upsert job — the industry universe is merged into desiredCn (Task 6 INDUSTRY block)
   const today=opts.today??utcToday(deps.now());
   if(opts.dryRun){
    const skipped:Record<string,number>={};
    const rows=await industryCnUniverse(deps.tables,today,skipped);
    return {job,receipt:{batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts:{industry_universe:rows.length,...prefixed(skipped,'skipped.')},errors:[]}};
   }
   const r=await reconcileScope({tables:deps.tables,db:deps.scopeDb},'CN',{today});
   return {job,receipt:{batchId:null,status:'success',counts:{desired:r.desired,retired:r.retired,changed:r.changed,...prefixed(r.skipped,'skipped.')},errors:[]}};
  }
  case 'memberships-sw':{
   // B3 composition: classifications → source records → resolution (each its own batch, weekly freshness)
   if(opts.dryRun)return {job,receipt:batchReceipt(await runMembershipsSw(deps,{apply:false,l1Codes:opts.l1Codes,triggeredBy}))};
   const steps:{name:string;receipt:RunnerReceipt}[]=[{name:'classifications',receipt:batchReceipt(await runClassificationsSw(deps,{triggeredBy}))}];
   if(!stepFailed(steps[0].receipt)){
    steps.push({name:'source',receipt:batchReceipt(await runMembershipsSw(deps,{apply:true,l1Codes:opts.l1Codes,triggeredBy}))});
    steps.push({name:'memberships',receipt:batchReceipt(await runResolveMemberships(deps,{triggeredBy,today:opts.today}))});
   }
   return {job,receipt:combineReceipts(steps)};
  }
  case 'memberships-sic':{
   if(opts.dryRun)return {job,receipt:dryRunUnsupported(job)};
   const steps:{name:string;receipt:RunnerReceipt}[]=[{name:'classifications',receipt:batchReceipt(await runClassificationsSic(deps,{triggeredBy}))}];
   if(!stepFailed(steps[0].receipt)){
    const m=await runMembershipsSic(deps,{limit:opts.limit,triggeredBy});
    steps.push({name:'memberships',receipt:{...batchReceipt(m),counts:{...countsOf(m.counts),processed:m.processed,added:m.added}}});
   }
   return {job,receipt:combineReceipts(steps)};
  }
  case 'marks':{
   if(opts.dryRun)return {job,receipt:dryRunUnsupported(job)};
   if(!opts.tradeDates?.length)return {job,receipt:{batchId:null,status:'failed',counts:{},errors:[{code:'trade_dates_required',message:'pass --trade-date (trade_cal is deferred with I-3)'}]}};
   const r=await runMarks({tables:deps.tables,db:deps.db,now:deps.now,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,fetchDailyBasic:marksFetcher(deps.tushare??defaultTushareCall({fetch:deps.fetch}))},{tradeDates:opts.tradeDates,triggeredBy});
   if(r.status==='rejected')return {job,receipt:{batchId:null,status:'failed',counts:{},errors:[{code:r.code??'rejected'}]}};
   return {job,receipt:{batchId:r.batchId,status:receiptStatus(r.batchStatus),counts:countsOf(r.counts),errors:r.errors}};
  }
  case 'aggregate':{
   if(opts.dryRun)return {job,receipt:dryRunUnsupported(job)};
   const r=await runIndustryAggregation(deps,{scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',level:1,factsAsOf:opts.factsAsOf??utcToday(deps.now()),triggeredBy});
   return {job,receipt:{batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status==='active'?receiptStatus(r.batchStatus):'failed',
    counts:{groups:r.groups,reused_groups:r.reusedGroups,cells_ok:r.cells.ok,cells_missing:r.cells.missing,manifest_mismatches:r.manifestMismatches,read_truncated:r.truncatedIssuers.length},
    errors:r.code?[{code:r.code,...(r.runId?{key:r.runId}:{})}]:[]}};
  }
 }
 throw new Error(`unknown_job:${job}`);
}

/** Why a job may not run now, or null. Deferred jobs are not gated: they answer skipped. */
export function jobGate(job:IndustryJob,env:Record<string,string|undefined>,opts:{apply:boolean}):{code:'tushare_unavailable'|'job_disabled';message:string}|null{
 if(DEFERRED_JOBS.has(job))return null;
 if(TUSHARE_JOBS.has(job)&&!env.TUSHARE_TOKEN)return {code:'tushare_unavailable',message:'TUSHARE_TOKEN not configured'};
 if(!opts.apply)return null;   // dry runs write nothing
 if(job==='facts-scope'&&env.FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE!=='1')return {code:'job_disabled',message:'FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE is not 1 (owner decision E)'};
 if(job==='aggregate'&&env.FACTS_CN_ENABLED!=='1')return {code:'job_disabled',message:'FACTS_CN_ENABLED is not 1 (spec §4.10 V4: no CN facts feed yet)'};
 return null;
}

export interface ProductionIndustryDepsOptions{codeVersion:string|null;now?:()=>Date;/** reuse an existing admin client (scripts hold one) */admin?:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>}
/** Service-role wiring. `tushare` stays unset: the adapters fall back to defaultTushareCall (Task 5, tushareCallRaw). */
export function productionIndustryDeps(opts:ProductionIndustryDepsOptions):IndustryJobDeps{
 const sb=opts.admin??getAdminSupabase();
 const db=supabaseIndustryDb(sb);const facts=supabaseFactsDb(sb);
 return {tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),db,facts,scopeDb:facts,manifests:supabaseManifestStore(sb,db),now:opts.now??(()=>new Date()),codeVersion:opts.codeVersion,fetch:globalThis.fetch};
}

export interface SyncArgs{job:IndustryJob;apply:boolean;limit?:number;factsAsOf?:string;tradeDates:string[];l1Codes:string[];recomputeFrom?:string}
export const SYNC_USAGE='usage: sync.ts --job <load-a-share|facts-scope|memberships-sw|memberships-sic|marks|official|aggregate|valuation> [--apply] [--limit n] [--facts-as-of YYYY-MM-DD] [--trade-date YYYY-MM-DD]... [--l1 <code>]... [--recompute-from YYYY-MM-DD]';
const DATE_RE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const VALUE_FLAGS=new Set(['--job','--limit','--facts-as-of','--trade-date','--l1','--recompute-from']);
/** Pure argv parser of scripts/industry/sync.ts; errors carry the message printed before exit 2. */
export function parseSyncArgs(argv:string[]):{ok:true;args:SyncArgs}|{ok:false;error:string}{
 let job:string|undefined;const a:Omit<SyncArgs,'job'>={apply:false,tradeDates:[],l1Codes:[]};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--apply'){a.apply=true;continue;}
  if(!VALUE_FLAGS.has(x))return {ok:false,error:`unknown argument ${x}\n${SYNC_USAGE}`};
  const val=argv[i+1];
  if(val===undefined||val.startsWith('--'))return {ok:false,error:`${x} needs a value\n${SYNC_USAGE}`};
  i++;
  if(x==='--job')job=val;
  else if(x==='--limit'){const n=Number(val);if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>5000)return {ok:false,error:'--limit must be 1..5000'};a.limit=n;}
  else if(x==='--facts-as-of'){if(!DATE_RE.test(val))return {ok:false,error:'--facts-as-of must be YYYY-MM-DD'};a.factsAsOf=val;}
  else if(x==='--trade-date'){if(!DATE_RE.test(val))return {ok:false,error:'--trade-date must be YYYY-MM-DD'};a.tradeDates.push(val);}
  else if(x==='--l1'){if(!/^[0-9]{6}\.SI$/.test(val))return {ok:false,error:'--l1 must look like 801120.SI'};a.l1Codes.push(val);}
  else{if(!DATE_RE.test(val))return {ok:false,error:'--recompute-from must be YYYY-MM-DD'};a.recomputeFrom=val;}
 }
 if(job===undefined||!isIndustryJob(job))return {ok:false,error:SYNC_USAGE};
 if(a.recomputeFrom!==undefined&&job!=='valuation')return {ok:false,error:'--recompute-from belongs to the (deferred) valuation job'};
 return {ok:true,args:{job,...a}};
}

export interface ReplayCheckResult{runId:string;sampled:number;reproduced:number;mismatches:{code:string;metric:string;duration:string;periodEnd:string;manifestHash:string;reason:'value_differs'|'manifest_unreadable'}[]}
/** Deterministic sample: order ok cells by sha256(seed + cell key) and take n. */
export function sampleCells(cells:MetricCellRow[],n:number,seed:string):MetricCellRow[]{
 const key=(c:MetricCellRow)=>createHash('sha256').update(`${seed}|${c.code}|${c.metric}|${c.duration}|${c.period_start}|${c.period_end}`).digest('hex');
 return cells.filter(c=>c.status==='ok'&&c.manifest_hash!==null).map(c=>({c,k:key(c)})).sort((a,b)=>a.k<b.k?-1:a.k>b.k?1:0).slice(0,n).map(x=>x.c);
}
/** Spec §1.1: sample ok cells of a run, replay each manifest offline, compare with the stored value. */
export async function replayCheck(deps:{db:Pick<IndustryDb,'activeMetricRun'|'metricRowsOfRun'|'metricRun'>;manifests:Pick<ManifestStore,'get'>},opts:{runId?:string;sample:number;seed:string;scheme?:Scheme;version?:SchemeVersion}):Promise<ReplayCheckResult|{error:'unknown_run'|'no_active_run'}>{
 const run=opts.runId?await deps.db.metricRun(opts.runId):await deps.db.activeMetricRun(opts.scheme??'sw2021',opts.version??'2021',1);
 if(!run)return {error:opts.runId?'unknown_run':'no_active_run'};
 const picked=sampleCells(await deps.db.metricRowsOfRun(run.run_id),opts.sample,opts.seed);
 const out:ReplayCheckResult={runId:run.run_id,sampled:picked.length,reproduced:0,mismatches:[]};
 for(const c of picked){
  const miss=(reason:'value_differs'|'manifest_unreadable')=>out.mismatches.push({code:c.code,metric:c.metric,duration:c.duration,periodEnd:c.period_end,manifestHash:c.manifest_hash!,reason});
  let cells;
  try{cells=replayFromManifest(await deps.manifests.get(c.manifest_hash!)).cells;}catch{miss('manifest_unreadable');continue;}
  if(reproduces(cells.find(x=>x.metric===c.metric&&x.duration===c.duration&&x.period_start===c.period_start),c))out.reproduced+=1;else miss('value_differs');
 }
 return out;
}
```

```ts
import {afterEach,beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';

 return {...real,runIndustryJob:mocks.run,productionIndustryDeps:mocks.deps};

const ENV=['CRON_SECRET','TUSHARE_TOKEN','FACTS_CN_ENABLED','FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE'] as const;

describe('industry sync cron',()=>{

  process.env.CRON_SECRET='cron-secret';

  expect((await GET(req('job=memberships-sic'))).status).toBe(401);

 it('validates job and limit',async()=>{

   expect((await GET(req(qs,AUTH))).status,qs).toBe(400);
```
