- [ ] **Step 6: 实现 cron 路由**

`src/app/api/cron/industry-sync/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/industry-sync/route.ts
// Industry job trigger (spec §9, §10): CRON_SECRET bearer (same constant-time check as facts-sync),
// job=<one of INDUSTRY_JOBS> exactly once, optional limit 1..500. official/valuation answer 200
// {skipped:'deferred_i3'}. Gates (jobs.ts::jobGate): Tushare jobs without TUSHARE_TOKEN → 503
// tushare_unavailable; facts-scope / aggregate without their CN flags → 403 job_disabled (owner
// default E: they are not in vercel.json either). A missing code_version refuses the run. The HTTP
// receipt carries codes and counts only (no error messages). Only memberships-sic is scheduled
// (vercel.json, Sunday 02:00 UTC); everything else is a script until the owner enables it.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {DEFERRED_JOBS,isIndustryJob,jobGate,productionIndustryDeps,runIndustryJob} from '@/lib/industry/jobs';
import type {RunnerReceipt} from '@/lib/industry/jobs';
import {IndustryDbError} from '@/lib/industry/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const MAX_LIMIT=500;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
const publicReceipt=(r:RunnerReceipt)=>({batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key})});

function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 if(url.searchParams.getAll('job').length!==1)return err('invalid_parameter:job','job required once',400);
 const job=url.searchParams.get('job')!;
 if(!isIndustryJob(job))return err('invalid_parameter:job','unknown job',400);
 if(url.searchParams.getAll('limit').length>1)return err('invalid_parameter:limit','limit may be given once',400);
 const limitRaw=url.searchParams.get('limit');
 let limit:number|undefined;
 if(limitRaw!==null){if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(limitRaw)||Number(limitRaw)<1||Number(limitRaw)>MAX_LIMIT)return err('invalid_parameter:limit',`limit must be 1..${MAX_LIMIT}`,400);limit=Number(limitRaw);}
 const started=new Date();
 if(DEFERRED_JOBS.has(job))return NextResponse.json({ok:true,job,skipped:'deferred_i3',started_at:started.toISOString()},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 const gate=jobGate(job,process.env,{apply:true});
 if(gate)return err(gate.code,gate.message,gate.code==='tushare_unavailable'?503:403);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 try{
  const result=await runIndustryJob(job,productionIndustryDeps({codeVersion}),{dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'cron',limit});
  if('skipped' in result)return NextResponse.json({ok:true,job,skipped:result.skipped,started_at:started.toISOString()},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:result.receipt.status==='success',job,limit:limit??null,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(result.receipt)},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof IndustryDbError?e.code:'sync_failed','Industry sync failed',500);   // code only: no message leaves the server
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

`src/app/api/admin/industries/licenses/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/industries/licenses/route.ts
// POST /api/admin/industries/licenses {dataset_key, status, note} (spec §4.8, §9): the only licence
// switch. requireAdminUser(); JSON only; a browser-sent Origin must be ours (same defence as
// /api/admin/dq). The write goes through set_industry_dataset_license (IndustryDb.setDatasetLicense;
// service_role has no direct DML on industry_dataset_licenses), then research_audit_log, then
// revalidateTag('industries') so cached classification trees follow the switch (runbook: switch to
// internal FIRST, then revalidate; CDN residue ≤ one UTC day is accepted by spec §4.8). The licence is
// already committed when the audit runs, so an audit failure is logged instead of answering 500.
import {revalidateTag} from 'next/cache';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from '@/lib/industry/db';
import {DATASET_KEYS,isLicensedStatus} from '@/lib/industry/licenses';
import type {DatasetKey} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import {audit,type ResearchSupabase} from '@/lib/research/store';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};
const MAX_NOTE=500;

export async function POST(request:Request){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  if(!(request.headers.get('content-type')??'').toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json'))return NextResponse.json({error:'unsupported_media_type'},{status:415,headers:NO_STORE});
  const origin=request.headers.get('origin');
  if(origin!==null&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)return NextResponse.json({error:'forbidden_origin'},{status:403,headers:NO_STORE});
  const body:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const b=(body??{}) as {dataset_key?:unknown;status?:unknown;note?:unknown};
  if(typeof b.dataset_key!=='string'||!(DATASET_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(b.dataset_key))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_dataset_key'},{status:400,headers:NO_STORE});
  if(typeof b.status!=='string'||!isLicensedStatus(b.status))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_status'},{status:400,headers:NO_STORE});
  if(b.note!==undefined&&b.note!==null&&(typeof b.note!=='string'||b.note.length>MAX_NOTE))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_note'},{status:400,headers:NO_STORE});
  const key=b.dataset_key as DatasetKey,status=b.status,note=typeof b.note==='string'?b.note:null;
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  await supabaseIndustryDb(admin).setDatasetLicense(key,status,user.id,note);
  try{
   await audit({supabase:admin as unknown as ResearchSupabase,userId:user.id},'industry.license_set',key,{dataset_key:key,status,note});
  }catch(auditError){
   console.error('[admin/industries] audit failed',auditError instanceof Error?auditError.message:auditError);
  }
  revalidateTag('industries');
  return NextResponse.json({dataset_key:key,status},{headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(error){
  if(error instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return NextResponse.json({error:'authentication required'},{status:401,headers:NO_STORE});
  if(error instanceof AdminForbidden)return NextResponse.json({error:'admin role required'},{status:403,headers:NO_STORE});
  console.error('[admin/industries/licenses]',error instanceof Error?error.message:error);
  return NextResponse.json({error:'licence update unavailable'},{status:500,headers:NO_STORE});
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/admin/industries/runs/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/industries/runs/route.ts
// GET /api/admin/industries/runs?scheme= (spec §9): every aggregate and valuation run of the scheme
// (any status, newest generation first, coverage/reconciliation summaries and failure reasons), the
// licence rows and industry freshness. requireAdminUser() + service role; no licence gate.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from '@/lib/industry/db';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};

export async function GET(request:Request){
 try{
  await requireAdminUser();
  const url=new URL(request.url);
  const all=url.searchParams.getAll('scheme');
  if(all.length!==1||(all[0]!=='sw2021'&&all[0]!=='sic'))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_parameter:scheme'},{status:400,headers:NO_STORE});
  const scheme=all[0];
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
  const page={orderBy:'generation',desc:true,limit:100};
  const [metricRuns,valuationRuns,licenses,freshness]=await Promise.all([
   tables.select('industry_metric_runs',{scheme},page),
   tables.select('industry_valuation_runs',{scheme},page),
   tables.select('industry_dataset_licenses',{},{orderBy:'dataset_key',limit:100}),
   supabaseIndustryDb(admin).freshness(),
  ]);
  return NextResponse.json({scheme,metricRuns,valuationRuns,licenses,freshness},{headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(error){
  if(error instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return NextResponse.json({error:'authentication required'},{status:401,headers:NO_STORE});
  if(error instanceof AdminForbidden)return NextResponse.json({error:'admin role required'},{status:403,headers:NO_STORE});
  console.error('[admin/industries/runs]',error instanceof Error?error.message:error);
  return NextResponse.json({error:'industry runs unavailable'},{status:500,headers:NO_STORE});
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/admin/industries/replay/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/industries/replay/route.ts
// GET /api/admin/industries/replay?runId=&code=&periodEnd=[&metric=&duration=] (spec §9): any run
// status (failed and building included), every cell of the (code, period_end) group with its
// `reproduced`, the full manifest, the replay, the unresolved source records, and — with metric — a
// `focus` shaped like the public original replay (the source drawer uses it in the admin preview).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {QueryError,dateParam,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from '@/lib/industry/db';
import {supabaseManifestStore} from '@/lib/industry/manifest';
import {adminReplayView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {codeOf,metricOf,optionalDurationOf,uuidOf} from '@/lib/industry/route-params';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};
const bad=(code:string)=>NextResponse.json({error:code},{status:400,headers:NO_STORE});

export async function GET(request:Request){
 try{
  await requireAdminUser();
  let q:{runId:string;code:string;periodEnd:string;metric:AggMetric|null;duration:AggDuration|null};
  try{
   const p=readParams(new URL(request.url),['runId','code','periodEnd','metric','duration']);
   const periodEnd=dateParam(p,'periodEnd');
   if(periodEnd===undefined)throw new QueryError('periodEnd');
   const code=p.get('code');
   if(code===undefined)throw new QueryError('code');
   const metric=p.has('metric')?metricOf(p,null):null;
   q={runId:uuidOf(p,'runId'),code:codeOf(code),periodEnd,metric,duration:metric?optionalDurationOf(p,metric):null};
  }catch(e){if(e instanceof QueryError)return bad(e.message);throw e;}
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const db=supabaseIndustryDb(admin);
  const v=await adminReplayView({db,manifests:supabaseManifestStore(admin,db)},q);
  if(v.state!=='ok')return NextResponse.json({error:v.state},{status:404,headers:NO_STORE});
  return NextResponse.json(v,{headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(error){
  if(error instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return NextResponse.json({error:'authentication required'},{status:401,headers:NO_STORE});
  if(error instanceof AdminForbidden)return NextResponse.json({error:'admin role required'},{status:403,headers:NO_STORE});
  console.error('[admin/industries/replay]',error instanceof Error?error.message:error);
  return NextResponse.json({error:'industry replay unavailable'},{status:500,headers:NO_STORE});
 }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Industry jobs from the command line (spec §10). Dry run by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file="$HOME/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env" --import tsx scripts/industry/sync.ts --job <job> [--apply]   (Tushare jobs; never print the token)
 *        [--limit n] [--facts-as-of YYYY-MM-DD] [--trade-date YYYY-MM-DD]... [--l1 <code>]... [--recompute-from YYYY-MM-DD]
 *
 * Jobs: load-a-share | facts-scope | memberships-sw | memberships-sic | marks | aggregate, plus the
 * deferred official | valuation (I-3: printed as skipped deferred_i3, exit 0). --recompute-from belongs
 * to valuation only. Gates (src/lib/industry/jobs.ts::jobGate): Tushare jobs need TUSHARE_TOKEN even
 * for a dry run; --apply of facts-scope needs FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE=1 and of aggregate needs
 * FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1 (spec §4.10 V4). --apply needs a code version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git
 * checkout). The weekly aggregate runs here (Mac Studio launchd, spec §5.4), never concurrently with
 * a cron run of the same job (spec §10); a late worker is stopped by activation's obsolete_run.
 * Exit 0 success (or dry run without failures), 1 failed/partial, 2 bad arguments or a refused gate.
 * tsx does NOT load env files: use node --env-file as above (Supabase keys from the usual env file, the token from
 * ~/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env — pass both --env-file flags; never commit or print either).
 */
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {DEFERRED_JOBS,jobGate,parseSyncArgs,productionIndustryDeps,runIndustryJob} from '../../src/lib/industry/jobs';

async function main(){
 const parsed=parseSyncArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 if(!parsed.ok){console.error(parsed.error);process.exit(2);}
 const args=parsed.args;
 if(DEFERRED_JOBS.has(args.job)){console.log(JSON.stringify({job:args.job,skipped:'deferred_i3',note:'verification items 1/2 open; see docs/runbooks/industry-research.md'},null,1));process.exit(0);}
 const gate=jobGate(args.job,process.env,{apply:args.apply});
 if(gate){console.error(`${gate.code}: ${gate.message}`);process.exit(2);}
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??(args.apply?null:'dry-run');
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');process.exit(2);}
 const result=await runIndustryJob(args.job,productionIndustryDeps({codeVersion}),{dryRun:!args.apply,triggeredBy:'script',limit:args.limit,factsAsOf:args.factsAsOf,tradeDates:args.tradeDates.length?args.tradeDates:undefined,l1Codes:args.l1Codes.length?args.l1Codes:undefined});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:args.apply?'apply':'dry-run (nothing written; pass --apply to write)',codeVersion,...result},null,1));
 if('skipped' in result)process.exit(0);
 const ok=args.apply?result.receipt.status==='success':result.receipt.status!=='failed';
 process.exit(ok?0:1);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`scripts/industry/replay-check.ts`：

```ts
/**
 * Weekly replay sample (spec §1.1 success criteria, §15): pick `--sample` ok cells of a run
 * deterministically (sha256 of --seed + cell key), read each content-addressed manifest from the
 * private bucket and recompute the cell with replayFromManifest only; compare with the stored value.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/industry/replay-check.ts [--run <run_id>] [--sample 50] [--seed <text>]
 *
 * Without --run the active sw2021 L1 run is checked; the default seed is the ISO week (YYYY-Www) so
 * each week samples a different set. Read-only. Exit 0 when every sampled cell reproduced, 1 on any
 * mismatch or unreadable manifest, 2 on bad arguments or no run.
 */
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from '../../src/lib/industry/db';
import {replayCheck} from '../../src/lib/industry/jobs';
import {supabaseManifestStore} from '../../src/lib/industry/manifest';

const USAGE='usage: replay-check.ts [--run <run_id>] [--sample n (1..500, default 50)] [--seed <text>]';
function isoWeek(d:Date):string{
 const t=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),d.getUTCMonth(),d.getUTCDate()));
 const day=t.getUTCDay()||7;t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate()+4-day);
 const y=t.getUTCFullYear(),w=Math.ceil(((t.getTime()-Date.UTC(y,0,1))/86_400_000+1)/7);
 return `${y}-W${String(w).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let runId:string|undefined,sample=50,seed=isoWeek(new Date());
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--')){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
  if(x==='--run'){if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(v)){console.error('--run must be a uuid');process.exit(2);}runId=v;}
  else if(x==='--sample'){sample=Number(v);if(!Number.isInteger(sample)||sample<1||sample>500){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}}
  else if(x==='--seed')seed=v;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
  i++;
 }
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const db=supabaseIndustryDb(admin);
 const r=await replayCheck({db,manifests:supabaseManifestStore(admin,db)},{runId,sample,seed});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({seed,...r},null,1));
 if('error' in r)process.exit(2);
 process.exit(r.mismatches.length===0?0:1);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`scripts/industry/record-fixture.ts`：

```ts
/**
 * Record provider fixtures of the industry module (spec §10). Tushare pages are written in the envelope the
 * Task 5 fixtureTushareCall serves — {"request":{api_name,params,fields},"response_sha256":…, <the response
 * object's own keys, byte-for-byte>} — so numeric literals are never re-serialized and the token (never a
 * request param) never reaches a file. SEC files are written as received, with a .meta.json sibling.
 *
 * Tushare (needs TUSHARE_TOKEN; exit 2 without it). Never print the token; run with the env file outside the repo:
 *   node --env-file="$HOME/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env" --import tsx scripts/industry/record-fixture.ts --sw-classify
 *        → src/lib/industry/fixtures/tushare/index_classify-SW2021-L<n>.json  (levels L1..L3; 31/134/346 on 2026-11-06)
 *   … --sw-members <l1_code>     → index_member_all-<l1>-<Y|N>-p<k>.json  (is_new Y and N, limit/offset 2000 rows/page)
 *   … --stock-basic <L|D|P>      → stock_basic-<status>-p<k>.json          (upstream returns only L unless asked, K-§17.1)
 *   … --sw-daily <index_code>    → sw_daily-<code>-p<k>.json               (deferred I-3 input; recording only)
 *   … --daily-basic <YYYYMMDD>   → daily_basic-<date>-p<k>.json            (6000 rows/page; free_share included, K1)
 *   … --trade-cal                → trade_cal-SSE-p<k>.json
 * SEC (no token; EDGAR_USER_AGENT or DEFAULT_USER_AGENT; ≤ 10 requests/s):
 *   npx tsx scripts/industry/record-fixture.ts --sec-submissions <cik>  → fixtures/sec/submissions-<cik10>.json
 *   npx tsx scripts/industry/record-fixture.ts --sic-codes              → fixtures/sec/sic-codes.html
 * Every file directly in fixtures/tushare is served by fixtureTushareCall (rows merged per api): record a new
 * whole-market page into a scratch directory first, and only move into fixtures/tushare what tests should see.
 * Exit 1 on an upstream error (Tushare code ≠ 0, HTTP ≠ 200), 2 on bad arguments or a missing token.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {tushareCallRaw} from '../../src/lib/data/sources/tushare';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/shared';

const ROOT=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../src/lib/industry/fixtures/',import.meta.url));
const USAGE='usage: record-fixture.ts --sw-classify | --sw-members <l1_code> | --stock-basic <L|D|P> | --sw-daily <index_code> | --daily-basic <YYYYMMDD> | --trade-cal | --sec-submissions <cik> | --sic-codes';
const SEC_SIC_CODES_URL='https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/standard-industrial-classification-sic-code-list';
function fail(msg:string):never{console.error(msg);process.exit(2);}
const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
function write(rel:string,bytes:Uint8Array,meta:Record<string,unknown>){
 const p=join(ROOT,rel);mkdirSync(join(p,'..'),{recursive:true});
 writeFileSync(p,bytes);writeFileSync(p.replace(/\.(json|html)$/,'.meta.json'),JSON.stringify({...meta,recorded_at:new Date().toISOString(),sha256:sha(bytes),bytes:bytes.byteLength},null,1)+'\n');
 console.log(`wrote ${p} (${bytes.byteLength} bytes)`);
}

/** Pages one Tushare API by offset until has_more is false; each page is its own file in the fixture envelope. */
async function tusharePages(api:string,params:Record<string,unknown>,fields:string,pageSize:number,name:(k:number)=>string){
 for(let k=0,offset=0;;k++,offset+=pageSize){
  const r=await tushareCallRaw(api,params,fields,{limit:pageSize,offset});
  if(r.code!==0){console.error(`${api} code ${r.code}`);process.exit(1);}   // never echo the upstream message (it may quote the request)
  const body=new TextDecoder().decode(r.bytes).trim();
  if(!body.startsWith('{'))fail(`${api}: response is not a JSON object`);
  const head=JSON.stringify({request:{api_name:api,params:{...params,limit:pageSize,offset},fields},response_sha256:sha(r.bytes)});
  const p=join(ROOT,'tushare',name(k));mkdirSync(join(p,'..'),{recursive:true});
  writeFileSync(p,`${head.slice(0,-1)},${body.slice(1)}\n`);
  console.log(`wrote ${p} (${r.items.length} rows, has_more ${r.hasMore})`);
  if(!r.hasMore||r.items.length===0)return;
 }
}
async function secGet(url:string):Promise<Uint8Array>{
 const res=await fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT,'Accept-Encoding':'gzip, deflate'}});
 if(res.status!==200){console.error(`GET ${url} → HTTP ${res.status}`);process.exit(1);}
 return new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
}

async function main(){
 const [mode,arg]=process.argv.slice(2);
 const needsToken=['--sw-classify','--sw-members','--stock-basic','--sw-daily','--daily-basic','--trade-cal'];
 if(mode===undefined)fail(USAGE);
 if(needsToken.includes(mode)&&!process.env.TUSHARE_TOKEN)fail('TUSHARE_TOKEN not set (pass --env-file with a file outside the repo)');
 switch(mode){
  case '--sw-classify':
   for(const level of ['L1','L2','L3'])await tusharePages('index_classify',{level,src:'SW2021'},'index_code,industry_name,parent_code,level,industry_code,is_pub,src',5000,k=>`index_classify-SW2021-${level}${k?`-p${k}`:''}.json`);
   return;
  case '--sw-members':
   if(!arg||!/^\d{6}\.SI$/.test(arg))fail(USAGE);
   for(const isNew of ['Y','N'])await tusharePages('index_member_all',{l1_code:arg,is_new:isNew},'l1_code,l1_name,l2_code,l2_name,l3_code,l3_name,ts_code,name,in_date,out_date,is_new',2000,k=>`index_member_all-${arg}-${isNew}-p${k}.json`);
   return;
  case '--stock-basic':
   if(!arg||!['L','D','P'].includes(arg))fail(USAGE);
   await tusharePages('stock_basic',{list_status:arg},'ts_code,symbol,name,fullname,exchange,list_status,list_date,delist_date',5000,k=>`stock_basic-${arg}-p${k}.json`);
   return;
  case '--sw-daily':
   if(!arg||!/^\d{6}\.SI$/.test(arg))fail(USAGE);
   await tusharePages('sw_daily',{ts_code:arg},'ts_code,trade_date,name,open,low,high,close,change,pct_change,vol,amount,pe,pb,float_mv,total_mv',4000,k=>`sw_daily-${arg}-p${k}.json`);
   return;
  case '--daily-basic':
   if(!arg||!/^\d{8}$/.test(arg))fail(USAGE);
   await tusharePages('daily_basic',{trade_date:arg},'ts_code,trade_date,close,total_share,free_share,total_mv',6000,k=>`daily_basic-${arg}-p${k}.json`);
   return;
  case '--trade-cal':
   await tusharePages('trade_cal',{exchange:'SSE'},'exchange,cal_date,is_open,pretrade_date',10000,k=>`trade_cal-SSE-p${k}.json`);
   return;
  case '--sec-submissions':{
   if(!arg||!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(arg))fail(USAGE);
   const cik10=arg.padStart(10,'0');const url=`https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK${cik10}.json`;
   write(`sec/submissions-${cik10}.json`,await secGet(url),{url});
   return;
  }
  case '--sic-codes':
   write('sec/sic-codes.html',await secGet(SEC_SIC_CODES_URL),{url:SEC_SIC_CODES_URL});
   return;
  default:fail(USAGE);
 }
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`src/i18n/messages-parity.test.ts`：在文件末尾（最后一个 `});` 之后）追加。它复用文件顶部已有的 `keys`、`placeholders`、`readFileSync`、`resolve`、`describe/it/expect`，因为该文件的 `Domain` 联合类型与四域列表是硬编码的，这里不改它们（其他会话也在改这个文件）：

```ts

// INDUSTRY:BEGIN
describe('industries translations', () => {
  const load = (locale: 'en' | 'zh') => JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'messages', locale, 'industries.json'), 'utf8'));
  const leaves = (value: unknown, prefix = ''): [string, string][] =>
    typeof value === 'string' ? [[prefix, value]] : Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([k, v]) => leaves(v, prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k));

  it('keeps Chinese and English keys in parity', () => {
    expect(keys(load('zh')).sort()).toEqual(keys(load('en')).sort());
  });

  it('keeps every interpolation parameter in parity and every value non-empty', () => {
    const zh = new Map(leaves(load('zh')));
    for (const [key, en] of leaves(load('en'))) {
      expect(en.trim(), key).not.toBe('');
      expect(zh.get(key)?.trim(), key).not.toBe('');
      expect(placeholders(zh.get(key) ?? ''), key).toEqual(placeholders(en));
    }
  });
});
// INDUSTRY:END
```

```ts
  const r=rows[0].cells;
  expect(r.find(c=>c.periodEnd==='2024-12-31')?.alpha).toBe(ALPHA_MIN);
```

`src/components/industries/hrefs.ts`：

```ts
// src/components/industries/hrefs.ts
// URL builders of the industry pages (search params carry every selector, spec §8.2) and the
// locale rule for node names: SW publishes no English names, so the English UI shows the Chinese name
// plus the code (canvas "Detail" note); SIC has English titles only.
import type {Locale} from '@/lib/industry/display';

export type Search=Record<string,string|undefined>;
export const INDUSTRIES_PATH='/intel/industries';
/** Same path with `patch` applied; undefined or '' removes a key; keys sorted for stable URLs. */
export function hrefWith(path:string,current:Search,patch:Search):string{
 const merged:Search={...current,...patch};
 const qs=Object.keys(merged).sort().filter(k=>merged[k]!==undefined&&merged[k]!=='').map(k=>`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(merged[k]!)}`).join('&');
 return qs?`${path}?${qs}`:path;
}
export const industryPath=(scheme:string,code:string)=>`${INDUSTRIES_PATH}/${scheme}/${encodeURIComponent(code)}`;
export const constituentsPath=(scheme:string,code:string)=>`${industryPath(scheme,code)}/constituents`;
export const stockPath=(ticker:string)=>`/stock/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`;
export function nodeName(n:{code:string;nameZh:string|null;nameEn:string|null},locale:Locale):string{
 return (locale==='en'?n.nameEn??n.nameZh:n.nameZh??n.nameEn)??n.code;
}
export function issuerLabel(i:{nameZh:string|null;nameEn:string|null;ticker:string|null;issuerId:string},locale:Locale):string{
 return (locale==='en'?i.nameEn??i.nameZh:i.nameZh??i.nameEn)??i.ticker??i.issuerId.slice(0,8);
}
/** Flatten Next's searchParams (repeated keys keep the first value: the routes reject repeats, pages tolerate them). */
export function flatSearch(sp:Record<string,string|string[]|undefined>):Search{
 const out:Search={};
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(sp))out[k]=Array.isArray(v)?v[0]:v;
 return out;
}
```

`src/components/industries/heatmap-model.ts`：

```ts
// src/components/industries/heatmap-model.ts
// Layout of the list heatmap (spec §8.2, canvas "Main"): rows = nodes, columns = period ends, one
// cell per (node, period end) from the active run. Colour is a single brass hue whose alpha runs
// 0.12–0.6 over the value range of the displayed cells, with the value overprinted; cells that fail
// a display threshold show their counts, missing cells show '—' and their reason (never 0, never
// red/green). JS numbers are used only to compute alpha (colour), never for any displayed text.
import {formatMetricValue} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {Locale} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {NodeView,PublicCell} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric,MissingReason} from '@/lib/industry/types';

export const ALPHA_MIN=0.12,ALPHA_MAX=0.6;
export type HeatText=
 |{kind:'value';text:string}
 |{kind:'insufficient';n:number;d:number}
 |{kind:'unresolved';n:number}
 |{kind:'missing';reason:MissingReason|'absent'};
export interface HeatCell{periodEnd:string;cell:PublicCell|null;text:HeatText;alpha:number|null;mobileHidden:boolean}
export interface HeatRow{node:NodeView;cells:HeatCell[]}

export function alphaFor(v:number,min:number,max:number):number{
 if(!(max>min))return Math.round((ALPHA_MIN+ALPHA_MAX)/2*100)/100;
 const t=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(v-min)/(max-min)));
 return Math.round((ALPHA_MIN+(ALPHA_MAX-ALPHA_MIN)*t)*100)/100;
}
/** The brass token at `alpha` (no hard-coded colour: color-mix over var(--accent)). */
export const brassBackground=(alpha:number)=>`color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) ${Math.round(alpha*100)}%, transparent)`;

export function heatText(c:PublicCell|null,metric:AggMetric,locale:Locale):HeatText{
 if(!c)return {kind:'missing',reason:'absent'};
 if(c.display==='missing')return {kind:'missing',reason:c.missingReason??'empty_set'};
 if(c.display==='unresolved')return {kind:'unresolved',n:c.nUnresolved};
 if(c.display==='insufficient')return {kind:'insufficient',n:c.nWithData,d:c.nMembers+c.nUnresolved};
 return {kind:'value',text:formatMetricValue(metric,c.value??'',locale)};
}

/** Rows in node order; the last `mobileColumns` period ends stay visible below 640px (canvas M-List). */
export function heatmapModel(nodes:NodeView[],periodEnds:string[],cells:PublicCell[],metric:AggMetric,locale:Locale,mobileColumns=5):HeatRow[]{
 const byKey=new Map(cells.filter(c=>c.metric===metric).map(c=>[`${c.code}|${c.periodEnd}`,c]));
 const shown=cells.filter(c=>c.metric===metric&&c.display==='value'&&c.value!==null).map(c=>Number(c.value)).filter(Number.isFinite);
 const min=shown.length?Math.min(...shown):0,max=shown.length?Math.max(...shown):0;
 const firstMobile=Math.max(0,periodEnds.length-mobileColumns);
 return nodes.map(node=>({node,cells:periodEnds.map((pe,i)=>{
  const cell=byKey.get(`${node.code}|${pe}`)??null;
  const text=heatText(cell,metric,locale);
  return {periodEnd:pe,cell,text,alpha:text.kind==='value'&&cell?.value?alphaFor(Number(cell.value),min,max):null,mobileHidden:i<firstMobile};
 })}));
}
```

`src/components/industries/series-model.ts`：

```ts
// src/components/industries/series-model.ts
// SVG geometry of a series chart (spec §8.3, canvas "Detail" §3): one brass line over the ok cells,
// broken at missing cells (a gap is a gap, never a 0), a dot per ok cell (each a source-drawer
// button), four y ticks and ≤ 10 x labels. Coordinates use JS numbers; every label is formatted from
// a decimal string, and the same series is always rendered as a table next to the chart.
import {formatMetricValue} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {Locale} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {PublicCell} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric} from '@/lib/industry/types';

export interface SeriesPoint{periodEnd:string;cell:PublicCell|null}
export interface SeriesGeometry{
 width:number;height:number;pad:{l:number;r:number;t:number;b:number};
 segments:string[];dots:{x:number;y:number;periodEnd:string;cell:PublicCell}[];
 yTicks:{y:number;label:string}[];xLabels:{x:number;label:string}[];
}
const plotted=(c:PublicCell|null):c is PublicCell=>!!c&&c.status==='ok'&&c.value!==null&&Number.isFinite(Number(c.value));
const r1=(n:number)=>Math.round(n*10)/10;

export function seriesGeometry(points:SeriesPoint[],metric:AggMetric,locale:Locale,size:{width:number;height:number}={width:780,height:300}):SeriesGeometry{
 const pad={l:64,r:12,t:16,b:32};
 const w=size.width-pad.l-pad.r,h=size.height-pad.t-pad.b;
 const vals=points.filter(p=>plotted(p.cell)).map(p=>Number(p.cell!.value));
 let lo=vals.length?Math.min(...vals):0,hi=vals.length?Math.max(...vals):1;
 if(hi===lo){const d=Math.abs(lo)>0?Math.abs(lo)*0.1:1;lo-=d;hi+=d;}
 const span=hi-lo;lo-=span*0.05;hi+=span*0.05;
 const x=(i:number)=>r1(pad.l+(points.length<=1?w/2:i*w/(points.length-1)));
 const y=(v:number)=>r1(pad.t+h-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*h);
 const segments:string[]=[];let cur:string[]=[];
 const dots:SeriesGeometry['dots']=[];
 points.forEach((p,i)=>{
  if(!plotted(p.cell)){if(cur.length)segments.push(cur.join(' '));cur=[];return;}
  const px=x(i),py=y(Number(p.cell.value));
  cur.push(`${cur.length?'L':'M'}${px} ${py}`);
  dots.push({x:px,y:py,periodEnd:p.periodEnd,cell:p.cell});
 });
 if(cur.length)segments.push(cur.join(' '));
 const yTicks=[0,1,2,3].map(k=>{const v=lo+(hi-lo)*k/3;return {y:y(v),label:formatMetricValue(metric,v.toFixed(10),locale)};});
 const step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(points.length/10));
 const allYearEnds=points.every(p=>p.periodEnd.endsWith('-12-31'));
 const xLabels=points.flatMap((p,i)=>i%step===0||i===points.length-1?[{x:x(i),label:allYearEnds?p.periodEnd.slice(0,4):p.periodEnd.slice(0,7)}]:[]);
 return {width:size.width,height:size.height,pad,segments,dots,yTicks,xLabels};
}
```

```ts
// src/components/industries/drawer-model.ts
// What the source drawer shows and where it fetches it (spec §8.5, canvas "Drawer" A–D): payload
// kinds, the replay URL (public route, or the admin route for the internal preview), normalisation of
// both replay responses, and the role / input / diff summaries rendered in sections 2–4.
import type {FactCellView,MembershipView,NodeView,PublicCell,PublicValuation,ReplayDiff,RunHeader} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggregateManifest,ManifestCell,Scheme} from '@/lib/industry/types';

export type DrawerPayload=
 |{kind:'aggregate';scheme:Scheme;code:string;nodeName:string;cell:PublicCell;header:RunHeader;preview:boolean}
 |{kind:'valuation';scheme:Scheme;code:string;nodeName:string;runId:string;cell:PublicValuation;preview:boolean}
 |{kind:'fact';issuerName:string;ticker:string|null;fact:FactCellView}
 |{kind:'membership';scheme:Scheme;nodeName:string;issuerName:string;ticker:string|null;membership:MembershipView;path:NodeView[]};
export type AggregatePayload=Extract<DrawerPayload,{kind:'aggregate'}>;
export interface ReplayPayload{cell:PublicCell;manifestHash:string;manifest:AggregateManifest;replay:ManifestCell[];reproduced:boolean}
export interface RecomputePayload{result:'match'|'changed';diff:ReplayDiff}

const qs=(o:Record<string,string>)=>Object.entries(o).map(([k,v])=>`${k}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`).join('&');
/** Public replay route; the admin preview reads the admin route (original only: recompute is public-only). */
export function replayUrl(p:AggregatePayload,mode:'original'|'recompute'):string|null{
 const c=p.cell;
 if(p.preview)return mode==='original'?`/api/admin/industries/replay?${qs({runId:p.header.runId,code:p.code,periodEnd:c.periodEnd,metric:c.metric,duration:c.duration})}`:null;
 return `/api/industries/${p.scheme}/${encodeURIComponent(p.code)}/replay?${qs({runId:p.header.runId,metric:c.metric,duration:c.duration,periodEnd:c.periodEnd,mode})}`;
}
export function valuationReplayUrl(p:Extract<DrawerPayload,{kind:'valuation'}>):string|null{
 if(p.preview)return null;
 return `/api/industries/${p.scheme}/${encodeURIComponent(p.code)}/replay?${qs({runId:p.runId,metric:p.cell.metric,tradeDate:p.cell.tradeDate})}`;
}
const isObj=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>typeof v==='object'&&v!==null;
/** Public original body or the admin body's `focus` → the drawer's replay shape; anything else → null. */
export function normalizeReplay(json:unknown):ReplayPayload|null{
 const src=isObj(json)&&isObj(json.focus)?json.focus:json;
 if(!isObj(src)||!isObj(src.manifest)||!Array.isArray(src.replay)||typeof src.reproduced!=='boolean'||typeof src.manifestHash!=='string'||!isObj(src.cell))return null;
 return src as unknown as ReplayPayload;
}
export function normalizeRecompute(json:unknown):RecomputePayload|null{
 if(!isObj(json)||(json.result!=='match'&&json.result!=='changed')||!isObj(json.diff))return null;
 return json as unknown as RecomputePayload;
}
/** Error code of an API error body ({error:{code}} or the admin {error:'code'}), else the HTTP status. */
export function errorCodeOf(status:number,json:unknown):string{
 if(isObj(json)){const e=json.error;if(typeof e==='string')return e;if(isObj(e)&&typeof e.code==='string')return e.code;}
 return `http_${status}`;
}

export const coverageOf=(c:{nWithData:number;nMembers:number;nUnresolved:number})=>({n:c.nWithData,d:c.nMembers+c.nUnresolved});
/** Issuers per role of the (metric-filtered) manifest; excluded split by reason, largest first. */
export function roleSummary(m:AggregateManifest):{included:number;excluded:{reason:string;n:number}[]}{
 const inc=new Set<string>(),exc=new Map<string,Set<string>>();
 for(const r of m.roles){
  if(r.role==='included')inc.add(r.issuer_id);
  else{const k=r.reason??'excluded';const s=exc.get(k)??new Set<string>();s.add(r.issuer_id);exc.set(k,s);}
 }
 return {included:inc.size,excluded:[...exc.entries()].map(([reason,s])=>({reason,n:s.size})).sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n||(a.reason<b.reason?-1:1))};
}
export interface InputRow{issuerId:string;ticker:string|null;concept:string;value:string;unit:string;availableDate:string;filingId:string;citation:string|null}
/** Input facts of included issuers (the manifest is metric-filtered), ordered by issuer then concept. */
export function inputRows(m:AggregateManifest,limit:number):{rows:InputRow[];total:number}{
 const included=new Set(m.roles.filter(r=>r.role==='included').map(r=>r.issuer_id));
 const ticker=new Map(m.members.map(x=>[x.issuer_id,x.ticker]));
 const all=m.facts.filter(f=>included.size===0||included.has(f.issuer_id))
  .sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:a.concept<b.concept?-1:a.concept>b.concept?1:0)
  .map(f=>({issuerId:f.issuer_id,ticker:ticker.get(f.issuer_id)??null,concept:f.concept,value:f.value_text,unit:f.unit,availableDate:f.available_date,filingId:f.filing_id,citation:f.citation}));
 return {rows:all.slice(0,limit),total:all.length};
}
export function diffCounts(d:ReplayDiff){
 return {ma:d.members.added.length,mr:d.members.removed.length,ua:d.unresolved.added.length,ur:d.unresolved.removed.length,fa:d.facts.added.length,fr:d.facts.removed.length,revs:d.stateRevs.length};
}
/** Evidence link of one fact (plan-2 public route, factIds mode). */
export const factEvidenceUrl=(ticker:string|null,factId:string)=>ticker?`/api/facts/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}?factIds=${encodeURIComponent(factId)}`:null;
export const short=(hash:string|null)=>hash?`${hash.slice(0,4)}…${hash.slice(-4)}`:'—';
```

```ts
// src/components/industries/design-tokens.test.ts
// Static DESIGN.md guard over every industry component and page (spec §8 conventions, canvas notes):
// tokens only (no hex / rgb literals), brass as the single accent, no market red/green on industry
// metrics, no purple/indigo, no gradients, no spinners or "Loading…" text, numbers in Geist Mono with
// tabular figures, and every chart paired with a table.
import {readFileSync,readdirSync,statSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const ROOTS=['src/components/industries','src/app/(app)/intel/industries'];
function files(dir:string):string[]{
 let out:string[]=[];
 let entries:string[]=[];
 try{entries=readdirSync(dir);}catch{return out;}
 for(const e of entries){const p=join(dir,e);if(statSync(p).isDirectory())out=out.concat(files(p));else if(p.endsWith('.tsx'))out.push(p);}
 return out;
}
/** Code only: comments may name what is banned. */
const stripComments=(s:string)=>s.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm,'$1');
const SOURCES=ROOTS.flatMap(r=>files(join(process.cwd(),r))).map(p=>({p,src:stripComments(readFileSync(p,'utf8'))}));

describe('industry UI follows DESIGN.md tokens',()=>{
 it('finds the components',()=>expect(SOURCES.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(9));
 it.each(SOURCES.map(s=>[s.p.split('/src/')[1],s.src]))('%s: no hard-coded colours, no signal colours, no purple, no gradients, no spinners',(_,src)=>{
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/);
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/\brgba?\(/);
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/\b(text|bg|border|fill|stroke)-(up|down|bullish|bearish|red|green|emerald|rose)\b/);
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/purple|violet|indigo/);
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/gradient/);
  expect(src).not.toMatch(/animate-spin|Loading…|Loading\.\.\./);
 });
 it('numbers are Geist Mono with tabular figures where values render',()=>{
  for(const name of ['CoverageCell.tsx','Heatmap.tsx','SeriesChart.tsx','PercentileBar.tsx','SourceDrawer.tsx']){
   const s=SOURCES.find(x=>x.p.endsWith(`/${name}`));
   expect(s,name).toBeDefined();
   expect(s!.src).toContain('font-mono');
   expect(s!.src).toContain('tabular-nums');
  }
 });
 it('the series chart always renders its table equivalent',()=>{
  const s=SOURCES.find(x=>x.p.endsWith('/SeriesChart.tsx'))!.src;
  expect(s).toContain('<table');
  expect(s).toContain("t('detail.tableEquivalent')");
 });
});
```

```tsx
'use client';
// src/components/industries/SourceDrawer.tsx
// The source drawer (spec §8.5; canvas "Drawer" A–D, "M-Drawer"): every displayed number is a
// SourceButton (or a SourceDot in a chart) that opens it. Right-side panel on desktop, full-width
// bottom sheet on mobile; Esc and the backdrop close it. Aggregate cells fetch the original replay
// (public route, or the admin route in the internal preview) and offer "recompute on current
// evidence"; valuation cells show the official comparison value only when the route attaches it.
import {createContext,useCallback,useContext,useEffect,useMemo,useState} from 'react';
import type {CSSProperties,ReactNode} from 'react';
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {formatMetricValue,formatMoney,formatValuation} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {Locale} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import {HistoryClassBadge} from './HistoryClassBadge';
import {nodeName} from './hrefs';
import {coverageOf,diffCounts,errorCodeOf,factEvidenceUrl,inputRows,normalizeRecompute,normalizeReplay,replayUrl,roleSummary,short,valuationReplayUrl} from './drawer-model';
import type {AggregatePayload,DrawerPayload,RecomputePayload,ReplayPayload} from './drawer-model';

const DrawerContext=createContext<{open:(p:DrawerPayload)=>void}|null>(null);

export function SourceDrawerProvider({children}:{children:ReactNode}){
  const [payload,setPayload]=useState<DrawerPayload|null>(null);
  const open=useCallback((p:DrawerPayload)=>setPayload(p),[]);
  const value=useMemo(()=>({open}),[open]);
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(!payload)return;
    const onKey=(e:KeyboardEvent)=>{if(e.key==='Escape')setPayload(null);};
    window.addEventListener('keydown',onKey);
    return ()=>window.removeEventListener('keydown',onKey);
  },[payload]);
  return (<DrawerContext.Provider value={value}>{children}{payload&&<DrawerPanel payload={payload} onClose={()=>setPayload(null)} />}</DrawerContext.Provider>);
}

export function SourceButton({payload,children,className,label,style}:{payload:DrawerPayload;children:ReactNode;className?:string;label?:string;style?:CSSProperties}){
  const ctx=useContext(DrawerContext);
  return (
    <button type="button" aria-label={label} title={label} style={style} onClick={()=>ctx?.open(payload)} data-source-button=""
      className={`cursor-pointer rounded font-mono tabular-nums hover:outline hover:outline-1 hover:outline-[var(--border-active)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-accent ${className??''}`}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function SourceDot({payload,cx,cy,label}:{payload:DrawerPayload;cx:number;cy:number;label:string}){
  const ctx=useContext(DrawerContext);
  return (
    <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={4} role="button" tabIndex={0} aria-label={label} strokeWidth={2} data-source-button=""
      className="cursor-pointer fill-[var(--bg-elevated)] stroke-[var(--accent)]"
      onClick={()=>ctx?.open(payload)} onKeyDown={e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();ctx?.open(payload);}}} />
  );
}

function Row({label,children,mono}:{label:string;children:ReactNode;mono?:boolean}){
  return (<><dt className="text-text-dim">{label}</dt><dd className={`m-0 break-words ${mono?'font-mono text-xs tabular-nums':''}`}>{children}</dd></>);
}
function Section({title,children}:{title:string;children:ReactNode}){
  return (<section><div className="mb-2 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{title}</div>{children}</section>);
}
const dl='grid grid-cols-[112px_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5 text-sm';

/** fetch JSON with abort; {status:'idle'|'loading'|'ok'|'error'} */
function useJson<T>(url:string|null,parse:(j:unknown)=>T|null){
  const [state,setState]=useState<{status:'idle'|'loading'|'ok'|'error';data?:T;code?:string}>({status:url?'loading':'idle'});
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(!url){setState({status:'idle'});return;}
    const ctrl=new AbortController();
    setState({status:'loading'});
    fetch(url,{signal:ctrl.signal}).then(async r=>{
      const j:unknown=await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      const data=r.ok?parse(j):null;
      setState(data?{status:'ok',data}:{status:'error',code:errorCodeOf(r.status,j)});
    }).catch(e=>{if((e as {name?:string}).name!=='AbortError')setState({status:'error',code:'network'});});
    return ()=>ctrl.abort();
  },[url,parse]);
  return state;
}

function DrawerPanel({payload,onClose}:{payload:DrawerPayload;onClose:()=>void}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.drawer');
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50">
      <button type="button" aria-label={t('close')} onClick={onClose} className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full cursor-default" style={{background:'color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent)'}} />
      <aside role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={t('title')} data-drawer-kind={payload.kind}
        className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[85dvh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-xl border border-border bg-bg-elevated sm:inset-y-0 sm:left-auto sm:right-0 sm:max-h-none sm:w-[440px] sm:rounded-none sm:rounded-l-lg">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-bg-card sm:hidden" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 border-b border-border p-4">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><Heading payload={payload} /></div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label={t('close')} className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded text-text-dim hover:bg-[var(--accent-wash)]">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 p-4">
          {payload.kind==='aggregate'&&<AggregateBody p={payload} />}
          {payload.kind==='valuation'&&<ValuationBody p={payload} />}
          {payload.kind==='fact'&&<FactBody p={payload} />}
          {payload.kind==='membership'&&<MembershipBody p={payload} />}
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

function Heading({payload}:{payload:DrawerPayload}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const locale:Locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  let title='',big='';
  if(payload.kind==='aggregate'){title=`${payload.nodeName} · ${t(`metrics.${payload.cell.metric}`)} · ${payload.cell.periodEnd}`;big=payload.cell.value!==null?formatMetricValue(payload.cell.metric,payload.cell.value,locale):'—';}
  if(payload.kind==='valuation'){title=`${payload.nodeName} · ${payload.cell.metric} · ${payload.cell.tradeDate}`;big=formatValuation(payload.cell.metric,payload.cell.value,locale);}
  if(payload.kind==='fact'){title=`${payload.issuerName} · ${payload.fact.concept} · ${payload.fact.periodEnd}`;big=formatMoney(payload.fact.value,payload.fact.unit,locale);}
  if(payload.kind==='membership'){title=`${payload.ticker??''} ${payload.issuerName} ∈ ${payload.nodeName}`;big='';}
  return (
    <>
      <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t(`drawer.kind.${payload.kind}`)}</div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">{title}</div>
      {big&&<div className="mt-1 font-mono text-[26px] font-medium tabular-nums">{big}</div>}
    </>
  );
}

function AggregateBody({p}:{p:AggregatePayload}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const c=p.cell;const cov=coverageOf(c);
  const [recomputeOn,setRecomputeOn]=useState(false);
  const replay=useJson<ReplayPayload>(c.status==='ok'?replayUrl(p,'original'):null,normalizeReplay);
  const recUrl=recomputeOn?replayUrl(p,'recompute'):null;
  const recompute=useJson<RecomputePayload>(recUrl,normalizeRecompute);
  const roles=replay.data?roleSummary(replay.data.manifest):null;
  const inputs=replay.data?inputRows(replay.data.manifest,5):null;
  return (
    <>
      <Section title={`1 · ${t('drawer.sections.value')}`}>
        <dl className={dl}>
          <Row label={t('drawer.formula')}>{t(`formulas.${c.metric}`)}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.period')} mono>{c.periodStart} → {c.periodEnd} · {c.duration}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.method')} mono>{p.header.methodVersion} · {p.header.formulaVersion}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.factsAsOf')} mono>{p.header.factsAsOf}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.availableAt')} mono>{c.updatedAt??'—'} <span className="font-sans text-text-dim">{t('drawer.availableAtNote')}</span></Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.historyClass')}><HistoryClassBadge historyClass={p.header.historyClass} /></Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.codeVersion')} mono>{p.header.codeVersion.slice(0,7)}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.manifest')} mono>{short(c.manifestHash)}</Row>
        </dl>
      </Section>
      <Section title={`2 · ${t('drawer.sections.coverage')}`}>
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2"><span className="font-mono text-base tabular-nums">{cov.n} / {cov.d}</span><span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('drawer.coverageRatio')}</span></div>
        <ul className="mt-2 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1 pl-5 text-xs text-text-dim">
          {roles?.excluded.map(e=><li key={e.reason}>{t('drawer.excludedBy',{reason:t(`roles.${e.reason}`),n:e.n})}</li>)}
          <li>{t('drawer.unresolvedCount',{n:c.nUnresolved})}</li>
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {c.status!=='ok'?(
        <Section title={`3 · ${t('drawer.sections.replay')}`}>
          <p className="text-sm text-text-dim">{t('drawer.missingCell',{reason:t(`missing.${c.missingReason??'empty_set'}`)})}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{t('drawer.counts',{members:c.nMembers,withData:c.nWithData,unresolved:c.nUnresolved})}</p>
        </Section>
      ):(
        <Section title={`3 · ${t('drawer.sections.replay')}`}>
          {replay.status==='loading'&&<div role="status" aria-busy="true" className="h-16 rounded bg-bg-card"><span className="sr-only">{t('drawer.replayLoading')}</span></div>}
          {replay.status==='error'&&<p role="alert" className="text-sm text-danger">{t('drawer.replayFailed',{code:replay.code??''})}</p>}
          {replay.data&&(replay.data.reproduced?(
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-accent p-3" data-reproduced="true">
              <span className="rounded border border-accent px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-accent">{t('drawer.reproducedTrue')}</span>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('drawer.reproducedNote',{value:c.value??''})}</p>
            </div>
          ):(
            <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-danger p-3" data-reproduced="false">
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-danger">{t('states.replayMismatch.title')}</div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('drawer.mismatchNote',{replayed:replay.data.replay[0]?.value_text??'—',stored:c.value??'—'})}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('states.replayMismatch.body')}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
          {roles&&(
            <table className="mt-2 w-full text-xs">
              <thead><tr className="text-left text-text-dim"><th className="py-1 font-normal">{t('drawer.roles')}</th><th className="py-1 text-right font-normal">{t('drawer.issuers')}</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr className="border-t border-border"><td className="py-1">{t('roles.included')}</td><td className="py-1 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">{roles.included}</td></tr>
                {roles.excluded.map(e=><tr key={e.reason} className="border-t border-border"><td className="py-1">{t('roles.excluded')} · {t(`roles.${e.reason}`)}</td><td className="py-1 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">{e.n}</td></tr>)}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
          {!p.preview&&(
            <div className="mt-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={()=>setRecomputeOn(true)} disabled={recomputeOn} className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text-dim hover:border-[var(--border-active)] hover:text-text disabled:opacity-60">{t('drawer.recompute')}</button>
              {recompute.status==='error'&&<p role="alert" className="mt-1 text-xs text-danger">{t('drawer.replayFailed',{code:recompute.code??''})}</p>}
              {recompute.data&&(
                <div className="mt-2 text-xs" data-recompute={recompute.data.result}>
                  <p className={recompute.data.result==='match'?'text-text':'text-warn'}>{t(recompute.data.result==='match'?'drawer.recomputeMatch':'drawer.recomputeChanged')}</p>
                  {recompute.data.result==='changed'&&<p className="mt-1 font-mono tabular-nums text-text-dim">{t('drawer.diffCounts',diffCounts(recompute.data.diff))}</p>}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </Section>
      )}
      {inputs&&inputs.total>0&&(
        <Section title={t('drawer.inputsTop',{n:inputs.rows.length,total:inputs.total})}>
          <table className="w-full text-xs">
            <thead><tr className="text-left text-text-dim"><th className="py-1 font-normal">{t('drawer.issuer')}</th><th className="py-1 font-normal">{t('drawer.concept')}</th><th className="py-1 text-right font-normal">{t('drawer.value')}</th><th className="py-1 font-normal">{t('drawer.availableDate')}</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {inputs.rows.map(r=>(
                <tr key={`${r.issuerId}:${r.concept}:${r.filingId}`} className="border-t border-border">
                  <td className="py-1 font-mono">{r.ticker??r.issuerId.slice(0,8)}</td><td className="py-1">{r.concept}</td>
                  <td className="py-1 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">{r.value} {r.unit}</td>
                  <td className="py-1 font-mono tabular-nums text-text-dim">{r.availableDate} · {r.citation??'—'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </Section>
      )}
      <Section title={`4 · ${t('drawer.sections.membership')}`}>
        <dl className={dl}>
          <Row label={t('drawer.upstream')}>{p.scheme==='sw2021'?t('drawer.membershipUpstreamSw'):t('drawer.membershipUpstreamSic')}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.availableDateLabel')}>{p.scheme==='sw2021'?t('drawer.availabilityAssumed'):t('drawer.availabilityObserved')}</Row>
          <Row label={t('drawer.historyClass')}><HistoryClassBadge historyClass={p.header.historyClass} /></Row>
        </dl>
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}

function ValuationBody({p}:{p:Extract<DrawerPayload,{kind:'valuation'}>}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const parse=useCallback((j:unknown)=>(typeof j==='object'&&j!==null&&'cell' in j?j as {officialValue?:string}:null),[]);
  const r=useJson(valuationReplayUrl(p),parse);
  return (
    <Section title={t('drawer.sections.value')}>
      <dl className={dl}>
        <Row label={t('drawer.formula')}>{t(`formulas.${p.cell.metric}`)}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.tradeDate')} mono>{p.cell.tradeDate}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.availableAt')} mono>{p.cell.updatedAt??'—'}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.factsAsOf')} mono>{p.cell.factsAsOf}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.mcapCoverage')} mono>{p.cell.mcapCoverage??'—'}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.pairStatus')}><span className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 text-xs">{t('valuation.within')}</span></Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.officialValue')}>{r.data?.officialValue?<span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{r.data.officialValue}</span>:<span className="text-text-dim">{t('drawer.officialUnavailable')}</span>}</Row>
        <Row label={t('drawer.manifest')} mono>{short(p.cell.manifestHash)}</Row>
      </dl>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('drawer.valuationReplayDeferred')}</p>
    </Section>
  );
}

function FactBody({p}:{p:Extract<DrawerPayload,{kind:'fact'}>}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.drawer');
  const href=factEvidenceUrl(p.ticker,p.fact.factId);
  return (
    <Section title={t('sections.evidence')}>
      <dl className={dl}>
        <Row label={t('concept')} mono>{p.fact.concept}</Row>
        <Row label={t('period')} mono>{p.fact.periodStart??'—'} → {p.fact.periodEnd} · {p.fact.duration}</Row>
        <Row label={t('value')} mono>{p.fact.value} {p.fact.unit}</Row>
        <Row label={t('availableDate')} mono>{p.fact.availableDate}</Row>
        <Row label={t('filingId')} mono>{p.fact.filingId}</Row>
        <Row label={t('rawHash')} mono>{short(p.fact.rawHash)}</Row>
      </dl>
      {href&&<a className="mt-2 inline-block text-xs" href={href}>{t('factEvidence')} →</a>}
    </Section>
  );
}

function MembershipBody({p}:{p:Extract<DrawerPayload,{kind:'membership'}>}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.drawer');
  const locale:Locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const m=p.membership;
  const availability=m.availability==='evidenced'?t('availabilityEvidenced'):m.availability==='observed'?t('availabilityObserved'):t('availabilityAssumed');
  return (
    <Section title={t('sections.membership')}>
      <dl className={dl}>
        <Row label={t('path')}>{p.path.map(n=>nodeName(n,locale)).join(' › ')}</Row>
        <Row label={t('sourceRecord')} mono>{m.sourceMembershipId?short(m.sourceMembershipId):'—'}</Row>
        <Row label={t('upstream')}>{p.scheme==='sw2021'?t('membershipUpstreamSw'):t('membershipUpstreamSic')}</Row>
        <Row label={t('rawHash')} mono>{short(m.rawHash)}</Row>
        <Row label={t('locator')} mono>{m.locator?JSON.stringify(m.locator):'—'}</Row>
        <Row label={t('availableDateLabel')} mono>{m.availableDate} <span className="font-sans text-text-dim">{availability}</span></Row>
        <Row label={t('validFrom')} mono>{m.validFrom}</Row>
        <Row label={t('validTo')} mono>{m.validTo??'—'}</Row>
        <Row label={t('batch')} mono>{short(m.batchId)}</Row>
      </dl>
    </Section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/CoverageCell.tsx
// The content of one aggregate cell wherever it appears (heatmap, tables): the formatted value, or
// "x/y" (coverage < 0.8), or "z unresolved" (> 5%), or "—" with its missing reason (spec §5.2, §8.2;
// canvas "Entry" coverage badges). Never 0 for missing; Geist Mono, tabular figures.
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {formatMetricValue} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {PublicCell} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric} from '@/lib/industry/types';

export function CoverageCell({cell,metric}:{cell:PublicCell|null;metric:AggMetric}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  if(!cell||cell.display==='missing'){
    const reason=t(`missing.${cell?.missingReason??'absent'}`);
    return (<span className="font-mono text-text-dim" title={reason}>—<span className="sr-only"> {reason}</span></span>);
  }
  if(cell.display==='unresolved'){
    return (<span className="rounded-[3px] border border-dashed border-warn px-1 font-mono text-[12px] tabular-nums text-warn">{t('coverage.unresolved',{n:cell.nUnresolved})}</span>);
  }
  if(cell.display==='insufficient'){
    return (<span className="rounded-[3px] border border-dashed border-text-dim px-1 font-mono text-[12px] tabular-nums text-text-dim">{t('coverage.ratio',{n:cell.nWithData,d:cell.nMembers+cell.nUnresolved})}</span>);
  }
  return <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{formatMetricValue(metric,cell.value??'',locale)}</span>;
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/FreshnessChip.tsx
// Freshness of the dataset behind the page (spec §8.2 header; canvas "Entry" components): a dot and a
// label. Brass = fresh, amber = stale, danger = error, dim = no record. Not red/green: freshness is an
// operational state, not a market signal.
import {useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import type {FreshnessStatus} from '@/lib/dq/freshness';

const DOT:Record<FreshnessStatus,string>={fresh:'bg-accent',stale:'bg-warn',error:'bg-danger',missing:'bg-text-dim'};
const TEXT:Record<FreshnessStatus,string>={fresh:'text-text-dim',stale:'text-warn',error:'text-danger',missing:'text-text-dim'};

export function FreshnessChip({status}:{status:FreshnessStatus}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.freshness');
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs ${TEXT[status]}`} data-freshness={status}>
      <span aria-hidden="true" className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${DOT[status]}`} />
      {status} · {t(status)}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/SchemeLevelSwitch.tsx
// Selectors as links (canvas "Entry" scheme & level switch): every choice is a search-param URL, so
// pages stay server-rendered and shareable. LinkMenu is a <details> dropdown, LinkSegment a segmented
// control; SchemeLevelSwitch combines the scheme menu with the SW level segment (hidden for SIC,
// which is single-level).
import Link from 'next/link';
import {useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {hrefWith} from './hrefs';
import type {Search} from './hrefs';

export interface LinkOption{value:string;label:string;href:string;disabled?:boolean}

export function LinkMenu({label,current,options}:{label:string;current:string;options:LinkOption[]}){
  const active=options.find(o=>o.value===current);
  return (
    <details className="relative">
      <summary className="flex min-h-[36px] cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-3 text-sm hover:border-accent">
        <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{label}</span>
        <span>{active?.label??current}</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-text-dim">▾</span>
      </summary>
      <div className="absolute z-20 mt-1 flex min-w-[220px] flex-col rounded-lg border border-border bg-bg-elevated p-1.5 shadow-[var(--shadow)]">
        {options.map(o=>o.disabled
          ?<span key={o.value} className="rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm text-text-dim">{o.label}</span>
          :<Link key={o.value} href={o.href} aria-current={o.value===current?'true':undefined}
            className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-[var(--accent-wash)] hover:no-underline ${o.value===current?'bg-[var(--accent-wash)] text-accent':'text-text'}`}>{o.label}</Link>)}
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

export function LinkSegment({label,current,options}:{label:string;current:string;options:LinkOption[]}){
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className="inline-flex rounded-md border border-border p-0.5 text-sm">
      {options.map(o=>o.disabled
        ?<span key={o.value} className="min-h-[32px] px-3 py-1 text-text-dim">{o.label}</span>
        :<Link key={o.value} href={o.href} aria-current={o.value===current?'true':undefined}
          className={`flex min-h-[32px] items-center rounded px-3 hover:no-underline ${o.value===current?'bg-[var(--accent-wash)] font-semibold text-accent':'text-text-dim hover:text-text'}`}>{o.label}</Link>)}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SchemeLevelSwitch({path,search,scheme,level}:{path:string;search:Search;scheme:'sw2021'|'sic';level:number}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <LinkMenu label={t('controls.scheme')} current={scheme} options={[
        {value:'sw2021',label:t('schemes.sw2021Market'),href:hrefWith(path,search,{scheme:'sw2021',level:undefined})},
        {value:'sic',label:t('schemes.sicMarket'),href:hrefWith(path,search,{scheme:'sic',level:undefined,metric:undefined,duration:undefined,view:undefined})},
      ]} />
      {scheme==='sw2021'&&(
        <LinkSegment label={t('controls.level')} current={String(level)} options={['1','2','3'].map(l=>({value:l,label:t(`levels.${l}`),href:hrefWith(path,search,{level:l==='1'?undefined:l})}))} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/PercentileBar.tsx
// Percentile bar (canvas "Entry" components; spec §6.5): single brass fill, the percent text, and
// n / expected. A percentile is a statistic, not an over/under-valued judgment. `value` is a 0..1
// decimal string; null (unpublished or insufficient sample) draws the dashed empty bar.
import {useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {percentText} from '@/lib/industry/display';

export function PercentileBar({value,n,expected,width='w-[140px]'}:{value:string|null;n?:number;expected?:number;width?:string}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.valuation');
  if(value===null){
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className={`inline-block h-1.5 ${width} rounded-full border border-dashed border-border`} />
        <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('unpublished')}</span>
      </span>
    );
  }
  const pct=percentText(value);
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
      <span className={`relative inline-block h-1.5 ${width} overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-bg-card`}>
        <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-accent" style={{width:`${pct}%`}} />
      </span>
      <span className="font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">{pct}%</span>
      {n!==undefined&&expected!==undefined&&<span className="font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-text-dim">{n}/{expected}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/StateNotice.tsx
// Page and section states (spec §8.2, §12; canvas "States"): loading is a static skeleton (no spinner,
// no "Loading…" text), error and replay-mismatch are alerts in the danger tone, the rest are neutral
// callouts; admin-preview is the brass bar. Titles/bodies default to messages industries.states.<kind>.
import type {ReactNode} from 'react';
import {useTranslations} from 'next-intl';

export type NoticeKind='loading'|'stale'|'error'|'unlicensed'|'empty'|'reconstruction'|'partialUnpublished'|'replayMismatch'|'officialUnavailable'|'notEnabled'|'adminPreview'|'noJudgment'|'currentOnly'|'noMembers';

const TONE:Record<NoticeKind,string>={
  loading:'',stale:'border-warn',error:'border-danger',unlicensed:'border-border',empty:'border-border',reconstruction:'border-warn',
  partialUnpublished:'border-border',replayMismatch:'border-danger',officialUnavailable:'border-border',notEnabled:'border-border',
  adminPreview:'border-accent bg-[var(--accent-wash)]',noJudgment:'border-border',currentOnly:'border-warn',noMembers:'border-border',
};

export function StateNotice({kind,values,body,children}:{kind:NoticeKind;values?:Record<string,string|number>;body?:string;children?:ReactNode}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.states');
  if(kind==='loading'){
    return (
      <div role="status" aria-busy="true" data-state="loading" className="card-base">
        <span className="sr-only">{t('loading.title')}</span>
        <div className="mb-3 flex gap-3"><div className="h-7 w-44 rounded bg-bg-elevated" /><div className="ml-auto h-7 w-28 rounded bg-bg-elevated" /></div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-[120px_repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr))] gap-[3px]">
          {Array.from({length:27},(_,i)=><div key={i} className="h-6 rounded-[3px] bg-bg-elevated" />)}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const alert=kind==='error'||kind==='replayMismatch';
  return (
    <div role={alert?'alert':'status'} data-state={kind} className={`rounded-lg border p-4 ${TONE[kind]}`}>
      <div className={`text-sm font-semibold ${alert?'text-danger':kind==='adminPreview'?'text-accent':'text-text'}`}>{t(`${kind}.title`,values)}</div>
      <p className="mt-1 max-w-[65ch] text-sm text-text-dim">{body??t(`${kind}.body`,values)}</p>
      {children&&<div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/Heatmap.tsx
// List heatmap (spec §8.2; canvas "Main", "M-List"): rows = industries (name → detail page), columns
// = period ends, every cell a button that opens the source drawer. Single brass hue at alpha
// 0.12–0.6 with the value overprinted; counts instead of values below the display thresholds; '—'
// with the reason for missing cells. Below 640px only the last 5 columns render (no horizontal page
// scroll). The table view of the same series is one click away (`tableHref`).
import type {CSSProperties} from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import type {NodeView,PublicCell,RunHeader} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric,Scheme} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import {CoverageCell} from './CoverageCell';
import {SourceButton} from './SourceDrawer';
import {brassBackground,heatmapModel,ALPHA_MAX,ALPHA_MIN} from './heatmap-model';
import {industryPath,nodeName} from './hrefs';

export function Heatmap({scheme,nodes,periodEnds,cells,metric,header,preview,tableHref}:{scheme:Scheme;nodes:NodeView[];periodEnds:string[];cells:PublicCell[];metric:AggMetric;header:RunHeader;preview:boolean;tableHref:string}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const rows=heatmapModel(nodes,periodEnds,cells,metric,locale);
  const cols=periodEnds.length,mcols=Math.min(5,cols);
  const grid='grid items-center gap-[3px] grid-cols-[112px_repeat(var(--mcols),minmax(0,1fr))] sm:grid-cols-[196px_repeat(var(--cols),minmax(0,1fr))]';
  const style={'--cols':String(cols),'--mcols':String(mcols)} as CSSProperties;
  const steps=[0,1,2,3,4].map(i=>ALPHA_MIN+(ALPHA_MAX-ALPHA_MIN)*i/4);
  return (
    <section aria-label={t('heatmap.label')} className="card-base" style={{padding:'16px 16px 12px'}}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs text-text-dim">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">{t('coverage.legendLow')}
          <span className="inline-flex gap-0.5">{steps.map(a=><i key={a} className="inline-block h-3 w-[18px] rounded-[2px]" style={{background:brassBackground(a)}} />)}</span>
          {t('coverage.legendHigh')}</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="rounded-[3px] border border-dashed border-text-dim px-1 font-mono">6/9</span>{t('coverage.legendInsufficient')}</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="rounded-[3px] border border-dashed border-warn px-1 font-mono text-warn">{t('coverage.unresolved',{n:3})}</span>{t('coverage.legendUnresolved')}</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="font-mono">—</span>{t('coverage.legendMissing')}</span>
        <Link href={tableHref} className="ml-auto">{t('table.label')} →</Link>
      </div>
      <div className={grid} style={style}>
        <div className="pl-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('heatmap.industry')}</div>
        {periodEnds.map((pe,i)=>(
          <div key={pe} className={`text-center font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-text-dim ${i<cols-mcols?'hidden sm:block':''}`}>{pe.endsWith('-12-31')?pe.slice(0,4):pe.slice(0,7)}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-[3px]">
        {rows.map(r=>{
          const name=nodeName(r.node,locale);
          return (
            <div key={r.node.code} className={grid} style={style}>
              <Link href={industryPath(scheme,r.node.code)} className="flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-2 pl-1 text-[13px] text-text hover:text-accent">
                <span className="truncate">{name}</span><span className="hidden font-mono text-[11px] text-text-dim sm:inline">{r.node.code}</span>
              </Link>
              {r.cells.map(c=>{
                const title=t('heatmap.cellTitle',{industry:name,period:c.periodEnd,metric:t(`metrics.${metric}`)});
                const base=`min-h-[28px] w-full rounded-[3px] px-0.5 text-center font-mono text-[12px] tabular-nums ${c.mobileHidden?'hidden sm:flex':'flex'} items-center justify-center`;
                if(!c.cell)return <span key={c.periodEnd} title={title} className={`${base} border border-border text-text-dim`}><CoverageCell cell={null} metric={metric} /></span>;
                return (
                  <SourceButton key={c.periodEnd} label={title} className={`${base} ${c.text.kind==='value'?'text-text':'border border-border'}`}
                    style={c.alpha!==null?{background:brassBackground(c.alpha)}:undefined}
                    payload={{kind:'aggregate',scheme,code:r.node.code,nodeName:name,cell:c.cell,header,preview}}>
                    <CoverageCell cell={c.cell} metric={metric} />
                  </SourceButton>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('heatmap.caption')} <span className="sm:hidden">{t('heatmap.mobileNote')}</span></p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/SeriesChart.tsx
// One aggregate series as an SVG line + its table equivalent (spec §8.3; canvas "Detail" §3 and
// "M-Detail": below 640px only the table renders). Every dot and every table value opens the source
// drawer; missing points break the line and appear in the table as '—' with the reason.
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import type {NodeView,PublicCell,RunHeader} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric,Scheme} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import {CoverageCell} from './CoverageCell';
import {SourceButton,SourceDot} from './SourceDrawer';
import {nodeName} from './hrefs';
import {seriesGeometry} from './series-model';
import type {SeriesPoint} from './series-model';

export function SeriesChart({scheme,node,metric,points,header,preview,tableOnly}:{scheme:Scheme;node:NodeView;metric:AggMetric;points:SeriesPoint[];header:RunHeader;preview:boolean;tableOnly:boolean}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const g=seriesGeometry(points,metric,locale);
  const name=nodeName(node,locale);
  const payload=(cell:PublicCell)=>({kind:'aggregate' as const,scheme,code:node.code,nodeName:name,cell,header,preview});
  const table=(
    <div>
      <div className="mb-1.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('detail.tableEquivalent')}</div>
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead><tr className="text-left text-xs text-text-dim"><th className="py-1 font-normal">period_end</th><th className="py-1 text-right font-normal">{t(`metrics.${metric}`)}</th><th className="py-1 text-right font-normal">{t('table.coverage')}</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {[...points].reverse().map(p=>(
            <tr key={p.periodEnd} className="border-t border-border">
              <td className="py-1 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{p.periodEnd}</td>
              <td className="py-1 text-right">{p.cell?<SourceButton payload={payload(p.cell)} label={`${name} ${p.periodEnd}`}><CoverageCell cell={p.cell} metric={metric} /></SourceButton>:<CoverageCell cell={null} metric={metric} />}</td>
              <td className="py-1 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{p.cell?`${p.cell.nWithData}/${p.cell.nMembers+p.cell.nUnresolved}`:'—'}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
  if(tableOnly)return table;
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,8fr)_minmax(0,4fr)]">
      <figure className="m-0 hidden sm:block">
        <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${g.width} ${g.height}`} width="100%" role="img" aria-label={t('detail.chartLabel',{industry:name,metric:t(`metrics.${metric}`)})}>
          <g className="stroke-[var(--border)]" strokeWidth={1}>
            {g.yTicks.map(tk=><line key={tk.y} x1={g.pad.l} x2={g.width-g.pad.r} y1={tk.y} y2={tk.y} />)}
          </g>
          <g className="fill-[var(--text-dim)] font-mono" fontSize={11}>
            {g.yTicks.map(tk=><text key={tk.y} x={g.pad.l-8} y={tk.y+4} textAnchor="end">{tk.label}</text>)}
            {g.xLabels.map(l=><text key={l.x} x={l.x} y={g.height-8} textAnchor="middle">{l.label}</text>)}
          </g>
          {g.segments.map(d=><path key={d} d={d} fill="none" className="stroke-[var(--accent)]" strokeWidth={2} />)}
          {g.dots.map(d=><SourceDot key={d.periodEnd} cx={d.x} cy={d.y} label={`${name} ${d.periodEnd}`} payload={payload(d.cell)} />)}
        </svg>
        <figcaption className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('detail.chartCaption')}</figcaption>
      </figure>
      {table}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/ValuationSnapshot.tsx
// Valuation section of the list and detail pages (spec §6.4, §8.2–8.3; canvas "Main" valuation table,
// "States" valuation states). Only published cells are ever shown. In this plan the valuation
// pipeline is deferred (verification items 1/2), so the usual state is "not enabled"; an active run
// with nothing published in the window says so; published cells render as source buttons, the
// percentile column stays "not enabled" until §6.5 lands.
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';

import {SourceButton} from './SourceDrawer';

export function ValuationSnapshot({scheme,nodes,block,preview,title}:{scheme:Scheme;nodes:NodeView[];block:ValuationBlock;preview:boolean;title:'title'|'titleDetail'}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.valuation');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  return (
    <section aria-label={t(title)} className="card-base" data-valuation-state={block.state}>
```
