```tsx
          <tbody>
            {nodes.map(n=>{
              const pe=block.cells.find(c=>c.code===n.code&&c.metric==='pe_ttm'),pb=block.cells.find(c=>c.code===n.code&&c.metric==='pb');
              if(!pe&&!pb)return null;
              const name=nodeName(n,locale);
              const cellBtn=(c:typeof pe)=>c?<SourceButton payload={{kind:'valuation',scheme,code:n.code,nodeName:name,runId:block.runId,cell:c,preview}} label={`${name} ${c.metric} ${c.tradeDate}`}>{formatValuation(c.metric,c.value,locale)}</SourceButton>:<span className="font-mono text-text-dim">{t('unpublished')}</span>;
              return (
                <tr key={n.code} className="border-t border-border">
                  <td className="py-1.5">{name}</td>
                  <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{cellBtn(pe)}</td>
                  <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{cellBtn(pb)}</td>
                  <td className="hidden py-1.5 sm:table-cell"><PercentileBar value={null} width="w-[96px]" /><span className="ml-2 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('percentileDeferred')}</span></td>
                  <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{(pe??pb)?.mcapCoverage??'—'}</td>
                  <td className="hidden py-1.5 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim sm:table-cell">{(pe??pb)?.tradeDate}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

`src/components/industries/client-bundle.test.ts`：

```ts
// src/components/industries/client-bundle.test.ts
// Codex plan audit round 1 #1: Next bundles the static import graph of every 'use client' module for the
// browser, so none may reach a node: builtin (node:crypto via method.ts → canonical-json.ts was the defect).
// Walks every client module of the industry UI (components + industry pages) through relative and '@/'
// imports; `import type` is skipped (erased). Task 19/20 add client modules: this test covers them too.
import {existsSync,readdirSync,readFileSync,statSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname,join,resolve} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const ROOT=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../',import.meta.url));
const SRC=join(ROOT,'src');
const ROOTS=['src/components/industries','src/app/(app)/intel/industries'].map(d=>join(ROOT,d));
const NODE=/^(node:|fs$|path$|crypto$|zlib$|child_process$|pg$)/;
function sources(d:string):string[]{
 if(!existsSync(d))return [];
 return readdirSync(d).flatMap(n=>{const p=join(d,n);return statSync(p).isDirectory()?sources(p):/\.tsx?$/.test(n)&&!/\.test\.tsx?$/.test(n)?[p]:[];});
}
function specifiers(src:string):string[]{
 const out:string[]=[];
 for(const m of src.matchAll(/^\s*(?:import|export)\s+(type\s+)?[^;]*?from\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/gm))if(!m[1])out.push(m[2]);
 for(const m of src.matchAll(/^\s*import\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/gm))out.push(m[1]);
 return out;
}
function resolveSpec(from:string,spec:string):string|null{
 const base=spec.startsWith('@/')?join(SRC,spec.slice(2)):spec.startsWith('.')?resolve(dirname(from),spec):null;
 if(base===null)return null;
 for(const ext of ['.ts','.tsx','/index.ts','/index.tsx'])if(existsSync(base+ext))return base+ext;
 return null;
}
/** Every import chain from `entry` that ends in a node builtin. */
function nodeChains(entry:string):string[]{
 const bad:string[]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();const stack:[string,string[]][]=[[entry,[entry]]];
 while(stack.length){
  const [file,path]=stack.pop()!;
  if(seen.has(file))continue;seen.add(file);
  for(const spec of specifiers(readFileSync(file,'utf8'))){
   if(NODE.test(spec)){bad.push([...path.map(p=>p.slice(ROOT.length)),spec].join(' > '));continue;}
   const next=resolveSpec(file,spec);
   if(next)stack.push([next,[...path,next]]);
  }
 }
 return bad;
}

describe('client bundle guard',()=>{
 it("no 'use client' module of the industry UI reaches a node: builtin",()=>{
  const clients=ROOTS.flatMap(sources).filter(f=>/^\s*['"]use client['"]/.test(readFileSync(f,'utf8')));
  expect(clients.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(clients.flatMap(nodeChains)).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('display.ts and method-constants.ts are browser-safe',()=>{
  expect(nodeChains(join(SRC,'lib/industry/display.ts'))).toEqual([]);
  expect(readFileSync(join(SRC,'lib/industry/method-constants.ts'),'utf8')).not.toMatch(/^\s*import\s/m);
 });
 it('the walker does see a node import (method.ts reaches node:crypto through canonical-json.ts)',()=>{
  expect(nodeChains(join(SRC,'lib/industry/method.ts')).some(c=>c.endsWith('node:crypto'))).toBe(true);
 });
});
```

```ts
  // licence revoked; the next public read fails → the re-check answers false → nothing old is shown, and the dataset is forgotten
  const revoked=deps({publicDeps:()=>readDepsOf(stubIndustryDb({public:new Set()}))});
  expect(await loadView('r',down,{...SW,now:NOW,deps:revoked})).toEqual({view:null,error:'read_failed',staleAt:null,preview:false});
  expect((await loadView('r2',down,{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()})).view).toBeNull();   // forgotten with the dataset
  // the licence check itself fails (gate unreachable) → also closed
  await loadView('g',async()=>({state:'ok'}),{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  const gateDown=deps({publicDeps:()=>readDepsOf({...stubIndustryDb({}),isDatasetPublic:async()=>{throw new Error('gate down');}} as ReadDb)});
  expect((await loadView('g',down,{...SW,now:NOW,deps:gateDown})).view).toBeNull();
  spy.mockRestore();
 });
 it('stale views expire after 2 hours; forgetViews(datasetKey) drops one dataset only (the licence switch calls it)',async()=>{
  const spy=vi.spyOn(console,'error').mockImplementation(()=>{});
  const down=async():Promise<{state:string}>=>{throw new Error('down');};
  await loadView('e',async()=>({state:'ok'}),{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  expect((await loadView('e',down,{...SW,now:new Date(NOW.getTime()+2*3_600_000+1),deps:deps()})).view).toBeNull();
  await loadView('s',async()=>({state:'ok',v:'sw'}),{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  await loadView('c',async()=>({state:'ok',v:'sic'}),{scheme:'sic',now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  forgetViews('scheme:sw2021:2021');
  expect((await loadView('s',down,{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()})).view).toBeNull();
  expect((await loadView('c',down,{scheme:'sic',now:NOW,deps:deps()})).view).toEqual({state:'ok',v:'sic'});
  spy.mockRestore();
 });
 it('an unlicensed answer forgets the last good view (a revoked licence stops serving old numbers)',async()=>{
  const spy=vi.spyOn(console,'error').mockImplementation(()=>{});
  await loadView('b',async()=>({state:'ok'}),{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  await loadView('b',async()=>({state:'unlicensed'}),{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()});
  expect((await loadView('b',async()=>{throw new Error('down');},{...SW,now:NOW,deps:deps()})).view).toBeNull();
  spy.mockRestore();
 });
```

`src/lib/industry/stale-views.ts`（无依赖，admin 授权路由也 import 它）：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/stale-views.ts
// The pages' "last good response" memory (spec §11), keyed by query and tagged with the licence dataset
// key it was read under. Per instance, bounded (200), expiring (2 h). page-data.ts serves an entry only
// after re-confirming the dataset is public; the admin licence switch calls forgetViews(key) so a revoke
// drops every remembered view of that dataset at once (Codex plan audit round 1 #2).
import type {DatasetKey} from './types';

export const STALE_MAX_MS=2*3_600_000;
const MAX_REMEMBERED=200;
const views=new Map<string,{view:unknown;at:string;datasetKey:DatasetKey}>();

export function rememberView(key:string,view:unknown,datasetKey:DatasetKey,now:Date):void{
 views.delete(key);views.set(key,{view,at:now.toISOString(),datasetKey});
 if(views.size>MAX_REMEMBERED){const oldest=views.keys().next().value;if(oldest!==undefined)views.delete(oldest);}
}
/** The remembered entry when it exists and has not expired (an expired entry is dropped). */
export function rememberedView(key:string,now:Date):{view:unknown;at:string;datasetKey:DatasetKey}|null{
 const v=views.get(key);
 if(!v)return null;
 if(now.getTime()-Date.parse(v.at)>STALE_MAX_MS){views.delete(key);return null;}
 return v;
}
export const forgetView=(key:string)=>{views.delete(key);};
/** Drops every remembered view of one dataset (licence change), or everything. */
export function forgetViews(datasetKey?:DatasetKey):void{
 if(datasetKey===undefined){views.clear();return;}
 for(const [k,v] of views)if(v.datasetKey===datasetKey)views.delete(k);
}
```

`src/lib/industry/page-data.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/page-data.ts
// Server-side loading of the industry pages (spec §8.1, §11 "page: show the last good response +
// error badge; never 0 for missing"). Pages read the read models directly (no HTTP hop). A view that
// answers 'unlicensed' is rebuilt over the service role only for an admin viewer (internal preview,
// flagged on the page). The last good public view per query is kept in stale-views.ts (per instance,
// bounded, 2 h expiry) and shown with an error notice when a later read fails — but ONLY after the
// dataset's licence is re-checked as public right now; a failed or negative check fails closed and
// forgets the whole dataset (spec §4.8: a revoked licence never keeps serving old numbers).
import {requireAdminUser} from '../admin/auth';
import {schemeDatasetKey} from './licenses';
import {adminReadDeps,publicReadDeps} from './public-deps';
import {AGG_METRICS,METRIC_DURATIONS,SCHEME_VERSION,utcDate} from './read';
import type {ConstituentsQuery,DetailQuery,ListQuery,ReadDeps,Window} from './read';
import {CODE_RE,MAX_PAGE_SIZE,MAX_PERIODS} from './route-params';
import {forgetView,forgetViews,rememberView,rememberedView} from './stale-views';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric,Scheme} from './types';

export interface PageLoad<T>{view:T|null;error:'read_failed'|null;staleAt:string|null;preview:boolean}
export interface PageDeps{publicDeps:(now:Date)=>ReadDeps;adminDeps:(now:Date)=>ReadDeps;isAdmin:()=>Promise<boolean>}

export async function isAdminViewer():Promise<boolean>{try{await requireAdminUser();return true;}catch{return false;}}
const DEFAULT_DEPS:PageDeps={publicDeps:publicReadDeps,adminDeps:adminReadDeps,isAdmin:isAdminViewer};

export async function loadView<T extends {state:string}>(key:string,build:(deps:ReadDeps)=>Promise<T>,opts:{scheme:Scheme;now?:Date;deps?:PageDeps}):Promise<PageLoad<T>>{
 const now=opts.now??new Date();const d=opts.deps??DEFAULT_DEPS;
 const datasetKey=schemeDatasetKey(opts.scheme,SCHEME_VERSION[opts.scheme]);
 const closed:PageLoad<T>={view:null,error:'read_failed',staleAt:null,preview:false};
 try{
  const view=await build(d.publicDeps(now));
  if(view.state==='unlicensed'){
   forgetViews(datasetKey);
   if(await d.isAdmin())return {view:await build(d.adminDeps(now)),error:null,staleAt:null,preview:true};
   return {view,error:null,staleAt:null,preview:false};
  }
  rememberView(key,view,datasetKey,now);
  return {view,error:null,staleAt:null,preview:false};
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[industries page]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  const last=rememberedView(key,now);
  if(!last)return closed;
  if(last.datasetKey!==datasetKey){forgetView(key);return closed;}
  let stillPublic=false;
  try{stillPublic=await d.publicDeps(now).db.isDatasetPublic(datasetKey);}catch{stillPublic=false;}   // fail closed
  if(!stillPublic){forgetViews(datasetKey);return closed;}
  return {view:last.view as T,error:'read_failed',staleAt:last.at,preview:false};
 }
}

// ---------- tolerant search-param parsing (pages fall back to defaults instead of answering 400) ----------
type SP=Record<string,string|undefined>;
const one=<T extends string>(v:string|undefined,allowed:readonly T[],fallback:T):T=>v!==undefined&&(allowed as readonly string[]).includes(v)?v as T:fallback;
const intIn=(v:string|undefined,lo:number,hi:number,fallback:number)=>v!==undefined&&/^\d{1,5}$/.test(v)&&Number(v)>=lo&&Number(v)<=hi?Number(v):fallback;
const isDate=(v:string|undefined):v is string=>v!==undefined&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)&&!Number.isNaN(Date.parse(`${v}T00:00:00Z`))&&new Date(`${v}T00:00:00Z`).toISOString().slice(0,10)===v;

export function schemeFromSearch(sp:SP):Scheme{return one(sp.scheme,['sw2021','sic'] as const,'sw2021');}
/** Dynamic route segments → scheme / code, or null (the page answers notFound()). */
export const schemeOfPath=(raw:string):Scheme|null=>raw==='sw2021'||raw==='sic'?raw:null;
export function codeOfPath(raw:string):string|null{
 let s:string;
 try{s=decodeURIComponent(raw);}catch{return null;}
 return CODE_RE.test(s)?s:null;
}
export function listQueryFromSearch(sp:SP):ListQuery&{view:'heatmap'|'table'}{
 const scheme=schemeFromSearch(sp);
 const metric=one<AggMetric>(sp.metric,AGG_METRICS,'gross_margin');
 const duration=one<AggDuration>(sp.duration,METRIC_DURATIONS[metric],METRIC_DURATIONS[metric][0]);
 return {scheme,version:SCHEME_VERSION[scheme],level:scheme==='sic'?1:intIn(sp.level,1,3,1),metric,duration,periods:intIn(sp.periods,1,MAX_PERIODS,10),view:sp.view==='table'?'table':'heatmap'};
}
export function detailQueryFromSearch(scheme:Scheme,code:string,sp:SP):DetailQuery&{metric:AggMetric;duration:AggDuration;tableOnly:boolean}{
 const metric=one<AggMetric>(sp.metric,AGG_METRICS,'gross_margin');
 const duration=one<AggDuration>(sp.duration,METRIC_DURATIONS[metric],METRIC_DURATIONS[metric][0]);
 return {scheme,version:SCHEME_VERSION[scheme],code,metrics:[metric],durations:[duration],window:one<Window>(sp.window,['5y','10y','all'],'10y'),metric,duration,tableOnly:sp.view==='table'};
}
export function constituentsQueryFromSearch(scheme:Scheme,code:string,sp:SP,now:Date):ConstituentsQuery{
 const today=utcDate(now);
 return {scheme,version:SCHEME_VERSION[scheme],code,on:isDate(sp.on)&&sp.on<=today?sp.on:today,page:intIn(sp.page,1,10_000,1),pageSize:intIn(sp.pageSize,1,MAX_PAGE_SIZE,100)};
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/industries/ListTable.tsx
// Table view of the list (spec §8.2; canvas "List-Table", "M-List"): the same cells as the heatmap,
// latest period per industry — members (unresolved), latest period end, value, coverage, the stored
// YoY companion for sums ('—' otherwise: no page-side arithmetic), a source button. Below 640px
// code, period and source columns collapse; values stay buttons.
import Link from 'next/link';
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {formatMetricValue} from '@/lib/industry/display';
import type {NodeView,PublicCell,RunHeader} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import type {AggMetric,Scheme} from '@/lib/industry/types';
import {CoverageCell} from './CoverageCell';
import {SourceButton} from './SourceDrawer';
import {industryPath,nodeName} from './hrefs';

export function ListTable({scheme,nodes,periodEnds,cells,companion,metric,header,preview}:{scheme:Scheme;nodes:NodeView[];periodEnds:string[];cells:PublicCell[];companion:PublicCell[];metric:AggMetric;header:RunHeader;preview:boolean}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const latest=periodEnds[periodEnds.length-1];
  const at=(list:PublicCell[],code:string)=>list.find(c=>c.code===code&&c.periodEnd===latest)??null;
  return (
    <section aria-label={t('table.label')} className="card-base" style={{padding:'4px 0'}}>
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="text-left text-xs text-text-dim">
            <th className="py-2 pl-3 font-normal sm:pl-4">{t('table.industry')}</th>
            <th className="hidden py-2 font-normal sm:table-cell">{t('table.code')}</th>
            <th className="hidden py-2 text-right font-normal sm:table-cell">{t('table.members')}</th>
            <th className="hidden py-2 font-normal sm:table-cell">{t('table.latestPeriod')}</th>
            <th className="py-2 text-right font-normal">{t('table.value')}</th>
            <th className="py-2 text-right font-normal">{t('table.coverage')}</th>
            <th className="py-2 text-right font-normal">{t('table.yoy')}</th>
            <th className="hidden py-2 pr-4 font-normal sm:table-cell">{t('table.source')}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {nodes.map(n=>{
            const c=at(cells,n.code),y=at(companion,n.code);const name=nodeName(n,locale);
            const payload=c?{kind:'aggregate' as const,scheme,code:n.code,nodeName:name,cell:c,header,preview}:null;
            return (
              <tr key={n.code} className="border-t border-border">
                <td className="py-1.5 pl-3 sm:pl-4"><Link href={industryPath(scheme,n.code)} className="text-text hover:text-accent">{name}</Link></td>
                <td className="hidden py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-text-dim sm:table-cell">{n.code}</td>
                <td className="hidden py-1.5 text-right font-mono tabular-nums sm:table-cell">{c?<>{c.nMembers} <span className="text-text-dim">({c.nUnresolved})</span></>:'—'}</td>
                <td className="hidden py-1.5 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim sm:table-cell">{latest??'—'}</td>
                <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{payload?<SourceButton payload={payload} label={`${name} ${latest}`}><CoverageCell cell={c} metric={metric} /></SourceButton>:<CoverageCell cell={null} metric={metric} />}</td>
                <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{c?`${c.nWithData}/${c.nMembers+c.nUnresolved}`:'—'}</td>
                <td className="py-1.5 text-right">
                  {y&&y.status==='ok'&&y.value!==null
                    ?<SourceButton payload={{kind:'aggregate',scheme,code:n.code,nodeName:name,cell:y,header,preview}} label={`${name} ${t(`metrics.${y.metric}`)}`} className="text-xs text-text-dim">{formatMetricValue(y.metric,y.value,locale)}</SourceButton>
                    :<span className="font-mono text-xs text-text-dim" title={t('table.yoyNotStored')}>—</span>}
                </td>
                <td className="hidden py-1.5 pr-4 sm:table-cell">{payload&&<SourceButton payload={payload} label={`${t('table.sourceButton')} ${name}`} className="font-sans text-xs text-text-dim">{t('table.sourceButton')}</SourceButton>}</td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('table.note')}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`src/components/industries/IndustryEntryCard.tsx`：

```tsx
'use client';
// src/components/industries/IndustryEntryCard.tsx
// "/intel" research-tab entry card (spec §8.1; canvas "Entry"): title, scope line, and — when the
// public list answers — facts-as-of and freshness. A 403 says the SW licence is pending; any other
// failure just omits the status line (the card stays a plain link).
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import type {FreshnessStatus} from '@/lib/dq/freshness';
import {FreshnessChip} from './FreshnessChip';
import {INDUSTRIES_PATH} from './hrefs';

type Status={kind:'ok';factsAsOf:string|null;freshness:FreshnessStatus}|{kind:'unlicensed'}|{kind:'none'};

export function IndustryEntryCard(){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.entry');
  const [status,setStatus]=useState<Status>({kind:'none'});
  useEffect(()=>{
    const ctrl=new AbortController();
    fetch('/api/industries?scheme=sw2021&metric=member_count&periods=1',{signal:ctrl.signal})
      .then(async r=>{
        if(r.status===403){setStatus({kind:'unlicensed'});return;}
        if(!r.ok)return;
        const b=await r.json() as {factsAsOf?:string|null;freshness?:FreshnessStatus};
        if(b.freshness)setStatus({kind:'ok',factsAsOf:b.factsAsOf??null,freshness:b.freshness});
      })
      .catch(()=>{});
    return ()=>ctrl.abort();
  },[]);
  return (
    <Link href={INDUSTRIES_PATH} data-entry="industries" className="card-base flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-text hover:border-[var(--border-active)] hover:no-underline" style={{marginBottom:0}}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('title')}</span><span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('titleEn')}</span><span aria-hidden="true" className="ml-auto text-accent">→</span></div>
      <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('desc')}</span>
      {status.kind==='ok'&&<span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-dim">{status.factsAsOf&&<span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{t('factsAsOf',{date:status.factsAsOf})}</span>}<FreshnessChip status={status.freshness} /></span>}
      {status.kind==='unlicensed'&&<span className="text-xs text-warn">{t('unlicensed')}</span>}
    </Link>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/intel/industries/page.tsx
// Industry list (spec §8.2; canvas "Main", "List-Table", "States", "M-List"). Server component:
// selectors are search params (scheme, level, metric, duration, view), data comes from the read model
// over the anon client (RLS licence gate) or, for an admin on an unlicensed scheme, the flagged
// internal preview. States: error (with the last good view when there is one), unlicensed, empty,
// stale, reconstruction, SIC navigation. Every number is a source-drawer button; the heatmap has a
// table view. Valuations render "not enabled" until the deferred I-3 pipeline publishes.
import Link from 'next/link';
import {getLocale,getTranslations} from 'next-intl/server';
import {Heatmap} from '@/components/industries/Heatmap';
import {ListTable} from '@/components/industries/ListTable';
import {RunHeaderBar} from '@/components/industries/RunHeaderBar';
import {LinkMenu,LinkSegment,SchemeLevelSwitch} from '@/components/industries/SchemeLevelSwitch';
import {SourceDrawerProvider} from '@/components/industries/SourceDrawer';
import {SourcesFooter} from '@/components/industries/SourcesFooter';
import {StateNotice} from '@/components/industries/StateNotice';
import {ValuationSnapshot} from '@/components/industries/ValuationSnapshot';
import {INDUSTRIES_PATH,constituentsPath,flatSearch,hrefWith,industryPath,nodeName} from '@/components/industries/hrefs';
import {listQueryFromSearch,loadView} from '@/lib/industry/page-data';
import {AGG_METRICS,METRIC_DURATIONS,SOURCES,industryListView} from '@/lib/industry/read';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export default async function IndustriesPage({searchParams}:{searchParams:Promise<Record<string,string|string[]|undefined>>}){
  const search=flatSearch(await searchParams);
  const q=listQueryFromSearch(search);
  const {view:mode,...query}=q;
  const load=await loadView(`list:${JSON.stringify(query)}`,deps=>industryListView(deps,query),{scheme:query.scheme});
  const t=await getTranslations('industries');
  const locale=(await getLocale())==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const v=load.view;
  return (
    <SourceDrawerProvider>
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1400px] flex-col gap-5" data-page="industries-list">
        <div className="text-xs text-text-dim"><Link href="/intel">{t('page.breadcrumbResearch')}</Link> / {t('page.breadcrumbIndustries')}</div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <h1 className="text-[clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem)] font-semibold tracking-tight">{t('page.title')}</h1>
            <p className="m-0 max-w-[65ch] text-xs text-text-dim">{t('page.subtitle')}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="ml-auto"><SchemeLevelSwitch path={INDUSTRIES_PATH} search={search} scheme={q.scheme} level={q.level} /></div>
        </div>
        {load.error&&(
          <StateNotice kind="error" body={load.staleAt?t('states.error.body',{at:load.staleAt.replace('T',' ').slice(0,16)}):t('states.error.bodyNoCache')}>
            <Link href={hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{})}>{t('states.error.retry')}</Link>
          </StateNotice>
        )}
        {load.preview&&v&&v.state!=='unlicensed'&&<StateNotice kind="adminPreview" values={{dataset:v.datasetKey}} />}
        {v?.state==='unlicensed'&&(
          <StateNotice kind="unlicensed" values={{scheme:t(`schemes.${q.scheme}`)}}>
            <Link href={hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,{},{scheme:'sic'})}>{t('states.unlicensed.switchToSic')}</Link>
            <a href="#industry-sources">{t('states.unlicensed.learnMore')} →</a>
          </StateNotice>
        )}
        {v?.state==='empty'&&(<><RunHeaderBar header={null} freshness={v.freshness} /><StateNotice kind="empty" /></>)}
        {v?.state==='ok'&&v.kind==='navigation'&&(
          <section className="card-base" aria-label={t('schemes.sic')}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><StateNotice kind="currentOnly" /></div>
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead><tr className="text-left text-xs text-text-dim"><th className="py-1.5 font-normal">SIC</th><th className="py-1.5 font-normal">{t('table.industry')}</th><th className="py-1.5 text-right font-normal">{t('detail.members')}</th><th className="py-1.5 font-normal" /></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {v.nodes.map(n=>(
                  <tr key={n.code} className="border-t border-border">
                    <td className="py-1.5 font-mono tabular-nums">{n.code}</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5"><Link href={industryPath('sic',n.code)} className="text-text hover:text-accent">{nodeName(n,locale)}</Link></td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">{n.members===null?'—':n.members}</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-right"><Link href={constituentsPath('sic',n.code)} className="text-xs">{t('detail.viewConstituents')} →</Link></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </section>
        )}
        {v?.state==='ok'&&v.kind==='aggregate'&&(
          <>
            <RunHeaderBar header={v.header} freshness={v.freshness} extra={t('header.grid',{codes:v.nodes.length,periods:v.periodEnds.length})} />
            {v.freshness==='stale'&&<StateNotice kind="stale" values={{date:v.header.factsAsOf}} />}
            {v.header.historyClass==='reconstruction'&&<StateNotice kind="reconstruction" />}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <LinkMenu label={t('controls.metric')} current={q.metric} options={AGG_METRICS.map(m=>({value:m,label:t(`metrics.${m}`),href:hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{metric:m,duration:undefined})}))} />
              <LinkMenu label={t('controls.basis')} current={q.duration} options={METRIC_DURATIONS[q.metric].map(d=>({value:d,label:t(`durations.${d}`),href:hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{duration:d})}))} />
              <LinkSegment label={t('controls.view')} current={mode} options={[
                {value:'heatmap',label:t('controls.heatmap'),href:hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{view:undefined})},
                {value:'table',label:t('controls.table'),href:hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{view:'table'})},
              ]} />
            </div>
            {mode==='heatmap'
              ?<Heatmap scheme={q.scheme} nodes={v.nodes} periodEnds={v.periodEnds} cells={v.cells} metric={v.metric} header={v.header} preview={v.preview} tableHref={hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,search,{view:'table'})} />
              :<ListTable scheme={q.scheme} nodes={v.nodes} periodEnds={v.periodEnds} cells={v.cells} companion={v.companion} metric={v.metric} header={v.header} preview={v.preview} />}
            <ValuationSnapshot scheme={q.scheme} nodes={v.nodes} block={v.valuation} preview={v.preview} title="title" />
            <section className="card-base" aria-label={t('judgments.title')}>
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('judgments.title')}</h2><span className="rounded-[4px] border border-border px-1.5 text-xs text-text-dim">F4</span></div>
              <StateNotice kind="noJudgment" />
            </section>
          </>
        )}
        <div id="industry-sources"><SourcesFooter sources={SOURCES[q.scheme]} /></div>
      </div>
    </SourceDrawerProvider>
  );
}
```

- 判断区只渲染 F4 `JudgmentCard`（规格 §7.2）；只有服务端环境变量 `INDUSTRY_JUDGMENTS_ENABLED==='1'` 时才把 `enabled` 传给客户端组件并请求 `GET /api/judgments?subject_type=industry&subject_key=sw2021:2021:<code>`；缺省关 → "未设判断"、不发请求。owner 决策 D 默认：未校准只显示类别标签 + 徽标 + 可证伪条件，不显示百分比/分数/带状/颜色等级（`probability × calibrated` 才显示百分比，F4 §9.3）。F4 落地后用 `import type … from '@/lib/judgments/contract'` 替换 `judgment-contract.ts` 里的类型。
- 输入适配器：`natural_key = 'industry_metrics:<run_id>:<code>:<period_end>'`；快照 = 该 (run, code, period_end) 的全部 `ok` 行，列 = 表列（`MetricCellRow` 的 15 列），按 (metric, period_start, duration) 排序；`hash = digest(snapshot)`（F4 复用的 `src/lib/research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js::digest`，RFC 8785 + sha256）；`available_at = updated_at 的 UTC 日终`（F4 §3.7 原文规则，不用 `facts_as_of`/`period_end`/`created_at`）；`origin = {publisher:'OsbornAlpha', adapter: run.method_version（已是 'industry-agg/1.0'）, locator:'manifest:<hash>', transform: config_hash（重建期附 ';history_class=reconstruction'）, license: 数据集键}`；经 **anon** `IndustryDb` 读，读不到（run 不可见、未授权、building、无 ok 行）→ `input_not_public`。`industry_valuations` 的键可解析，构造返回 `unsupported_deferred_i3`（估值流水线未实施）。本计划不写 `src/lib/judgments/**`；由 F4 的 `inputs.ts` 注册 `industryTableRowsInput`。
- 详情页与成分页对未知方案/非法代码/未知行业一律 `notFound()`。

```ts
  await err(industryTableRowsInput(db,{table:'industry_valuations',natural_key:nk}),'invalid_natural_key');

 it('endOfUtcDay keeps the UTC day of a late-evening activation (the cross-midnight rule)',()=>{

 });
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现两个模块**

`src/lib/industry/judgment-contract.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/judgment-contract.ts
// Local copy of the F4 display contract (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-judgment-framework-design.md
// §3.1 Subject, §9.1 lifecycle/calibration, §9.2 JudgmentCard, §10 GET /api/judgments) until F4 lands
// and exports it; then replace these declarations with `import type … from '@/lib/judgments/contract'`.
// The industry page renders judgments only through this card (spec §7.2) and only when
// INDUSTRY_JUDGMENTS_ENABLED=1 (server flag; default off → "no judgment", no request). Owner decision
// D default: an uncalibrated card shows its category label, a badge and the falsifiable condition —
// never a percent, a score, a band or a colour grade.
export type Subject=
 |{type:'issuer';key:string}|{type:'industry';key:string}|{type:'macro_region';key:'US'|'CN'}
 |{type:'macro_series';key:string}|{type:'security';key:string}|{type:'document';key:string};
export type Kind='probability'|'categorical'|'score'|'interval';
export type Lifecycle='abstained'|'open'|'settled'|'void'|'withdrawn'|'pending_fill';
export type CalibrationState='insufficient'|'failed'|'calibrated'|'evaluated'|'self_assessed';
export interface Localized{zh:string;en:string}
export interface JudgmentCard{
 judgment_id:string;subject:Subject;judgment_type:string;kind:Kind;
 lifecycle:Lifecycle;calibration:CalibrationState;retrospective:boolean;
 as_of:string;registered_at:string;
 methodology:{id:string;version:string;title:Localized;href:string};
 display:{
  headline:Localized;
  percent:number|null;
  value:number|string|[number,number]|null;
  scale?:{min:number;max:number};dims?:{id:string;label:string;value:number|null;coverage:boolean}[];
  band?:'low'|'mid'|'high';
  nominal_coverage?:number;
 };
 condition:{text:Localized;horizon:unknown;target:unknown;label_policy:string;settle_after:string;settle_by:string}|null;
 settlement:{kind:string;outcome:string;realized:unknown;settled_at:string;evidence_summary:unknown}|null;
 calibration_summary:{n_independent:number;n_total:number;threshold_n:number;brier:number|null;brier_skill:number|null;ece_raw_holdout:number|null;valid_until:string|null;hit_rate:{rate:number;low:number;high:number}|null;href:string}|null;
 inputs:{kind:string;ref:unknown;available_at:string;origin:unknown;href:string|null}[];
 abstain_reason?:string;missing?:string[];
}
export interface JudgmentsResponse{subject:Subject;asOf:string;view:string;cards:JudgmentCard[]}

/** F4 §3.1 industry subject key: `${scheme}:${version}:${code}`. */
export const industrySubjectKey=(scheme:string,version:string,code:string)=>`${scheme}:${version}:${code}`;
export const judgmentsEnabled=(env:Record<string,string|undefined>=process.env)=>env.INDUSTRY_JUDGMENTS_ENABLED==='1';
export const judgmentsUrl=(subjectKey:string)=>`/api/judgments?subject_type=industry&subject_key=${encodeURIComponent(subjectKey)}`;

export type JudgmentsState={state:'disabled'}|{state:'ok';cards:JudgmentCard[]}|{state:'error';code:string};
/** Client fetch of the F4 cards; never called while the flag is off. */
export async function fetchIndustryJudgments(subjectKey:string,opts:{enabled:boolean;fetch?:typeof fetch;signal?:AbortSignal}):Promise<JudgmentsState>{
 if(!opts.enabled)return {state:'disabled'};
 try{
  const r=await (opts.fetch??fetch)(judgmentsUrl(subjectKey),{signal:opts.signal});
  if(!r.ok)return {state:'error',code:`http_${r.status}`};
  const body=await r.json() as Partial<JudgmentsResponse>;
  return Array.isArray(body.cards)?{state:'ok',cards:body.cards}:{state:'error',code:'malformed'};
 }catch(e){
  return {state:'error',code:(e as {name?:string}).name==='AbortError'?'aborted':'network'};
 }
}

export interface CardView{
 title:string;headline:string;
 badge:{kind:'uncalibrated';n:number;threshold:number}|{kind:'calibrated'}|{kind:'evaluated'}|{kind:'self_assessed'};
 /** only probability × calibrated (F4 §9.3); null everywhere else */
 percent:number|null;
 condition:string|null;abstainReason:string|null;lifecycle:Lifecycle;retrospective:boolean;
 footer:{method:string;asOf:string;settleBy:string|null};
}
/** F4 §9.3 rendering rules with owner decision D: uncalibrated → label + badge + condition only. */
export function judgmentCardView(card:JudgmentCard,locale:'zh'|'en'):CardView{
 const calibrated=card.calibration==='calibrated';
 const s=card.calibration_summary;
 const badge:CardView['badge']=calibrated?{kind:'calibrated'}:card.calibration==='evaluated'?{kind:'evaluated'}:card.calibration==='self_assessed'?{kind:'self_assessed'}:{kind:'uncalibrated',n:s?.n_independent??0,threshold:s?.threshold_n??0};
 return {
  title:card.methodology.title[locale],headline:card.display.headline[locale],badge,
  percent:card.kind==='probability'&&calibrated&&card.display.percent!==null?card.display.percent:null,
  condition:card.condition?.text[locale]??null,abstainReason:card.lifecycle==='abstained'?card.abstain_reason??null:null,
  lifecycle:card.lifecycle,retrospective:card.retrospective,
  footer:{method:`${card.methodology.id}@${card.methodology.version}`,asOf:card.as_of,settleBy:card.condition?.settle_by??null},
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/judgment-input.ts
// F4 input adapter for industry rows (spec §7.1, F4 §3.5 InputRef<'table_rows'>), delivered here and
// registered by F4's src/lib/judgments/inputs.ts (this plan writes nothing under src/lib/judgments).
// natural_key 'industry_metrics:<run_id>:<code>:<period_end>'; snapshot = every ok row of that
// (run, code, period_end) with the table's columns, ordered by (metric, period_start, duration);
// hash = digest(snapshot) (F4: RFC 8785 canonical JSON + sha256, the pa-v1 helper F4 reuses);
// available_at = end of the UTC day of the rows' updated_at (F4 §3.7 table_rows rule; = run activation,
// never facts_as_of / period_end / created_at); origin locator = the cell group's content-addressed
// manifest. Reads go through the ANON IndustryDb, so a row of an invisible run, an unlicensed dataset
// or a building/failed run is 'input_not_public' (F4 §3.5 constructor rule). The valuation table is the
// deferred I-3 pipeline: its natural keys parse but construction answers 'unsupported_deferred_i3'.
import {digest} from '../research/ingest/pa-v1/json';
import {schemeDatasetKey} from './licenses';
import type {DatasetKey,IndustryDb,MetricCellRow} from './types';

export type IndustryTable='industry_metrics'|'industry_valuations';
export interface IndustryTableRowsRef{table:IndustryTable;natural_key:string}
export interface IndustryTableRowsSnapshot{table:IndustryTable;natural_key:string;rows:MetricCellRow[]}
export interface IndustryTableRowsInput{
 kind:'table_rows';ref:IndustryTableRowsRef;snapshot:IndustryTableRowsSnapshot;hash:string;available_at:string;
 origin:{publisher:'OsbornAlpha';adapter:string;locator:string;transform:string;license:DatasetKey};
}
export class IndustryInputError extends Error{constructor(public code:'invalid_natural_key'|'input_not_public'|'unsupported_deferred_i3'){super(code);this.name='IndustryInputError';}}

const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
export const metricsNaturalKey=(runId:string,code:string,periodEnd:string)=>`industry_metrics:${runId}:${code}:${periodEnd}`;
export const valuationsNaturalKey=(runId:string,code:string,tradeDate:string)=>`industry_valuations:${runId}:${code}:${tradeDate}`;
/** 'table:run:code:date' — codes never contain ':' (CODE_RE), so splitting is unambiguous. */
export function parseIndustryNaturalKey(nk:string):{table:IndustryTable;runId:string;code:string;date:string}|null{
 const parts=nk.split(':');
 if(parts.length!==4)return null;
 const [table,runId,code,date]=parts;
 if((table!=='industry_metrics'&&table!=='industry_valuations')||!UUID.test(runId)||!/^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]{1,32}$/.test(code)||!DATE.test(date))return null;
 return {table,runId,code,date};
}
/** F4 §3.7: a table_rows input is available at the end of its rows' updated_at UTC day. */
export function endOfUtcDay(ts:string):string{
 const d=new Date(ts);
 if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))throw new IndustryInputError('input_not_public');
 return `${d.toISOString().slice(0,10)}T23:59:59.999Z`;
}
const ROW_KEYS=['run_id','code','metric','period_start','period_end','duration','status','missing_reason','value','unit','n_members','n_with_data','n_unresolved','manifest_hash','updated_at'] as const;
const project=(r:MetricCellRow):MetricCellRow=>Object.fromEntries(ROW_KEYS.map(k=>[k,r[k]])) as unknown as MetricCellRow;
const order=(a:MetricCellRow,b:MetricCellRow)=>a.metric<b.metric?-1:a.metric>b.metric?1:a.period_start<b.period_start?-1:a.period_start>b.period_start?1:a.duration<b.duration?-1:a.duration>b.duration?1:0;

/** Builds the InputRef from the anon read path; throws IndustryInputError. */
export async function industryTableRowsInput(db:Pick<IndustryDb,'metricRun'|'metricRowsOfRun'>,ref:IndustryTableRowsRef):Promise<IndustryTableRowsInput>{
 const k=parseIndustryNaturalKey(ref.natural_key);
 if(!k||k.table!==ref.table)throw new IndustryInputError('invalid_natural_key');
 if(k.table==='industry_valuations')throw new IndustryInputError('unsupported_deferred_i3');
 const run=await db.metricRun(k.runId);
 if(!run||run.status!=='active'&&run.status!=='superseded')throw new IndustryInputError('input_not_public');
 const rows=(await db.metricRowsOfRun(k.runId,{codes:[k.code],periodEnds:[k.date]})).filter(r=>r.code===k.code&&r.period_end===k.date&&r.status==='ok').sort(order);
 if(rows.length===0||rows.some(r=>r.updated_at===null))throw new IndustryInputError('input_not_public');
 const snapshot:IndustryTableRowsSnapshot={table:ref.table,natural_key:ref.natural_key,rows:rows.map(project)};
 const hashes=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.manifest_hash))];
 const latest=rows.map(r=>r.updated_at!).sort().at(-1)!;
 return {
  kind:'table_rows',ref:{table:ref.table,natural_key:ref.natural_key},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:endOfUtcDay(latest),
  origin:{publisher:'OsbornAlpha',adapter:run.method_version,locator:hashes.map(h=>`manifest:${h}`).join(','),
   transform:run.history_class==='reconstruction'?`${run.config_hash};history_class=reconstruction`:run.config_hash,license:schemeDatasetKey(run.scheme,run.version)},
 };
}
```

```tsx
'use client';
// src/components/industries/JudgmentArea.tsx
// Judgment area of the industry detail page (spec §7.2; canvas "Detail" §5, "States" judgments).
// Facts and judgments stay separate: this area renders only F4 JudgmentCards fetched from
// GET /api/judgments?subject_type=industry&subject_key=<scheme:version:code>, and only when the server
// flag INDUSTRY_JUDGMENTS_ENABLED=1 is passed down as `enabled` (default off → "no judgment", no
// request). Uncalibrated cards (owner decision D): category label + badge + falsifiable condition,
// no percent, score, band or colour grade.
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import {fetchIndustryJudgments,judgmentCardView} from '@/lib/industry/judgment-contract';
import type {JudgmentsState} from '@/lib/industry/judgment-contract';
import {StateNotice} from './StateNotice';

export function JudgmentArea({enabled,subjectKey}:{enabled:boolean;subjectKey:string|null}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.judgments');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const active=enabled&&subjectKey!==null;
  const [state,setState]=useState<JudgmentsState|{state:'loading'}>(active?{state:'loading'}:{state:'disabled'});
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(!active||subjectKey===null)return;
    const ctrl=new AbortController();
    fetchIndustryJudgments(subjectKey,{enabled:true,signal:ctrl.signal}).then(s=>{if(!ctrl.signal.aborted)setState(s);});
    return ()=>ctrl.abort();
  },[active,subjectKey]);
  return (
    <section className="card-base flex flex-col gap-3" aria-label={t('title')} data-judgments={state.state}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2><span className="rounded-[4px] border border-border px-1.5 text-xs text-text-dim">F4</span></div>
      {(state.state==='disabled'||(state.state==='ok'&&state.cards.length===0))&&<StateNotice kind="noJudgment" />}
      {state.state==='loading'&&<div role="status" aria-busy="true" className="h-24 rounded-lg bg-bg-elevated"><span className="sr-only">{t('title')}</span></div>}
      {state.state==='error'&&<p role="alert" className="text-sm text-danger">{t('loadFailed')} ({state.code})</p>}
      {state.state==='ok'&&state.cards.map(c=>{
        const v=judgmentCardView(c,locale);
        return (
          <article key={c.judgment_id} className="flex max-w-[760px] flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-bg-elevated p-4" data-calibration={c.calibration}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{v.title}</span>
              {v.retrospective&&<span className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('retrospective')}</span>}
              <span className={`ml-auto rounded-[4px] border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs ${v.badge.kind==='calibrated'?'border-accent text-accent':'border-border text-text-dim'}`}>
                {v.badge.kind==='uncalibrated'?t('uncalibrated',{n:v.badge.n,threshold:v.badge.threshold}):t(v.badge.kind)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-semibold">{v.headline}{v.percent!==null&&<span className="ml-2 font-mono text-base tabular-nums">{v.percent}%</span>}</div>
            {v.abstainReason&&<p className="text-sm text-text-dim">{t('abstained',{reason:v.abstainReason})}</p>}
            {v.condition&&<p className="text-sm text-text-dim"><span>{t('condition')}：</span>{v.condition}</p>}
            <div className="border-t border-border pt-2 text-xs text-text-dim">
              {t('method')} <a href={c.methodology.href} className="font-mono">{v.footer.method}</a> · {t('asOf')} <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{v.footer.asOf}</span> · {t(`lifecycle.${v.lifecycle}`)}
              {v.footer.settleBy&&<> · {t('settlement')} <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{v.footer.settleBy}</span></>}
            </div>
          </article>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';
// src/components/industries/IndustryRow.tsx
// "所属行业" row of the /stock/[ticker] overview (spec §7.3, §8.1; canvas "Entry"): ticker → issuer
// (GET /api/entities/resolve) → industries (GET /api/entities/[issuerId]/industries, public schemes
// only). SW path chips link to the L1 detail page with the "since" date; SIC chips carry the
// current_only badge; an A-share whose SW scheme is not public says "licence pending" instead of
// showing nothing. Unknown ticker / no data → the row is not rendered.
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {useLocale,useTranslations} from 'next-intl';
import type {IssuerIndustriesView} from '@/lib/industry/read';
import {industryPath,nodeName} from './hrefs';

type Ok=Extract<IssuerIndustriesView,{state:'ok'}>;

export function IndustryRow({ticker}:{ticker:string}){
  const t=useTranslations('industries.stock');
  const ts=useTranslations('industries.schemes');
  const locale=useLocale()==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const [data,setData]=useState<Ok|null>(null);
  useEffect(()=>{
    const ctrl=new AbortController();
    setData(null);
    (async()=>{
      const r=await fetch(`/api/entities/resolve?ticker=${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`,{signal:ctrl.signal});
      if(!r.ok)return;
      const issuer=await r.json() as {issuer_id?:string};
      if(!issuer.issuer_id)return;
      const r2=await fetch(`/api/entities/${issuer.issuer_id}/industries`,{signal:ctrl.signal});
      if(!r2.ok)return;
      setData(await r2.json() as Ok);
    })().catch(()=>{});
    return ()=>ctrl.abort();
  },[ticker]);
  if(!data)return null;
  const aShare=/\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/i.test(ticker);
  const swHidden=aShare&&data.schemes.some(s=>s.scheme==='sw2021'&&!s.public);
  if(data.industries.length===0&&!swHidden)return null;
  return (
    <div className="card-base flex flex-col gap-2" data-industry-row="">
      {data.industries.map(i=>(
        <div key={i.membershipId} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('label')}</span>
          <Link href={industryPath(i.scheme,i.path[0]?.code??'')} className="rounded-full border border-border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-text hover:border-[var(--border-active)] hover:no-underline">
            {ts(i.scheme)} · {i.scheme==='sic'?`${i.path[0]?.code??''} · `:''}{i.path.map(n=>nodeName(n,locale)).join(' › ')}
          </Link>
          {i.currentOnly
            ?<span className="rounded-[4px] border border-warn px-1.5 text-xs text-warn">{t('currentOnly')}</span>
            :<span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-text-dim">{t('since',{date:i.since})}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
      {swHidden&&<div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('label')}</span><span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('unlicensed')}</span></div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/intel/industries/[scheme]/[code]/page.tsx
// Industry detail (spec §8.3; canvas "Detail", "M-Detail", "States"): 1 title (Chinese name + code
// in both locales for SW), run header; 2 member summary (unresolved as a count) → constituents;
// 3 aggregate series: metric / basis / window / view selectors, SVG line + table equivalent (table
// only below 640px); 4 valuation (published cells only; "not enabled" in this plan); 5 judgment area
// (F4 cards behind INDUSTRY_JUDGMENTS_ENABLED); 6 methods & sources. Unknown code → notFound().
import Link from 'next/link';
import {notFound} from 'next/navigation';
import {getLocale,getTranslations} from 'next-intl/server';
import {JudgmentArea} from '@/components/industries/JudgmentArea';
import {RunHeaderBar} from '@/components/industries/RunHeaderBar';
import {LinkSegment} from '@/components/industries/SchemeLevelSwitch';
import {SeriesChart} from '@/components/industries/SeriesChart';
import {SourceDrawerProvider} from '@/components/industries/SourceDrawer';
import {SourcesFooter} from '@/components/industries/SourcesFooter';

import {AGG_METRICS,METRIC_DURATIONS,industryDetailView} from '@/lib/industry/read';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export default async function IndustryDetailPage({params,searchParams}:{params:Promise<{scheme:string;code:string}>;searchParams:Promise<Record<string,string|string[]|undefined>>}){
  const raw=await params;
  const scheme=schemeOfPath(raw.scheme),code=codeOfPath(raw.code);
  if(!scheme||!code)notFound();
  const search=flatSearch(await searchParams);
  const q=detailQueryFromSearch(scheme,code,search);
  const {metric,duration,tableOnly,...query}=q;
  const load=await loadView(`detail:${JSON.stringify(query)}`,deps=>industryDetailView(deps,query),{scheme});
  const t=await getTranslations('industries');
  const locale=(await getLocale())==='en'?'en':'zh';
  const v=load.view;
  if(v?.state==='unknown_industry')notFound();
  const path=industryPath(scheme,code);
  return (
    <SourceDrawerProvider>
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1400px] flex-col gap-5" data-page="industries-detail">
        <div className="text-xs text-text-dim"><Link href="/intel">{t('page.breadcrumbResearch')}</Link> / <Link href={hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,{},{scheme:scheme==='sw2021'?undefined:scheme})}>{t('page.breadcrumbIndustries')}</Link>{v?.state==='ok'&&<> / {t(`schemes.${scheme}`)} · {t(`levels.${v.node.level}`)} · {nodeName(v.node,locale)}</>}</div>
        {load.error&&<StateNotice kind="error" body={load.staleAt?t('states.error.body',{at:load.staleAt.replace('T',' ').slice(0,16)}):t('states.error.bodyNoCache')}><Link href={hrefWith(path,search,{})}>{t('states.error.retry')}</Link></StateNotice>}
        {v?.state==='unlicensed'&&<StateNotice kind="unlicensed" values={{scheme:t(`schemes.${scheme}`)}}><Link href={hrefWith(INDUSTRIES_PATH,{},{scheme:'sic'})}>{t('states.unlicensed.switchToSic')}</Link></StateNotice>}
        {v?.state==='ok'&&(
          <>
            {load.preview&&<StateNotice kind="adminPreview" values={{dataset:v.datasetKey}} />}
            <section className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <h1 className="text-[clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem)] font-semibold tracking-tight">{nodeName(v.node,locale)} <span className="font-mono text-xl font-medium text-text-dim">{v.node.code}</span></h1>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-dim">
                  <span className="rounded-[4px] border border-border px-2 py-0.5">{t(`schemes.${scheme}`)}</span>
                  <span className="rounded-[4px] border border-border px-2 py-0.5">{t(`levels.${v.node.level}`)}</span>
                  {scheme==='sw2021'&&locale==='en'&&<span>{t('detail.namesNote')}</span>}
                  {scheme==='sic'&&<span className="rounded-[4px] border border-warn px-2 py-0.5 text-warn">{t('stock.currentOnly')}</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>
            <RunHeaderBar header={v.header} freshness={v.freshness} />
            {v.header?.historyClass==='reconstruction'&&<StateNotice kind="reconstruction" />}
            {v.freshness==='stale'&&v.header&&<StateNotice kind="stale" values={{date:v.header.factsAsOf}} />}
            <section className="card-base flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8" aria-label={t('detail.summary')}>
              <div><div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('detail.members')}</div><div className="font-mono text-[22px] font-medium tabular-nums">{v.members.count}</div></div>
              {scheme==='sw2021'&&<div><div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('detail.unresolved')}</div><div className="font-mono text-[22px] font-medium tabular-nums">{v.members.unresolved}</div></div>}
              <div><div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('detail.lastAddition')}</div><div className="font-mono text-[22px] font-medium tabular-nums">{v.members.lastAddition??'—'}</div></div>
              {v.children.length>0&&<div><div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-text-dim">{t('detail.children')}</div><div className="font-mono text-[22px] font-medium tabular-nums">{v.children.length}</div></div>}
              <Link href={constituentsPath(scheme,code)} className="ml-auto rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm text-text hover:border-[var(--border-active)] hover:no-underline">{t('detail.viewConstituents')} →</Link>
            </section>

              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('detail.series')}</h2>

                    <LinkSegment label={t('controls.basis')} current={duration} options={METRIC_DURATIONS[metric].map(d=>({value:d,label:t(`durations.${d}`),href:hrefWith(path,search,{duration:d})}))} />

                    <LinkSegment label={t('controls.view')} current={tableOnly?'table':'chart'} options={[{value:'chart',label:t('controls.chartAndTable'),href:hrefWith(path,search,{view:undefined})},{value:'table',label:t('controls.tableOnly'),href:hrefWith(path,search,{view:'table'})}]} />
                  </div>
                  <SeriesChart scheme={scheme} node={v.node} metric={metric} header={v.header} preview={v.preview} tableOnly={tableOnly}
                    points={v.periodEnds.filter(pe=>duration!=='12M'||pe.endsWith('-12-31')).map(pe=>({periodEnd:pe,cell:v.series.find(c=>c.periodEnd===pe&&c.metric===metric&&c.duration===duration)??null}))} />
                </>

            {scheme==='sw2021'&&<ValuationSnapshot scheme={scheme} nodes={[v.node]} block={v.valuation} preview={v.preview} title="titleDetail" />}
            <JudgmentArea enabled={judgmentsEnabled()} subjectKey={scheme==='sw2021'?industrySubjectKey(scheme,'2021',code):null} />
            <details className="card-base" open>
              <summary className="cursor-pointer text-lg font-semibold">{t('detail.methods')}</summary>

                <dt className="text-text-dim">{t('drawer.method')}</dt><dd className="m-0 font-mono text-xs">{v.method.methodVersion} · {t('detail.configHash')} {v.method.configHash.slice(0,8)} · {t('detail.formulaVersion')} {v.method.formulaVersion??'—'}</dd>
                <dt className="text-text-dim">{t('detail.methodConfig')}</dt><dd className="m-0 min-w-0"><code className="block whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-xs text-text-dim">{JSON.stringify(v.method.config)}</code></dd>

                <dt className="text-text-dim">{t('detail.availabilityAssumption')}</dt><dd className="m-0">{scheme==='sw2021'?t('detail.availabilitySw'):t('detail.availabilitySic')}</dd>
                <dt className="text-text-dim">{t('detail.licence')}</dt><dd className="m-0"><span className="rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs">{v.datasetKey} · {v.preview?'internal':'public'}</span></dd>
                <dt className="text-text-dim">{t('detail.codeVersion')}</dt><dd className="m-0 font-mono text-xs">{v.method.codeVersion?.slice(0,7)??'—'}</dd>
              </dl>
            </details>
            <SourcesFooter sources={v.sources} />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </SourceDrawerProvider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/intel/industries/[scheme]/[code]/constituents/page.tsx

                          <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{fact(r.revenue)}</td>

                          <td className="hidden py-1.5 pr-4 sm:table-cell">{r.ticker&&<Link href={stockPath(r.ticker)} className="text-xs">{t('constituents.companyLink')} →</Link>}</td>

                  <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">

                    {v.page<pages?<Link href={hrefWith(path,search,{page:String(v.page+1)})} className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1">{t('controls.next')} →</Link>:<span className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1 opacity-50">{t('controls.next')}</span>}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/e2e-fixture.ts
// E2E fixture mode (spec §13.5): with INDUSTRY_E2E_FIXTURES=1 outside production, public-deps.ts
// serves these synthetic read dependencies instead of Supabase, so Playwright can drive the three
// routes, the drawer, the table view, the reconstruction badge and the unlicensed state on a dev
// server with no database. The cookie `industry_e2e=unlicensed` flips the SW licence. NODE_ENV is
// 'production' on every Vercel build, so this path can never serve a deployed page.
// Consistency (Codex plan audit round 1 #8): every displayed cell comes from a manifest COMPUTED by the
// real pipeline (computeAggregateCell → buildAggregateManifest, synthetic facts), one manifest per
// (code, period_end) group with its own members, values and counts, so the drawer's original replay
// reproduces each stored value — except E2E_TAMPERED, whose stored value is deliberately altered so the
// E2E run sees the "not reproduced" state too. Values are synthetic layout data, not facts.

 try{return (await cookies()).get(E2E_COOKIE)?.value!=='unlicensed';}catch{return true;}
}

let seq=0;

 filing_id:`e2e:${issuer}:${year}`,run_id:'e2e',concept,source_concept:concept,statement:'IS',period_start:`${year}-01-01`,period_end:`${year}-12-31`,duration:'12M',value,value_text:value,
 unit:'CNY',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:`${Number(year)+1}-03-31`,mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:'e2e',status:'ok',raw_hash:`e2e-${seq}`,created_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
 disclosure_seq:1,is_current:true,is_revision:false});

 source_membership_id:null,raw_hash:null,locator:null,resolution_method:'today'});
interface GroupSpec{code:string;financial:boolean;members:{id:string;ticker:string|null;rev?:string;cost?:string}[];unresolved:number}

function groupManifest(year:string,g:GroupSpec):AggregateManifest{
 const issuers=new Map<string,IssuerFacts>(g.members.map(m=>[m.id,{issuer_id:m.id,stateRev:1,truncated:false,
  rows:m.rev!==undefined&&m.cost!==undefined?[fact(m.id,'revenue_operating',year,m.rev),fact(m.id,'cost_of_revenue',year,m.cost)]:[],derived:[]}]));
 const result=computeAggregateCell({code:g.code,period_end:`${year}-12-31`,financial:g.financial,members:g.members.map(m=>m.id),nUnresolved:g.unresolved,issuers});
 return buildAggregateManifest({header:{scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:g.code,level:1,period_end:`${year}-12-31`,facts_as_of:RUN.facts_as_of,knowledge_date:RUN.knowledge_date,
   history_class:RUN.history_class,method_version:RUN.method_version,config_hash:RUN.config_hash,formula_version:RUN.formula_version,code_version:RUN.code_version},
  members:g.members.map(m=>memberOf(m.id,m.ticker)),

  memberStateRevs:g.members.map(m=>({issuer_id:m.id,state_rev:1})),result,filings:new Map()});

  {code:'801780.SI',financial:true,unresolved:0,members:BANKS.map(id=>({id,ticker:null}))},

for(const year of YEARS)for(const g of SPECS(year)){

 classRow({code:'801124.SI',level:2,name_zh:'食品加工',parent_code:'801120.SI'}),classRow({code:'850111.SI',level:3,name_zh:'白酒Ⅲ',parent_code:'801124.SI'}),
 classRow({scheme:'sic',version:'sec-current',code:'3674',name_zh:null,name_en:'Semiconductors & Related Devices'}),
];
const MEMBERS=[
 membershipRow(),membershipRow({membership_id:'dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddd02',level:2,code:'801124.SI'}),membershipRow({membership_id:'dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddd03',level:3,code:'850111.SI'}),
 membershipRow({membership_id:'dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddd04',issuer_id:ISSUER_B,valid_from:'2014-02-21',available_date:'2014-02-21',batch_id:BATCH}),
];

function fixtureDb(now:Date):ReadDb{
 const base=stubIndustryDb({tree:TREE,runs:[RUN],cells,memberships:MEMBERS,
  freshness:[{dataset:'industry.agg.sw2021',status:'fresh',last_ok_at:new Date(now.getTime()-86_400_000).toISOString()},{dataset:'industry.sw2021.memberships',status:'fresh',last_ok_at:new Date(now.getTime()-86_400_000).toISOString()}]});
 return {...base,isDatasetPublic:async k=>k==='scheme:sic:sec-current'||(k==='scheme:sw2021:2021'&&await swLicensed())};

export function fixtureReadDeps(now:Date,preview=false):ReadDeps{
 return {db:fixtureDb(now),unresolved:{unresolvedCount:async()=>1},issuers:async ids=>new Map(ids.flatMap(id=>CARDS.has(id)?[[id,CARDS.get(id)!] as const]:[])),

export function fixtureReplayDeps(now:Date):ReplayDeps{
 const db=fixtureDb(now);
 return {db:{...db,metricRunVisible:async r=>r===RUN.run_id&&await db.isDatasetPublic('scheme:sw2021:2021')},manifests:{get:async h=>e2eManifest(h)},
  recompute:async q=>{const hit=cells.find(c=>c.code===q.code&&c.period_end===q.periodEnd&&c.manifest_hash!==null);return e2eManifest(hit!.manifest_hash!);},now};
```

`src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts` 的最终全文（相对 Task 15 只多了 import 一行与四个工厂第一行的 `if(fixtureMode())…`）：

`src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts
// Production wiring of the industry read models (spec §8, §9). The anon IndustryDb (RLS licence gate)
// serves everything the public may see; the service role is used only for (a) counts of the
// non-public source records, (b) the private manifest bucket after the anon authorization chain,
// (c) the recompute path and (d) the official comparison value of a published 'within' pair. The
// classification tree of a PUBLIC dataset is cached under the 'industries' tag (spec §4.6/§4.8: the
// licence switch calls revalidateTag('industries')); reads of a non-public dataset are never cached.
// Ad-hoc reads (issuer cards, SIC member counts, pairs) use the client's from() directly: they are
// read-only, single-caller, and not part of the IndustryDb write contract.
import {unstable_cache} from 'next/cache';
import {supabaseFactsDb} from '../facts/db';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {supabaseIndustryDb} from './db';
import {schemeDatasetKey} from './licenses';
import {supabaseManifestStore} from './manifest';
import {buildCellManifest} from './run-aggregation';
// E2E fixture mode (Task 20): synthetic deps under INDUSTRY_E2E_FIXTURES=1 outside production only.
import {fixtureMode,fixtureReadDeps,fixtureReplayDeps,fixtureValuationReplayDeps} from './e2e-fixture';
import type {IssuerCard,ReadDb,ReadDeps,ReplayDeps,ValuationReplayDeps} from './read';
import type {IndustryDb} from './types';

interface PgResult<T>{data:T|null;error:{message?:string}|null}
interface Query<T> extends PromiseLike<PgResult<T>>{
 select(cols:string):Query<T>;eq(col:string,v:unknown):Query<T>;in(col:string,v:unknown[]):Query<T>;lte(col:string,v:unknown):Query<T>;
 or(filter:string):Query<T>;order(col:string):Query<T>;range(from:number,to:number):Query<T>;maybeSingle():PromiseLike<PgResult<T extends (infer U)[]?U:T>>;
}
type Loose={from<T=Record<string,unknown>[]>(table:string):Query<T>};
const loose=(sb:unknown)=>sb as Loose;

function cachedTree(db:IndustryDb):ReadDb['classificationTree']{
 return async(scheme,version)=>{
  if(!await db.isDatasetPublic(schemeDatasetKey(scheme,version)))return db.classificationTree(scheme,version);
  return unstable_cache(()=>db.classificationTree(scheme,version),['industry-tree',scheme,version],{tags:['industries'],revalidate:3600})();
 };
}
function readDb(db:IndustryDb,cacheTree:boolean):ReadDb{
 return {
  isDatasetPublic:k=>db.isDatasetPublic(k),
  classificationTree:cacheTree?cachedTree(db):(s,v)=>db.classificationTree(s,v),
  freshness:()=>db.freshness(),
  activeMetricRun:(s,v,l)=>db.activeMetricRun(s,v,l),
  metricRun:r=>db.metricRun(r),
  metricRowsOfRun:(r,f)=>db.metricRowsOfRun(r,f),
  metricRunVisible:r=>db.metricRunVisible(r),
  activeValuationRun:(s,v,l)=>db.activeValuationRun(s,v,l),
  publishedValuations:(r,f)=>db.publishedValuations(r,f),
  membershipCandidates:q=>db.membershipCandidates(q),
  membershipsOfIssuer:(i,q)=>db.membershipsOfIssuer(i,q),
 };
}

interface IssuerRec{issuer_id:string;canonical_name_zh:string|null;canonical_name_en:string|null}
interface SecurityRec{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;is_primary:boolean;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null}
/** Names and today's primary ticker (issuers / issuer_securities are anon-readable: 20261105091000_issuers.sql). */
export function issuerDirectory(sb:unknown):ReadDeps['issuers']{
 return async(ids,today)=>{
  const out=new Map<string,IssuerCard>();
  for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=100){
   const chunk=ids.slice(i,i+100);
   const [iss,secs]=await Promise.all([
    loose(sb).from<IssuerRec[]>('issuers').select('issuer_id,canonical_name_zh,canonical_name_en').in('issuer_id',chunk),
    loose(sb).from<SecurityRec[]>('issuer_securities').select('issuer_id,ticker,is_primary,valid_from,valid_to').in('issuer_id',chunk),
   ]);
   if(iss.error||secs.error)throw new Error('issuer_directory_failed');
   const current=(secs.data??[]).filter(s=>s.valid_from<=today&&(s.valid_to===null||s.valid_to>today));
   for(const r of iss.data??[]){
    const mine=current.filter(s=>s.issuer_id===r.issuer_id).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.is_primary)-Number(a.is_primary)||(a.ticker<b.ticker?-1:a.ticker>b.ticker?1:0));
    out.set(r.issuer_id,{issuerId:r.issuer_id,nameZh:r.canonical_name_zh,nameEn:r.canonical_name_en,ticker:mine[0]?.ticker??null});
   }
  }
  return out;
 };
}
/** SIC navigation counts: current ok memberships per code, paged until an empty page (PostgREST max_rows). */
export function memberCounter(sb:unknown):NonNullable<ReadDeps['memberCounts']>{
 return async(scheme,version,on)=>{
  const counts=new Map<string,number>();
  for(let from=0;;){
   const {data,error}=await loose(sb).from<{code:string}[]>('issuer_industry_memberships').select('code,membership_id').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).eq('status','ok')
    .lte('valid_from',on).or(`valid_to.is.null,valid_to.gt.${on}`).order('membership_id').range(from,from+999);
   if(error)throw new Error('member_count_failed');
   const page=data??[];
   if(page.length===0)return counts;
   for(const r of page)counts.set(r.code,(counts.get(r.code)??0)+1);
   from+=page.length;
  }
 };
}

/** Public pages and routes: anon reads; service role only for unresolved counts (lazy: no key needed until used). */
export function publicReadDeps(now:Date):ReadDeps{
 if(fixtureMode())return fixtureReadDeps(now);
 const anon=getAnonSupabase();
 return {db:readDb(supabaseIndustryDb(anon),true),unresolved:{unresolvedCount:q=>supabaseIndustryDb(getAdminSupabase()).unresolvedCount(q)},
  issuers:issuerDirectory(anon),facts:supabaseFactsDb(anon),memberCounts:memberCounter(anon),now,preview:false};
}
/** Admin internal preview only (the caller has passed requireAdminUser): service-role reads, licence gate skipped. */
export function adminReadDeps(now:Date):ReadDeps{
 if(fixtureMode())return fixtureReadDeps(now,true);
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();const db=supabaseIndustryDb(admin);
 return {db:readDb(db,false),unresolved:db,issuers:issuerDirectory(admin),facts:supabaseFactsDb(admin),memberCounts:memberCounter(admin),now,preview:true};
}
export function replayDeps(now:Date):ReplayDeps{
 if(fixtureMode())return fixtureReplayDeps(now);
 return {
  db:supabaseIndustryDb(getAnonSupabase()),
  manifests:{get:h=>{const admin=getAdminSupabase();return supabaseManifestStore(admin,supabaseIndustryDb(admin)).get(h);}},
  recompute:q=>{const admin=getAdminSupabase();return buildCellManifest({db:supabaseIndustryDb(admin),facts:supabaseFactsDb(admin),codeVersion:process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA??null},q);},
  now,
 };
}
export function valuationReplayDeps():ValuationReplayDeps{
 if(fixtureMode())return fixtureValuationReplayDeps();
 return {
  db:supabaseIndustryDb(getAnonSupabase()),
  officialValue:async q=>{
   const {data,error}=await loose(getAdminSupabase()).from<{official_value:string|null;pair_status:string}[]>('industry_valuation_pairs').select('official_value::text,pair_status')
    .eq('run_id',q.runId).eq('scheme',q.scheme).eq('version',q.version).eq('code',q.code).eq('trade_date',q.tradeDate).eq('metric',q.metric).maybeSingle();
   if(error)throw new Error('official_value_failed');
   return data&&data.pair_status==='within'&&data.official_value!==null?data.official_value:null;   // ::text keeps the numeric exact (no JS number)
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/industry/e2e-fixture.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {E2E_TAMPERED,e2eCells,fixtureReplayDeps} from './e2e-fixture';
import {replayView} from './read';
import type {AggDuration,AggMetric} from './types';

describe('E2E fixture is self-consistent (Codex round 1 #8)',()=>{
 it('every ok cell replays from its own manifest to the stored value; only the tampered cell does not',async()=>{
  const deps=fixtureReplayDeps(new Date('2026-11-05T08:00:00.000Z'));
  const ok=e2eCells().filter(c=>c.status==='ok');
  expect(new Set(ok.map(c=>c.manifest_hash)).size).toBe(9);                         // one manifest per (code, period_end) group: 3 codes × 3 years
  const results=[];
  for(const c of ok){
   const v=await replayView(deps,{scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:c.code,runId:c.run_id,metric:c.metric as AggMetric,duration:c.duration as AggDuration,periodEnd:c.period_end,mode:'original'});
   if(v.state!=='ok'||v.mode!=='original')throw new Error(`${c.code} ${c.metric} ${c.period_end}: ${v.state}`);
   results.push([`${c.code}:${c.period_end}:${c.metric}`,v.reproduced]);
  }
  const tampered=`${E2E_TAMPERED.code}:${E2E_TAMPERED.periodEnd}:${E2E_TAMPERED.metric}`;
  expect(results.filter(([,r])=>!r).map(([k])=>k)).toEqual([tampered]);
  expect(e2eCells().find(c=>c.code==='801120.SI'&&c.period_end==='2025-12-31'&&c.metric==='gross_margin')).toMatchObject({value:'0.478',n_members:2,n_with_data:2});
  expect(e2eCells().find(c=>c.code==='801780.SI'&&c.period_end==='2025-12-31'&&c.metric==='gross_margin')).toMatchObject({status:'missing',missing_reason:'financial_excluded'});
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 运行手册**

~~~~markdown
# 行业研究模块运行手册

规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-industry-research-design.md`（第 6 稿）；计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-industry-research.md`。本手册覆盖本计划实际交付的部分：迁移 `20261111090000_industry_research.sql` / `20261111091000_industry_research_functions.sql` 的全部对象、A 股发行人装载、事实范围、申万来源记录/解析、SIC、时点聚合 + 内容寻址清单 + 离线回放、证券级标记采集、读接口、页面。**估值计算/对账/发布（I-3）未实施**：表、函数、权限、触发器已落地并有数据库测试，页面估值区恒显示"估值未启用"。

## 1. 作业与调度

| job | 运行方式（当前） | 计划频率（UTC，规格 §10） | 门（`src/lib/industry/jobs.ts::jobGate`） | 新鲜度数据集 | 入口 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memberships-sic` | **cron**（`vercel.json`） | `0 2 * * 0` | 无（SEC 不需要 token） | `industry.sic.classifications`、`industry.sic.memberships`（weekly） | `/api/cron/industry-sync?job=memberships-sic` |
| `load-a-share` | 脚本 | `30 22 * * *` | `TUSHARE_TOKEN` | `issuers.a_stock`（daily） | `scripts/industry/sync.ts --job load-a-share` |
| `facts-scope` | 脚本（apply 需开关） | `45 22 * * *` | apply 需 `FACTS_CN_INDUSTRY_UNIVERSE=1`（决策 E） | — | `--job facts-scope` |
| `memberships-sw` | 脚本 | `0 2 * * 1` | `TUSHARE_TOKEN` | `industry.sw2021.classifications`、`industry.sw2021.source`、`industry.sw2021.memberships`（均 weekly；三步各自一个批次） | `--job memberships-sw [--l1 801120.SI]...` |
| `marks` | 脚本 | `0 2 * * 6` | `TUSHARE_TOKEN` | `industry.marks`（weekly） | `--job marks --apply --trade-date YYYY-MM-DD ...`（交易日必须显式给出：`trade_cal` 随 I-3 延后） |
| `aggregate` | 脚本（Mac Studio launchd） | `0 3 * * 6` | apply 需 `FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1`（V4） | `industry.agg.sw2021`（weekly） | `--job aggregate [--facts-as-of YYYY-MM-DD]` |
| `official` / `valuation` | — | — | 延期（I-3）：返回 `skipped: deferred_i3` | — | — |

- 所有脚本默认 dry-run（不写库）；`memberships-sic`、`marks`、`aggregate` 的运行函数没有 dry-run 模式，dry-run 只回 `dry_run_unsupported`（不调用运行函数），必须 `--apply`；`--apply` 写批次回执、需要 code version（`VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` 或 git 检出）。退出码：0 成功，1 失败/partial，2 参数错误或门拒绝。
- cron 路由同一套门：Tushare 作业无 token → 503 `tushare_unavailable`；`facts-scope`/`aggregate` 未开关 → 403 `job_disabled`；`official`/`valuation` → 200 `skipped`。HTTP 回执只含码与计数，不含错误消息。
- cron 与脚本不要同时跑同一 job（规格 §10）；延迟工作者由 `activate_industry_metric_run` 的 `obsolete_run` 兜底。
- 每周回放抽样：`node --env-file=<file> --import tsx scripts/industry/replay-check.ts [--run <id>] --sample 50`（默认 seed = ISO 周；只读；任一格 `value_differs`/`manifest_unreadable` → 退出 1，按 §8 处理）。

| B 首发方案 | 两者都做；授权后默认 `sw2021` | 无代码改动（列表页默认 `scheme=sw2021`，未授权时显示 SIC 入口） |

## 3. CN 启用依赖（规格 §4.10 V4）

`facts-scope` 只写调度范围，不是采集。CN 事实真正进入数据库还需要（缺一不可）：

1. 完成计划二记录的 CN 真实数据核对（规格二 §16、计划二 Task 12/13 的未核对项）；
2. `TUSHARE_TOKEN` 已在 `~/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env`（仓库外；脚本用 `node --env-file="$HOME/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env" --import tsx …`；生产 Vercel 环境变量另设；绝不打印或提交）；
3. 设置 `FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1`（`src/app/api/cron/facts-sync/route.ts`）并配置 CN 事实 worker（`vercel.json` 目前只有 US）。

在此之前：允许离线实施与夹具测试；生产聚合保持关闭（`aggregate` 不进 cron，cron 路由对它返回 403 `job_disabled`）；**不得声称 95% 就绪门可通过**。

## 4. 授权开关流程（规格 §4.8）

唯一写路径：`POST /api/admin/industries/licenses`（admin 会话；body `{dataset_key, status, note}`；同源 JSON）。它调用 `set_industry_dataset_license`，写 `research_audit_log`（action `industry.license_set`），再 `revalidateTag('industries')`。

**撤回（public → internal）必须按这个顺序**：

1. `POST … {"dataset_key":"scheme:sw2021:2021","status":"internal","note":"<原因>"}`（RLS 立即对 anon/authenticated 返回 0 行）。
2. 路由已调用 `revalidateTag('industries')`（分类树缓存失效）；确认响应 200。
3. 验证（anon key，0 行即正确）：
   `curl -s "$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/industry_classifications?select=code&scheme=eq.sw2021&limit=1" -H "apikey: $NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"` → `[]`；
   `curl -s "$SITE/api/industries?scheme=sw2021"` → 403 `unlicensed`。
4. CDN 残留 ≤ 一个 UTC 日界（成功响应的 `s-maxage` 不越过下一个 UTC 午夜；`/replay` 为 `max-age=3600`）——规格接受。页面的"上次成功响应"内存缓存在下一次读到 `unlicensed` 时清除。

公开（internal → public）只需第 1、2 步，并在 PR/实施记录写明 owner 决策 A 的依据。`official:tushare-sw_daily` 公开只影响 `/replay` 估值格的 `officialValue` 字段（官方值永不进入任何公共表或清单）。

## 6. E2E（规格 §13.5）

数据库无关的夹具模式：`INDUSTRY_E2E_FIXTURES=1` 且非生产（`NODE_ENV!=='production'`）时 `src/lib/industry/public-deps.ts` 返回 `src/lib/industry/e2e-fixture.ts` 的合成依赖；cookie `industry_e2e=unlicensed` 切换申万授权态。

```bash
# 不能带 Supabase 环境变量（(app) 布局在未配置 Supabase 时放行）；不要用 3000 以外被占用的端口
env -u NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL -u NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY -u SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY \
  INDUSTRY_E2E_FIXTURES=1 npx playwright test e2e/industries.spec.ts
```

覆盖：列表热力图（含"历史重建"徽标与缺失格 "—"）→ 抽屉（原样回放 `reproduced`）→ 表格视图；详情（序列 + 表格等价视图、估值未启用、判断区关闭）；成分（日期驱动、未解析只给计数、成分行抽屉）；未授权空态；390px 无横向滚动、抽屉为底部弹层。`.cursor/skills/verify-osbornalpha` 的 guest/gate 模式没有数据库，本模块页面在那里只能看到 `error` 态（不在本计划拥有的路径内，未改动该技能）。

## 7. 错误码速查（规格 §11）

| 场景 | 码 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 公共读接口参数错 | 400 `invalid_parameter:<name>` | 调用方修正 |
| 数据集未公开 | 403 `unlicensed` | 见 §4；admin 在页面看到"内部预览"条 |
| 未知行业 / 发行人 / run / 格 | 404 `unknown_industry` / `unknown_issuer` / `unknown_run` / `unknown_cell` | `failed` run 与未发布格只经 `/api/admin/industries/replay` |
| `/replay` 超限 | 429 `rate_limited` | 每 IP 每分钟 10 次（单实例内存计数，多实例尽力而为） |
| cron 门 | 503 `tushare_unavailable`、403 `job_disabled`、503 `code_version_unavailable` | 见 §1、§3 |
| 激活失败 | `incomplete_run` / `obsolete_run` / `dependencies_incomplete` / `dependency_regression` | `dependency_regression`：重跑即可；其余看 `/api/admin/industries/runs` 的 `coverage_summary.failure_reason` |
| 回放不一致 | 页面红框"回放不一致"；隔离 `manifest_mismatch` | `/admin/dq` 处理；`replay-check` 记录 |

## 8. 回放不一致的处理

1. `GET /api/admin/industries/replay?runId=&code=&periodEnd=` 取完整清单与逐格 `reproduced`。
2. 若清单不可读（桶对象缺失）：确认 `industry_manifests` 索引行仍在，GC 是否误删（`gc_industry_manifest_candidates` 只列未被引用的哈希）。
3. 若值不同：`replayFromManifest` 与 `computeAggregateCell` 不一致是代码缺陷——冻结该 run（不重新激活），开缺陷单，修复后以新 run 覆盖。
~~~~
